entries.title_zh: 亚临界长程 Ising 模型总磁化的正态近似
entries.summary_zh: 论文对可和相互作用的零场 Ising 模型证明总自旋经方差标准化后满足 Berry–Esseen 界，Kolmogorov 距离为 C_{β,J}|Λ|⁻¹/²，适用于任意固定亚临界 β；周期化格点模型的相应速率为 L⁻ᵈ/²。经典最近邻模型还可覆盖 −βc<β<βc 的铁磁与反铁磁区间，作者同时得到相同速率的 1-Wasserstein 界，并将结论延伸到相应无限体积自由边界 Gibbs 测度。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合概率统计物理读者了解亚临界条件下磁化涨落何时可定量近似为高斯。
entries.pragmatic_review: 显式样本量收敛速率让中心极限定理近似可定量使用。
entries.cynic_review: 速率常数依赖 β 与相互作用，临界点本身不在结论内。
entries.paper_review: 摘要陈述两种概率距离及边界条件范围，常数与证明细节需全文确认。

entries.source_title: Residual-driven lattice Boltzmann equation. Part I: framework and nonlinear solution methods
entries.source_excerpt: We developed a residual-driven framework of the lattice Boltzmann equation (LBE) to integrate general nonlinear iterative methods. The nonlinear residual is constructed directly from the complete LBE collision-streaming update, allowing general nonlinear solvers to be integrated without modifying the original LBE algorithmic structure, i.e., the kernel consisting of collision-streaming, boundary conditions, and various forcing and interaction effects. Sophisticated techniques, such as weighted fixed-point iteration, full approximation scheme (FAS) multigrid, and Jacobian-free Newton-Krylov methods are integrated into the LBE via this framework, and preconditioned LBE is further incorporated as a nonlinear smoother to demonstrate solver composability. Numerical tests validate that FAS and Newton methods do converge to the same discrete steady fixed-point obtained with the primitive LBE iteration. For the 2D lid-driven cavity flow, the FAS scheme reduces the measured solution time by a factor of approximately 44 at Re = 1000 and more than 224 at Re = 5000. Accurate results are also obtained for the steady flows past a cylinder at Re = 2

entries.source_title: Unified Sharp Bounds on Probabilities of Causation
entries.source_excerpt: Probabilities of causation (PoCs) have developed steadily, from the binary measures first introduced by Pearl to the non-binary setting recently studied by Shu et al. As the theory has matured, PoCs have found applications in a growing range of areas, including personalized medicine, marketing and legal attribution. Shu et al. proposed closed-form bounds for multi-valued treatments and outcomes and proved them valid, but left their sharpness in high dimensions open. We close this gap with a mathematical proof. We further show that $\PNS$, $\PSub$, $\PRep$ and $\PN$ are all special cases of a single, more general formula. Combined with their equivalence classes, this settles the question of sharp bounds for discrete PoCs from experimental and observational data: in every dimension, they are given in closed form by a single theorem.

entries.source_title: Gallai's path decomposition conjecture for $K_5$-minor-free graphs
entries.source_excerpt: Gallai conjectured that the edges of every connected graph on $n$ vertices can be partitioned into at most $\ceil{n/2}$ paths. We prove that every connected $K_5$-minor-free graph other than $K_3$ and $K_5-e$ admits such a partition into at most $\floor{n/2}$ paths. The two exceptions require $\ceil{n/2}$ paths. In a smallest counterexample we find a $4$-connected planar part containing four vertices of degree five. Their neighborhoods meet the boundary in at most one vertex. This allows us to apply the planar configurations of Blanch\'e, Bonamy, and Bonichon and to realize the reduced graph as a minor of the original graph.
entries.title_zh: K₅-minor-free 图的 Gallai 路径分解猜想

entries.source_title: Forcing global $\Pi^2_n$ uniformization with or without projective determinacy
entries.source_excerpt: We construct a set-forcing extension of $L$ which has the same reals as $L$ and satisfies the $\Pi^2_n$-uniformization property for every $n\geq1$. Assuming $\omega$ Woodin cardinals and a measurable cardinal above them, we also obtain a forcing extension of $L(\mathbb R)^{M_\omega}$ which has the same reals and satisfies projective determinacy together with the $\Pi^2_n$-uniformization property for every $n\geq1$.

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把强迫、一致化和射影决定性放入同一构造框架，明确展示假设强度分层。

entries.source_title: RefinedGAW: A Refined German Academic Web Dataset
entries.source_excerpt: The largest open German text datasets are built from broad web crawls, which provide scale but limited coverage of specific domains. We introduce RefinedGAW, a processed and annotated resource derived from 26 semi-annual crawls of the German Academic Web, totaling 122 million documents and 314 billion tokens, with full crawl and capture history of every text. Documents labeled as academic research account for 84% of German RefinedGAW tokens across HTML and PDF. At 87.6 billion tokens, this exceeds the 64.9 billion tokens in the German subsets of FineWeb2 and FinePDFs, despite their almost five-times-larger combined size. RefinedGAW also contains substantial amounts of educational, math-heavy, and expert-oriented content with minimal commercial bias. Across HTML and PDF, 88% of German RefinedGAW documents have no near-duplicate candidate match in the three evaluated reference datasets, supporting complementary coverage. We release a queryable metadata index for fine-grained data selection and a rehydration tool for retrieving and processing source documents.

entries.source_title: Lower bounds on ranks of universal quadratic forms through geometry-of-numbers
entries.source_excerpt: We obtain lower bounds for the ranks of universal forms over totally real cubic fields using techniques from geometry-of-numbers and the parametrisation of cubic rings by binary cubics due to Delone--Faddeev. entries.source_title: Relative distality and incidence bounds in positive characteristic
entries.source_excerpt: We prove Szemer\'edi-Trotter-type incidence bounds for algebraic relations in any field $F$ admitting a valuation with finite residue field. This includes $\mathbb F_q(t)$, $\mathbb F_q((t))$, and all finitely generated extensions of finite fields. Bays and Martin show that any algebraic $K_{d,s}$-free relation $E\subseteq F^k\times F^\ell$ admits a power-saving in the classical Zarankiewicz bound of K\H{o}v\'ari, S\'os, and Tur\'an. Answering a question of the authors, we show that this power-saving is uniform in $F$: There is some $\epsilon>0$ depending only on $d$ and the complexity of $E$ (and not on $F$) such that for $A\subseteq F^k$ and $B\subseteq F^\ell$, the number of edges $|E(A,B)|$ is at most $O(|A|^{1-\epsilon}|B|^{1-\frac{1-\epsilon}{d}}+|A|+|B|)$. For the case where $A$ is a set of points and $B$ is a set of lines in $F^2$ and $E$ is the incidence relation, we prove the explicit bound $O(|P|^{\frac{8}{9}}|L|^{\frac{5}{9}}+|P|+|L|)$. entries.source_title: The elephant random walk with proportionally growing recent memory
entries.source_excerpt: In this work, we study an elephant random walk with recent restricted memory, where at step $n$ the elephant remembers only the last $m_n=\max\{\lfloor cn\rfloor,1\}$ steps for $c\in(0,1)$. We show that the random walk undergoes a phase transition at the critical point $p_c=(3+\sqrt{1-c})/4$, which depends on the memory proportion $c$. For $0 <1$, $S_n/n^{\rho}$ converges almost surely and in $L^2$ to a random variable for some constant $\rho\in (1/2, 1)$. This phase transition differs from that of the classical elephant random walk and its remote-memory counterpart, both of which have the same fixed critical point $3/4$.
entries.title_zh: 近期记忆比例增长的大象随机游走

entries.source_title: How Generative Models Generate: A Concise Guide to the Generative AI Landscape
entries.source_excerpt: The rapidly expanding generative AI landscape brings together methods that differ in architecture, learning objective, mathematical representation and sampling procedure. A concise, selectively organised technical guide can provide an accessible starting point for developing a coherent understanding of this increasingly complex landscape. This article takes a generation-centred approach, connecting how models produce new observations with the modelling and learning principles that make generation possible. We develop a two-level perspective: first, distinguishing three recurring generation routes-direct transformation or decoding, sequential conditional construction, and iterative updating or transport; and second, examining the modelling and learning principles underlying these routes. Representative approaches are introduced through their key components, learning objectives and sampling procedures. We then examine their broader connections, including how different architectures and generation mechanisms can overlap or be combined. entries.source_title: Demodalising G\"odel's God? Ultrafilters, Rigidity and Modal Collapse Revisited
entries.source_excerpt: G\"odel's ontological argument is modal by design. Possibility and necessity are among its central concerns, and connected interpretation decisions -- extensions or intensions for the positive properties, constant or varying quantifier domains, the choice of modal logic, etc. -- subtly shape the argument and, in particular, whether the modal collapse is implied or not. It is tempting to abstract the modality away and to read the positive properties as merely forming an ultrafilter -- which, however, may replace G\"odel's argument with a perhaps more manageable alternative that may have little to do with G\"odel's original intention. In this spirit, Odifreddi and Gomes argue that modal collapse is an intrinsic structural feature of any theory that characterises positive properties as an ultrafilter and identifies God as its principal generator. entries.source_title: Classification of bipartite observables III: simplicity, mixtures and quantum error correction
entries.source_excerpt: This is the third of a series of three papers that bring model theory to quantum information. The dividing lines of Shelah's classification theory, which separate the tame first-order theories from the wild ones, become properties of bipartite observables: properties of the expectation values obtained when two independently prepared quantum systems are idealized one after the other. In this paper we focus on simple unstable theories. The Pauli group of quantum error correction, with anticommutation as its relation, has a simple unstable theory, like the random graph. Forking and the Kim--Pillay independence theorem acquire a meaning in stabilizer codes: forking recognizes logical errors, and the independence theorem glues syndromes.

entries.source_title: Low Residuals, Wrong Value: Learning the Viscosity Solution of Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs Equations with PINNs
entries.source_excerpt: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and other residual-trained solvers judge a candidate solution by the size of its sampled PDE residual. For first-order Hamilton-Jacobi equations this is not sufficient: the same equation and boundary data admit Lipschitz almost-everywhere solutions that differ from the viscosity solution by $O(1)$ while violating the equation only on sets of measure zero. We study whether residual minimization selects such solutions in a fixed-horizon pursuit-evasion game whose Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs value function is known in closed form on the circle $S^1$ and on the flat tori $\mathbb{T}^{2}$ and $\mathbb{T}^{4}$. We train four neural parameterizations with ten seeds on each geometry, 120 runs in total. A standard network with periodic Fourier features converges to folded almost-everywhere solutions in all 30 runs: small residuals and the expected capture-layer gradient, yet values that are wrong over most of the domain. entries.title_zh: 低残差却错值：PINN 学习 Hamilton–Jacobi–Isaacs 黏性解

entries.source_title: Evergreen leaves and universal lifetime laws in preferential-attachment trees
entries.source_excerpt: We study leaf lifetimes in general preferential-attachment trees. First we characterize the existence of evergreen leaves, that is, vertices that remain leaves forever. When no evergreen leaves exist, we establish, for a broad class of attachment functions, a remarkable one-parameter universality: the normalizations and limiting laws for various characteristics of leaf lifetimes depend on the attachment function only through a single numerical parameter. In particular, we obtain a shifted Pareto limit law for individual lifetimes and a joint functional limit theorem for the lifetime and label of the longest-lasting leaf. The limiting two-dimensional process, which we call the beta-decorated Fr\'echet extremal process, admits an elegant representation in terms of the Stoev--Taqqu extremal integral and the sets of optimal choices considered by Molchanov and Strokorb. We also establish a Poisson point-process limit for rescaled leaf lifetimes and corresponding labels, a finiteness criterion for long-lasting leaves, and a functional central limit theorem for their number at the critical threshold.

entries.source_title: Brauer--Manin obstruction for Weil restrictions
entries.source_excerpt: For a quasi-projective variety $X$ defined over a number field $k$, let $X'$ be its Weil restriction with respect to a finite field extension $k/k'$. We prove that the Brauer--Manin set of $X$ agrees with the Brauer--Manin set of $X'$. We also prove the agreement for Brauer--Manin set of them given by $\mathrm{Br}_1$.
entries.title_zh: Weil 限制下的 Brauer–Manin 障碍不变性
entries.summary_zh: 对数域 k 上准射影簇 X 及有限域扩张 k/k′ 的 Weil 限制 X′，作者证明 X 与 X′ 的 Brauer–Manin 集一致，Br₁ 部分也一致。结果说明此种换底与打包变量构造不会改变该类局部—整体可解性障碍。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合算术几何中的有理点局部—整体原理。
entries.pragmatic_review: Brauer–Manin 障碍用 Brauer 群配对筛除不可能来自有理点的阿代尔点。
entries.cynic_review: 主障碍集合及代数 Brauer 子群版本均有明确结论。

entries.source_title: The $m=2$ amplituhedron is a positive geometry
entries.source_excerpt: Amplituhedra are semi-algebraic sets of fundamental importance in particle physics. Their discovery initiated the field of Positive Geometry. We settle a central conjecture in this field: we show that the $m=2$ amplituhedron is a positive geometry. Our main new tool is a Hodge-theoretic criterion for being a positive geometry, connecting the work of Brown--Dupont with the original setup of Arkani-Hamed--Bai--Lam.
entries.title_zh: m=2 amplituhedron 是正几何

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 证明一个核心正几何猜想，并提供可推广的 Hodge 理论判据。
entries.pragmatic_review: 有助于散射振幅几何化及正几何研究的理论基础。
entries.cynic_review: 结论针对 m=2 情形，不能自动推广到其他 m。

entries.source_title: Regular quadratic lattices are rare over real quadratic fields
entries.source_excerpt: We show that a positive definite regular quadratic lattice of rank at least 4 over a totally real number field contains a regular sublattice that represents precisely the totally positive integers lying in an ideal. Under the generalized Riemann hypothesis and a conjecture on class numbers, it follows that, for each $m$, real quadratic fields admitting a positive definite regular lattice of some rank between 4 and $m$ have density 0. Unconditionally, only finitely many real quadratic fields of narrow class number 1 admit a positive definite regular lattice of some rank between 4 and 7.
entries.title_zh: 实二次域上的正则二次格十分稀少
entries.summary_zh: 文章研究全实数域上秩至少为 4 的正定正则二次格，证明它包含一个正则子格，其表示的恰是某个理想中的全正整数。由此，在 GRH 与一个类数猜想下，对任意固定上界 m，拥有秩 4 至 m 此类格的实二次域密度为零；无条件地，窄类数为 1 且允许秩 4 至 7 的实二次域只有有限多个。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把二次型表示问题与数域的类数、域族密度联系起来，适合数论和二次型读者关注。

entries.cynic_review: 主要稀疏性结论依赖 GRH 和类数猜想；无条件结论的秩范围较窄。

entries.source_title: Equivalence of Restricted and Full Division
entries.source_excerpt: We prove over $\mathrm{PA}^{-}$ that the restricted Euclidean division principle $\mathrm{pa17}^{-}$, which asserts division only for co-prime pairs, is equivalent to the full principle $\mathrm{pa17}$. The proof uses a transformation that preserves the quotient in division with remainder to reduce an arbitrary division problem to one for a co-prime pair. This answers Visser's Open Question 8.29 and shows that the restricted principle has the same strength as full Euclidean division over $\mathrm{PA}^{-}$.
entries.title_zh: 受限除法原理与完整除法原理等价

entries.source_title: VeriMath: Human-in-the-Loop Generation and Verification of Curriculum-Aligned Mathematics Assessment Items
entries.source_excerpt: Automatic generation of mathematics assessment items is a growing area in educational artificial intelligence, yet classroom deployment remains challenging. Generated questions must satisfy multiple constraints: mathematical correctness, curriculum alignment, appropriate cognitive difficulty, and educator reviewability. While prior work has advanced text generation, reliable assessment authoring requires granular control over localized examination formats and expert educational judgment. To address this challenge, we present VeriMath, a generalized, human-in-the-loop framework for generating rigorous, curriculum-constrained mathematics assessment drafts. Using annotated reference items, the framework anchors generation to the requested examination section and cognitive reasoning level, then applies sequential automated verification and guided repair before submitting drafts for expert review. We evaluate VeriMath through a national curriculum case study using 4,555 mathematics items from the Vietnamese Grade 12 curriculum and 50 distinct generation requirements covering multiple-choice, true/false, and short-answer formats. entries.source_title: The Segal-Bargmann Transform in Neural Partial Differential Equations
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce a novel neural operator method based on Segal-Bargmann transform and Bargmann-Fock space for learning the solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). The method brings data encoding, latent-space representation, operator learning, and decoding into an unifed framework. From only finitely many observations, we establish a sup-norm reconstruction error of order $ L^{-\frac{1}{2}} $, where L is the number of complex sampling points that are decoupled with the original samplings and observations. The reconstruction error is independent of the spatial dimension and the number of original sampling points. We show that this new mesh-free Segal-Bargmann Neural Operator approach has superior performance compared to existing NO approaches like FNO, BelNet, GNOT, etc.,\ particularly in terms of pointwise control $ \sup_{x}\lvert\hat{u}_{NO} - u_{truth}\rvert $ for solutions of PDEs $ \mathcal{L}u = f $ which provides pointwise accuracy and interpretability as classical numerical solvers. entries.title_zh: 神经偏微分方程中的 Segal–Bargmann 变换

entries.source_title: Optimal Control of RKHS Diffeomorphic Flows for Classification and Generative Modeling
entries.source_excerpt: We develop a unified optimal-control framework that solves supervised classification and likelihood-based density estimation with a single diffeomorphic flow whose velocity lives in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS); the two tasks share all structure except the objective. Variable projection eliminates the terminal model (a classifier, or a Gaussian-mixture (GMM) reference), leaving a reduced control problem whose gradient comes from an analytic discrete adjoint. The RKHS parameterization makes the flow's divergence exact and deterministic at the cost of one kernel matrix-vector product, avoiding the stochastic trace estimators and potential-flow restrictions of existing continuous normalizing flows. Because the objective and gradient are deterministic, matrix-free reduced Gauss-Newton (GN) and related second-order solvers are practical for both tasks, which we benchmark against a range of first- and second-order optimizers; the learned map is a diffeomorphism with explicitly controlled regularity. entries.title_zh: 用于分类与生成建模的 RKHS 微分同胚流最优控制
entries.summary_zh: 论文用再生核 Hilbert 空间中的速度场构造统一微分同胚流，同时处理监督分类和似然密度估计，并通过变量投影消去终端分类器或高斯混合参考分布。解析离散伴随给出确定性梯度，散度只需一次核矩阵向量乘法；在 2 到 256 维实验中，降阶 Gauss–Newton 求解器使用的迭代次数最少，联合 L-BFGS 的总工作量也较低。

entries.source_title: Tree-independence number VIII. 3PC-free graphs have logarithmic tree-independence number
entries.source_excerpt: A three-path-configuration is a graph consisting of three pairwise internally vertex-disjoint paths, the union of every two of which is an induced cycle of length at least four. A graph is 3PC-free if no induced subgraph of it is a three-path-configuration. We show that 3PC-free graphs have logarithmic tree-independence number, which is asymptotically best possible.
entries.title_zh: 树独立数 VIII：3PC-free 图的树独立数为对数阶
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明不含三路径构型（3PC-free）的图，其树独立数随图规模至多按对数增长，并证明该阶在渐近意义下最优。这里 3PC 由三条内部顶点互不相交的路径组成，任意两条路径的并都是长度至少四的诱导圈。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 为一类禁止诱导结构的图给出紧的树独立数界，可用于图分解和结构参数研究。

entries.source_title: Vector bundles on singular surfaces and threefolds
entries.source_excerpt: We fully classify vector bundles of critical rank on normal affine surfaces and threefolds over algebraically closed fields via their Chern classes. We also prove existence of rank $2$ bundles on threefolds with prescribed first and second motivic Chern classes. The main input is the motivic filtration on algebraic $K$-theory: its third piece is generated by smooth closed points and is identified with motivic cohomology by the third Chern class.
entries.title_zh: 奇异曲面与三维簇上的向量丛
entries.summary_zh: 论文通过 Chern 类完整分类代数闭域上正规仿射曲面和三维簇的临界秩向量丛，并证明三维簇上存在具有指定第一、第二 motivic Chern 类的秩二向量丛。关键工具是代数 K 理论的 motivic 过滤：其第三层由光滑闭点生成，并通过第三 Chern 类与 motivic 上同调识别。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数几何读者关注 Chern 类何时足以分类低秩向量丛，以及 K 理论过滤的构造作用。

entries.source_title: A Dubnov-Ivanov-Nagata-Higman Theorem for NIP nilrings
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that NIP nilrings of bounded nilexponent are nilpotent. We also deduce that NIP $\omega$-categorical $n$-Engel Lie algebras of characteristic $p>n$ are nilpotent, yielding a case of the Lie algebra analogous of Wilson conjecture for $\omega$-categorical groups.

entries.source_title: Non-adjacent triples of cells in a triangular grid: proofs of three conjectured generating functions
entries.source_excerpt: Let $\Tn$ be the triangular grid of side $n$, with its $n^2$ unit cells, and let two cells be side-adjacent if they share an edge and point-adjacent if they share a vertex. We count the orbits of $3$-element sets of pairwise non-adjacent cells under the rotation group $C_3$ and under the full symmetry group $D_3$ of $\Tn$. Three of the four resulting sequences are OEIS A397730, A397731 and A397732, for each of which the only formula on record is a generating function conjectured by Sean A.\ Irvine on 14 July 2026. We prove all three conjectures. The route is Burnside's lemma, together with exact lattice counts for each fixed-point term. The side-adjacency graph turns out to be bipartite, so its triangle count vanishes, and the triangles of the point-adjacency graph have a clean structural description, which gives that count too. Along the way we obtain the first explicit closed forms for the three sequences, each a quasi-polynomial of degree $6$ and period $3$, $6$, $3$ respectively. The same machinery settles the fourth member of the family, whose closed form has been recorded at A289230 without proof since 2017, and the labeled coun
entries.title_zh: 三角网格中两两不相邻三格的生成函数猜想
entries.summary_zh: 作者计数三角形网格中三格彼此既不边相邻也不点相邻的集合，在旋转群 C₃ 和全对称群 D₃ 下取轨道。文章证明三条此前仅有猜测的生成函数，并给出相应序列为次数 6、周期分别为 3、6、3 的准多项式；方法结合 Burnside 引理和固定点精确格点计数。

entries.paper_review: 需要注意不同邻接定义和群作用对应不同序列。

entries.source_title: Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models
entries.source_excerpt: During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors' behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host's existing mathematical competence.
entries.title_zh: 把人脑组织分析方法用于语言模型
entries.summary_zh: 研究者将分析人类皮层功能梯度的 diffusion map 方法用于三类语言模型家族的基础版与推理训练版，发现整体梯度大体保留，但局部连续层段出现变化。把这些层的权重移植到指令模型后，数学推理平均提升且更能保留原先已解题目，增益与层区重叠相关；结果是权重移植实验，不能据此断言模型内部等同于脑区组织。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 研究模型内部表征与推理训练机制的读者可关注跨模型权重移植结果。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可为层级消融提供线索，先在目标模型复现权重移植。
entries.cynic_review: 类比脑组织有启发，但结构对应不等于机制相同。
entries.paper_review: 跨三家族并做移植验证，细节与统计显著性需看全文。

entries.source_title: When Parameter Gradient Flows Close in Representation Space
entries.source_excerpt: The represented gradient flow of a parameterized model depends on a mobility that can retain hidden parameter information. We study when one entire represented mobility map works for every autonomous loss from one fixed initialization. For two-factor matrix representations wider than both output dimensions, with individually full-row-rank factors, we classify all admissible joint ranks: closure occurs precisely at effective scalar-balanced minimal joint rank or a two-value signed spectral family at full joint rank. All intermediate ranks are excluded; positive represented flows belong to known square-root families. For general representations with constant ambient representation and gradient-Lie ranks, ordinary closure is equivalent to a local invariant-level metric in the analytic case and specified smooth regimes. An endpoint section forces the initially unrestricted mobility map to admit a locally smooth representative on the represented image. We also separate testing families: linear losses locally admit closure at every submersion, whereas one fixed translated strongly convex quadratic family fails it on a delayed-bracket exampl
entries.title_zh: 表示空间中参数梯度流的闭合条件
entries.summary_zh: 参数化模型的梯度流映射到表示空间后，通常依赖隐藏参数状态；论文研究从一个固定初始化出发，何时能由同一表示空间 mobility 描述所有自治损失。对宽度超过两侧输出维数、且各因子满行秩的双因子矩阵表示，作者完整分类允许的联合秩：闭合只在有效标量平衡的最小联合秩或满联合秩的两值带符号谱族出现，中间秩均不允许；一般表示也给出常秩条件下的判别。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 精确刻画何时参数训练可在表示层闭合为一套统一动力学。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可帮助分析矩阵分解模型训练动力学与表示空间简化。
entries.cynic_review: 结论依赖矩阵因子秩、宽度及自治损失等结构假设。
entries.paper_review: 对可闭合秩情形作完整分类并排除中间秩。

entries.title_zh: Lauterbach TRACE32 MCP 服务器

entries.paper_review: 材料列出了工具、执行策略、参数约束和配置要求，但未提供测试结果或独立安全审计证据。

project_insight.translation_zh: t32mcp 是 Lauterbach 官方 MCP 服务器，可让 AI 代理访问 TRACE32 PowerView。它支持管理 PowerView 实例、查询目标系统状态、运行 PRACTICE 脚本和执行 PRACTICE 命令。PRACTICE 可以控制 PowerView，也可能更改目标或运行主机命令，因此项目通过执行策略限制代理可用工具；服务器与 PowerView 必须运行在同一系统，且 PowerView 必须启用 Remote API。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 把 TRACE32 PowerView 的状态查询和受策略约束的 PRACTICE 操作封装为 MCP 工具，供 AI 代理辅助嵌入式调试。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先确认已安装 TRACE32 PowerView、Remote API 可用，并阅读 README 的执行策略与网络绑定说明；从 strict 策略和经过审阅的脚本开始，在隔离目标上验证行为。README 提供预编译版本和源码构建路径，但此处未验证安装流程。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 材料未给出项目许可证。使用需要 TRACE32 PowerView、Remote API 和本机运行环境；客户可用的额外技能还要求有效维护许可及登录。PRACTICE 可更改目标或执行主机命令，远程 HTTP 模式需要妥善设置认证和来源限制；README 的说明不是独立安全审计。

entries.summary_zh: Ponytail 是一份供 AI 编码代理使用的 skill，主张先读懂代码库和问题，再依次检查现有代码、标准库与平台功能，尽量减少不必要的实现，同时保留验证、安全、无障碍和必要测试。README 自述其基准测试中代码量、耗时、成本和输出 token 均有所下降，并报告了测试覆盖及安全任务成绩；这些是项目方报告的结果。

entries.paper_review: 材料提到 39 项任务、每项 5 次运行及基准结果文档，但没有提供该文档全文、原始数据或独立复现证据，因而只能视为项目方报告。

project_insight.translation_zh: “让你的 AI 代理像团队里最懒的资深开发那样思考。最好的代码，就是你根本没写的代码。”
project_insight.one_liner_zh: Ponytail 用一份代理 skill 引导编码代理先理解代码和数据流，再优先复用现有实现、标准库或平台能力，并执行代码审查与仓库审计。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读仓库中的 skills/ponytail/SKILL.md、与目标代理相关的接入说明，以及 benchmarks/results/2026-10-07-agentic.md；确认兼容性后，在可丢弃的个人测试仓库里用一项小任务比较启用前后的输出、修改范围和测试结果。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 摘录主要是项目说明和自报基准成绩，没有给出结果文档全文或独立复现材料。README 展示 MIT 许可徽章，但输入的 license 元数据为空，使用前宜核对仓库当前许可和具体代理支持情况；所述用量面板也注明仅适用于特定版本的 Claude Code 环境。

entries.source_title: Monte Carlo Power Iteration Algorithms: Convergence, Analysis and Application to Reactor Criticality Calculations
entries.source_excerpt: We study Monte Carlo power iteration algorithms in the context of reactor criticality simulations. Under mild conditions on the underlying physical system and the algorithmic structure, we derive explicit error bounds, which are to the best of our knowledge the first rigorous results for such methods which are ubiquitous in nuclear engineering. This is done by exploiting connections to Sequential Monte Carlo algorithms, and extending recent developments about stochastic neutron transport. We demonstrate the applicability of our results by considering a concrete version of the Monte Carlo power iteration algorithm as well as variance reduction schemes.
entries.title_zh: 反应堆临界计算中的 Monte Carlo 幂迭代收敛分析
entries.summary_zh: 作者将核工程常用 Monte Carlo 幂迭代与序贯 Monte Carlo 联系，在温和条件下推导显式误差界，并声称这是此类方法首批严格结果。文中以具体算法和方差缩减方案展示应用，研究目标是让反应堆临界计算的随机迭代误差可量化。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合核工程模拟、随机算法和数值误差保证领域。
entries.pragmatic_review: 幂迭代估计输运算子的主特征值，临界性与其相关。
entries.cynic_review: 为广泛使用的工程算法提供理论误差界。
entries.paper_review: “温和条件”的具体内容和常数需从全文判断实用性。

entries.source_title: Closedness of bounded strength and partition rank loci
entries.source_excerpt: We show the existence of a quartic form of strength $3$ in the closure of the strength at most $2$ locus, answering a question of Ballico--Bik--Oneto--Ventura in the negative. In the analogous setting of partition rank as introduced by Naslund, we further show that the locus of tensors of partition rank at most $2$ is closed, but the locus of tensors of partition rank at most $3$ is not. Together with a suspension lemma, this answers for all $r$ whether the locus of forms/tensors of strength/partition rank at most $r$ is Zariski-closed.
entries.title_zh: 有界 strength 与 partition rank 的闭性
entries.summary_zh: 论文给出 strength 为 3 的四次型，它落在 strength 至多 2 集合的闭包中，否定此前关于闭性的一个问题；对 partition rank，秩至多 2 的张量集合闭，而秩至多 3 的集合不闭。结合 suspension lemma，作者对所有 r 分类这些 strength/partition-rank 层集何时为 Zariski 闭集。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 精确厘清两种多项式/张量复杂度分层在代数几何拓扑中的闭性差异。
entries.pragmatic_review: 闭性分类有助于判断相关秩条件是否稳定于极限。
entries.cynic_review: 需区分 strength 与 partition rank，低阶结论并不相同。
entries.paper_review: 反例与全 r 分类共同回答了闭性问题。

entries.source_title: Nonexistence of Hadamard difference sets in groups of order $4p^2$ with $p\equiv 3 \pmod 4$, $p\ge 7$
entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Bernhard Schmidt; Subjects: Combinatorics (math.CO); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: 阶为 4p² 且 p≡3 mod 4、p≥7 的群中不存在 Hadamard 差集
entries.summary_zh: 元数据仅说明论文讨论阶为 4p² 的群中 Hadamard 差集的不存在性，条件是 p≡3 (mod 4)、p≥7。尚无摘要，无法判断群的范围、使用的论证或结论是否有额外假设。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对组合设计和有限群中的差集存在性问题有参考价值。
entries.pragmatic_review: 题目给出清楚的参数条件和否定结论方向。
entries.cynic_review: 证明范围和技术细节未提供。
entries.paper_review: 不把题名结论扩展到其他参数。

entries.source_title: Narrower arithmetic progressions in the primes
entries.source_excerpt: For each fixed $k\geq 3$ and $\delta > 0$, we prove that every subset of the primes up to $X$ of relative density at least $\delta$ contains a non-trivial $k$-term arithmetic progression with common difference $O_{k,\delta,\varepsilon}((\log X)^{k\cdot 2^{k-3}+\varepsilon})$, for any $\varepsilon>0$. This improves the previous exponent $(k-1)2^{k-2}$. The main ingredient is a relative Szemer\'{e}di theorem for narrow progressions under weaker linear forms conditions.
entries.title_zh: 素数集合中的等差数列可具有更小公差
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明，对任意固定 k≥3 和相对密度 δ>0，素数至 X 中密度至少 δ 的子集含有非平凡 k 项等差数列，公差可控制为 O((log X)^(k·2^(k−3)+ε))。这改善了此前的指数 (k−1)2^(k−2)，关键是使用较弱线性形式条件下的窄公差相对 Szemerédi 定理。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 加性组合数论研究者可关注公差上界改进及其相对定理工具。
entries.pragmatic_review: 推进素数中的组合定理，主要服务解析与加性数论研究。
entries.cynic_review: 参数范围和改进指数明确，公差仍随 log X 增长。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出精确上界及关键工具，隐含常数依赖 k、δ、ε。

entries.source_title: Horrocks-Mumford sheaves on toric varieties
entries.source_excerpt: Previous work of the authors introduced the class of Horrocks-Mumford sheaves over normal algebraic k-varieties, the most prominent example being the classical Horrocks-Mumford bundle on projective four-space. For a smooth semiprojective toric variety, we derive an explicit description of these sheaves in terms of finitely generated graded modules over the Cox ring which we use for an algorithmic treatment. In particular, we discuss some explicit examples, their indecomposability and local freeness.
entries.title_zh: 环面簇上的 Horrocks–Mumford 层
entries.summary_zh: 论文把 Horrocks–Mumford 层在光滑半射影环面簇上的描述转化为 Cox 环上的有限生成分次模，并据此给出算法化处理方式。作者讨论若干显式例子及其不可分解性、局部自由性；这些性质需针对具体层和簇检验。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 为环面几何上的特殊层提供可计算的代数表示与实例分析工具。
entries.pragmatic_review: 分次模表达有助于把几何问题转为代数计算。
entries.cynic_review: 算法化描述不意味着所有层的性质都自动判定。
entries.paper_review: 适合关注 Cox 环方法与向量丛推广的代数几何读者。

entries.source_title: On AI Disclosures
entries.source_excerpt: In this essay, I posit that to maintain integrity in mathematical sciences, journals and conferences must urgently adopt a policy of mandating detailed disclosures of AI usage. Academics should also respond by treating AI disclosure as a serious and integral part of the research process rather than a mere extra chore.

entries.source_title: Parallelize AI and Human Understanding, and Other Thoughts
entries.source_excerpt: “AI for math is a hot topic right now, as it has shown to be powerful but also controversial in many ways. This is a summary of my thoughts regarding the most prominent discussion points today: […]”

entries.source_title: Comparisons of benchmark equivalence relations
entries.source_excerpt:
We determine the Borel-reducibility comparison of each pair of $\mathbf\Pi^0_3$ benchmark equivalence relations in Gao's monograph. The additional comparisons we prove are $E_\infty\leq_B c_0$, $E_\infty
leq_B\ell_p$ for $2 <\infty$, $\ell_p
leq_B{\equiv_m}$ for $2 <\infty$, $c_0
leq_B{\equiv_m}$, $c_0
leq_B\ell_\infty^+$ and $\equiv_m
leq_B\ell_\infty^+$. Together with the previous positive direction, these give $\ell_p\leq_B{\equiv_m}$ if and only if $p\leq2$. These answer several questions in Gao's monograph and Kanovei' monograph. We also prove that unitary equivalence of all bounded linear operators is not Borel reducible to $\equiv_m$. This answers a question of Ding and Gao. Equivalently, unitary equivalence of arbitrary representations of $F_\infty$ is strictly more complicated than that of arbitrary representations of $\mathbb Z$. This answers a question of Thomas.
entries.title_zh: 比较 Borel 等价关系基准的复杂度
entries.summary_zh: 作者系统确定 Gao 专著中各类 Π⁰₃ 基准等价关系之间的 Borel 可化约关系，补充多条正负方向，并由此得到 ℓ_p≤_B≡_m 当且仅当 p≤2。还证明所有有界算子的酉等价关系不能 Borel 化约到 ≡_m，回答了关于自由群表示复杂度的开放问题。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合描述集合论、分类复杂度与算子代数。
entries.pragmatic_review: Borel 化约比较两个分类问题在可测编码意义下的相对复杂度。
entries.cynic_review: 一次性补齐多个基准关系并解决明确问题。
entries.paper_review: 符号体系专业，复杂度方向必须注意箭头含义。

entries.source_title: Weak Generators in Stable Module Categories
entries.source_excerpt: The aim of this note is to show that the existence of weak generators in the stable module category of a ring, or equivalently, of $p$-indigent modules in the terminology of Holston et al., depends on the underlying model of set theory.
entries.title_zh: 稳定模范畴中的弱生成元

entries.source_title: On Hamilton cycles in quasiprimitive graphs of order $2pq$
entries.source_excerpt: Let $p>q>5$ be primes. We determine the socles and corresponding actions of quasiprimitive imprimitive groups of degree $2pq$, all of which are almost simple. Using this classification, we prove that a connected graph of order $2pq$ admitting a quasiprimitive automorphism group contains a Hamilton cycle, except possibly for three specified families of actions with socle $\PSL(2,p)$ or $\PSL(2,q^2)$.

entries.source_title: When Cooperation Must Change: Semantic Strategy Unlearning in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
entries.source_excerpt: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) supports coordinated decision-making in distributed Web services, multi-robot control, and collaborative games through learned coordination conventions. When deployment requirements change, a previously useful convention may become obsolete or unsafe. For example, revised cache-sharing permissions in Web content delivery may require caches to abandon a learned division of storage and serving roles while maintaining efficient delivery. Teams must therefore remove the specified convention while preserving useful cooperation. This is challenging because the same relational pattern can be reproduced by different agents across different histories. Runtime shielding leaves the underlying coordination preference intact and can impair task progress, while existing reinforcement unlearning and trajectory-deletion methods do not directly target role-invariant conventions. entries.source_title: Small sums of roots of unity: polylogarithmic exceptional sets and conditional separation
entries.source_excerpt: We prove a polylogarithmic exceptional-set estimate for symmetric five-term sums of roots of unity of arbitrary order. More precisely, at most $O((\log(2N))^{11})$ points of the $N$-grid satisfy $|1+2\cos(2\pi x)+2\cos(2\pi y)|<\exp(-C(\log(2N))^{13})$. This implies the corresponding bound for small conjugates at the reduced conductor: outside polylogarithmically many real embeddings, every such sum is at least quasipolynomially large. The proof is unconditional and combines a polynomial-vector-field multiplicity estimate, arithmetic jet determinants, analytic propagation, and interpolation determinants for nearby grid points. As a companion result, assuming a uniform number-field $abc$ conjecture, we prove that every sum of a fixed number of distinct prime-order roots of unity has modulus at least $\exp(-\varepsilon p)$ for every $\varepsilon>0$ and all sufficiently large primes $p$, uniformly in the exponents. That proof uses simultaneous compression of the exponents, discriminant estimates, and cyclic resultants.

entries.source_title: Retriangular numbers and affine maps between polygonal numbers
entries.source_excerpt: A positive integer $a$ is called \emph{retriangular} if there is a positive integer $b$ such that $aT+b$ is a triangular number whenever $T$ is. We show that the retriangular numbers are exactly the odd squares greater than $1$, and that for each of them $b$ is unique. The proof rests on a rigidity principle: a non-constant affine map carrying the values of one quadratic sequence into the values of another is induced by an affine map of the plane sending the vertex of one parabola to the vertex of the other. We use it to classify all affine maps between sets of polygonal numbers; the $s$-gonal numbers map affinely into the $t$-gonal numbers if and only if $M_t\mid M_s$, where $M_s=2(s-2)/\gcd(s,4)$ defines a bijection from $\{3,4,5,\dots\}$ onto the positive integers. We also treat sparse data, polynomial maps, figurate numbers of higher degree and sums of two triangular numbers, and we study the monoid of affine self-maps of an arbitrary set of integers. For the $s$-gonal numbers this monoid is an arithmetical congruence monoid, and the factorization of self-maps into irreducible ones is unique only for triangular and square numbers.

entries.source_title: Syzygy and Adjoint Matroids
entries.source_excerpt: We give a matroid-theoretic analogue of Gaussian elimination and use it to construct, for every matroid M, the syzygy matroid Syz(M) on the collection of circuits of M. Dualizing the construction yields the combinatorial adjoint Adj(M) on the collection of maximal proper flats of M, and the two are related by Adj(M) \simeq Syz(M*). Neither construction depends on a realization. We determine Syz(M) when M is U_{k,k+3} or the Vamos matroid V_{8}. We also show that Adj(M) is an adjoint of M when M has rank 3. When M has rank 4 and V_{8} is a restriction of M, Adj(M) has rank 3 and is not an adjoint of M.

entries.source_title: The section conjecture for generic pointed curves
entries.source_excerpt: Let $k/\mathbb Q$ be finitely generated, let $g\geq3$ and $n\geq1$, and let $\mathcal M_{g,n/k}$ be the moduli stack of smooth proper genus-$g$ curves with $n$ distinct ordered markings. Put $K=k(\mathcal M_{g,n/k})$. We prove Grothendieck's section conjecture for the generic $n$-pointed genus-$g$ curve over $K$. Over both the moduli stack and its function field, the continuous sections of the arithmetic fundamental-group extension of the universal complete curve are, up to geometric conjugacy, exactly the $n$ tautological sections. The same classification holds for every geometrically pro-$\ell$ quotient, for every prime $\ell$. Together with Hain's determination of the rational points, these classifications give examples over fields finitely generated over $\mathbb Q$ with any prescribed positive number of rational points for which the full section conjecture holds. The proof builds on Hain's weighted-completion and nonabelian cohomology methods, with a hyperelliptic calculation providing the genus-three input. An integral normalizer lemma and moving-mark arguments pass from unipotent sections to geometrically pro-$\ell$ sections. C

entries.source_title: Weighted homogeneous surface singularities admitting rational homology disk smoothings
entries.source_excerpt: We study rational homology disk smoothings through canonical-cover representations and specialization of reflexive canonical powers, and recover the known dual graph and analytic classification. The geometric-genus representation of the canonical covering group, together with its complex conjugate, is a direct summand of the reduced regular representation. Specialization forces the canonical Riemann--Roch corrections to vanish; explicit formulas give equations for the Seifert invariants. For three arms and central weight two, these equations, the character restrictions, and the numerical identities determine the Seifert data without assuming the existence of a smoothing. Projective compactifications treat the remaining cases, and elliptic pencils explain the four-arm attachment points and the parameter independence of their cross ratios. We construct strong $\mathbb{Q}$-Gorenstein smoothings for all listed analytic structures by deforming canonical-cover equations and lifting generators of the full first syzygy module. The numerical Milnor formula gives rational homology disk fibers.

entries.source_title: Least singular values of Gaussian matrices with deterministic shifts
entries.source_excerpt: Let $A$ be a deterministic real square matrix and $G$ a standard Gaussian matrix. We determine $\E\smin(A+G)$, up to universal constants, in terms of the singular values of $A$. The expectation is comparable to the square root of the smallest zero of the expected characteristic polynomial of $(A+G)^{\top}(A+G)$. This resolves Problem~3 in Tikhomirov's ICM 2022 survey. We also prove that the zeros of the expected characteristic polynomial are majorized by the expected ordered eigenvalues of $(A+G)^{\top}(A+G)$.

entries.source_title: Square-root cancellation in three hyperbolic counting problems via maximal estimates
entries.source_excerpt: We study three counting problems for lattice orbits in hyperbolic space: counting orbit points within a prescribed distance of a fixed closed geodesic or a totally geodesic hyperplane, and counting orbit points above a prescribed height at a cusp. For almost every base point, we obtain error bounds of square-root size up to logarithmic factors. For the geodesic and hyperplane counts, these bounds match the conjectured exponents and improve earlier results due to Good and Laaksonen. For these two problems, we adapt the method of maximal estimates developed by Chatzakos and Dimakis for hyperbolic lattice counting, formulating it in both a discrete and a continuous framework. For the hyperplane problem, we also obtain an asymptotic formula for the spatial second moment of the error term, involving an almost periodic function. For the cusp problem, the square-root bound can be deduced from work of Yu, which incorporates Schmidt's dyadic maximal argument. entries.source_title: h1: A Taste of the Bitter Lesson in Automated Theorem Proving
entries.source_excerpt: While progress in informal mathematics has come largely from scaling the chain-of-thought and agentic reasoning of frontier language models, formal theorem proving has increasingly relied on human-designed workflows around these models, such as planning, decomposition, and orchestrating specialized provers. This raises a bitter-lesson question: can a simple agentic loop that scales test-time compute match these workflows? The answer matters as formal verification must scale to keep up with frontier models producing research mathematics, yet new workflows rarely settle it, as their gains are often confounded with stronger models or more compute. We study this question with h1, a simple harness that gives a model an efficient interface to Lean 4 and keeps it working through verifier feedback and self-reflection, without imposing a decomposition or search structure. h1 reaches state-of-the-art results on PutnamBench, FATE-X, and FormalConjectures100-Solved, settles eight open problems in FormalConjectures, and, at matched models, matches or outperforms specialized workflows such as Goedel-Architect and AlphaProof Nexus, surprisingly show

entries.source_title: Reinforcement Learning with Reference-Based Rewards for Language Model Reasoning and Alignment
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement learning (RL) powers two major lines of large language model (LLM) post-training: reasoning, which elicits deliberate, verifiable problem solving, and alignment, which steers models toward helpful, harmless, and honest behavior. Both hinge on reward design. Reasoning relies on rule-based verification of final answers, whose binary feedback is blind to intermediate derivations, whereas process reward models (PRMs) require step-level annotations too costly to scale. Alignment depends on reward models (RMs) trained on binary preference pairs, making both data collection and model training resource-intensive. We propose RL2R, reinforcement learning with reference-based rewards, as a unified and inexpensive alternative. Using pre-existing or distilled references, RL2R measures semantic similarity with lightweight metrics such as BERTScore between a sampled generation and a reference answer or solution. Similarity preserves ordinal quality signals that binary feedback discards: responses closer to the reference earn higher rewards, and sound derivations receive credit even when the final conclusion is wrong. entries.source_title: Solvable models of learning to pursue a moving target
entries.source_excerpt: Agents tasked with intercepting a moving target must learn how to reach it, ideally as efficiently as possible. As observers of animal pursuit behavior have noticed, different strategies are possible: on one extreme, the agent reactively moves toward the target's current location; on the other, the agent predicts the target's future location and moves directly there. Motivated by the desire to understand how such strategies might be learned, we introduce a continuous-time linear-quadratic model of open-loop target pursuit whose optimal control strategies interpolate between these possibilities. Usefully, a small number of interpretable parameters control which type of strategy is optimal, and it is possible to derive closed-form solutions for optimal strategies, policy learning dynamics, and value learning dynamics. Exploiting our model's linear structure, we find that the time scales of learning precisely correspond to the eigenvalues of certain matrices, and that relevant eigenvalue spectra generically have a gap. We show that this gap indicates that agents tend to learn how to reach their target before optimizing their movement. Ou

entries.source_title: How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies
entries.source_excerpt: Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textit{tasks}, \textit{environments}, and \textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this question end-to-end with three tightly coupled contributions. First, we decompose agentic data into three cardinality axes (task, environment, trajectory), plus a reward-density control variable, and fit per-axis scaling relations on different large language models (LLMs) across math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool application domains. Across all model sizes, model families, domains, and RL algorithms (PPO and GRPO) we measured, the scaling exponents order as environment $>$ task $>$ trajectory. entries.source_title: Counting Markov triples and simple geodesics
entries.source_excerpt: We give an asymptotic formula for the number of Markov triples with largest entry below $x$. We show that the error term is $o(\log x)$, which improves upon the previous best known results due to McShane and Rivin. We give an explicit error based on classical zero-free regions of the Riemann zeta function, and a sharper estimate under the quasi-Riemann hypothesis. The proof uses the correspondence between Markov triples and simple closed geodesics on the modular punctured torus and a careful analysis of the McShane-Rivin unit ball.

entries.source_title: Relaxation and $\Gamma$-Convergence of Stretch Energy on Surface Homeomorphisms
entries.source_excerpt: Area-preserving parameterization of triangular meshes is an essential task in geometry processing, yet an exactly area-preserving simplicial mapping may not exist in general. In this paper, we study area preservation of simplicial mappings in the limit of mesh refinement by establishing the $\Gamma$-convergence of the discrete stretch energy, a functional that measures their area distortion. We first introduce its limit functional, the relaxed stretch energy on surface homeomorphisms, defined through the pushforward of the area measure, and show that it is the relaxation of the stretch energy of diffeomorphisms with respect to uniform convergence. Then, to compare simplicial mappings with homeomorphisms, we construct a geometric lift that requires no shape-regularity assumption on the image mesh. Finally, we establish the $\Gamma$-convergence and show that the minimal discrete energies converge to the continuum minimum. Moreover, any homeomorphism arising as a limit of lifted discrete local minimizers in fixed-radius balls is area-preserving.
entries.title_zh: 曲面同胚伸展能的松弛与 Γ 收敛

entries.source_title: A generalised and modular proof-theoretic semantics for sequent systems
entries.source_excerpt: Base-extension semantics explains logical consequence via derivability in atomic systems. Extending this approach across logics requires careful control of structural principles and contexts. We present a modular sequent-based framework in which support is indexed by multisets of atomic resources and the semantic clauses for connectives are guided by their left introduction rules. The framework separates additive from multiplicative behaviour and makes explicit the contributions of structural rules and restrictions on sequents. We establish soundness and completeness for classical and intuitionistic propositional logic and for multiplicative-additive fragments of classical and intuitionistic linear logic. We then investigate axiomatic extensions of intuitionistic logic through Jankov logic. Two classes of atomic bases yield sound and complete semantics. Completeness is proven using two novel and modular methods using simulation bases, one of which is constructive. entries.title_zh: 序列演算系统的广义模块化证明论语义
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出一种基于序列演算的模块化语义，把支持关系索引在原子资源的多重集上，并依照联结词的左引入规则定义语义条款，从而明确区分加法式与乘法式行为及结构规则的作用。作者证明该框架对经典与直觉主义命题逻辑，以及经典和直觉主义线性逻辑的乘法—加法片段具有可靠性与完备性；并用两类原子基底研究 Jankov 逻辑扩张，给出两种模块化完备性证明，其中一种是构造性的。

entries.source_title: CLT for quadratic additive functionals of three-dimensional and four-dimensional voter models
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we prove central limit theorems for the quadratic additive functionals of the three-dimensional and four-dimensional voter models. Our main results show that, under proper time-space scalings, the centered quadratic additive functional of the four-dimensional voter model converges weakly to a Brownian motion and that in the three-dimensional case converges weakly to a Gaussian process without independent increment. The proof of the main result in the four-dimensional case extends the martingale decomposition method. In the three-dimensional case, we introduce a quadratic fluctuation limit theorem which shows that the quadratic fluctuation density field of the voter model converges weakly to a generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process. Then our main result in the three-dimensional case follows from an argument where the quadratic additive functional is approximated by an integral of a test function with respect to the quadratic fluctuation density field. entries.title_zh: 三维与四维投票模型二次加性泛函的中心极限定理
entries.summary_zh: 作者研究三维和四维投票模型的二次加性泛函，并在适当时空尺度下证明极限分布不同：四维情形收敛到布朗运动，三维情形收敛到具有相关增量的高斯过程。证明使用鞅分解、二次涨落密度场极限，并反复利用投票模型与共alescing 随机游走的对偶。

entries.source_title: Rigidity for Families of Abelian Varieties over $\mathcal{M}_{g,n}$
entries.source_excerpt: We provide a new proof of Farb's theorem on the global rigidity of the period map $\mathcal{M}_{g,n} \to \mathcal{A}_g$. We extend this classification to essentially include the period map for $\mathcal{M}_{2,n}$. We also provide a classification of holomorphic maps $\mathcal{M}_g \to \mathcal{A}_{h}$ for $h \leq 2g-1$. The only nonconstant maps in this range are given by taking the Jacobian of a curve and attaching a fixed Abelian variety. In addition to the group theory of the mapping class group, we make extensive use of the theory of variations of Hodge structures and the birational geometry on $\overline{\mathcal{M}}_2$.
entries.title_zh: 模空间 M_g,n 上阿贝尔簇族的刚性

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 给出曲线族到阿贝尔簇族映射的刚性分类，适合模空间与 Hodge 理论读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 结果对理解模空间之间可能存在的映射类型有帮助。

entries.source_title: A Mathematical Theory of the Jacobian Lens
entries.source_excerpt: Recent work from Anthropic introduced a new interpretability tool, called the Jacobian lens (J-lens, Gurnee et al., 2026). This method identified linear directions in the hidden states of frontier language models that had properties reminiscent of working memory-like representations. However, it is unclear what mechanistic properties of such features make them detectable to the J-lens. To this end, we introduce a mathematical theory of the J-lens, and show that it preferentially identifies coherent features -- directions that act like leading, spatially coherent Lyapunov modes. Small perturbations along these directions amplify across layers, remain roughly constant across token positions, and are consistent across different contexts. While we are agnostic to whether these properties are necessarily associated with a ``Global Workspace'', the analytically derived preferences of the J-lens nevertheless explain prior empirical applied to both model classes. entries.title_zh: Jacobian Lens 的数学理论
entries.summary_zh: 论文为 Jacobian lens 可解释性工具建立数学分析，证明它偏好识别相干特征：沿特定隐藏状态方向的小扰动会跨层放大、在 token 位置上较稳定，并对应领先的空间相干 Lyapunov 模式。作者用 Bayes filter 和玩具 Transformer 验证分析，同时对这些特征是否等于“全局工作空间”保持中立。

entries.source_title: Why is AI-generated language so hard to understand?
entries.source_excerpt: There is a widespread sense that AI-generated text has recently become harder to understand. In this study, we investigate a set of psycholinguistic features that are known to correlate with human processing difficulty (e.g., object relative clauses, long syntactic dependencies, low-frequency n-grams). Using a novel corpus of AI-generated text across diverse domains, we find that AI models use these difficult features more often than paraphrases generated by round-trip translation. Compared with human writing, all nine frontier and near-frontier models use more inanimate subjects with animate verbs and more low-frequency n-grams, and most also use longer dependencies, more stacked nouns, and more reduced object relatives in conversation; we also demonstrate substantial variation across model families. We propose and test a hypothesis as to why: while human language is optimized for successful communication, AI-generated text is increasingly optimized for other goals like math, code, and reasoning, in which there is a pressure for \textit{information density} rather than successful communication. entries.title_zh: 为什么 AI 生成的语言难以理解？
entries.summary_zh: 研究用心理语言学中与阅读负担相关的特征分析多领域 AI 文本，并与往返翻译改写及人类写作比较。摘要报告，九个前沿或近前沿模型更常使用无生命主语搭配有生命动词、低频 n-gram，多数模型还出现较长句法依存、名词堆叠等现象，且不同模型家族差异明显；作者提出并检验这些语言特征能否解释主观难读感。

entries.source_title: Relative Hitchin fibrations and endoscopy for Unitary Friedberg--Jacquet varieties
entries.source_excerpt: We prove a relative fundamental lemma for the unitary symmetric variety $GL_n(k')\backslash U_{2n}$, proving a conjecture of Leslie, Xiao, and Zhang. Our proof reduces to the Lie algebra and argues over function fields in positive characteristic, using methods from Ngo-Laumon and Ngo. In particular, we reinterpret orbital integrals in terms of the cohomology of relative affine Springer fibers and globalize this using unitary versions of Hitchin moduli spaces for symmetric pairs via a product formula. As the main global input, we prove a matching of perverse sheaves between relative Hitchin moduli spaces and their corresponding endoscopic variants.

entries.source_title: Metric Poissonian Pair Correlation Property Part 1: The Case \(n+\log n\)
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that $(\alpha(n+\log n))_{n\ge1}$ has Poissonian pair correlation for Lebesgue almost every real $\alpha$. This solves a Problem posed by Aistleitner, El-Baz and Munsch [Open Problem 2, Geom. Funct. Anal. 2021].
entries.title_zh: 度量 Poisson 配对相关性（一）：α(n+log n) 序列

entries.paper_review: 摘要报告精确的几乎处处结论和所解问题，技术贡献需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Reasoning with Context Management and External Memory
entries.source_excerpt: Reasoning models maintain information about the status of their reasoning process through in-context memory. Complex problems require larger context windows and memory requirements. In this scenario, context management without caching risks discarding useful information for reasoning. We propose RCMEM, an approach that extends context management with an external memory to maintain additional information without burdening the reasoning model with additional context. RCMEM significantly reduces computation time on problems that require repeated computation of intermediate steps, while achieving better performance on complex problems. We demonstrate our approach on a few mathematics problems using model sizes ranging from 0.4 to 25 million parameters, and GPT-2.

entries.source_title: From Single-Actor Environments to Multi-Actor Event Worlds: Can LLMs Be Event World Models?
entries.source_excerpt: World models help agents assess the consequences of their actions before acting. Many real systems, however, involve multiple actors who make their own decisions, can evolve even when the agent takes no action, and are only partially observed through event logs. We formalize these systems as event worlds and ask whether large language models can predict future observations from the log and the agent's proposed actions. We build complementary benchmarks from human Diplomacy games and real Polymarket trades. Our hierarchical framework compares prediction with and without other actors' actions, then tests multi-step rollouts, predictions for actions never taken, and usefulness to agents. Fine-tuning and more data improve prediction when all actors' recorded actions are given. With only the agent's action, models struggle when other actors strongly affect the outcome, and larger models and longer histories help little. This gap also limits multi-step prediction and agent decisions, with models overestimating plan success. entries.source_title: A Fibrational Framework For Multi-Conclusion Logics
entries.source_excerpt: The fibrational framework of Licata, Shulman, and Riley gives a uniform account of substructural and modal logics for single-conclusion judgments. This thesis extends it to a multiple-output setting in which cartesian resources may be used freely, while linear resources occur exactly once on either side of the turnstile. Judgments are indexed by descriptors: directed acyclic graphs generalizing the tree-shaped expressions of the original framework. Descriptor $2$-cells encode structural transformations, and explicit gates provide weakening, contraction, coweakening, and cocontraction at linear modes. We define a sequent calculus generated by two connectives, $F$ and $U$. We prove identity, invertibility, and cut admissibility. The mode and type theories present linear-non-linear $2$-polycategories, and the projection is a local discrete fibration and a fibration, with opcartesian lifts for one-output base morphisms. Two adequacy results validate the framework: its cartesian fragment recovers the Licata--Shulman--Riley calculus, and its purely linear fragment presents classical multiplicative linear logic. entries.title_zh: 多结论逻辑的纤维化框架

entries.title_zh: 高阶导出极限、Kurepa 族与 Chang 猜想

entries.source_title: Where Latents Belong and How They Flow: Joint Identification of Structural Roles
entries.source_excerpt: Latent factors in dynamical systems can play different roles across observations and time. For example, an idea in a group meeting may be expressed by only some participants, inherit information from earlier discussions, and shape what is said next. We formalize this notion as the structural role of a latent factor, describing where it is expressed, whether it receives influence from the past, and whether it transmits influence to the future. The main challenge is correspondence, since the three structures may be identified under different permutations, while a structural role is defined only when they are aligned to the same latent coordinate. We show that, under suitable structural and variability conditions, all three roles are jointly identifiable under a common permutation at each time point. Guided by this theory, we develop RoleTrace, a framework that traces structural roles in a shared latent coordinate system. Synthetic experiments validate structural recovery, while experiments on multiparty meetings examine the identified roles in real sequential interactions.

entries.source_title: Multilevel Gaussian Processes with Applications to Inverse Problems
entries.source_excerpt: We present a multilevel Gaussian process (GP) regression framework for approximating functions that are accessible only through a hierarchy of approximations of increasing accuracy and computational cost. One example is the response surface of a parametrized partial differential equation, where the hierarchy arises from the resolution of the numerical solver. Modeling level increments independently with Mat\'ern-kernel GPs and allocating samples flexibly across discretization levels yields substantial computational savings over single-level GP regression. We derive $L^2$ convergence rates for the posterior mean and variance, accounting for maximum likelihood estimation of the marginal variance and for kernel misspecification. When increment regularity or solver cost is unknown a priori, an adaptive sequential-design algorithm with cost-adapted active learning criteria allocates samples across levels. We apply the surrogate to Bayesian inverse problems, for which Hellinger distance bounds between the true and approximate posteriors are known. Numerical experiments illustrate the theoretical rates and the resulting computational savings

entries.source_title: Dynamic Properties of Numerical Solution for Stochastic Epidemic Models with a Fully Implicit Form
entries.source_excerpt: This paper establishes a fully implicit model to investigate the spread of epidemics and studies its dynamic properties, extending the semi-implicit model in Yang et al.(Commun. Nonlinear Sci. Numer. Simul., 152 (2026) 109140 ). We first employ the split-step backward Euler method to address the non-adaptability arising from backward Euler discretization and ensure the global convergence of the numerical solution. By linearizing the model, the computational cost is reduced at the expense of a slight increase in error, effectively avoiding complex iterative solution processes. Then, we derive the existence, uniqueness, positivity, and boundedness of the numerical solution, and obtain its global convergence order. On this basis, the extinction and persistence of the disease are investigated under three different scenarios. The results indicate that environmental noise is a key factor leading to disease extinction. Finally, numerical simulations visually verify the obtained theoretical conclusions.

entries.title_zh: 超图 Hajnal–Szemerédi 定理

entries.source_title: Mixed finite element methods for a heat-assisted model of sedimentation
entries.source_excerpt: A model for the consolidation-sedimentation process incorporating thermal effects is analysed. The model is motivated by novel applications to heat-assisted sedimentation of mineral suspensions. A system of convection-diffusion equations for the concentration and temperature are coupled to flow equations for the volume-average velocity and pressure. The model is supplemented with Dirichlet and mixed boundary conditions. A quasi-stationary approach of the system is analysed by means of a mixed variational formulation, where additional variables such as the pseudostress tensor and variables for the gradient of the temperature and concentration are introduced. The existence and uniqueness of the system is shown making use of the Babu{\v s}ka-Brezzi theory and Banach's fixed-point theorem, under hypotheses of smallness of the data and additional regularity on the solutions. A discrete formulation based on finite element spaces is proposed and analysed, and the existence of solutions is achieved thanks to Brouwer's fixed-point theorem. entries.source_title: Do Language Models Know Which Words Steer Their Reasoning?
entries.source_excerpt: While chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits intermediate reasoning steps from language models, it is unclear which words in the context actually steer the CoT. We identify Phantom Context Influence (PCI): language models are disproportionately steered by semantically irrelevant context words, even as the same models deny those words' relevance when asked. To localize PCI, we introduce Leave-One-Out Word JSD analysis, which removes one context word at a time from the otherwise intact context to isolate its marginal effect on the next-token distribution; words whose removal flips the prediction (pivot words) are passed to the same LLM to self-judge whether it recognizes this predictive dependence. Across four models and three benchmarks, language models largely do not know which words steer their reasoning, a mismatch we call the Generation-Judgment Contradiction. Inspired by this phenomenon, we propose Online KV Suppression: it scores every prompt word's influence over the whole chain of thought in a single pass, then zeroes the KV-cache entries of the highest-influence word the model itself judges inert and redecodes. This single-w
entries.title_zh: 语言模型知道哪些词在引导自己的推理吗？
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出“幻影上下文影响”（PCI）：模型的思维链会被语义上无关的上下文词显著牵引，但被问及原因时又常否认其相关性。作者用逐词删除后的分布变化定位关键词，再提出在线 KV 抑制：将模型自判为无关、实际影响较大的词从 KV cache 清除并重新解码；四模型、五个推理基准实验中，准确率最高提升 8.9 个百分点。

entries.source_title: On the number of edge-disjoint $K_r$ in $K_{r+1}$-free graphs
entries.source_excerpt: Gy\H ori and Keszegh [\emph{Combinatorica} \textbf{37} (2017), 1113--1124] proved that every $K_4$-free graph on $n$ vertices with $\lfloor n^2/4\rfloor+k$ edges contains at least $k$ pairwise edge-disjoint triangles. We extend this result to cliques of arbitrary fixed order. Specifically, we prove that for every fixed integer $r\ge 3$ and all sufficiently large $n$, every $K_{r+1}$-free graph on $n$ vertices with $t_{r-1}(n)+k$ edges contains at least $k$ pairwise edge-disjoint copies of $K_r$, where $t_{r-1}(n)$ denotes the number of edges in the Tur\'an graph $T_{r-1}(n)$. Moreover, equality holds if and only if $G$ is obtained from $T_{r-1}(n)$ by adding edges within one of its parts, with the added edges forming a triangle-free graph.
entries.title_zh: 不含 Kᵣ₊₁ 图中边不交 Kᵣ 的数量
entries.summary_zh: 文章将 K₄-free 图中多出的边迫使出现边不交三角形的结论推广到任意固定 r≥3。对充分大的 n，若 Kᵣ₊₁-free 图有 tᵣ₋₁(n)+k 条边，则至少含 k 个两两边不交的 Kᵣ；等号情形对应 Turán 图内部新增边形成三角形-free 图。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把 Turán 极值阈值与边不交团计数联系起来，且给出精确等号结构。

entries.source_title: Approximate Solomonoff Induction: On the Robustness of Learned Universal Predictors

u$ are drawn from a prior $w_{

u w_
u

This raises a natural question: \emph{Does the prediction performance remain robust under approximation}? In this paper, we first provide a tight bound on the worst-case effect of approximation on prediction error. We show any predictor $ho$ satisfying $D_{KL}(\xi \|ho)\leq \eta$ retains bounded cumulative-expected-squared prediction error. entries.title_zh: 近似 Solomonoff 归纳与学习通用预测器的稳健性
entries.summary_zh: 论文从元学习视角讨论大规模对数损失训练为何可能获得广泛泛化：若序列环境按先验 w 抽样，最优总体预测器是贝叶斯混合 ξ；当 w 是通用先验时，它对应 Solomonoff 通用归纳。现实算法只能近似优化，作者因此研究近似预测器对环境先验和学习误差的稳健性；摘要节选未展示最终定量定理，不能将理想极限等同于现有大模型。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 连接通用归纳理论与实际近似训练，分析先验和优化误差对泛化解释的影响。

entries.paper_review: 以近似稳健性补足从理想贝叶斯混合到实际学习器的理论间隙。

entries.source_title: Computing S(X) for Ruled Surfaces Defined by Stable Bundles on Curves of Genus 2
entries.source_excerpt: This paper discusses the algebra of symmetric tensors for ruled surfaces defined by rank 2 stable vector bundles on curves of genus 2. The algebra is computed for special bundles $E$ when $S^2 E$ is destabilized by a line bundle and when $S^3 E$ is destabilized by a bundle of rank 2. A strategy for computation is discussed in regards to the other special bundles $E$. This paper also discusses the generalization of these strategies to higher genus and gives a computation when $E$ is not stable and may be written as a direct sum of line bundles.
entries.title_zh: 亏格二曲线上稳定丛定义的 ruled surface 对称张量代数

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数几何读者研究向量丛稳定性如何影响 ruled surface 的对称张量代数结构。

entries.source_title: Dirichlet-Constrained Random Operators and Quenched Reflection Quantum Walks: Tree Spectra and Poisson Criticality at High Degree
entries.source_excerpt: We study spectral limits of random operators whose incident edge weights are coupled by local normalization, and the reflection quantum walks associated with them. At each vertex of a $d$-regular graph, an independent Dirichlet probability vector distributes unit mass among outgoing directions. At fixed degree, the empirical spectral measures of the associated self-adjoint operators converge almost surely on locally tree-like graph sequences. We give a closed-walk formula for every moment of the limiting tree law. Our main result identifies two distinct high-degree scales. After rescaling the deterministic expected root spectral law by $\sqrt d$, a weak limit exists if and only if $d\alpha_d^2$ converges in $[0,\infty]$, where $\alpha_d$ is the Dirichlet parameter. The limits range from a point mass at zero through non-semicircular critical laws to the semicircle law. The critical laws admit a Poisson-tree representation with an explicit Bessel intensity. entries.title_zh: Dirichlet 约束随机算子与反射量子游走的谱极限
entries.summary_zh: 研究每个顶点把单位质量按 Dirichlet 随机向量分配到出边的正则图随机算子，并分析关联反射量子游走的谱。局部树状图列上，固定度数时经验谱测度几乎必然收敛；高阶极限则由 dα_d² 的收敛决定，从零点质量、非半圆临界律到半圆律形成一族极限，临界律可由带显式 Bessel 强度的 Poisson 树表示。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合随机算子、量子游走和随机图谱分布交叉研究。
entries.pragmatic_review: 理解重点是局部树极限和半圆律之间的参数过渡。
entries.cynic_review: 按参数尺度完整区分多种极限谱型。
entries.paper_review: 结论依赖局部树状序列和特定 Dirichlet 参数缩放。

entries.source_title: Mathematics in the Dark Forest
entries.source_excerpt: An open problem list is a bullseye painted on your field.
entries.title_zh: 数学的“暗森林”：公开问题清单也可能成为 AI 的靶标
entries.summary_zh: Dave Anderson 以代数组合学公开问题清单为例，描述自己把三个问题交给 LLM 自主尝试：模型很快声称解决其中两个，但作者尚未仔细检查或用 Lean 形式化验证，因此特意把“解决”加上引号。文章借此讨论公开问题如何成为模型的明确目标、未经核验的解答如何影响声誉和研究激励；它呈现的是一次探索性实验和作者对学术机制的担忧，不证明模型已经可靠解决这些问题。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合了解 AI 数学实验如何从开放问题列表启动，也提醒读者区分模型产出的候选证明与经同行审查的定理。
entries.pragmatic_review: 问题清单可用于定向探索，但每个结果都需要数学家独立核验。
entries.cynic_review: 作者尚未验证两份解答，标题中的“解决”不能当作已证事实。
entries.paper_review: 文章公开了问题选择和提示方式，但没有给出形式验证或完整复现实验。

entries.source_title: Class polynomial obstructions to canonical congruences for the smallest parts function
entries.source_excerpt: We resolve an open conjecture by proving that the only "canonical'' Ramanujan congruence primes for the Andrews' smallest parts function, $\operatorname{spt}(n)$, are $\ell= 5, 7, 13$. Building on work of Ahlgren and Kim, we show that any such congruence forces square-index coefficients of certain weakly holomorphic forms of weight $1/2$ to vanish modulo the congruence prime. A normalized Borcherds product converts this into the vanishing of the derivative of a quotient of two oriented CM polynomials on $X_0(6)$. A quaternionic volume estimate in an Eichler order of level $6$ prevents that vanishing when a suitable inert discriminant is small. Trevi\~no's character estimate supplies such a discriminant for every prime at least $10^{11}$. The remaining range is covered by the previous calculations of Ahlgren and Kim. These results have been verified in Lean by AxiomProver.
entries.title_zh: 最小部分函数规范同余的类多项式障碍
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明 Andrews 最小部分函数 spt(n) 的规范 Ramanujan 同余素数仅为 5、7、13，从而解决一项开放猜想。证明链把同余转化为半整数权弱全纯模形式特定系数消失，再用 Borcherds 乘积联系到模曲线 X₀(6) 上定向 CM 类多项式商导数的消失；四元数体积估计与特征估计排除大素数，余下范围沿用既有计算。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 将分拆同余问题转化为模形式、CM 点与四元数体积的组合障碍。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合分拆函数与算术模形式方向研究者追踪证明技巧。
entries.cynic_review: “规范同余”是特定定义下的分类结论，勿泛化到所有同余。
entries.paper_review: 证明串联代数、模形式与显式估计，完成猜想分类。

entries.source_title: CreditFilter: Calibrated Token Weights over the Within-Response Entropy Rank for RLVR
entries.source_excerpt: Critic-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically assigns a uniform advantage to every token. Token-reweighting heuristics like the 80/20 mask favor high-entropy tokens, but fail to measure a token's actual impact on the outcome. We formalize this impact as the forking value: the variance of the success probability over the policy's next-token choices. The expected forking values along a response sum exactly to the reward variance. Token credit is thus, in expectation over a prompt's responses, a fixed budget spent at the forks. This motivates weights that redistribute credit within a response. The forking value factorizes into a fork consequence, which requires costly continuations to estimate, and a fork probability, which the softmax provides. On Qwen3-8B-Base, this fork probability decays exponentially with a token's within-response entropy rank at class-specific rates, revealing that most tokens carry negligible forking value. CreditFilter weights each token by an exponential window over the same rank. The window is calibrated to this fork-probability envelope, under an approximately flat fork consequenc
entries.title_zh: CreditFilter：基于响应内熵排名校准 RLVR token 权重
entries.summary_zh: RLVR 常把同一回答内所有 token 赋予相同优势，但高熵 token 掩码并不等于该 token 真正影响最终成败。本文定义“分叉价值”为下一 token 选择引起的成功概率方差，其期望沿回答求和恰等于奖励方差；据此按响应内熵排名的指数窗口重分配信用，无需额外前向计算。Qwen3-8B-Base 实验中，三随机种子平均成绩较 DAPO 在 MATH500 提高 7.7 分、AIME24 提高 10.5 分、AIME25 提高 9.1 分。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 提供 token 级奖励归因的统计解释，并把信用分配设计与可验证数学任务成绩联系。
entries.pragmatic_review: 无需额外前向计算的权重方案对 RLVR 训练成本有吸引力。
entries.cynic_review: 主要数值来自 Qwen3-8B-Base 与有限基准，外部模型复现及熵窗口假设值得关注。
entries.paper_review: 从奖励方差推导 token 分叉价值，并用消融支持响应内排序和窗口校准。

entries.source_title: Global generation of coinvariant vector bundles on $\overline{\mathrm{M}}_{0,n}$
entries.source_excerpt: Using fusion closed-ness and strong generation properties, we identify collections of modules over vertex operator algebras (VOAs) whose induced vector bundles of coinvariants on the moduli space $\overline{\mathrm M}_{0,n}$ of stable $n$-pointed curves of genus zero are globally generated. These results specialize to \cite{Fak12} for affine VOAs at positive integer levels, and of \cite{DG23} for strongly rational VOAs that are generated in degree 1. To illustrate the results, and to show that fusion-closedness is essential, we give numerous examples, including Lattice VOAs, Simple Current Extensions of Affine VOAs, and various tensor products.
entries.title_zh: M̄₀,ₙ 上 coinvariant 向量丛的整体生成
entries.summary_zh: 论文利用融合闭性和强生成性质，找出一类顶点算子代数模，使其在稳定 n 点有理曲线模空间 M̄₀,ₙ 上诱导的 coinvariant 向量丛由整体截面生成。结果涵盖正整数层仿射 VOA 和若干强有理 VOA 的既有情形，并以格点 VOA、仿射 VOA 的单根扩张及张量积为例说明融合闭性的重要性。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 拓展模空间上共形块向量丛的整体生成判据，具有明确代数构造背景。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合 VOA、共形场论与代数几何交叉研究。
entries.cynic_review: 适用对象受模类别的融合闭性和生成假设限制。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出一般判据并列举多类实例。

entries.source_title: Mutation-acyclicity in rank four is decidable but not semialgebraic
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that mutation-acyclicity of quivers on four vertices is decidable. If a four-vertex quiver $Q$ is mutation-acyclic, then some sequence of mutations takes it to an acyclic quiver without any arrow multiplicity exceeding $\operatorname{max}\{\operatorname{ht}(Q),m(Q)\}$, where $\operatorname{ht}(Q)$ is the largest arrow multiplicity of $Q$ and $m(Q)$ is the Markov invariant of Fomin and Neville evaluated on the totally proper wiggle class of $Q$. A search within a computable form of this bound decides mutation-acyclicity of four-vertex quivers with $O(h^{24})$ states for input height $h\ge1$. Together with a theorem of Caldero and Keller, it also decides mutation equivalence of two four-vertex quivers up to relabeling whenever one of them is mutation-acyclic. We conjecture that $\operatorname{ht}(Q)$ alone suffices as the bound, which would reduce the search to $O(h^{6})$ states, and we verify this for all four-vertex quivers of height at most three. entries.title_zh: 四顶点箭图的变异无环性可判定，但非半代数
entries.summary_zh: 作者证明四顶点箭图的 mutation-acyclicity 可判定：若箭图可变异为无环图，则存在受箭数高度和 Markov 不变量控制的有限搜索界。由此算法最多搜索 O(h²⁴) 个状态；若作者猜测的更强高度界成立，可降到 O(h⁶)，目前只验证了高度不超过 3 的情形。另构造每个 n≥4 上一族展示其集合不具半代数性。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 展示组合代数中的判定问题如何转化为有限搜索，并区分定理与猜想。
entries.pragmatic_review: 箭图变异是簇代数中的局部变换；无环性指可变到无有向圈的代表。
entries.cynic_review: 给出明确复杂度界和已验证范围。
entries.paper_review: O(h⁶) 是猜想，算法的实际规模可能很大。
