entries.source_title: PaperFormalizer: Author-in-the-Loop Autoformalization of Research Papers in Lean
entries.source_excerpt: Even a carefully proofread paper can leave small gaps in its proofs or its stated assumptions. We introduce PaperFormalizer, a Lean-based agentic pipeline that helps authors find and close such gaps in their own papers and turn each paper into a Lean-verified version. Starting from the LaTeX source, PaperFormalizer transcribes the paper into a dependency graph of statements, audits each statement in natural language for faithfulness, ambiguity and correctness, and then formalizes and proves the statements in Lean against Mathlib, optional domain libraries and the author's personal toolkit. Only the author knows what a statement is meant to say and how a formalization gap in a result is best fixed. The pipeline therefore stops and asks the author whenever a statement admits more than one reading, presents every repair, in natural language and TeX symbols, as a proposal that the author can accept, decline or redirect, and leaves to the author every decision that could potentially change what the paper claims. entries.source_title: The length of the longest path in random acyclic orientations of a complete multipartite graph
entries.source_excerpt: We study the distribution of the length of the longest path in a uniformly random acyclic orientation of a complete multipartite graph. We derive an explicit analytic expression for the probability generating function of the longest path length, and, for an arbitrary fixed number of parts of equal size, we apply analytic combinatorics in several variables to obtain asymptotics (as the part size tends toward infinity) for its mean longest path length.

entries.source_title: STaSBO: LLM-Guided Strategy Planning and Configuration Selection for Bayesian Optimization
entries.source_excerpt: Bayesian optimization (BO) enables sample-efficient search for expensive black-box problems, but its performance depends strongly on surrogate-acquisition configurations whose suitability varies across problems and optimization states. We take a significant step toward LLM-driven strategic management of BO with STaSBO, a task-agnostic meta-controller that plans search behavior and jointly selects surrogate-acquisition configurations, while numerical BO retains responsibility for probabilistic modeling and candidate generation. STaSBO comprises two coordinated stages: strategy planning and strategy-guided configuration selection. A structured memory system connects prior plans, configuration selections, and candidate behaviors to optimization states, allowing the controller to revise its trajectory summary and behavioral plans during planning. To navigate the large joint configuration space, the selection stage shortlists configurations using surrogate fit evidence. entries.source_title: A note on the rectangular Schoenberg-Whitney theorem for clamped B-splines
entries.source_excerpt: Wang et al.(Computer-Aided Design 40 (2008) 999-1008) proposed a knot-subsequence characterization of full row rank for rectangular B-spline collocation matrices. We identify an incorrect inequality in their Appendix proof, which invalidates the argument as written, and make explicit the endpoint and multiplicity conventions on which the criterion depends. The defect lies in the proof, not in the underlying result, which is valid under suitably stated hypotheses; in the lofting construction of Wang et al. these hypotheses are implicitly satisfied, so the lofted curves are unaffected. We state the corrected result and give a new proof, independent of the disputed argument, for clamped B-splines of arbitrary degree with continuous interior multiplicities. In our proof, sufficiency follows from inclusion of spline spaces and knot insertion; necessity selects independent columns and builds the reduced knot vector from them. The proof uses no recursive column-selection construction.
entries.title_zh: 夹持 B 样条矩形 Schoenberg–Whitney 定理的一则说明
entries.summary_zh: 作者指出 2008 年工作附录证明中有一处不等式错误，但问题在证明而非定理本身；在明确端点和节点重数约定后，原秩判据仍在相应假设下成立，原 lofting 构造不受影响。论文为任意次数、内部连续重数的夹持 B 样条给出独立新证明，充分性用样条空间包含与节点插入，必要性由独立列构造缩减节点向量。

entries.source_title: A hybridization-derived interior penalty Nitsche method for heterogeneous and anisotropic diffusion
entries.source_excerpt: We develop an interior penalty Nitsche finite element formulation for heterogeneous and anisotropic diffusion problems, which is derived from an interior-penalty stabilized Lagrange multiplier method. A distinctive feature of the derived method is that it simultaneously combines two popular stabilization strategies: (i) a boundary penalty mechanism similar to Nitsche's methods and (ii) an interior penalty mechanism as for Continuous Interior Penalty (CIP) methods. Furthermore, the normal component of the numerical flux is single-valued across the mesh skeleton and available in closed form. We establish the equivalence between the hybridized Lagrange multiplier formulation and its condensed Interior Penalty Nitsche (IPN) form, and we deliver the stability and convergence analysis of the latter. For sufficiently regular solutions, we establish energy-norm error estimates for the three symmetry variants. entries.title_zh: 异质各向异性扩散的混合化内罚 Nitsche 方法
entries.summary_zh: 论文从混合化的拉格朗日乘子稳定方法推导异质、各向异性扩散的内罚 Nitsche 有限元形式，同时结合边界罚项和类似连续内罚法的内部稳定项，并得到网格骨架上单值且可显式计算的法向数值通量。作者证明混合形式与消元后的 IPN 形式等价并分析稳定性与收敛：三种对称性变体都有能量范数误差界；在分片椭圆正则条件下，对称变体的 L² 估计最优，非对称和不完全变体损失半阶。

entries.source_title: Gaps for PLRS with zero coefficients
entries.source_excerpt: Zeckendorf proved that every positive integer has a unique decomposition as a sum of non-adjacent Fibonacci numbers. Among its extensions, we focus on Positive Linear Recurrence Sequences (PLRS): fixed depth recurrences with non-negative integral coefficients whose first and last terms are positive: $G_{n+1} = c_1 G_n + \dots + c_L G_{n-L+1}$ with $c_i$ non-negative integers and $c_1 c_L \ge 1$. We again find every integer can be written uniquely as an appropriate sum of terms of the sequence, and we can study the distribution of gaps between summands in decompositions. Bower et al. (2015) proved that if each $c_i \ge 1$ then the distribution of gaps in the generalized Zeckendorf decompositions of integers in $[G_n, G_{n+1})$ converges to a geometric decay for gaps at least two. What if some of the $c_i$'s are allowed to be zero? To date only the Kangaroo case, where there is a fixed $g$ such that $c_i = 1$ if $i \equiv 1 \bmod g$ and 0 otherwise, has been done and again geometric behavior emerges. entries.title_zh: 含零系数 PLRS 的表示间隙
entries.summary_zh: 论文从 Zeckendorf 唯一表示推广到系数非负、首尾系数非零的正线性递推序列（PLRS），研究表示项之间间隙的分布。已有结果指出所有系数为正时，长度区间内较大间隙呈几何衰减；零系数情形此前主要处理 Kangaroo 序列，而本文摘要提出进一步研究一般零系数模式，但提供的摘录在新结果前截断，故无法确认其定理。

entries.source_title: Littlestone Dimension and Its Dual
entries.source_excerpt: The dual Littlestone dimension of a concept class $\mathcal{H}\subseteq\{0,1\}^{\mathcal{X}}$, $\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H}):=\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H}^*)$, is the Littlestone dimension of the dual class $\mathcal{H}^*$, obtained by exchanging the roles of domain points and hypotheses. A classical result of Shelah implies that $\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})$ and $\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H})$ are finite simultaneously, and quantitative results of Hodges [Mathematika, 1981] imply the doubly exponential bound $\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})\le 2^{2^{O(\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H}))}}$. Malliaris and Moran [Trans. Amer. Math. Soc., 2024] asked whether this bound is optimal. We answer this by proving the improved bound \[ \operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})\le 2^{O(\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H})^2)}. \] An exponential dependence is necessary, as witnessed by the class of all binary hypotheses on a finite domain.
entries.title_zh: Littlestone 维数及其对偶
entries.summary_zh: 对偶 Littlestone 维数交换概念类中对象与假设的角色。本文把此前关于两种维数同时有限的双指数上界改进为 Ldim(H)≤2^{O(Ldim*(H)^2)}，回答了该上界是否最优的问题，给出更紧的定量关系。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: Littlestone 维数刻画在线学习可实现的学习复杂度，改进对偶维数上界有助于理解概念类结构。

entries.source_title: Multilevel Monte Carlo methods for random nonlinear eigenvalue problems
entries.source_excerpt: We develop a multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) estimator to compute statistical quantities of interest of solutions to parameter-dependent nonlinear eigenvalue problems. The main difficulty for this problem is that parametrized eigenpairs often lack a globally well-defined parameter-to-solution map due to crossings and bifurcations. These phenomena render eigenvalue-tracking infeasible in multi-dimensional parameter domains. To overcome this issue, we propose both an Eulerian and a Lagrangian perspective on parameter-to-solution maps for nonlinear eigenvalue problems, which remain well-defined even in the presence of local crossings and bifurcations. Their implementation is based on a straightforward modification of Beyn's contour integral approach. Building on these maps, we propose an MLMC estimator that does not rely on matching eigenvalues or eigenvectors across samples or discretization levels. Nested approximation spaces and inter-level prolongation are only required when statistical quantities of interest related to the eigenspaces are of interest, but not for quantities of interest related to the eigenvalues. entries.source_title: The square achievement game on $n \times n$ boards
entries.source_excerpt: Two players alternately claim cells of an $n \times n$ grid; the first to hold all four corners of an axis-parallel square wins, and a full board without one is a draw. The first player has a winning strategy if and only if $n \ge 5$, which answers a question of Erickson. For $n \ge 6$ one strategy serves every board: a rule with no lookup table whose moves after the second reply are all forcing, built around the plus, a stone with the four cells at a common distance from it along the axes, a shape proposed for this game by Sirgedas in 2010. The rule is checked on the boards of size $6$ to $17$, and a simulation theorem carries one checked run on the $23 \times 23$ board to every larger board. The proofs are formalized in Lean 4, and the theorem for the rule states that the tree of its own moves is winning.
entries.title_zh: n×n 棋盘上的正方形占点博弈
entries.summary_zh: 两名玩家轮流占据 n×n 网格的格子，先集齐某个轴平行正方形四角者获胜，填满棋盘仍无正方形则平局；论文证明先手当且仅当 n≥5 有制胜策略，回答了 Erickson 的问题。对 n≥6，作者给出统一无查表规则，并以“加号形”结构组织着法，6 至17 阶棋盘用程序检查，再通过模拟定理把 23×23 棋盘的一次验证推广到所有更大棋盘；证明已形式化为 Lean 4 定理，但具体规则仍需读正文。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合组合博弈与形式化数学读者，案例展示有限计算如何与归纳模拟定理及 Lean 证明结合。

entries.source_title: Relational Semantics and Completeness for Onto-Epistemic Logic
entries.source_excerpt: This paper investigates a relational semantics for onto-epistemic logic with two semi-negations. The frames carry two pairs of quasi-orders and two commuting involutions. Some frames have nondistributive lattices of stable sets. The four- and nine-valued entailments are recovered as joint entailment on two particular finite frames. Sound and complete binary consequence calculi are given for both component entailments and for joint entailment. The joint Lindenbaum algebra embeds subdirectly into the product of its two component quotients. This embedding shows that joint derivability is the intersection of the two component derivability relations. The finite model property is proved using Dedekind-MacNeille completion and a filter-ideal representation of the resulting lattice. All three entailments are decidable by interleaving the search for a derivation with the search for a finite countermodel.

entries.source_title: Rethinking Offline On-Policy Distillation: From Scalar Advantages to Distributional Supervision
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities through token-level feedback on student-generated trajectories, but repeatedly evaluating fresh rollouts with the teacher is computationally expensive. Offline methods such as Lightning OPD reduce this cost by caching recorded tokens' teacher log-probabilities on fixed reference rollouts. By extending the idea to a multi-turn agentic search setup, we find that it consistently underperforms the SFT starting point trained by the same teacher. We empirically observe greater teacher--reference mismatch than in mathematical reasoning and post-training distributional flattening, and theoretically show that scalar advantage supervision on fixed rollouts admits solutions with flattened output distributions under suitable conditions. Motivated by these findings, we propose Distributional On-Policy Distillation (DistOPD), a simple yet effective offline OPD method that retains candidate-token probabilities from both reference and teacher at selected positions and aggregates the remaining parts into a residual token. On agentic search, DistOPD achieves performance comparable to online OP

entries.source_title: Bridging Badiou's Gaps: Topos Theory and the Bodies of Mathematical Expression
entries.source_excerpt: This article develops a second stage of an argument begun in 2013, revisiting Alain Badiou's use of topos theory in Being and Event and Logics of Worlds. The previous article diagnosed Badiou's reduction of topos theory to its atomistic, localic form as the scientific scapegoat in his attack on 'democratic materialism'. Now I ask what follows when this logicist illusion is dispelled and the categorical alternative is taken seriously, particularly with respect to forcing, semantic expression, and mathematical subjectification that constitute the key elements of Badiou's earlier work. I thus reconstruct Badiou's own arguments in a corrected form, while transferring them to a categorical framework. The aim is not to introduce new mathematical results, but to identify what is conceptually lost through their reduction to set-theoretic formalism. In particular, I describe Cohen's forcing argument in the context of Grothendieck topoi and Kripke-Joyal semantics, thereby explicating the geometric structures implicit in Badiou's thinking. This reconstruction further brings into view a different way of understanding Badiou's concepts of subjec
entries.title_zh: 弥合巴迪欧理论的缺口：拓扑斯理论与数学表达的主体
entries.summary_zh: 本文继续一项关于 Alain Badiou 如何使用拓扑斯理论的哲学研究，批评其将拓扑斯约化为原子化的局部拓扑斯形式，并转而采用范畴论框架重构相关论证。文章讨论 forcing、语义表达和数学主体化等概念，作者明确表示目标是分析概念损失而非提出新的数学定理。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关注数学哲学、范畴论思想史及 Badiou 著作中数学使用方式的读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 文章可帮助理解拓扑斯理论在当代哲学论证中的概念角色。
entries.cynic_review: 这是哲学性重构，不能当作拓扑斯理论的新数学结果。
entries.paper_review: 主要贡献是概念分析与论证重述，数学技术贡献有限。

entries.source_title: Antidirected paths on five vertices in 5-chromatic digraphs
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that every 5-chromatic digraph containing no copy of the regular tournament on five vertices contains both antidirected paths on five vertices. This answers a question posed by El Sahili in 2004. The proof uses an edge bound for 5-critical graphs to constrain the out-degrees in a counterexample and obtain a contradiction by constructing a proper 4-colouring.
entries.title_zh: 5-色有向图中必含两种五顶点反向有向路径
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明：若一个 5-色有向图不含五顶点正则锦标赛，则必同时含有两种不同的五顶点反向有向路径，回答了 El Sahili 于 2004 年提出的问题。证明用 5-critical 图的边数界限制反度数，并由假设构造矛盾性的 4-着色。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 有向图着色和禁子图研究者可关注该长期问题的解决。
entries.pragmatic_review: 图论理论结论明确，主要价值在着色与路径结构。
entries.cynic_review: 直接回答旧问题，证明路线通过临界图度数转化清楚。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出命题和核心反证工具，细节需读证明。

entries.source_title: On $(\Sigma^2_1)^{uB}$ Absoluteness Between V and HOD
entries.source_excerpt: We put together Woodin's $\Sigma^2_1$ basis theorem of AD$^+$ and Vop\v{e}nka's theorem to conclude the following: If there is a proper class of Woodin cardinals, then every $(\Sigma^2_1)^{\mbox{uB}}$ statement that is true in $V$ is true in $\mbox{HOD}$. Moreover, this is true even if we allow a parameter $C \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ such that $C$ and its complement have scales that are $\mbox{OD}$ and universally Baire. We also investigate whether $(\Sigma^2_1)^{\mbox{uB}}$ statements are upwards absolute from $\mbox{HOD}$ to $V$ under large cardinal hypotheses, observing that this is true if $\mbox{HOD}$ has a proper class of Woodin cardinals. Finally, we discuss $(\forall^{\mathbb{R}})\, (\Sigma^2_1)^{\mbox{uB}}$ absoluteness and conclude that this much absoluteness between $\mbox{HOD}$ and $V$ cannot be implied by any large cardinal axiom consistent with the axiom ``$V =$ Ultimate $L$''.
entries.title_zh: V 与 HOD 之间的 Σ²₁ᵘᴮ 绝对性
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究带 universally Baire 参数的 Σ²₁ᵘᴮ 语句在宇宙 V 与 HOD 之间的绝对性，并证明在存在真类 Woodin 基数等强大基数假设下的向下绝对性。结果同时讨论更强绝对性原则的限制；它依赖高阶集合论大基数公理，不是 ZFC 下无条件结论。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 研究描述集合论、大基数与内模型的读者可关注。
entries.pragmatic_review: 高度专门的集合论结果，适用读者很有限。
entries.cynic_review: 假设强度写在前面，不能把相对结果说成无条件事实。
entries.paper_review: 摘要说明绝对性形式与大基数背景，技术定义需读全文。

We give preference to applicants in areas of pure and applied mathematics. Applicants […]

entries.source_title: Probabilistic large deviations approach to obstacle Hamilton-Jacobi equations
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we derive a non-classical variational representation of a viscosity solution of a Hamilton-Jacobi equation with obstacle, in which the Hamiltonian may take infinite values. We study a nonlinear selection-mutation model with an exponential-decay mutation kernel, using a probabilistic Feynman-Kac representation of a pure jump process. To handle the singular character of this process, we rely on a non-standard tool from large deviations theory, which allows us to establish a Varadhan-type lemma. This, in turn, yields the variational representation of the viscosity solution.
entries.title_zh: 障碍 Hamilton–Jacobi 方程的大偏差概率方法
entries.summary_zh: 论文为 Hamiltonian 可取无穷值的障碍型 Hamilton–Jacobi 方程导出一种非经典变分表示。对带指数衰减突变核的非线性选择—突变模型，作者用纯跳过程的 Feynman–Kac 表示，并借助大偏差中的非标准工具证明 Varadhan 型引理，从而得到黏性解的变分表示。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合黏性解、大偏差和群体演化建模读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 处理无限值 Hamiltonian 与奇异跳过程的结合。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要侧重表示公式，数值方法和解的应用未展示。
entries.paper_review: 论证工具链和目标结论清楚。

entries.source_title: Chain-of-Thought Controllability Can Reduce Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
entries.source_excerpt: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising tool for detecting hidden goals, off-task behavior, and other failures in AI agents. One risk is that models could deliberately shape their reasoning to make it opaque to monitors. We stress-test this risk through persona-control training: supervised fine-tuning on mathematical reasoning traces rewritten in the voices of diverse personas. This induces a broader ability to control CoT, even though training contains no monitor-evasion examples. In covert side-task evaluations, traces in which a gpt-oss-20b model organism completes the hidden side task contain less monitorable evidence than the base model's. Averaged across evaluations and CoT lengths, weighted by side-task-success counts, the CoT monitorability metric g-mean$^2$ falls from 0.94 for the base model to 0.68 for the model organism without a hiding instruction, and to 0.22 when explicitly instructed to hide. In intervention evaluations, explicit hiding often drives monitorability near zero. The effect extends to a Kimi-K2.6 model organism in agentic environments, though hidden objectives requiring extended reasoning or longer
entries.title_zh: 思维链可控性可能降低思维链可监测性
entries.summary_zh: 论文实验发现，对数学思维轨迹进行 persona 微调可使评测中的可监测性由 0.94 降至 0.68；加入明确隐藏要求后降至 0.22，并在 Kimi 模型上扩展测试。结果提示让模型更听从指定推理风格可能同时让安全监测更困难，但数字依赖特定模型、任务与监测器设置。

entries.source_title: Pole rigidity in root-optimal rational approximation of the exponential on infinite sectors
entries.source_excerpt: The optimal root convergence factor for uniform rational approximation of the exponential on an infinite sector is classical. We prove that, for every fixed infinite sector of opening less than $\pi$, the normalized pole-counting measures of any reduced root-optimal sequence, after scaling the poles by degree, converge weakly to a uniquely determined probability measure supported on a compact analytic arc outside the sector. For the half-line, the corresponding pole law was previously announced by Stahl and Schmelzer; our new result covers sectors of positive opening. The proof rules out boundary pole accumulation and controls an exponentially small Hermite residual through reflection and noncancellation, without assuming interpolation or orthogonality. We explicitly construct the equilibrium measure and its supporting arc in terms of a zero of a Ferrers function, and relate this parameterization to the Gonchar--Rakhmanov theta equation. We also obtain a degree-independent comparison for simultaneous approximation of finitely many $\varphi$-functions with a common denominator. Numerical pole distributions support the theoretical law.
entries.title_zh: 无穷扇区上指数函数根最优有理逼近的极点刚性
entries.summary_zh: 对开角小于 π 的任意固定无穷扇区，论文证明任一约化根最优有理逼近序列的归一化极点计数测度，在按次数缩放后弱收敛到扇区外一条解析弧上的唯一概率测度。新结果把此前半直线情形推广到正开角扇区，并构造相应平衡测度；证明不假设插值或正交性，数值极点分布与理论规律相符。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 给根最优逼近的极点分布建立唯一极限规律，并推广经典半直线结果。
entries.pragmatic_review: 对高精度有理逼近和数值稳定性分析有理论意义。
entries.cynic_review: 结论适用于固定扇区且开角小于 π 的根最优序列。
entries.paper_review: 补足扇区情形并给出显式极限测度，是清晰的理论推广。

entries.source_title: Gopakumar-Vafa invariants and Mordell-Weil lattices
entries.source_excerpt: Let $X\to B$ be a Weierstrass fibration with integral fibers from a smooth Calabi--Yau threefold to a del Pezzo surface. For a smooth curve $D\subset B$ with smooth inverse image $Y$, we decompose the moduli fiber of stable sheaves with Euler characteristic one and projected cycle $D$. In fiber degree $k$, its components are indexed by all sections $C$ of $Y\to D$ with $\tfrac12\langle C,C\rangle\leq k$, where $\langle\, ,\,\rangle$ is the Mordell--Weil height pairing. For infinitesimally rigid sections we compute the GV contributions, recovering the $E_8$ theta product over a $(-1)$-curve. We formulate the corresponding conjecture for families of sections.
entries.title_zh: Gopakumar–Vafa 不变量与 Mordell–Weil 格
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究 Calabi–Yau 三维簇到 del Pezzo 曲面的 Weierstrass 纤维化，并按椭圆曲面截面的 Mordell–Weil 高度配对分解稳定层模空间的分支。对无穷小刚性的截面，作者计算其 GV 不变量贡献，并在一条 (-1) 曲线上恢复 E₈ theta 乘积；更一般截面族的对应公式仍以猜想形式提出。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数几何与弦论计数不变量研究者，展示 Mordell–Weil 格如何组织曲线计数。
entries.pragmatic_review: 与特定 Calabi–Yau 纤维化相关，主要价值在结构与计数公式。
entries.cynic_review: 刚性截面的贡献是计算结果，推广到截面族的部分尚属猜想。
entries.paper_review: 摘要提供模空间分解和一个明确恢复公式，适用几何条件较专门。

entries.source_title: LEAN: Loss-Engineered Modulation of the Model Weight-Sensitivity Distribution for Efficient, Error-Tolerant Neural Networks
entries.source_excerpt: The weights of a trained network do not have uniform sensitivity to model accuracy: the 1% most sensitive weights carry about a fifth of the damage a bit flip can do. This distribution decides the bit-flip tolerance of a model, the fraction of weights a code must cover and the bits each weight needs; existing schemes work with the distribution training leaves. We show that we can systematically modulate or alter the weight sensitivity distribution of a trained model, thereby shifting weights from one sensitivity bin to another. The sensitivity of a stored weight is the product of its gradient and the step a flip takes in the storage format, and LEAN adds a composite regularizer on both factors, a range term that bounds the flip step and a tail term that lowers the gradient of the most sensitive weights, with one coefficient {\lambda} setting how far the distribution moves. Ten epochs with the term, as a fine-tune or as the last epochs of training, shrink the sensitive tail 5 to 13 times on nine vision models (ResNet-18, ResNet-50, VGG-16 on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ImageNet) within 0.5 points of accuracy; real flips confirm that the resha
entries.title_zh: LEAN：通过损失设计调节网络权重敏感度
entries.summary_zh: 论文指出神经网络权重对精度的敏感度分布高度不均：最敏感的 1% 权重可承载约五分之一的位翻转损害，而这决定存储纠错码需要保护哪些权重和位数。LEAN 在训练损失中加入调节项，主动改变权重敏感度分布，把权重从高敏感区转移，以期降低硬件位翻转风险和纠错开销；具体可靠性收益须结合存储格式与测试条件评估。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把模型训练目标与部署时的存储容错需求直接连接，而非只在训练后被动纠错。
entries.pragmatic_review: 面向存储噪声敏感的边缘或高密度部署环境。
entries.cynic_review: 敏感度转移可能与任务精度、模型规模及位翻转模式存在权衡。
entries.paper_review: 从敏感度统计出发设计损失，针对性明确。

entries.source_title: Rank Functions of Flag Matroids with Applications to Order-Neutral Submodular Valuations
entries.source_excerpt: We provide a rank function axiomatization for flag matroids and show that it is cryptomorphic to the definition of flag matroids as a sequence of matroid quotients. Afterwards, we present some applications of flag matroid rank functions by providing solutions to selected problems. In particular, we discuss connections between flag matroids and submodular valuations in computational economics by showing that rank functions of flag matroids of length $k$ are precisely the same as $\{0, 1, \dots, k\}$-order-neutral submodular valuations. We then prove that $v:2^E\to \mathbb{R}$ is an order-neutral submodular valuation if and only if $v$ can be written as $v(X) = b|X| + \sum_{i=1}^l c_ir_{N_i}(X), \quad b \in \mathbb{R}, c_i > 0$, where $N_{i+1}$ is a quotient of $N_i$. Doing so allows us to prove that every order-neutral submodular valuation is a gross-substitute valuation and that not every order-neutral submodular valuation is a Rado valuation. Furthermore, we prove that if $|E|\geq 3$, then a set $A$ is a Sidon set if and only if all $A$-submodular valuations are order-neutral, if and only if all $A$-submodular valuations are gross-su
entries.title_zh: 旗拟阵秩函数及其在次模估值中的应用
entries.summary_zh: 论文为旗拟阵建立秩函数公理化描述，并证明它与“拟阵商序列”的定义等价。作者将其联系到计算经济学中的次模估值，刻画长度 k 的旗拟阵秩函数与取值在 0 到 k 的阶中性次模估值之间的对应，并证明这类估值是 gross-substitute 估值，但一般不必是 Rado 估值。

entries.source_title: PORA: Learning When More Reasoning Pays Off for LLM Agents
entries.source_excerpt: LLM agents perform tasks over multiple steps and revise their actions based on feedback. As the total reasoning budget is often limited and must support future steps, the agent must choose between short and long reasoning before each action. Longer reasoning may improve the final task outcome by preventing later errors, but it also uses budget capacity that may be needed for future decisions. This creates two challenges: estimating the downstream value of long reasoning and deciding when that value is worth using the remaining budget. We propose Paired Outcome-guided Reasoning Allocation (PORA), which learns this decision by comparing short and long reasoning from the same interaction state. During training, \method{} completes the task twice from each selected state, once with a short reasoning allowance and once with a long allowance, and compares their final quality and total processing to estimate when longer reasoning is valuable. During inference, a controller weighs this estimate against learned prices on remaining-budget pressure and chooses either short or long reasoning without running both alternatives. entries.title_zh: PORA：让智能体判断何时值得多推理

entries.source_title: Effectively nuclear C*-algebras
entries.source_excerpt: We study the computable content of nuclearity for $C^*$-algebras. We show that nuclearity effectivizes automatically: a presentation of a $C^*$-algebra is effectively nuclear, in the sense that the completely positive approximations witnessing nuclearity can be computed uniformly from the data they approximate, if and only if it is a computable presentation of a nuclear $C^*$-algebra, and likewise for the effectivization of the Choi--Effros form of nuclearity. The main tool is an effective version of the Arveson extension theorem: we prove that the $n$-th matrix numerical range of a tuple from a computable presentation is computably compact, uniformly in all of its data, and deduce an algorithm which converts an approximately attainable tuple of matrices into a computable unital completely positive map attaining it. A byproduct is that the computable states of any computable presentation of a unital $C^*$-algebra are weak$^*$-dense in its state space. entries.source_title: Vector bundles on spin K\"ahler surfaces and the multi-spinor Seiberg-Witten equations
entries.source_excerpt: We compute new lower bounds on the second Chern class of a vector bundle $\mathscr{E}$ on a spin K\"ahler surface $X$ that satisfies $c_1(\mathscr{E}) = 0$ and $H^2(\text{End}_0\mathscr{E}) = 0.$ When $X$ is a regular elliptic surface and $\mathscr{E}$ has rank 2, our bound is sharp. Our technique is to use Furuta's finite-dimensional approximation on the multi-spinor Seiberg-Witten equations, together with their algebro-geometric interpretation by the second named author. We also use these techniques to prove an existence theorem for singular Fueter sections and multi-spinor Seiberg-Witten solutions that holds for every Riemannian metric on a large class of 4-manifolds.

entries.source_title: Base-extension Semantics for Intuitionistic Predicate Logic
entries.source_excerpt: Sandqvist's base-extension semantics explains the logical constants of intuitionistic propositional logic by inference in bases: collections of rules over atomic sentences that record the inferential content of a state of affairs. We extend it to intuitionistic predicate logic, first- and second-order, reading the quantifiers substitutionally, and prove natural deduction sound and complete. Two ideas carry the extension. First, a rule of a base may require a premiss to be established for a fresh name, one about which neither the assumptions nor the base say anything. With such rules, Sandqvist's completeness proof extends to first-order logic, whether validity is taken over all bases or over finite ones. Second, the second-order quantifier ranges over the atomic predicates, and validity is support in comprehensive bases, where every expressible condition has a definitional proxy. This yields intuitionistic Henkin second-order logic with full comprehension, not full second-order semantics.
entries.title_zh: 直觉主义谓词逻辑的基扩张语义

entries.source_title: Polar: A Benchmark for Evaluating Political Bias in LLMs
entries.source_excerpt: Political bias in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly significant, but difficult to measure reproducibly across political and linguistic contexts. We introduce Polar, a 4,026-instance multiple-choice benchmark that measures political bias through option-level likelihoods rather than prompt-based generation. Polar covers two ideological axes and eight issue categories derived from the Manifesto Project, and evaluates models in parallel across U.S. and South Korean political contexts. Across 38 LLMs, measured bias varies systematically with political context, issue category, model group, and presentation language. All models lean left-progressive on U.S. political content, but show more centered and mixed patterns on South Korean content. Translation experiments further show that presentation language alone can shift measured bias. These findings highlight the need for multilingual and cross-contextual evaluation of political bias in LLMs. The code and dataset are publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/mcrl/Polar) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/thunder-research-group/Polar).
entries.title_zh: Polar：评测大型语言模型政治偏见的跨语境基准

entries.source_title: Percolation on Bidirected Graphs
entries.source_excerpt: We study bidirected percolation on an undirected graph $G$: each edge is replaced by two oppositely directed edges, each of which is open independently with probability $p$. Two vertices are strongly connected if they are mutually reachable by open directed paths. Let $p_\mathrm{sc}$ denote the threshold for the existence of an infinite strongly connected cluster, and let $p_c$ denote the usual Bernoulli percolation threshold on $G$. On every transitive amenable graph, we prove that $p_\mathrm{sc}=p_c$. In contrast, sufficiently spread-out modifications of every transitive non-amenable graph satisfy $p_\mathrm{sc}>p_c$. We also show that, on $\mathbb Z^d$ with $d\ge11$, the expected size of the strongly connected cluster is finite at $p=p_\mathrm{sc}$.

entries.source_title: What RL Brings to Reasoning: A Few Decisions the Base Model Would Not Make
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) substantially improves mathematical reasoning, but what it adds to the base model remains unclear. We investigate this through a sequence of generation-time interventions on Qwen3-4B-Base, measuring how much of its RL-trained counterpart's gain each intervention recovers on 120 AIME problems. Power sampling with the same 8,192-token output limit brings no gain beyond greedy decoding. Yet borrowing the RL model's token only where the two models' greedy choices differ, roughly 4% of generated positions, recovers 90.5% of the pass@1 gain, with similar recovery across three model pairs on MATH-500. We find that even a single opening token has a substantial effect: forcing the base model to begin with "Alright" recovers 35% of the RL gain. The opening alone is insufficient, however. Later replacements after the same opening add another 5.2 percentage points to pass@1, and the fixed rules we test for inserting reflective words such as "Wait" do not reproduce this benefit. Sparse replacement also retains much of the base model's diversity while staying close to the RL model at pass@1. At
entries.title_zh: 强化学习为推理带来了什么：基座模型原本不会做的少数决策

entries.source_title: Couplings with prescribed maxima: A short proof of the quasi-copula characterization
entries.source_excerpt: We provide a short probabilistic proof of the classical characterization of multivariate quasi-copulas, addressing the call for a simpler and more transparent proof expressed by Sempi (2017). Our approach is based on a coupling construction for random variables with fixed marginal distributions and a prescribed distribution of their maximum. In our main result, we show that such a coupling exists if and only if the maximum is stochastically no smaller than each component and the distribution of the maximum is dominated by the sum of the marginal measures. The construction applies to arbitrary distributions and relies only on a decomposition of the maximum law and monotone quantile couplings. A direct consequence of our main result is the existence of copulas with prescribed values along an increasing track.

entries.summary_zh: 论文给出具有固定边缘分布且最大值分布指定的耦合存在性充要条件：最大值随机序不小于任一分量，且其分布测度受边缘测度和支配。方法仅用最大值分布分解与单调分位数耦合，由此获得多元拟 copula 的简短概率证明。

entries.source_title: A Gauge-Invariant Finite Element Method for the Time-Dependent Ginzburg--Landau Equations
entries.source_excerpt: It is well known that the Ginzburg--Landau equations are gauge invariant. The most popular gauge choice in practical simulations is the temporal gauge, also known as the zero electric potential gauge. However, the commonly used N\'ed\'elec approximations may produce spurious giant vortices on domains with re-entrant corners. To address this issue while retaining the N\'ed\'elec approximation, we propose a finite element scheme that preserves the gauge invariance of the time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau equations at the discrete level. Under the temporal gauge, the method employs lowest-order N\'ed\'elec edge elements for the magnetic potential and continuous piecewise-linear elements for the order parameter on triangular and tetrahedral meshes, and yields a linear, decoupled formulation that requires only the solution of linear systems at each time step. We prove that the scheme is gauge invariant, preserves a discrete maximum bound principle for the order parameter, $\|\psi_h^n\|_{L^\infty(\Omega)}\le 1$, and satisfies a discrete energy law under mild step-size and mesh conditions. Numerical experiments confirm these theoretical proper
entries.title_zh: 时间依赖 Ginzburg–Landau 方程的规范不变有限元方法
entries.summary_zh: 作者构造离散层面保持规范不变性的 Ginzburg–Landau 有限元格式，在时间规范下用最低阶 Nédélec 边元表示磁势、连续分片线性元表示序参量，并形成每步只需解线性系统的解耦格式。论文证明序参量离散最大值界 |ψ_h^n|≤1 及温和网格/步长条件下的离散能量律，数值实验验证理论性质并针对再入角可能出现的伪巨型涡旋问题。

entries.source_title: Irreducible components of affine Deligne-Lusztig variety in the affine flag variety
entries.source_excerpt: We establish a bijection between elements of stable Demazure crystals and labeled longest increasing paths in the double Bruhat graph. As an application, we show that the orbits of irreducible components of certain special affine Deligne-Lusztig varieties (ADLVs) in the affine flag variety of a split reductive group are counted by weight multiplicities of the associated Demazure modules for the dual group. By decomposing an arbitrary ADLV into strata that are iterated fibrations over these special ADLVs, we then obtain a formula for the number of orbits of irreducible components for ADLVs in the affine flag variety, generalizing the numerical form of the Chen-Zhu conjecture.
entries.title_zh: 仿射旗簇 Affine Deligne–Lusztig 簇不可约分支轨道计数

entries.source_title: Choice principles in countable partition models
entries.source_excerpt: We study the countable partition model over a set of atoms of arbitrary uncountable cardinality $\kappa$. Its supports are partitions of the atoms into countably many blocks, and a permutation fixes a support when it preserves each block setwise. This model was proposed by Bruce and studied by Banerjee. We prove that dependent choice holds for every $\kappa$, although the filter of subgroups is not closed under countable intersections. Choice for well-orderable families holds exactly when $\kappa<\aleph_{\omega_1}$; when $\kappa\ge\aleph_{\omega_1}$, an $\omega_1$-indexed family witnesses its failure. The Hartogs and Lindenbaum numbers of the set of atoms are both $\omega_1$. The proofs use permutations matching blocks of equal cardinality and establish shift completeness of the filter. Together with Banerjee's failure of $\mathsf{DC}_{\omega_1}$, these results determine which dependent choice principles hold in the model.

entries.source_title: Projected Distillation: On Learning to Solve Hard Problems from Close, Correct Targets
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy learning is central to post-training: training on a model's own generations limits distribution shift and helps preserve existing capabilities. On hard problems, however, on-policy RL provides no reward-based learning signal when all attempts fail. On-policy distillation provides next-token supervision from a teacher, but on hard problems, if a rollout goes wrong early, subsequent supervision is conditioned on prefixes that already contain the mistake. Correct behavior can instead come from a gold or teacher solution, but such off-policy targets can differ substantially from the model's generations and, as we show, may erode existing capabilities. We therefore treat on-policyness as a continuum and propose projected distillation, which minimally edits the student's failed attempts into correct targets. The method uses contrastive updates to favor corrections over failed attempts and refreshes these corrections as the student evolves, enabling near-on-policy learning even when all student attempts fail. entries.source_title: FlashREINFORCE: Critic-Free Single-Rollout Asynchronous RL for Agentic Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: Asynchronous reinforcement learning suits long-horizon agents with irregular rollout times, but group-relative updates require repeated rollouts of each prompt. However, group-based sampling limits prompt coverage at a fixed rollout budget and introduces group synchronization barriers. One rollout per prompt avoids these constraints but removes the variance-reducing group baseline, making updates noisier and more prone to instability on stale, variable-length trajectories. We present FlashREINFORCE, a critic-free, one-pass framework built on One-Batch REINFORCE, a Sequence Trust Region, and Sample-Mean Optimization. These components preserve prompt coverage and signed feedback while controlling policy drift and length-amplified negative updates. In our experiments, FlashREINFORCE remains stable through 6,000 updates on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B at a policy lag of approximately four updates. On Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, it reaches 38.0 mean accuracy across five benchmarks, outperforming the reported GRPO baseline by 1.7 percentage points with half the rollouts (256k versus 512k). Python-tool experiments extend to the 30B MoE model Qwen3-3

entries.source_title: Uniform convergence at optimal rate and scale
entries.source_excerpt: Uniform convergence asks how many random samples suffice for empirical averages to approximate expectations simultaneously over an entire class of functions. It is a central concept in probability and a foundation of statistical learning. For binary-valued classes, the Vapnik--Chervonenkis theorem characterizes uniform convergence by finiteness of the VC dimension. For dimension $d$, the sharp worst-case sample complexity for additive error $\varepsilon$ is of order $d/\varepsilon^2$. For real-valued functions, the analogous combinatorial parameter is the fat-shattering dimension, which depends on an approximation scale $\gamma$. The challenge is to achieve error $\gamma+\varepsilon$ with order $d/\varepsilon^2$ samples, matching the sample bound for binary classes, where $d$ is now the fat-shattering dimension at scale $\gamma$. Previous results achieved either the optimal scale or the optimal sample complexity, but not both. Our main result closes this gap, establishing the sharp sample complexity at the optimal scale. entries.source_title: A quaternary Diophantine inequality with prime numbers of a special form (II)
entries.source_excerpt: Let $N$ be a sufficiently large real number. In this paper, it is proved that, for $1<\frac{5179}{3909}$ and for any arbitrary large number $E>0$, the Diophantine inequality \begin{equation*} \big|p_1^c+p_2^c+p_3^c+p_4^c-N\big|<(\log N)^{-E} \end{equation*} is solvable in prime variables $p_1,p_2,p_3,p_4$ such that each of the numbers $p_i+2\,(i=1,2,3,4)$ has, counted according to multiplicity, at most $[\frac{31250}{5179-3909c}]$ prime factors, which constitutes a large improvement upon the previous results of Dimitrov [13] and Li-Xue-Zhang [22], respectively.

entries.source_title: Non-aware computable presentations of randomizations
entries.source_excerpt: Let 2 be the two-element structure in the empty signature. We build a computable presentation Q of the Borel randomization $2^{[0,1)}$ in which neither constant random variable is a computable point. Consequently, Q is not aware. This gives a negative answer to a question of Cuervo Ovalle and Goldbring \cite{CG}. We also construct a countable structure $M$ with no computable presentation but $M^{[0,1)}$ has a computable presentation. This answers another question and establishes the necessity of the awareness condition stated in one of the main theorems in \cite{CG}.

entries.source_title: Cubic local observability of Gaussian-blind sources in thermal $\phi^4_2$ fields
entries.source_excerpt: We study external sources that are invisible to a spatially local observation in a massive Gaussian thermal field on a circle. A quadratic-reference calibration removes the first-order thermal mass-shift signal. For the resulting quartic model we prove a cutoff-independent, source-uniform $C^1$ expansion of local Wick cubic means. Its leading operator has the time-integrated cube of the thermal covariance as its kernel. A positive bilateral Laplace representation proves injectivity on the entire external source space, while analyticity gives exponential singular-value upper bounds. The expansion yields local Araki relative-entropy lower bounds on every fixed finite-dimensional source space, and a uniform separation theorem at every prescribed Sobolev resolution. Under an additional interval-length condition, a reflection-positivity identity yields an explicit, nonoptimal double-logarithmic conditional stability bound for this specific thermal kernel. Continuum probability estimates and the integrability assumptions of the Feynman--Kac--Nelson construction are verified in Section~3.
entries.title_zh: 热 φ⁴₂ 场中高斯盲源的三次局部可观测性

entries.source_title: Dihedral fields with Bloch lattice index five and quadratic subfield Q(i)
entries.source_excerpt: We construct infinitely many Galois extensions $M/\mathbb{Q}$ with dihedral group of order ten, quadratic subfield $\mathbb{Q}(i)$, and Bloch lattice index $Q_2(M)=5$. More precisely, we specify a Chebotarev set of rational primes of density $1/50$. For every prime $\ell$ in this set, at least two of four mixed cyclic quintic extensions of $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ of conductor $(25\ell)$ have this index and satisfy $K_2(O_M)(5)\simeq(\mathbb{Z}/5)^2$. A two-dimensional cup-product pencil selects the extensions. Generalized Bockstein maps, integral co-descent, and a motivic genus formula then determine the tame kernel and the subfield Bloch-lattice index. The result is unconditional.
entries.title_zh: Bloch 格指标为 5 且二次子域为 Q(i) 的二面体域
entries.summary_zh: 作者无条件构造无穷多个 Galois 扩张 M/Q，其群为阶 10 二面体群、二次子域为 Q(i)，Bloch 格指标 Q₂(M)=5；对应素数来自密度 1/50 的 Chebotarev 集。对其中每个素数，至少两个导子为 (25ℓ) 的混合五次扩张还满足 K₂(O_M)(5) 同构于 (Z/5)²，证明使用 cup-product pencil、Bockstein 映射及积分下降。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数数论读者关注 K₂、Bloch 格与显式 Galois 扩张的交叉构造。

entries.source_title: Training with Ciphers to Enhance In-Context Terminology Learning For Translation from Rare Languages
entries.source_excerpt: Fine-tuning LLMs with in-context examples (IC-Train) lets translation models adapt to new parallel data at deployment, but it is unclear whether they actually learn the translations of rare terms from those examples. We formalize this capability as in-context term learning (ICTL). We show that standard IC-Train develops this capability only weakly, and propose RareCipherFT, which strengthens it without any lexical resources. RareCipherFT pairs each training target with in-context examples that share a rare term with it. It then replaces that term with a character-shuffled cipher in both the context and the reference, so the term can only be recovered by copying from context. The ciphered fraction of training data is annealed to preserve translation quality. Across seven translation directions between English and Tamil, Assamese, Mizo, Nepali and Hausa, and four models from 1B to 7B parameters, RareCipherFT raises term recall over standard IC-Train by 5-15 absolute points without lowering COMET. Probes using synonyms, nonce words and controls for shared surface context show that these gains come from linking source terms to their in-co
entries.title_zh: 通过密码训练增强稀有语言翻译的上下文术语学习
entries.summary_zh: RareCipherFT 在训练中为目标文本和共享稀有词的上下文示例同时替换成字符打乱密码，使模型只能从上下文复制恢复术语，并逐步退火密码比例以保留译文质量。跨英语与泰米尔语、阿萨姆语、米佐语、尼泊尔语、豪萨语的七个翻译方向及 1B–7B 模型，论文报告术语召回率较标准 IC-Train 提升 5–15 个百分点，COMET 未下降。

entries.source_title: Rational analytic prismatization
entries.source_excerpt: We develop a general theory of analytic prismatization with $\mathbb{Q}_p$-coefficients in rigid analytic geometry over $\mathbb{Q}_p$. We prove an equivalence of perfect complexes on the perfect analytic prismatization modulo Frobenius with perfect complexes on the relative Fargues--Fontaine curve for any smooth partially proper rigid analytic variety. In particular, we explain how this equivalence conceptualizes the decompletion techniques by passing to locally analytic vectors which appear in (geometric) Sen theory
entries.title_zh: 有理系数的解析棱柱化理论
entries.summary_zh: 论文在 Q_p 上的刚性解析几何中发展带 Q_p 系数的解析棱柱化理论，并证明对任意光滑、部分适当的刚性解析簇，完美解析棱柱化模 Frobenius 的完美复形范畴等价于相对 Fargues–Fontaine 曲线上的完美复形范畴。该等价也为几何 Sen 理论中通过局部解析向量进行的降完备化技术提供概念解释。

entries.source_title: Cohomology Rings of Fiber Products of Lefschetz Fibrations
entries.source_excerpt: We prove a Lefschetz-type theorem for the cohomology rings of fiber products of two Lefschetz fibrations with disjoint critical loci. As an application, we compute the Hodge numbers of several examples of higher-dimensional Schoen's Calabi-Yau manifolds.
entries.title_zh: Lefschetz 纤维化纤维积的上同调环
entries.summary_zh: 论文为临界点集互不相交的两个 Lefschetz 纤维化的纤维积证明类似 Lefschetz 型的上同调环定理，并用它计算若干高维 Schoen Calabi–Yau 流形的 Hodge 数。该结果把纤维化结构的信息转化为高维复几何拓扑不变量，条件包括临界集互不相交。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 研究 Calabi–Yau 几何、Lefschetz 纤维化和 Hodge 数计算的读者可参考。
entries.pragmatic_review: 为特定高维几何例子提供计算工具，主要面向研究者。
entries.cynic_review: 定理假设清楚，应用只展示若干 Schoen 型例子。
entries.paper_review: 摘要交代环结构定理及 Hodge 数应用，具体条件需核对。

entries.source_title: Pearl-Chat: Engineering a native Luganda language model from first principles in JAX and Flax NNX
entries.source_excerpt: Autoregressive foundation language models predominantly target high-resource Indo-European languages, imposing computational and morphological penalties on under-represented African languages. Generic multilingual tokenizers routinely exceed fertility rates of 3.2 tokens per word on agglutinative Bantu languages, degrading context efficiency and inflating latency. We present Pearl-Chat, an 8,473,122-parameter ($\sim$8.5M) causal decoder-only transformer engineered for Luganda (Oluganda, ISO 639-2: lg), a low-resource Niger-Congo Bantu language spoken by over 10 million people in East Africa. Built from first mathematical principles in JAX and Flax NNX, Pearl-Chat uses explicit functional state decomposition (nnx.split and nnx.merge), deterministic resumable data streaming via Google Grain, and SPMD tensor parallelism using jax.sharding.Mesh. We introduce a byte-level byte-pair encoding (BPE) subword tokenizer trained from scratch on curated Luganda corpora ($V = 8,192$), achieving 4.88 characters per token compression and 1.60 tokens per word fertility, a two-fold compression improvement over LLaMA-3 (128K) and Gemma (256K). The model
entries.title_zh: Pearl-Chat：从头用 JAX/Flax NNX 构建卢干达语模型
entries.summary_zh: 论文介绍约 847 万参数的卢干达语自回归 Transformer，并从卢干达语语料训练 8192 词表的字节级 BPE；报告每词 token fertility 为 1.60、压缩约 4.88 字符/token，改善通用多语 tokenizer 对黏着语的切分效率。实现采用 JAX/Flax NNX、可恢复数据流和张量并行，聚焦低资源语言的本地建模。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合低资源语言 NLP 与小模型工程读者。

entries.title_zh: 非结构网格浅水色散模型的熵稳定分裂方法
entries.summary_zh: 论文为 Serre–Green–Naghdi 浅水模型的温和坡度形式设计熵稳定分裂求解器，把慢速重力波部分写成含被动标量的浅水子系统，把快速色散效应放入声学子系统。该形式保留精确能量方程作为稳定性基础，目标是在非结构网格上高效模拟色散水波；结论针对未包含增强色散项的模型版本。

entries.pragmatic_review: 可作为复杂地形浅水波求解器的算法候选。

entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Rigoberto Flórez , Robinson Higuita-Diaz , José L. Ramírez; Subjects: Number Theory (math.NT); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: Fibonacci 多项式拉普拉斯变换产生的 p 进赋值树
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究序列 e_n=∫₀∞e^(−t)F_n(t)dt 的 p 进赋值树，并否定 Givens 与 Moll 提出的一个开放问题：构造反例表明内部分支不一定简单。作者还把偶、奇子序列的提升判据改写为相关多项式的根与导数条件；简单模 p 根对应简单内部枝，并给出递归提升以逐层确定唯一存活剩余类及相应赋值。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 将特殊函数积分、p 进赋值与多项式根提升联系起来，并给出反例及可操作递归。

entries.title_zh: 稀疏图中有界度割

entries.source_title: 𝜏-Entity: Can voice agents get the details right?
entries.source_excerpt: Sierra 发布 𝜏-Entity 基准，测量语音智能体能否正确采集、识别错误并修复姓名、电话号码、地址和邮箱等细节，包含 10 种实体类型共 200 个任务，并与 𝜏-i18n 一样覆盖六种语言。
entries.title_zh: τ-Entity：语音智能体能否准确记录关键信息？
entries.summary_zh: Sierra 发布 τ-Entity 基准，测试语音代理能否询问并准确记录姓名、电话、地址和邮箱，并在噪声、口音或用户更正下发现和修复错误。作者报告称，GPT Live 1 在常规电话的字段正确率为 60.3%，但同一任务在常规、噪声和语音干扰三种条件都成功的比例为 34%；规定拼读、复述、确认流程可把跨条件成功率提高 14–31 个百分点，却增加约 21–28 秒通话时间。

entries.source_title: An Explicit Construction of Large Families of MSTD Sets
entries.source_excerpt: A finite set $S\subset\mathbb Z$ is more sums than differences (MSTD) if $|S+S|>|S-S|$. Yufei Zhao's bidirectional-ballot construction gives $\Theta(2^N/N)$ MSTD subsets of $[0,N-1]$, the best previously known size bound for an explicit family, to the author's knowledge. We improve this bound: for every fixed integer $T\geq1$, we construct a family of $\Theta_T(2^N/(\log_2^{\circ T} N)^{2^T})$ MSTD subsets, where $\log_2^{\circ T}$ denotes the $T$-fold iterated logarithm. This family is asymptotically larger than Zhao's for every fixed $T\geq1$. A subfamily of the same order of magnitude can be numbered so that any chosen member can be generated deterministically in time polynomial in $N$, without listing preceding members. As a supplementary comparison, replacing the terminal ballot rule by exhaustive fringe search gives a positive-proportion family with the same polynomial-time generation property.
entries.title_zh: 显式构造更大规模的 MSTD 集族
entries.summary_zh: MSTD 集满足 |S+S|>|S−S|，论文改进其显式家族规模：对任意固定整数 T≥1，构造数量为 Θ_T(2ᴺ/(log₂迭代 T 次 N)²ᵀ) 的区间子集，比此前 Θ(2ᴺ/N) 的显式构造渐近更大。作者还说明可对同阶子族编号，以便确定性生成指定成员；结论针对每个固定 T。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 加法组合数论研究者可参考更丰富且可显式生成的特殊集合族。
entries.pragmatic_review: 理论构造推进明确，适用读者主要是加法组合研究者。
entries.cynic_review: 对每个固定迭代次数改进了已知规模，T 不是随 N 任意增长。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出渐近计数与显式构造，常数依赖 T。

entries.source_title: Verified AI just had its greatest month.
entries.source_excerpt: 作者称 Verified AI 迎来标志性月份，Axiom 的 AI 智能体集群用 24 天完成数学史上最长证明的验证，将跨越 500 多篇论文的 15,000 页有限单群分类定理（CFSG）转化为 3800 万行以上机器验证代码，并发现已发表记录中的 34 处严重出入。引用内容补充称该形式化证明可能是最大的开源项目之一，图中显示 Axiom CFSG 达 43.0M 行，约每 37 天翻倍。
entries.title_zh: Axiom 声称完成有限单群分类定理的大规模形式化核验
entries.summary_zh: X 帖转述称，Axiom 使用智能体集群在 24 天内把跨 500 多篇论文、约 15,000 页的有限单群分类（CFSG）论证转成数千万行机器验证代码，并报告发现 34 处已发表材料中的出入。现有材料是社交媒体转述，尚不足以确认形式化覆盖范围、差异严重程度或独立复核状态。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 这是 AI 辅助形式化数学的重要线索；若属实，成果更接近大规模核验工程，而非机器独立发现整套定理。
entries.pragmatic_review: 应追踪 Axiom 原始发布、代码库及数学共同体的复核。
entries.cynic_review: 规模化形式验证可能改变超长证明的可审计性。
entries.paper_review: 关键数字与“严重出入”尚缺可核对的项目报告和独立说明。

entries.source_title: Stabilizing Parabolic Vector Bundles
entries.source_excerpt: For an irreducible parabolic flat vector bundle of rank $r < 2\sqrt{g}$ on a genus $g$ curve, we prove that an analytically general isomonodromic deformation is stable. This refines Landesman-Litt's semistability result for bundles of rank $< 2\sqrt{g+1}$. The proof applies the non-generically globally generated (non-GGG) lemma to establish infinitesimal obstructions to extending destabilizing subbundles of semistable bundles.
entries.title_zh: 稳定化抛物向量丛
entries.summary_zh: 对亏格为 g 曲线上的不可约抛物平坦向量丛，论文证明当秩 r<2√g 时，一般意义下的等单值形变是稳定的。结果细化了此前在较宽秩范围内得到的半稳定性结论，证明利用非一般全局生成引理来阻止不稳定子丛延拓。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 在明确秩界内把形变后的半稳定性提升为稳定性。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于研究平坦联络、向量丛模空间和等单值形变。
entries.cynic_review: 结论只覆盖不可约对象且秩满足给定不等式。
entries.paper_review: 摘要清楚给出改进的参数范围和关键技术引理。

entries.source_title: Decompositions of the diagonal of complete intersections in products of projective spaces
entries.source_excerpt: We study rationality of very general complete intersections in products of projective spaces. By constructing specific reference varieties and apply specialization method in the form of relative torsion orders, we extend the quintic constructions by Hotchkiss and the quartic constructions by B\"ohning, Graf von Bothmer, Pirutka and Zhang to very general complete intersections in products in every characteristic. In particular, we prove that very general quartic hypersurfaces of positive dimension admit no decomposition of the diagonal in every characteristic.
entries.title_zh: 射影空间乘积中完全交的对角分解
entries.summary_zh: 作者用特定参考簇和相对挠率阶的特化方法，研究射影空间乘积中的非常一般完全交，并把既有五次与四次构造推广到任意特征。一个具体结论是：任意正维的非常一般四次超曲面都不存在对角分解；这提供稳定有理性研究中的障碍信息，但摘要没有声称一般完全交均不可有理。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对角分解是研究代数簇稳定有理性的工具，本文扩展了其适用构造。
entries.pragmatic_review: 为识别稳定有理性障碍提供新的特化论证。
entries.cynic_review: 不存在对角分解是特定几何结论，不能等同于完整有理性分类。
entries.paper_review: 任意特征下的推广和四次超曲面结论都值得细读。

entries.source_title: NVIDIA Kumo Relational Outperforms Supervised Machine Learning on Relational Data, No Training Required
entries.title_zh: NVIDIA Kumo Relational：无需任务训练的关系数据预测模型
entries.summary_zh: Kumo Relational 是面向多表关系数据库的预训练模型，通过预测查询从历史上下文样例中推断流失、需求或欺诈等目标，不必先把表展平并手工造特征。厂商报告称，在 15 个数据库、41 项任务中超过所比较的监督式关系学习和特征工程梯度提升基线，并在 SAP SALT 基准上比 AutoGluon 集成高 8% MRR；这些是作者报告的基准结果，部署仍需验证数据泄漏、时序切分和领域迁移。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 可作为关系型企业数据预测的低训练成本候选，需先用自身任务复现基准并评估数据库访问与推理成本。
entries.pragmatic_review: 直接利用表关系有望减少特征工程工作。

entries.source_title: Motivic Borel-Moore Homology is Borel-Moore Motivic Homology
entries.source_excerpt: This paper studies the higher Chow groups of arbitrary finite type separated schemes using motivic homotopy theory, serving as a Borel-Moore counterpart to the $\mathbb{A}^1$-invariant motivic cohomology of Bachmann-Elmanto-Morrow. We construct a filtration on the G-theory spectrum of a finite type separated scheme $X$, inducing an Atiyah-Hirzebruch style spectral sequence whose associated graded pieces are a complex computing the higher Chow groups of $X$. We prove that this complex is representable in the stable motivic homotopy category, and is a module over the $\mathbb{A}^1$-motivic complex, giving rise to an action of $\mathbb{A}^1$-invariant motivic cohomology on the Bloch-Levine cycle complex. This generalizes some results of Bloch and Levine relating higher Chow groups and motivic cohomology to the case of schemes over an arbitrary base, and which need not be smooth or equidimensional.
entries.title_zh: 动机上同调中的 Borel–Moore 同调与 Borel–Moore 动机同调
entries.summary_zh: 论文用动机同伦论研究任意有限型分离概形的高阶 Chow 群，并构造 G-理论谱的过滤及类似 Atiyah–Hirzebruch 的谱序列，其分次部分由计算高阶 Chow 群的复形给出。作者证明该复形可在稳定动机同伦范畴中表示，并获得 A¹ 不变动机上同调对 Bloch–Levine 循环复形的作用，从而把相关结果推广到不要求光滑或等维的概形。

entries.source_title: Quadratic mixing for the Lee--Sidford Dikin walk
entries.source_excerpt: Let $K=\{x\in\R^d:Ax\ge b\}$ be a bounded full-dimensional polytope with $m$ inequalities. For targets on $K$ with density proportional to $\exp(-\vartheta^\transpose x)$, we prove a $\widetilde O(d^2)$ bound, measured in Markov chain iterations, for the chi-square mixing of the $1/2$-lazy Metropolis Dikin walk based on a polylogarithmically rescaled Lee--Sidford metric. The estimate holds for every initial law with finite chi-square divergence. The proof controls the reverse Gaussian proposal through a quantitative average self-concordance estimate at the required $O(1/d)$ scale. We establish this estimate from uniform analytic derivative bounds for the Lewis-weight subspace and an all-order projection-weighted contraction inequality for Gaussian chaoses. For order $j$, the latter bounds each base-point polynomial at scale $d^{j/2}$, up to $j$-dependent and logarithmic factors. Truncating at logarithmic order then absorbs the remaining pathwise loss. entries.title_zh: Lee–Sidford Dikin 随机游走的二次混合时间界

entries.source_title: The geometric expansion of the coarse trace formula of GL(4)
entries.source_excerpt: We study the non-semisimple terms in the geometric side of Arthur's trace formula of $\rm{GL}(4)$ for the further study of the invariant trace formula. After modifying the zeta function and Arthur's definition of the weighted orbital integrals, we compare the two ways to calculate the distributions $J^T(f)$ of the geometric side, we can obtain that the distributions can be written as the linear combanition of the weighted orbital integrals. In particular, we get the coefficients $a^M(S,\gamma)$, for all $\gamma\in \rm{GL}(4,F)$, expressed by the measure and zeta functions.

entries.source_title: Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation of RL Experts: Toward Continual Post-Training
entries.source_excerpt: RL post-training typically produces domain experts that must then be consolidated into one model, and as new experts keep arriving, this consolidation becomes a continual process. Weight merging and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) must re-consolidate the whole model whenever an expert is added, and can erode capabilities outside the target domains. We propose Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation (CSPD), which keeps the pre-RL model frozen, distills each RL expert independently into a soft prompt, and composes experts by concatenating their prompts without joint training. A single soft prompt suffices to distill an RL expert, recovering at least 90% of the teacher's gain in 22 of 23 math, code, and agent settings. Independently trained prompts compose well. In a multi-expert setting, the average rises with every expert added, and the full composition matches MOPD (67.83 vs. 67.79). The composition generalizes best across six held-out benchmarks. entries.source_title: Polynomial Residual Networks are Generically Identifiable
entries.source_excerpt: We prove identifiability results for constant-width residual networks with polynomial activations and bias terms. For activations of degree at least five with generic coefficients, the fiber over a generic parameter is a singleton. For activations of degree at least three with no linear term after a suitable translation of the input, the generic fiber is given by translating biases and then scaling weights and translated biases by real roots of unity. These results specialize to networks without bias terms. With the same proof technique, we further derive necessary conditions for critical points of the ResNet parametrization, that are central in singular learning theory.

entries.source_title: Theoretical Foundations of Computational Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh)
entries.source_excerpt: This paper presents the theoretical foundations and a comprehensive formal system for Computational Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh). We begin by establishing six foundational principles that distinguish computational Fiqh from conventional natural language processing and general theological formalization. These principles define Islamic jurisprudence as a normative deductive science operating on empirically grounded facts, necessitating a dual inductive-deductive methodology, and requiring a logical foundation specifically engineered for Fiqh rather than adopted from existing formalisms. Based on these principles, we construct a three-layer stratified computational language, $\mathcal{F} = D \circ A \circ G$, consisting of: (1) an Arabic Morphological/Grammatical Grounding Engine that transforms fully vocalized Classical Arabic into language-independent Grounded Action Structures (GAS); (2) the Arabic Reified Action Calculus (ARAC) that normalizes these structures into canonical logical representations; and (3) a function-free Horn-clause Datalog engine for executable legal deduction. entries.source_title: Edit, Don't Imitate: Minimal-Edit On-Policy Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
entries.source_excerpt: Visual mathematical reasoning can fail before reasoning begins: when a vision-language model (VLM) misreads a diagram, subsequent reasoning proceeds from false premises. This perceptual bottleneck is especially pronounced in smaller models, while accurate textual descriptions can substantially narrow the gap to larger models. Because obtaining such descriptions at inference requires additional annotation or model calls, we propose minimal-edit corrective on-policy distillation. Using reference figure descriptions and verified reference solutions as training-only information, a teacher scores incorrect student rollouts under a minimal-edit objective, and only teacher-disfavored tokens contribute to the corrective loss. Correct rollouts receive task-reward reinforcement learning. This preserves on-policy supervision while avoiding full-response imitation. Across model scales, the method requires no descriptions at test time and meets or exceeds the corresponding base model supplied with a reference figure description at inference. It also improves perception-oriented performance, particularly low-level geometric perception, and transfer

entries.source_title: Preserving Ramsey ultrafilters with tree forcings
entries.source_excerpt: We define a wide class of tree forcings that we call $\textit{normed-tree forcings}$ and prove that they can preserve Ramsey ultrafilters. These include $\textit{fat-tree forcings}$ as particular cases. As an application, we prove the consistency with $\mathsf{ZFC}$ of $\mathfrak{d}=\mathfrak{u}=\aleph_1 < \mathsf{minLc}=\mathfrak{c}=\aleph_2$, where $\mathfrak{d}$ denotes the dominating number, $\mathfrak{u}$ the ultrafilter number, and $\mathsf{minLc}$ the minimum localization cardinal. This solves some open questions about pairs of classical cardinal characteristics, such as the consistency of both $\mathfrak{e}_{\mathsf{ubd}}$ and its dual strictly larger than $\mathfrak{u}$.
entries.title_zh: 用树 forcing 保持 Ramsey 超滤子

entries.source_title: The injectivity of the Kudla--Millson lift on unitary Shimura varieties
entries.source_excerpt: We prove the injectivity of the Kudla--Millson lift on unitary Shimura varieties over imaginary quadratic fields under some lattice hypotheses. We express integrals of the lift over special cycles as special values of Dirichlet series and deduce injectivity by separating the Fourier coefficients of the cusp forms. We also establish a converse theorem for Borcherds products on $\mathrm{U}(n,1)$.
entries.title_zh: 酉 Shimura 簇上 Kudla–Millson 提升的单射性

entries.source_title: The Schubert bialgebra
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce a Schubert bialgebra $\mathcal{A}=\bigoplus_{n\geq 0}\mathbb{Z}[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$, in which polynomials in different numbers of variables multiply to zero and the coproduct splits the variables into two consecutive blocks, and study its graded dual $\mathcal{D}$, whose product is concatenation of weak compositions. The Schubert polynomials $\mathfrak{S}_u^n$ form a basis of $\mathcal{A}$; we give an explicit formula for the dual Schubert basis $\Xi_u^n$ of $\mathcal{D}$ via a transition formula to an elementary symmetric basis, and show that the Schubert structure constants $c_{u,v}^w$ are the coefficients of the coproduct of $\mathcal{D}$ in the dual Schubert basis. The product of $\mathcal{D}$ is then lifted to an associative product $\sqcup$ on the free abelian group $\mathcal{BRC}$ of bounded RC graphs, built from a transition map $\mathcal{Z}$ on RC graphs that realizes the Lascoux-Sch\"utzenberger transition formula and generalizes Little's bumping algorithm. Quotienting $\mathcal{BRC}$ by ideals coming from Demazure crystal equivalence, Nadeau-Tewari forest equivalence, and quasi-Yamanouchi equivalence yields manife
entries.title_zh: Schubert 双代数与组合图上的正 Littlewood–Richardson 规则
entries.summary_zh: 论文构造由不同变量数多项式组成的 Schubert 双代数及其分次对偶，给出对偶 Schubert 基的显式公式，并把 Schubert 结构常数表示为对偶代数余乘积的系数。作者再把对偶乘法提升到有界 RC 图的自由阿贝尔群上，利用实现 Lascoux–Schützenberger 转移公式的图转移映射，经过若干等价关系商化后得到 dual Schubert、key、forest 和 slide 基的显式正 Littlewood–Richardson 规则；在 Schubert 情形对应 GL_p×GL_q 嵌入 GL_{p+q} 的分支系数。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数组合与表示论读者了解 Schubert 系数如何通过 RC 图和双代数结构获得正组合公式。

entries.source_title: Small Is Not Dead: Distance-Aware Cluster Revival for e-means
entries.source_excerpt: e-means (Bessa et al., 2026) is a recent mini-batch k-means algorithm, now part of the FAISS library, that reaches the error of Lloyd's algorithm about an order of magnitude faster on large embedding datasets. Every five mini-batches, it removes every cluster whose running point count falls below a tenth of the average and reuses its centre to split a large cluster. In the authors' ablation, removing this mechanism, called dead-cluster revival, raises the error more than removing any other component added to the moving-average update. The rule, however, considers only cluster size: it cannot distinguish a cluster that is small because it is redundant from one that covers a rare, isolated group of points, and on data with such groups it repeatedly removes centres whose removal is costly. We add a second condition, based on the distance between centres: a small cluster is removed only if its centre is close to another centre, relative to a running estimate of the mean squared error. entries.title_zh: 小簇并非死簇：基于距离的 k-means 簇重启
entries.summary_zh: 论文改进 e-means 的死簇重启规则：小簇只有在其中心靠近其他中心、删除代价相对当前误差较小时才会被移除，避免把稀有而孤立的数据簇误判为冗余。作者报告，在开发阶段未见过的小型孤立簇数据上，两轮后测试误差相对原计数规则下降约 10%–80%，在若干基准上不影响 FAISS 结果；实现是 CPU 概念验证，GPU 版本留待后续。

entries.source_title: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
entries.source_excerpt: Large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their adaptability to evolving task requirements. Although recent approaches enable dynamic orchestration, trajectory-level rewards they apply assign one outcome to each decision, ofen struggling to identify the contributions of individual structural changes. We propose RoleFlow, a self-evolving multi-role agentic system that refines collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits and on-demand role synthesis. To make structural adaptation learnable, we introduce Single-Edit Counterfactual Policy Optimization (SECPO), which evaluates each edit against its no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and assigns targeted credit to edit-specific tokens. Across seven benchmarks spanning four domains, RoleFlow achieves the optimal average performance, surpassing the strongest competitor by 4.7 points. It leads on all three multi-hop QA benchmarks by 3.2-7.5 F1 points and also shows supremacy on mathematical reasoning, web interaction, and code generation. Further analyses demonstrate cross-benchmark transferability

entries.source_title: Certified neural approximations for parabolic obstacle problems
entries.source_excerpt: Residual-trained neural surrogates carry no error guarantee, a limitation for free-boundary problems such as phase change and contact. We derive guaranteed error bounds for neural approximations of parabolic obstacle problems in first-order state--flux--multiplier form. The main result bounds the flux error of the network and the energy error of its feasible projection $\max\{v,g\}$ by the constitutive residual, the initial mismatch, the complementarity defect, and the PDE residual weighted by $c_F^2/\alpha$, without the coercivity and norm-equivalence constants of the first-order formulation. It extends the Apushkinskaya--Repin majorant for the heat operator to general coefficients, free multipliers and a flux bound. A penetration-consistency result shows that neural triples with arbitrarily small bound exist. Outward-rounded cellwise Taylor-model enclosures turn the bound into a finite computation valid on any adaptive partition. The flux and gradient errors of the projected output are certified below $0.27$ and $0.33$ of the solution scale for a one-dimensional Stefan problem and, after adaptive refinement, below one half for all t
entries.title_zh: 抛物障碍问题的可认证神经近似

entries.source_title: The cop number of the flower snarks, and the generalized Petersen graphs with cop number two
entries.source_excerpt: We study two questions of Morris, Runte and Skelton (Australas. J. Combin. 83 (2022)) on the game of Cops and Robbers. First, we show that the flower snark $J_n$ has cop number $3$ for every $n\geq 5$, and that $J_3$ has cop number $2$. The upper bound comes from a three-cop strategy, which we call the rolling wall. It works on every connected graph whose vertices can be arranged in a cycle of columns, each dominated by a single vertex. Because only one cop moves on each turn, the same strategy also shows that the lazy cop number of $J_n$ is $3$ for $n\geq 5$. Second, we prove the conjecture of Morris, Runte and Skelton that the only generalized Petersen graphs with cop number $2$ are $\mathrm{GP}(n,1)$ and the four graphs $\mathrm{GP}(6,2)$, $\mathrm{GP}(8,2)$, $\mathrm{GP}(9,3)$ and $\mathrm{GP}(12,3)$. The new ingredient is an explicit robber strategy showing that two cops do not suffice on $\mathrm{GP}(3k,k)$ and $\mathrm{GP}(4k,k)$ for $k\geq 4$. The theorem on flower snarks and all of the new lower bounds have been formally verified in the Lean 4 proof assistant.

entries.source_title: Set-theoretic inevitability
entries.source_excerpt: After defining the concept of inevitability for statements with the modal logic of forcing, we raise the question of which statements are inevitable under $\mathsf{ZFC}$ and under large cardinal hypotheses. We show that $\mathsf{SOA}$ (defined as $\mathsf{ZFC}^-$ + $\mathsf V=\mathsf{HC}$) plus the $\boldsymbol\Sigma^1_2$-perfect set property is $\mathsf{ZFC}$-inevitable, and that Projective Determinacy is inevitable in the theory of $\mathsf{ZFC}$ with a proper class of Woodin cardinals. We then discuss the possible conceptual significance of these results for the foundations of set theory.
entries.title_zh: 集合论中的必然性：强迫模态逻辑的视角

entries.source_title: Determinateness in a classical theory of nonclassical truth
entries.source_excerpt: Recent theories that take determinateness as primitive are either nonclassical theories of nonclassical truth, like Field's INT, or classical theories of classical truth, like Fujimoto and Halbach's CD and CD^+. This paper develops a third option: a classical theory of nonclassical truth. The theory, KFDcs, extends the Kripke-Feferman theory KFcs with a primitive determinateness predicate. Unlike CD^+, KFDcs keeps the iteration of truth unrestricted and gives up its completeness. With or without a consistency axiom, KFD is proof-theoretically equivalent to the theory \widehat{ID}_2 of twice iterated fixed points, with ordinal {\varphi}({\varphi}({\varepsilon}_0, 0)0), thus stronger than CD^+. It is also shown that replacing full induction with internal induction yields ordinal {\varphi}({\varphi}({\omega}, 0)0), and restricting internal induction to total formulae yields {\varphi}({\varepsilon_0},0), the ordinal of KF.
entries.title_zh: 非经典真理论的经典确定性理论
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出 KFDcs：在经典逻辑中研究非经典真值，并把“确定性”作为原始谓词加入 Kripke–Feferman 真理论。它允许真谓词无约束迭代但不要求完备性；作者证明该理论与二次迭代不动点理论在证明论强度上等价，并比较完整归纳、内部归纳及限制到全公式时对应的序数强度。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 提供确定性、非经典真值与证明论强度之间的一种新的理论组合。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合研究真理论、非经典逻辑和序数分析的读者。

entries.source_title: Lax descent and foliated Verdier duality
entries.source_excerpt: Higher categorical methods allow us to view recollements as lax descent data and build a corresponding descent theory governed by an $\infty$-bicategorical theory of limits. We demonstrate some concrete innovations brought along by these new techniques in the classical context of constructible and perverse sheaves on stratified spaces. Our first application uses partially (op)lax descent to recover the famous result of Beilinson telling us how to glue perverse sheaves in terms of vanishing and nearby cycles. The remainder of the article is concerened with establishing a uniform view on a series of classification results for perverse sheaves culminating in recent work of Kapranov-Schechtman. Namely, we use lax descent to establish a ``foliated'' variant of Verdier duality which, informally speaking, identifies the derived constructible category of a suitably foliated space with sections of a categorical cosheaf on the leaf space whose stalks are the categories of sheaves along the leaves. entries.source_title: Uniform asymptotics and the Weil--Petersson constant
entries.source_excerpt: In their celebrated work on the large-genus asymptotic expansion of Weil--Petersson volumes, Mirzakhani and Zograf left open the question of whether the Weil--Petersson constant satisfies $C_{\mathrm{WP}}=\pi^{-1/2}$. We resolve the conjecture affirmatively. Our strategy is to consider a family of spectral curves interpolating between $y=z-4z^3$ and $y=\sin(2\pi z)/(2\pi)$. For each fixed number $n\geq2$ of marked points, we normalize the cusp coefficients using the action integral and the derivative at its first positive zero. We prove that the logarithmic derivatives of these normalized coefficients with respect to the family parameter are $O_n(g^{-1})$, uniformly along the family. The proof combines the descendant recursion, positivity, the dilaton equation, KdV, and coefficient asymptotics for the Painlev\'e I equation.

entries.source_title: Numina Fuse: Interactive Autoformalization in Lean 4
entries.source_excerpt: Numina Fuse is an agent-native application for formalizing mathematics in Lean 4. Since Lean can compile while not representing its intended informal meaning, and agents now write Lean faster than people can read it, we built Fuse around human supervision of agent work. A user works with an AI orchestrator on a Lean project and supervises it through views of the blueprint, the dependency graph, and the Lean code, while the backend keeps the project's derived state and runs agents for hours without the user present. We describe the development of Fuse throughout 2026, as it moved from a prescribed pipeline of agents paced by human review to an orchestrator that dispatches specialists, provers, and parallel children on its own. We designed for this shift, keeping project state, tooling, and interface design separate from orchestration so that agents could take over more of the work as models improved. We report Fuse's use in a formalization of the three-dimensional Kakeya conjecture and a study of prover models. We close with lessons for the next generation of autoformalization systems. entries.source_title: Sch\"affer's conjecture for even $k \le 42$
entries.source_excerpt: In 1956, Sch\"affer made a conjecture on the whole number solutions to the Diophantine equation $S_k(x):=1^k+2^k+\cdots+x^k=y^n$. In this paper we show how for even $k$, we can descend to a long list of three coupled equations of the form $Ax^p-By^p=1$, where $A,B\in\mathbb{Q}$. To this system, we apply the modular method, linear forms in logarithms, and local methods. As a result, we prove Sch\"affer's conjecture for even $k \le 42$.

entries.source_title: A Little Advice Suffices: Diffie-Hellman Is as Hard as Discrete Logarithm
entries.source_excerpt: Is computing a Diffie-Hellman key as hard as computing a discrete logarithm? Maurer showed that it is, given a few bits of advice, provided that short intervals contain enough integers with only small prime factors; that proviso has stood for thirty years. We remove it. For every prime $p$ there is an advice string of $O(\log p)$ bits, depending only on $p$, with which discrete logarithms in every group of order $p$ are computed in polynomial time from a Diffie-Hellman oracle. The reduction is the classical one; what was missing was a proof that short intervals contain polylogarithmically smooth integers. We show that a zero-free half-plane for the Riemann zeta function, which is now known, gives the expected number of $(\log x)^K$-smooth integers in every interval $[x,x+x^\theta]$ with $\theta>17/30$. With smoothness this small the saddle point of the counting integral lies just to the left of the line $\mathrm{Re}\,s=1$, and a zero-free strip of any fixed width absorbs the shift once $K$ is large. Genus-2 Jacobians, whose orders fill such intervals, then turn one of these integers into the order of an auxiliary group. The same input
entries.title_zh: 少量建议可将 Diffie–Hellman 化为离散对数
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明：对每个素数 p，存在仅依赖 p、长度为 O(log p) 的建议，使得借助 Diffie–Hellman 预言机可在多项式时间内求解任意阶为 p 的群中的离散对数。结果是带建议的复杂度归约，并非声称现实密码系统已被破解；论证使用短区间光滑整数及 ζ 函数零点区域等数论输入。

entries.source_title: Global invertibility of polynomial mappings and connectedness of preimages of large spheres
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that a polynomial mapping $\mathbb{R}^2 \to \mathbb{R}^2$ with nowhere zero Jacobian determinant is a global diffeomorphism provided the preimage of large circles are connected. In higher dimensions this result fails and we present families of counterexamples. Yet, in dimension $3$ with codimension of Jelonek set greater than one, we prove that if the preimages of large spheres are connected, then the Jelonek set of the mapping is neither homeomorphic to a line nor can have a single end at infinity.
