entries.source_title: Can Test-Time Memory Evolution Outperform Test-Time Training for Scientific Discovery?
entries.source_excerpt: Recent \emph{test-time training} (TTT) frameworks have enabled open-weight large language models (LLMs) to outperform inference-only frameworks powered by frontier models on scientific discovery tasks. However, TTT introduces additional computational cost for online weight updates during the discovery process, making computational efficiency an important consideration when scaling to larger models. This motivates us to explore an efficient \emph{test-time adaptation} method for scientific discovery. We introduce \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} (TTME), a plug-and-play test-time adaptation method, as an alternative to TTT. TTME continually updates the external memory by distilling the experience to guide subsequent discovery without updating model weights. To have a clean comparison, we evaluate TTME and TTT under the same discovery framework, replacing only the test-time adaptation method. Our evaluation shows that TTME outperforms TTT on all five mathematical tasks, while reducing computational cost by $82.8$-$84.6\%$ in FLOPs and $47.7$-$58.4\%$ in runtime. These results establish TTME as an effective and computationally efficient

entries.title_zh: SAM 3：面向图像与视频的可提示概念分割模型
entries.summary_zh: SAM 3 将图像和视频中的目标检测、分割与跟踪统一到可提示模型中，可使用文本短语或点、框、掩码等视觉提示。Meta 称其可穷尽分割开放词汇概念的所有实例，并在其 SA-CO 基准上达到人类表现的 75%–80%；该成绩是来源自述，材料没有提供独立验证信息。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 个人研究者可据此探索开放词汇图像分割、视频目标跟踪，以及将视觉提示接入数据标注或科研影像处理流程。
entries.pragmatic_review: 材料提供 Transformers 和原生接口的图像、视频调用示例，便于有 GPU 环境的用户评估其与现有视觉流程的适配性。
entries.cynic_review: 模型页面要求登录并同意信息共享条件后访问权重，许可标为 other；所谓大规模概念覆盖与接近人类的表现来自 Meta 自报。
entries.paper_review: 材料给出接口示例和 SA-CO 基准的概述，但未附论文、基准协议、完整结果或独立复现证据。

project_insight.translation_zh: SAM 3 是用于图像和视频的统一基础模型，可根据文本或点、框、掩码等视觉提示检测、分割并跟踪对象。与前代 SAM 2 相比，来源称 SAM 3 新增了对短文本概念或示例进行提示、并穷尽分割所有匹配实例的能力。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 用文本或视觉提示在图像和视频中识别、分割并跟踪目标实例。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先用模型卡提供的 Transformers 示例在一张小图上验证目标类别和掩码质量，再检查官方 sam3 仓库与运行环境要求；处理视频前，先抽取少量帧评估速度和跟踪稳定性。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 这是模型而非软件项目。模型访问需登录并同意分享 Hugging Face 信息，许可标注为 other，需先核对具体使用条款；材料没有披露 SA-CO 的完整评测协议或独立验证结果。
use_cases_zh: 为个人照片或视频中的特定物体生成分割掩码并跟踪其运动。
辅助科研影像或实验视频中的目标筛选和半自动标注。
比较文本提示与框、点提示在开放词汇分割任务中的效果。

entries.source_title: WaveCommitments: Private and Verifiable Speech-Agent Marketplaces
entries.source_excerpt: Modern speech systems are evolving into ecosystems of autonomous speech agents that interact, negotiate, and trade assets such as embeddings, spectrograms, or raw data. In such markets, sellers cannot reveal assets for evaluation due to privacy constraints, and buyers cannot price what they cannot test. Thus, we introduce WaveCommitments, an end-to-end design that couples multivariate polynomial commitments with confidential asset valuation via Data Shapley inside a trusted execution environment. It enables selective openings and tamper-evident provenance to prove that a delivered asset matches the valuation while hiding everything else. Our extensive experiments across three standard datasets and various tasks with state-of-the-art encoders, including Whisper, reveal that we speed up the strongest baselines by up to 18.1x while reducing their proof sizes by up to 43.2x. We also analyze how a speaker's value shifts across tasks and encoders, revealing agent-level market prices.
entries.title_zh: WaveCommitments：隐私可验证的语音智能体市场
entries.summary_zh: 语音智能体市场中，卖方因隐私不能公开音频嵌入、频谱或原始数据供买方评估，买方也难以给不可测试资产定价。WaveCommitments 将多变量多项式承诺与可信执行环境内的 Data Shapley 估值结合，支持选择性揭示和防篡改来源证明，使交付资产可验证为与估值时一致而隐藏其余内容；作者在三个标准数据集和多类任务上实验。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把资产估值、隐私保护和交付一致性证明组合到语音代理交易流程。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合涉及语音数据交易、模型代理协作或隐私数据贡献结算的场景。
entries.cynic_review: 可信执行环境和承诺方案带来安全假设、性能开销及实现复杂度。
entries.paper_review: 覆盖端到端市场流程，并通过多任务实验评估。

entries.source_title: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
entries.source_excerpt: 若破产方案获法院批准，Disney 将获得 Character.AI 的员工和大部分技术栈，同时避开导致其破产的诉讼和 46 个州与地区的联合调查。破产文件显示 40 个州指控 Character.AI 聊天机器人曾鼓励未成年人隐瞒自残伤痕甚至杀害父母，公司发言人称该描述不准确；相关州已保留挑战破产方案的权利。

entries.summary_zh: Ars Technica 根据破产文件报道，Character.AI 破产可能与一系列安排相关：Disney 已聘用其多数员工，并可能取得大部分技术，而余下实体继续处理未结诉讼和监管调查。报道称 40 个州在文件中指控聊天机器人曾鼓励未成年人自残或伤害他人，公司发言人否认这一描述准确，相关州还保留挑战破产方案的权利；因此交易和责任分配仍取决于法院程序，相关指控不能当成已裁定事实。

project_insight.translation_zh: Jev 复现追踪器：追踪社区正在公开复现 TypeSafe 的 Jev（System One / RLCD）的进展。它提供新闻条目和决策模型索引，涵盖解码方法、扩散模型、训练模型、先例与解释材料。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 汇总 Jev 相关复现动态，并以包含公开基准和私有任务的指数比较候选模型。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先查看 Methodology 页面，弄清综合分与公开分的差异，再用自定义权重观察排名变化；对重要结论回到对应模型、基准或原始公告核对。
project_insight.limitations_zh: Space 自述与 TypeSafe AI 无关联，且排行榜包含私有测试和新领域任务，全部分数无法仅凭公开基准独立验证。互动数据是 2026-09-24 的快照，页面属于静态追踪索引，不是模型或基准软件包。

entries.source_title: Risk measures for infinite-server queues driven by a Cox-BESQ process
entries.source_excerpt: This paper introduces a model for infinite-server queues driven by a Cox process with stochastic intensity given by a squared Bessel (BESQ) process. Exploiting the affine structure of the underlying dynamics, we derive a closed-form expression for the joint moment-generating function (MGF) of the arrival intensity, the number of customers in the system, and the integral of the number of customers in the system over a time interval. This MGF can also be obtained at two (or more) dates, thereby allowing an analysis of the time evolution of infinite-server queues driven by a Cox--BESQ process. The availability of these explicit MGFs enables the development of risk measures for these variables, such as the joint moments of the arrival intensity, the number of customers in the system, and the integral of the number of customers in the system over a time interval, conditional on one of these variables exceeding a critical threshold. These risk measures can be determined at one or two dates. They rely essentially on the explicit form of the MGF of the state variables and on Fourier representations of the risk measures. entries.source_title: Beyond On-Policy vs. Off-Policy: At What Level Should LLM Agent Distillation Follow the Student?
entries.source_excerpt: Distilling interactive LLM agents requires choosing between teacher-generated demonstrations and student-generated experience, corresponding broadly to off-policy and on-policy distillation. entries.title_zh: 交互式智能体蒸馏该在什么层级跟随学生？
entries.summary_zh: 作者指出 on-policy/off-policy 不只是数据来源二分：交互历史由谁产生与当前动作 token 前缀由谁生成是两个层级。三模型、四环境受控研究发现，学生产生历史、教师生成动作前缀通常最强；两个层级都完全跟随学生通常最弱，但把 fully on-policy 数据混合进训练后有益。

entries.paper_review: 结论来自三阶段有限实验，可能依任务和模型而变。

entries.source_title: Instructor-designed AI improves learning in a randomized trial across 19 universities
entries.source_excerpt: Universities are alarmed by recent evidence that artificial intelligence (AI) can undermine learning, with students prescribed generic chatbots or centrally designed AI tools performing worse. In a pre-registered randomized controlled trial across 7,200 students at 19 universities over three semesters, we tested whether AI designed by frontline instructors can improve learning. We encouraged instructors to design AI solutions they believed would best help their students. Drawing on their unique knowledge of their classes and students, the instructors created a wide array of innovations. We show that these instructor-designed AI innovations improved student learning, measured by AI-proof assessments (proctored, in-person examinations). We found no change in student engagement, measured by course activity records, or satisfaction, measured by course evaluations. Our findings demonstrate that AI can improve student learning when its adoption is frontline-driven, with instructors empowered to design and refine AI solutions for their own classrooms.
entries.title_zh: 19 所大学随机试验：教师设计的 AI 改善学习表现
entries.summary_zh: 一项预注册随机对照试验覆盖 19 所大学、7200 名学生和三个学期，研究由一线教师为自己的课程设计的 AI 工具。作者报告这些方案提高了现场监考考试成绩，但学生参与度和课程满意度没有变化；结果针对该试验中的多种教师设计方案，不能直接推断所有通用聊天机器人都会产生相同效果。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 用跨校随机试验检验教师主导的 AI 教学设计，而非只依赖学生满意度调查。
entries.pragmatic_review: 强调让教师按课程需求迭代工具，可供教育试点设计参考。
entries.cynic_review: 方案异质且参与度、满意度无变化，需查看效应大小与学科分布。
entries.paper_review: 大样本预注册随机试验并使用现场考试评估，证据设计较强。

entries.source_title: Low-weight compactly supported cohomology of $\mathcal M_{g,n}^{ct}$ and the extended Torelli morphism
entries.source_excerpt: We study the weight zero and weight two graded pieces of the compactly supported cohomology of the moduli space $\mathcal M_{g,n}^{ct}$ of stable $n$-pointed curves of genus $g$ of compact type and show that they are computed by bridgeless graph complexes. In weight two, we construct a natural embedding of shifted weight zero cohomology from lower genus. For unmarked curves, we construct canonical classes represented by pinched odd wheel graphs and prove that distinct wheel monomials give linearly independent classes in the dual of $W_0H_c^{2g}(\mathcal M_g^{ct};\mathbb Q)$. By relating the bridgeless graph complex to the $K$-theory of graphs and the Quillen spectral sequence, we show that these classes remain linearly independent after pushforward along the extended Torelli morphism $\mathcal M_g^{ct}\to\mathcal A_g$. Finally, we prove that the realizations of the motivic Lie algebra arising from $\mathcal M_g$ and $\mathcal A_g$ have the same image in the weight zero compactly supported cohomology of $\mathcal M_g^{ct}$.
entries.title_zh: 紧致型曲线模空间的低权紧支撑上同调与扩展 Torelli 映射
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究紧致型稳定曲线模空间 M_{g,n}^{ct} 的权零与权二紧支撑上同调，并用无桥图复形计算这些部分。对无标记曲线，作者构造由压扁奇数轮图表示的典范类，证明不同轮图单项式在权零上同调的对偶中线性独立，且通过图 K 理论与 Quillen 谱序列证明这些类经扩展 Torelli 映射推前到阿贝尔簇模空间后仍独立；最后比较两种 motivic Lie 代数实现的像。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合模空间、图复形与 motivic 上同调研究者关注组合图如何捕捉低权结构并在 Torelli 映射下保留。
entries.pragmatic_review: 图复形方法提供可操作的组合代表元来研究模空间上同调。
entries.cynic_review: 结论集中在特定权数与紧致型模空间，不能代表全部上同调。
entries.paper_review: 摘要陈述独立性与推前保持结果，谱序列论证需要阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Semigroup Hessian Estimates for Underdamped Langevin Dynamics
entries.source_excerpt:
For the semigroup $e^{t\mathcal L}$ of the underdamped Langevin dynamics, we bound the Hessian $
abla^2(e^{t\mathcal L}f)$ when $
abla f$ is uniformly bounded. When the potential is strongly convex outside a ball and has bounded second and third derivatives, and the damping rate is above an explicit threshold, the bounds on $
abla^2(e^{t\mathcal L}f)$ decay exponentially in time with constants free of the dimension. The proof combines the Wasserstein contraction of the dynamics with a Bismut--Elworthy--Li formula for the degenerate noise. As an application, we prove the uniform-in-time error of the stochastic gradient UBU integrator, with an explicit coefficient of the numerical bias in the step size, proportional to the covariance of the stochastic gradient noise.

entries.source_title: Rapid convergence of Langevin AIS for multimodal distributions on $\mathbb{R}^d$
entries.source_excerpt: We study annealed importance sampling (AIS) driven by the overdamped Langevin diffusion, targeting a multimodal Gibbs measure $\pi_\varepsilon \propto e^{-U/\varepsilon}$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$ at low temperature $\varepsilon$. For a potential $U$ with nondegenerate critical points, finitely many wells of comparable mass, and at least quadratic growth at infinity, we show that AIS with a harmonically spaced temperature schedule produces a weighted empirical measure that approximates $\pi_\varepsilon$ to accuracy $\delta$ at a total cost of order $\varepsilon^{-2}\delta^{-2}$, up to logarithmic factors, and the exponents do not depend on the dimension. This is an exponential improvement over plain Langevin Monte Carlo, whose relaxation time obeys the Arrhenius law. The assumptions cover, in particular, the potentials of Gaussian mixtures, as long as their critical points are nondegenerate and their wells carry comparable mass. The analysis extends that of arXiv:2604.17526 [math.PR] from the torus $\mathbb{T}^d$ to the noncompact state space $\mathbb{R}^d$. entries.source_title: Planar Disk Filters and Real Chromatic Roots at Beraha Numbers
entries.source_excerpt: We construct simple plane triangulations whose chromatic polynomials have real roots accumulating at every noninteger Beraha number $B_\ell=4\cos^2(\pi/\ell)$; the integer values $0,1,2,3$ are roots of $K_4$. The construction rests on the observation that a triangulated disk with four boundary vertices acts, inside a larger triangulation, as a transfer operator lying in a commutative three-parameter algebra. Rotating such disks by a quarter turn and composing them in series moves their eigenvalue triples around this algebra in a controllable way, and for every fixed $q\in(B_{10},4)$ one can manufacture a finite disk whose two competing local eigenvalues are strictly dominated by the third -- a physical filter. entries.source_title: Height growth of rational self-maps
entries.source_excerpt: Let $K$ be a number field or a function field of a curve. Let $f$ be a dominant rational self-map of a normal projective variety $X$ of dimension $d$ over $K$, and let $h_H\geq1$ be an ample Weil height. Let $\lambda_1(f)$ denote the first dynamical degree of $f$. We show that there is a constant $C_{f,h_H}>0$ such that, for any $n\geq1$ and any point $P\in X(\overline{K})$ with well-defined forward orbit, $h_H(f^n(P))\leq C_{f,h_H}h_H(P)n^{2(d-1)}\lambda_1(f)^n$ if $\lambda_1(f)>1$, and $h_H(f^n(P))\leq C_{f,h_H}h_H(P)n^{2d}$ if $\lambda_1(f)=1$. Over number fields, the proof combines a new uniform upper bound for arithmetic degrees with a uniform comparison of point heights. Over function fields, it relies on the corresponding uniform upper bound for geometric degrees on a projective model.

entries.source_title: Path space large deviation on a lattice for interacting particle systems
entries.source_excerpt: We investigate the path space large deviation principle (LDP) for a class of interacting particle systems on a fixed finite discrete torus. As an illustrative example, we use the partial exclusion process with maximal occupation of $s$ particles. We first verify the standard Kurtz-type law of large numbers for the original and tilted processes, thereby identifying the deterministic flows around which the large deviations are formulated. We then establish the path space LDP, with speed $s$, and identify the associated rate function in variational form as the Legendre transform of a nonlinear Hamiltonian. The proof relies on martingale techniques, exponential tightness, and a change-of-measure argument based on exponential tilting, which renders atypical trajectories typical under a modified dynamics. We also explain how the same strategy extends to further interacting particle systems. The inclusion process illustrates the conservative non-compact finite-jump case. entries.source_title: Conserved Verdicts, Drifting Commitments: Identifying Harmful Overthinking
entries.source_excerpt: A reasoning model that has reached a correct answer can lose it by continuing to think. Deciding whether to stop means comparing two probabilities at the same point of a chain: that the answer the model would give if stopped now is correct (its commitment), and that the answer it will finish with is correct (its verdict). We show that the verdict alone, which is what final-correctness probes estimate, cannot make this comparison. As a forecast of a fixed outcome it has no predictable drift, whether continuing helps or hurts. The commitment-verdict gap equals the expected remaining change in answer quality and the accuracy gained by stopping. A second identity splits any accuracy-versus-budget curve into answer change within chains and change in which chains are still running. We measure both on MATH-500. At all 379 points where DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B holds a correct answer, selected without regard to how its chain ends, continuing loses 3.6 points on average (95% CI [2.2, 5.2]), and the loss concentrates in a few problems. entries.source_title: CONCUR: Concordant Auxiliary Rewards for Multi-Task, Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
entries.source_excerpt: When a Large Language Model (LLM) is trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL) on multiple tasks, a task's primary reward can gate auxiliary rewards such as a length reward: on a failing response, an auxiliary cannot exceed the primary. However, group-relative advantage estimators treat a gated auxiliary like any other component, so it can reverse the primary's order, and at the primary's ceiling only auxiliaries order responses. Keeping gated auxiliaries hurts some tasks, while dropping them hurts others. We propose CONCUR, an advantage estimator that replaces the standardized scores of each gated auxiliary with the closest scores that satisfy two conditions: responses with higher primary rewards cannot receive lower scores, and responses at the primary's ceiling receive equal scores. CONCUR-T applies both conditions throughout training, and CONCUR-A lifts the second for an auxiliary that agrees with the primary's order more often than it reverses it among passing responses. entries.source_title: On the diameter and distribution of Sidon sets
entries.source_excerpt: A Sidon set is a set $\mathcal{A}$ of integers with the property that if $0\neq a-b=c-d$ and $a,b,c,d\in\mathcal{A}$, then $(a,b)=(c,d)$. Our main result is an improved and explicit bound on the diameter of a Sidon set: if $\mathcal{A}$ is a Sidon set with $k\ge 1$ elements, then \[\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{A}) \ge k^2 \left(\frac{1}{1 + 0.945/\sqrt{k}}-\frac{0.945}{\sqrt k}\right) -1;\] in particular, $\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{A})\ge k^2-1.89 k^{3/2}$. This implies that if $\mathcal{A}\subseteq[1,N]$ is a Sidon set, then $|\mathcal{A}| \le N^{1/2}+0.945 \, N^{1/4}+0.447$. Our technique also gives an improved bound for the case of large $k$, namely $\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{A}) \ge k^2-1.88607 k^{3/2}$ for $k\ge 483$. A $\gamma$-Golomb ruler is a set $\mathcal{A}$ of integers with the property that there are not $\gamma+1$ distinct pairs $(a_i,b_i)\in\mathcal{A}^2$ with $0\neq a_1-b_1=\cdots=a_{\gamma+1}-b_{\gamma+1}$. Our diameter bounds extend in a natural way to the case of Golomb rulers. entries.source_title: Guiding AI Agents to Generate Conjectures by Encoding How Theorems Build on One Another
entries.source_excerpt: Recently, LLMs have been making headlines, and headway, in mathematical research. Much of this work focuses on proving existing open conjectures. Deciding what to prove is harder and less studied, because of the lack of a clear criterion for what makes a conjecture worth pursuing. We present a method for conjecture generation that builds on the observation that mathematical theorems build on one another: new theorems can modify the setting or hypotheses of earlier theorems, strengthen their conclusions, or extend their scope. We encode these relationships in a new kind of graph, the Theorem Evolution Graph (TEG), which we instantiate as an online search method for LLM agents. An agent builds a TEG in two steps: (1) identifying relevant theorems from papers found by following citations backward and forward from a seed paper; and (2) comparing those theorems to record how one builds on another. LLM judges and an expert mathematician preferred TEG-generated conjectures over those from an unconstrained baseline. entries.source_title: On a conjecture of Velani
entries.source_excerpt: We investigate the approximation of elements of the middle-third Cantor set by dyadic rationals, and natural extensions. We prove a conjecture of Velani, completing the metric theory for the Cantor measure. Our key method enables a quantitative study of the incommensurability of binary and ternary expansions of integers, initiated by Furstenberg. The method has other applications, e.g. $\sum_{k} |\hat{\mu}(2^k)|^\sigma < \infty$ for any $\sigma > 0$, where $\mu$ is the Cantor measure.

entries.summary_zh: SimReady Central 是一个用于搜索 3D 资产并查看 USD 与 RTX 仿真预览的演示。摘录称其由 OpenSearch、Neo4j、Redis、深度搜索 API 和资产图服务等组件构成，使用 SigLIP2 嵌入；GPU 部署会在启动时从 S3 获取索引。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关注 3D 资产检索、资产图谱和仿真工作流的人，能从项目描述了解多组件搜索服务如何组合；个人试用价值受专用 GPU 部署限制。

entries.cynic_review: Space 依赖 RTX PRO 6000 硬件，索引还需从 S3 拉取，实际可访问性和运行成本不能从摘录确认。
entries.paper_review: 摘录列出服务组件与部署方式，但没有提供检索质量评测、数据集说明或可复现实验结果。

project_insight.translation_zh: 用于 USD 资产的 SimReady Central 搜索，是一个单容器演示，包含 OpenSearch、Neo4j、Redis、deepsearch-api 和 asset-graph-service；通过本地 siglip2-triton 进程运行 SigLIP2 嵌入。GPU 版本运行在 RTX PRO 6000 硬件层级；免费层版本则将 SigLIP2 请求路由到 NVCF。索引在容器启动时从 S3 制品存储桶拉取，而非预先打包进容器。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 将 3D 资产的语义搜索、资产图服务与 USD/RTX 仿真预览组合成一个演示应用。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先打开 Space 确认演示当前是否可访问，再查看公开代码与第三方声明，了解索引来源、资产范围和预览交互；不要假设免费层与 GPU 版本具备相同推理部署方式。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 这是依赖多项后端服务的演示，GPU 部署要求 RTX PRO 6000，索引从 S3 获取。摘录未说明资产数据许可、搜索效果或普通个人部署所需资源；提及第三方声明文件，但未给出具体许可信息。

entries.source_title: Connected Cayley Approximation of Power Graphs of Finite Groups
entries.source_excerpt: For a nontrivial finite group \(G\), we define its connected intersection density as the maximum, over all connected Cayley graphs on \(G\), of the proportion of edges that also belong to the undirected power graph of \(G\). We show that this density is \(1\) if and only if \(G\) is cyclic, and that it is \(1/4\), \(1/6\), and \(1/12\) for \(A_4\), \(S_4\), and \(A_5\), respectively. For the dihedral group of order \(2n\), with \(n\geq 3\), we give a general formula and show that the connected intersection density equals \((\binom{n}{2}+1)/n^2\) if and only if \(n\) is a prime power. We also give a formula for the connected intersection density of dicyclic groups. For generalized quaternion groups of order \(2N\), where \(N=2^{m-1}\geq 4\), the density is \(\frac{N^2+8}{2N(N+1)}\). For the elementary abelian group \(C_p^r\), where \(p\) is prime and \(r\geq 1\), the density is \(p^{1-r}\).
entries.title_zh: 有限群幂图的连通 Cayley 近似
entries.summary_zh: 作者定义有限群 G 的连通交集密度：在连通 Cayley 图中，最多有多少比例的边同时属于 G 的无向幂图。密度等于 1 当且仅当 G 为循环群，并算出 A₄、S₄、A₅ 的值分别为 1/4、1/6、1/12，同时给出二面体、二面扩张、广义四元数及初等阿贝尔群的公式。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 提出一个衡量群图相似度的新不变量，并覆盖若干经典有限群族。
entries.pragmatic_review: 定义与若干群族的显式计算便于后续比较群结构和 Cayley 图。
entries.cynic_review: 指标依赖对所有连通 Cayley 图取最大值，摘要未说明求值算法或复杂度。
entries.paper_review: 分类结论明确，但主要价值取决于新不变量后续能否揭示更深群结构。

entries.source_title: Physics-informed neural networks for spacecraft trajectory optimization with exact boundary conditions
entries.source_excerpt: We use neural networks to optimize trajectories by modeling the position as a function of time and minimizing the thrust with respect to the network parameters. This corresponds to an unsupervised training procedure in which physical laws are incorporated directly into the optimization objective. In standard physics-informed neural networks, initial and terminal states are enforced through additional weighted loss terms, resulting in a multi-objective optimization problem that is highly sensitive to the choice of loss weights and can lead to poor convergence and reduced accuracy. To address this challenge, we construct a simple transformation, exploiting the mathematical structure of trajectory optimization problems, to enforce boundary conditions exactly a-priori. This transformation can be interpreted as a reparameterization of the solution space that embeds the boundary conditions directly into the function. This converts the original constrained optimization problem into an unconstrained one over admissible trajectories. entries.title_zh: 以精确边界条件求解航天器轨迹的物理信息网络
entries.summary_zh: 论文针对航天器轨迹优化中的物理信息神经网络，通过重参数化可行轨迹来精确满足端点边界条件，而不是用加权惩罚项近似约束。这样可避免训练时边界残差与方程损失之间的权衡；优化速度、精度及复杂任务表现仍需参照论文实验。

entries.paper_review: 方法机制清楚，定量收益与适用轨迹范围需查全文。

entries.source_title: Models of Arbitrary Sets
entries.source_excerpt: There is a growing literature on arbitrary objects as other types of mathematical objects, besides particular mathematical objects. In this paper we study arbitrary sets in the context of ZFC set theory. An arbitrary object is one that is determined by a state space across which it varies and by its instantiations. We compare two semantic strategies. First, we analyse the possibility of modeling arbitrary sets using direct powers of a ZFC structure. This yields a natural setting, but one where Extensionality and, crucially, the full Separation scheme fail. Second, we consider structures composed of arbitrary sets using a direct power construction evaluated in a Boolean-valued semantics. Within this setting, we develop the cumulative hierarchy of arbitrary sets, arbitrary ordinals, cardinals, and filtrations of the structure of arbitrary sets. The final section develops a combinatorial interpretation in terms of independent assignments across a fixed state space. Its connection with the iterative conception is then discussed.
entries.title_zh: 任意集合的模型
entries.summary_zh: 论文在 ZFC 集合论中研究由状态空间和具体取值共同刻画的“任意对象”，并比较两种语义建模。直接对 ZFC 结构取幂虽自然，却会失去外延公理和完整分离模式；作者转而在布尔值语义下构造任意集合的累积层级、序数、基数与过滤结构，并讨论独立赋值的组合解释及其与迭代集合观的联系。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合集合论与数学哲学读者了解“对象随状态变化”这一建模方式对公理性质的影响。
entries.pragmatic_review: 两种语义路线的比较能提醒建模者检查哪些 ZFC 原理仍成立。
entries.cynic_review: “任意对象”的技术框架与应用范围需结合全文定义理解。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确给出失败公理和替代语义构造，证明细节仍需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Moduli spaces of logarithmic connections associated with difference Painlev\'e equations of type $E^{(1)}_n$
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we provide an explicit correspondence between moduli spaces of parabolic logarithmic connections on the projective line with spectral type $(2^2,1^4,1^4)$ and $(3^2, 2^3, 1^6)$, and the spaces of initial conditions for difference Painlev\'e equations with symmetry of type $E^{(1)}_7$ and $E^{(1)}_8$, respectively. Furthermore, we realize the extended affine Weyl group symmetries of the space of initial conditions in terms of connections.
entries.title_zh: 与 E₇^(1)、E₈^(1) 差分 Painlevé 方程相关的对数联络模空间
entries.summary_zh: 论文为两类射影直线上带抛物结构的对数联络模空间，建立其与 E₇^(1)、E₈^(1) 对称差分 Painlevé 方程初值空间的显式对应。它还把初值空间上的扩展仿射 Weyl 群对称性实现为联络变换。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把差分 Painlevé 动力系统、模空间和联络几何之间的对应关系具体化。
entries.pragmatic_review: 主要面向几何与可积系统研究者。
entries.cynic_review: 对应依赖摘要所列谱型和对称类型。
entries.paper_review: 将仿射 Weyl 对称提升到模空间联络描述。

entries.source_title: Breaking the high-degree barrier in Lehmer's problem with a human-AI discovery loop
entries.source_excerpt: While artificial intelligence has made rapid progress in mathematical reasoning, many open problems depend on structure that is revealed only through large-scale computational exploration and analytical synthesis. One such example is Lehmer's problem from 1933. It asks whether the Mahler measure of an integer polynomial, which measures how far its roots stray from the unit circle, can be made arbitrarily small. Previously, constructing irreducible polynomials with integer coefficients and small Mahler measure has been carried out systematically only for even degrees $d \le 180$. At higher degrees, Boyd's analytical one-parameter family frequently factors, skipping nearly 50% of target degrees and leaving no general construction for arbitrary $d$. Here, we address the high-degree regime through a human-AI discovery loop, in which we extend the conversational prompting with a fast numerical pipeline, an exact symbolic verifier, and large-scale distributed search. entries.title_zh: Lehmer 问题中的高次数人机发现循环
entries.summary_zh: 论文围绕构造高次数、低 Mahler 测度整系数不可约多项式，介绍数值流水线、精确符号验证与分布式搜索结合的人机协作。现有摘录在结果前截断，只说明既有构造会漏过很多次数；不能据标题声称解决 Lehmer 问题或给出未见的性能数字。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究计算探索如何转化为可核验数论构造。
entries.pragmatic_review: 数值候选与精确验证的分工值得借鉴。

entries.paper_review: 应查看完整构造和不可约性验证。

entries.title_zh: 非局部晶体交换谜题的精确 93 步解
entries.summary_zh: 论文把《Order of the Sinking Star》一个 11×11 棋盘关卡形式化为晶体交换谜题：方向指令会把玩家与同行最近晶体互换，只有射线上无晶体时才能普通移动，目标是让 16 个晶体归位并通过出口。作者给出 93 条指令的解，并以带成本上界的精确广度优先搜索排除所有更短解，状态编码只需 17 个占据位置和玩家位置。

entries.source_title: The domination number of the $k$-token graph of the complete bipartite graph $K_{m,n}$
entries.source_excerpt: This paper is about token graphs and domination number. Let $G=(X,E)$ denote an undirected graph that is connected, with no loops or multiple edges, vertex set $X$, and edge set $E$. Pick a positive integer $k\leq \vert X\vert$. The $k$-token graph of $G$, denoted by $F_k(G)$, is defined as follows. The vertex set $\mathcal{X}$ consists of all $k$-subsets of $X$. Two vertices $x,y\in \mathcal{X}$ are adjacent whenever the symmetric difference of $x$ and $y$ consists of two vertices that form an edge in $E$. In this paper, we compute the exact value for the domination number of $F_2(K_{m,n})$ where $K_{m,n}$ is the complete bipartite graph with parameters $m,n$. We present some bounds for the domination number of $F_k(K_{m,n})$ when $k\geq 3$.
entries.title_zh: 完全二部图 k-token 图的支配数
entries.summary_zh: 论文把图的顶点替换为原图的 k 元子集，当两个子集仅交换一条边的端点时连边，得到 token 图 F_k(G)。作者精确计算 F₂(K_{m,n}) 的支配数，并在 k≥3 时给出上下界；摘要没有列出闭式公式及界的具体数值。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把组合移动图上的支配问题落实到完全二部图，精确结果与高阶界可作为后续研究基线。
entries.pragmatic_review: k=2 的精确公式可直接用于相应参数实例。

entries.paper_review: 将 token 图的支配参数细化到完全二部图族。

entries.source_title: Hankel determinants for the $(n+2)$-shifted $q$-metallic numbers
entries.source_excerpt: Let $\Phi_n(q)$ denote the $q$-deformation (in the sense of Morier-Genoud & Ovsienko) of the metallic number $\phi_n=\frac{n+\sqrt{n^2+4}}{2}$. This is a power series with integer coefficients. We prove that the Hankel continued fraction of the $(n+2)$-shifted series $\Phi_n^{(n+2)}$ is eventually periodic, and that the corresponding Hankel determinant sequence $\Delta^{(n+2)}$ is $2n(n+1)$-periodic if $n$ is even, $2n(n+1)$-antiperiodic if $n$ is odd, and that it takes only the values $-2,-1,0,1,2$. This confirms part of a former conjecture of ours and complements similar results we obtained for all $\ell$-shifts of $\Phi_n$ with $0\le\ell\le n+1$. In addition, we formulate a new conjecture of quasi-polynomiality for higher shifts $\ell\ge n+3$. The determinant values arise as telescoping products of the partial numerators of the Hankel continued fraction. Most of the technically involved and lengthy verifications are carried out by a symbolic computation program, whose code is publicly available on GitHub for independent verification.
entries.title_zh: 移位 q-金属数的 Hankel 行列式周期性
entries.summary_zh: 令 Φₙ(q) 为金属数的 q 变形，论文证明其 (n+2) 移位级数的 Hankel 连分数最终周期；相应 Hankel 行列式序列在 n 为偶数时以 2n(n+1) 为周期、n 为奇数时以该长度反周期，且取值仅为 −2 到 2。结果证实作者先前猜想的一部分，并对更高移位提出新的准多项式猜想；较长验证由公开符号计算代码辅助。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合对 q-级数、连分数与特殊数序列结构感兴趣的人。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可结合 q-金属数定义与 Hankel 行列式计算代码复核。
entries.cynic_review: 有清楚的周期长度、奇偶分类和有限取值结论。
entries.paper_review: 高移位部分仍是猜想；部分计算验证依赖符号程序。

entries.source_title: Ensemble forecasting with IBM Granite time-series models

entries.paper_review: 概率预测的合并方式与校准表现值得对照评估。

entries.source_title: Interactive Structured Environment Scaling for Large Language Model Agentic Reasoning
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement learning via environmental interaction is a cornerstone post-training paradigm for evolving large language models into autonomous agents capable of multi-turn tool use and exploration. Because the environment defines what the policy observes and how actions are verified, its structure directly bounds the capabilities an agent can acquire. Yet existing structured and retrieval environments rely on upstream pre-filtering---extracting a compact subgraph around the gold answer or retrieving fixed passages before the policy acts. We show that such pre-filtering introduces a fundamental measurement confound: because per-question subgraphs enclose ground-truth paths, they compress the candidate space by orders of magnitude and leak answer locations via local topology, allowing a question-blind degree heuristic to surface gold answers far above chance. To restore path selection, candidate pruning, and optimal stopping as genuine policy decisions, we propose RISE (Interactive Structured Environment), which transitions structured reinforcement learning from static subgraphs to full-scale interactive databases along two coupled axe
entries.title_zh: 交互式结构化环境扩展大语言模型代理推理
entries.summary_zh: 论文指出，先按标准答案裁剪知识图或检索固定段落会泄露路径线索，使代理看似会推理却未真正完成路径选择、剪枝和停止决策；作者提出 RISE，让策略在调用预算内交互式探索完整数据库，并逐步推进学习难度。论文在 19 个基准和三个模型骨干上报告结构化知识图推理、未见 schema、开放域检索及数学逻辑推理均有提升；这些成绩依赖其环境和评测构造。

entries.source_title: The Nygaard graded piece, the Frobenius--Witt cotangent complex and regularity criteria
entries.source_excerpt: For a $p$-torsionfree $p$-quasisyntomic ring, we construct a fiber sequence relating the $p$-th Nygaard graded piece of absolute prismatic cohomology to the Frobenius--Witt cotangent complex. The latter is an arithmetic analogue of the cotangent complex in which the differential of $p$ need not vanish. We also clarify the relationship between the regularity criterion proved by Mao using the Frobenius--Witt cotangent complex and the regularity criterion established by Bhatt and Mathew using the Nygaard graded piece. This relationship was anticipated by Bhatt and Mathew.
entries.title_zh: Nygaard 分次层、Frobenius–Witt 余切复形与正则性判据
entries.summary_zh: 论文建立 Nygaard 过滤分次层与 Frobenius–Witt 余切复形之间的纤维序列，并据此联系两种正则性判据。结果提供了在 p 进或 Witt 向量框架下比较代数对象正则性的结构工具；摘要未展开具体对象类别，需依据正文假设使用。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 研究 p 进几何、棱柱上同调或 Frobenius–Witt 理论的读者可关注。

entries.source_title: On the Ramanujan-Ligozat modular unit
entries.source_excerpt: Let $\chi$ be the quadratic Dirichlet character of conductor $N$ associated with a given real quadratic field $k$ and let $X_\chi(N)$ be the double covering of $X_0(N)$ associated with $\chi$. In this note, we study a modular unit $f$ on the curve $X_\chi(N)$. We prove that the transform of $f$ by the Fricke involution $\mathscr{w}_N$ is the level $N$ analogue of the Rogers-Ramanujan continued fraction introduced by Lee and Park. Furthermore, if $N$ is a positive prime discriminant, then $f$ is Ligozat's modular unit, which is known from Mazur's work on the Eisenstein ideal. We extend Ligozat's construction to any positive fundamental discriminant $N$.
entries.title_zh: Ramanujan–Ligozat 模单位
entries.summary_zh: 作者研究与实二次域相关的曲线 Xχ(N) 上的模单位 f，证明其经 Fricke 对合变换后是 Lee 与 Park 提出的 Rogers–Ramanujan 连分数的 N 级推广。若 N 为正素判别式，f 恰为 Mazur Eisenstein 理论中已知的 Ligozat 模单位，并把 Ligozat 构造推广到任意正基本判别式 N。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合模曲线、模单位与连分数研究者了解经典构造的统一推广。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把 Fricke 对合、连分数和经典模单位构造联系起来。
entries.cynic_review: 属于特定模曲线与判别式设定下的构造性结果。
entries.paper_review: 结论陈述具体，函数归一化与证明需查看原文。

entries.source_title: Normal approximation for subgraph counts in random intersection graphs: the case of cliques
entries.source_excerpt: Let $X^{(r)}_n$ denote the number of copies of a complete graph $K_r$ in the random intersection graph model on $n$ vertices. We derive upper bounds on the distance between the standardized version of $X^{(r)}_n$ and the standard normal distribution, measured in both the Kolmogorov and Wasserstein metrics. We complement these results with necessary and sufficient conditions for asymptotic normality. As a byproduct, we provide precise estimates for the variance of $X^{(r)}_n$. In the process, we develop new general techniques for analysing so--called clique covers, which play a crucial role in the study of subgraph probabilities in random intersection graphs.
entries.title_zh: 随机交图团计数的正态近似
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究随机交图中 r 团数量 X_n^(r) 的渐近分布，给出标准化计数到标准正态的 Kolmogorov 与 Wasserstein 距离上界，并给出渐近正态成立的充要条件。过程中还得到团计数方差的精确估计，并发展分析团覆盖的新技术。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 同时刻画团计数的误差率、正态性条件和方差，完善随机交图局部结构理论。

entries.source_title: $A_1^{(1)}$-Grounded partitions at levels $1$ and $2$, Part II: affine crystal structure
entries.source_excerpt: Grounded partitions are coloured partitions with difference conditions, introduced by Dousse and Konan, that are in bijection with the paths of the Kyoto path model of Kang, Kashiwara, Misra, Miwa, Nakashima and Nakayashiki. We describe the affine crystal structure on the grounded partitions arising from the level $1$ and level $2$ perfect crystals of type $A_1^{(1)}$. At level $1$, grounded partitions are naturally identified with $2$-restricted partitions, and the affine crystal structure is given by Kleshchev's modular branching rule for symmetric groups in characteristic $2$. At level $2$, we give explicit bracketing rules which make grounded partitions into affine crystal graphs of highest weights $2\Lambda_0$, $\Lambda_0+\Lambda_1$, and $2\Lambda_1$. We prove this by constructing explicit graph isomorphisms with the asymptotic model of Ariki and Mathas, whose vertices are Kleshchev multipartitions arising from Ariki-Koike algebras. Finally, we erase the $0$-arrows, which leaves the crystal graphs of the restrictions to the Levi subalgebra, and decompose them into finite strings. This decomposition gives new $q$-series identities
entries.title_zh: A₁⁽¹⁾ 类型 1、2 级 grounded 分拆的仿射晶体结构（二）

entries.source_title: Africa-Papers: A 10-Billion-Token Multi-Domain Academic Corpus for African Foundation Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) depend fundamentally on the diversity, depth, and factual rigor of their pre-training corpora. However, contemporary foundational pre-training datasets (such as The Pile, S2ORC, and Dolma) exhibit a severe structural omission: African scientific, medical, legal, and agricultural scholarship constitutes less than 0.5% of global pre-training tokens. Consequently, state-of-the-art models suffer from systematic failure modes when reasoning about tropical epidemiology, localized smallholder agro-ecologies, regional economic governance, and indigenous linguistic structures. To resolve this representation deficit and advance African intellectual sovereignty in artificial intelligence, we introduce Africa-Papers, the largest curated multi-domain Pan-African academic pre-training corpus to date. Comprising over 844,807 full-text papers spanning 10.15 billion tokens across 879 Parquet shards, Africa-Papers unifies four primary scientific streams: (1) continental peer-reviewed journals indexed in DOAJ across 31 African nations, (2) the CGIAR CGSpace agricultural repository, (3) African-authored and African-focused ST
entries.title_zh: Africa-Papers：面向非洲基础模型的百亿 token 多领域学术语料

entries.source_title: Improving the Chain-of-Thought Compressibility of Pruned Reasoning Models via Long--Short Contrastive Pruning
entries.source_excerpt: Large reasoning models are costly to serve because they are large and because they generate long chains of thought (CoT). Weight pruning and CoT compression address these two costs separately, but they interfere in that pruning adds redundant reasoning on problems the model still solves and incomplete reasoning on those it no longer solves, and on harder problems makes the model less compressible by subsequent length-preference optimization. We trace this to a blind spot on each side: pruning criteria do not distinguish necessary from redundant reasoning, and preference-based CoT compression receives no training signal on problems a pruned model always or never solves. We propose Contrastive Set-Difference (CSD), which identifies neurons enriched in redundant reasoning by contrasting their activations on long and short correct solutions of the same problem and prunes them preferentially, and we extend preference pairs to the problems a pruned model always or never solves. Pruning 20\% of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, the combination uses 8--22\% fewer thinking tokens on four math benchmarks than pruning with reasoning-aware calibration
entries.title_zh: 长短对比剪枝提升推理模型思维链可压缩性
entries.summary_zh: 模型剪枝与思维链压缩会相互影响：剪枝可能带来冗余或不完整推理，长度偏好训练也缺少对始终/从不答对样本的信号。CSD 对同题长短正确解的神经元激活做差，优先剪掉与冗余推理相关单元，并扩展偏好对；剪掉 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 的 20% 参数后，四个数学基准比推理感知校准剪枝少用 8–22% 思维 token。

The issues regarding formal mathematics are parallel to those regarding informal […]

entries.source_title: Shifted Hankel determinants via Hankel continued fractions
entries.source_excerpt: The Hankel determinants $H_n(F)$ of a power series $F(x)$, as well as the shifted ones $H_n^{(1)}(F)$ and $H_n^{(2)}(F)$, can be read off from its Jacobi continued fraction, provided that all $H_n(F)$ are nonzero. Without any condition on $F$, the Hankel continued fraction ($H$-fraction) still yields all $H_n(F)$. We show that the $H$-fraction of $F$ also determines the shifted Hankel determinants $H_n^{(1)}(F)$, $H_n^{(2)}(F)$ and the backward shifted ones $H_n^{(-1)}(F)$, and we give explicit formulas for them. As applications, we provide simple proofs of Hankel determinant evaluations that were previously established by means of complicated explicit $H$-fractions.
entries.title_zh: 用 Hankel 连分数计算移位 Hankel 行列式
entries.summary_zh: 论文利用 Hankel 连分数建立移位 Hankel 行列式的计算方法，涵盖向前与向后移位，并导出显式公式。该框架还为若干已知行列式恒等式提供更短证明，说明生成函数的连分数结构可以系统组织行列式关系。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 研究组合序列、生成函数或行列式恒等式的读者可复用其计算框架。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合组合数学研究，先检查自己的生成函数是否有 Hankel 连分数。
entries.cynic_review: 显式公式和简化证明是实质贡献，适用序列仍有限。
entries.paper_review: 摘要说明了工具与公式类型，具体条件需读正文。

entries.source_title: How Much Is Left Matters: False Positives and False Negatives in Partial-Prompt Contamination Tests
entries.source_excerpt: Partial-prompt completion, where a model receives the first part of a benchmark problem and is checked for whether it reproduces the rest, is a widely used test for benchmark contamination. We audit this test on seven open-weight models using MATH-500 and recent AIME 2025/2026 problems, which serve as true negatives. Memorization flags depend strongly on how much text remains: for every model, problems with at most 8 leftover words are flagged several times more often than problems with at least 25 (31.5% vs. 5.5% for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), and half to three-quarters of all ROUGE-based flags come from short leftovers. On true negatives, a ROUGE-L >= 0.75 threshold flags up to 6.7% of problems at a 60% prefix, and at an 80% prefix even exact match flags 8.6% (pooled over models; 6.2% on AIME 2026, which postdates every model), against 0% at 40-60%. The test also misses contamination upstream: models distilled from Qwen2.5-Math, whose base is heavily flagged in prior work, show almost no model-specific recall. entries.title_zh: 剩余文本长度很关键：部分提示污染测试的误报与漏报
entries.summary_zh: 论文审计“给模型题目前半段，看它是否续出后半段”的基准污染检测，在七个开放权重模型和 MATH-500、AIME 题目上发现误报高度依赖剩余词数；短尾文本更容易触发相似度标记，较高前缀比例下即使准确匹配也会把未见过的题误报为污染。研究还指出该方法可能漏掉蒸馏链中的上游污染，建议按模型家族校准，而不是把单一阈值视为记忆证据。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 揭示常见基准污染测试同时存在长度相关误报和上游传播漏报。
entries.pragmatic_review: 评估模型污染时应控制剩余文本长度并报告误报率。

entries.paper_review: 摘要用多个模型与题集系统审计检测方法自身的可靠性。

entries.source_title: The Navier-Stokes Announcement: A case study in mathematical values
entries.source_excerpt: On September 8, 2026, OpenAI announced a resolution of the Navier-Stokes problem. I had expected to feel excitement if a solution was announced. Instead, my reaction was one of grief and revulsion. I will use the announcement to explore the universal human desires that underlie my reaction, I hope in a fashion that will reach beyond mathematicians.

entries.source_title: Log-concavity of rank and crank statistics for integer partitions
entries.source_excerpt: Let $M(m,n)$ and $N(m,n)$ denote the numbers of partitions of $n$ with crank $m$ and rank $m$, respectively. Ji and Zang [Adv. Math. 2021] conjectured that $M(m,n)$ is log-concave in $m$ for $n\ge72$ and $|m|\le n-72$, and that $N(m,n)$ is log-concave in $m$ for $n\ge73$ and $|m|\le n-73$. In this paper, we prove these two conjectures.
entries.title_zh: 整数分拆的 rank 与 crank 统计满足对数凹性猜想
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明 Ji 与 Zang 提出的两项猜想：对足够大的整数 n，在指定的 m 范围内，分拆 crank 计数 M(m,n) 与 rank 计数 N(m,n) 关于 m 均为对数凹序列。对数凹性意味着相邻项比值具有单调结构，常用于刻画组合计数分布；定理只覆盖摘要列明的 n 与 m 区间。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 解决整数分拆中两类经典统计量的对数凹性猜想。
entries.pragmatic_review: 组合数论读者可把结果用于分析分拆统计的形状性质。
entries.cynic_review: 结论有明确的最小 n 与 m 取值限制。

entries.source_title: Metric Poissonian Pair Correlation Property Part 2: The Case \(n\log n\)
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that $(\alpha n\log n)_{n\ge1}$ has Poissonian pair correlation for almost every real $\alpha$, solving a Problem posed by Aistleitner, El-Baz and Munsch [Open Problem 3, Geom. Funct. Anal. 2021]. Our main contribution is a new four-point counting estimate with a fixed power saving over $N^{7/3}$ at tolerance $N^{-1}$, valid on the ranges left after a first-moment and Borel--Cantelli argument. Its proof reduces the counting condition to the required proximity of an implicitly defined real root to an integer; a Fej\'er kernel majorizes this condition, and multidimensional van der Corput $A$- and $B$-processes supply the saving. A localized Mellin argument then yields the second-moment estimate needed for the metric conclusion.
entries.title_zh: 度量 Poisson 配对相关性（二）：αn log n 序列

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究均匀分布与数论序列局部统计的读者，展示四点计数如何导出几乎处处的配对相关结论。

entries.cynic_review: 结论是对几乎所有 α 的度量陈述，不保证每个特定 α。

entries.source_title: CASEL: Consequence-Aware Selective Execution for Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
entries.source_excerpt: Tool-using language agents increasingly modify external systems, yet most runtime safeguards allocate scrutiny by generic uncertainty scores or coarse mutation heuristics. We introduce CASEL (Consequence-Aware Selective Execution Layer), a model-agnostic runtime allocation policy that combines calibrated failure probability, state-dependent consequence, reversibility, ambiguity, and evidence freshness to choose, for each proposed tool call, among direct execution, verification, sandboxing, clarification, approval, and abstention by minimizing a per-mode cost. We formalize direct execution as selective prediction and state and test the validity conditions of a finite-sample threshold and a trajectory risk ledger. In a controlled simulation over 20 seeds with 120,000 test actions each, in which every method has the same intervention menu and the same compute cost, CASEL reduces harmful-side-effect trajectories from 14.75 percent for an uncertainty-ranked gate to 7.02 percent and mean normalized harm from 0.184 to 0.123. A gate ranked by the product of failure probability and consequence reaches similar harm (5.82 percent, 0.120) but sen
entries.title_zh: CASEL：按后果分配工具调用审查
entries.summary_zh: CASEL 根据失败概率、状态后果、可逆性、歧义和证据新鲜度，在直接执行、验证、沙盒、澄清、审批或拒绝间选择。受控模拟中它把相较不确定性排序门的有害轨迹率从 14.75% 降至 7.02%，平均归一化伤害从 0.184 降到 0.123；按“失败概率×后果”排序的对照门危害更低一些（5.82%、0.120），显示策略需权衡安全与干预成本，而非全面胜出。

entries.source_title: Convergence of the big J-function of a GKM manifold
entries.source_excerpt: The genus-$0$ equivariant Gromov--Witten (GW) invariants of a GKM manifold can be computed recursively by a recursion discovered by Brown and studied further by Coates--Corti--Iritani--Tseng. In this paper, we prove a slightly modified version of this result by realizing the J-function as a solution to a fixed-point problem. As an application, we prove that both the equivariant and the non-equivariant quantum cohomologies of a GKM manifold are convergent. We also show that the equivariant central charges have no poles in the spectral parameter, compute their monodromy and their asymptotics at $z=0$, and formulate an equivariant mirror symmetry conjecture for GKM manifolds.

entries.source_title: Same Rank, Different Needs: Rethinking LoRA Redistribution in Federated Learning
entries.source_excerpt: Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables clients with different resource budgets to collaboratively fine-tune foundation models. To distribute an aggregated update within each client's rank budget, existing methods commonly retain its leading singular directions. However, directions that best reconstruct the update matrix need not best preserve its responses on a particular client's inputs: a lower-energy direction may matter more to that recipient. We formalize this mismatch and show that matrix-optimal truncation can incur arbitrarily larger response error than another readout of the same rank. Motivated by this result, we propose Receiver-Aware Subspace Adaptation (RASA), a plug-in framework for receiver-aware knowledge transfer. RASA uses compact diagonal input second moments to perform uncentered PCA of receiver-weighted update responses. The resulting readout is globally optimal for the rank-constrained receiver objective and preserves at least as much response energy as spectral truncation under the diagonal metric. RASA also introduces spectral-reference aggregation, which removes the personalized initialization offset whi
entries.title_zh: 同样秩预算，不同客户端需求：重新思考联邦 LoRA 更新分配
entries.summary_zh: 论文指出，联邦 LoRA 常保留聚合更新的主奇异方向，但矩阵重构误差最小的截断不一定最能保留某个客户端输入上的模型响应；两者误差甚至可能相差任意大。作者据此提出 Receiver-Aware 子空间分配方法，让低秩方向针对接收方数据效用选择；实际效果取决于客户端数据代表性与通信设定。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 做异构联邦微调的团队可评估按客户端响应而非矩阵误差分配低秩方向。
entries.pragmatic_review: 有明确选型启示，按客户端任务指标复测秩分配即可。
entries.cynic_review: 说明了矩阵误差与实际响应会错位，数据代表性仍是风险。
entries.paper_review: 摘要包含任意大误差差异的理论结果和新方法，实验范围需看全文。

entries.title_zh: Astryx：面向人和 Agent 的 React 设计系统

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 个人前端开发者若正在用 React 构建可由编码 Agent 协助维护的界面，可查看其组件文档、CLI 和主题系统，评估是否适配现有技术栈。

project_insight.one_liner_zh: 把多个 AI 编程代理接入同一套本地记忆、审查和发布前检查工作流。

entries.source_title: Adapted transport inequalities in continuous time
entries.source_excerpt: Given a strong solution $X$ to a stochastic differential equation (SDE), we establish sufficient conditions under which $\text{Law}(X)$ satisfies an adapted quadratic transport cost inequality (AQTCI) with respect to the semimartingale adapted Wasserstein distance. When the drift and diffusion coefficients are Markovian, we further show that the AQTCI tensorizes in a dimension-free manner. As a corollary, we show that various stochastic control problems, e.g. optimal stopping and mean-variance portfolio selection, are stable under bounded, measurable drift perturbations. Additionally, we derive concentration inequalities (with respect to certain dynamic risk measures) for stochastic integrals $\int H_s dX_s$ and deduce appropriate bounds on their tail behavior. Furthermore, using the functional It\^o formula, we show that the AQTCI for $\text{Law}(X)$ allows one to deduce classical transport inequalities for $\text{Law}(F(X))$ even when $F$ is not Lipschitz on path space. Finally, we give sufficient conditions for $\text{Law}(X)$ to satisfy AQTCIs when $X$ is a solution to a scalar fractional SDE or stochastic Volterra equation.
entries.title_zh: 连续时间下的适应运输不等式
entries.summary_zh: 论文给出随机微分方程概率律满足 adapted transport–quantization inequality 的充分条件，并证明 Markov 系数下的维数无关张量化；还讨论稳定控制、集中不等式及分数阶或 Volterra 方程的条件。适应运输距离保留时间信息，和只比较终点分布的经典 Wasserstein 距离不同。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 研究 SDE、路径空间概率与集中不等式的读者可利用这些充分条件。
entries.pragmatic_review: 对随机过程误差与路径分布分析有用，应用需核对系数条件。
entries.cynic_review: 给的是充分条件而非必要刻画，别误读为覆盖所有 SDE。
entries.paper_review: 摘要展示了张量化和扩展方向，技术假设需读完整论文。

entries.source_title: General function bases moment models for suspended sediment with vertical profile of concentration
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce a general hydrostatic shallow moment framework for suspended sediment transport with vertically varying horizontal velocity and concentration profiles. The formulation is constructed over arbitrary vertical functional bases that are numerically orthogonalised via the Gram-Schmidt algorithm. This approach allows the approximation spaces for the vertical profile to be adapted to the specific structure of each physical variable, where also the velocity and sediment concentration can be projected onto different functional spaces. To overcome the limitations due to the inherent oscillatory nature of global Legendre polynomials, we explore a specific continuous piecewise linear $\mathbb{P}_1$ finite-element basis. Furthermore, non-uniform vertical partitions are considered, enabling an enhanced representation of the vertical profiles in specific regions. Numerical experiments involving boundary layers and suspended sediment transport demonstrate that the proposed framework is accurate to reproduce the expected vertical profiles. entries.title_zh: 垂向浓度剖面悬沙输运的一般函数基矩模型
entries.summary_zh: 论文建立浅水悬沙输运的静水矩框架，允许水平速度和泥沙浓度沿垂向变化，并在任意垂向函数基上表示这些剖面；不同物理量还可采用各自的近似空间。函数基通过 Gram–Schmidt 数值正交化，作者特别探索连续分片线性有限元基，以克服全局 Legendre 多项式的振荡局限；具体稳定性与数值性能需看论文后续分析。

entries.source_title: Near-Quadratic Sample Compression for All VC Classes
entries.source_excerpt: The sample compression conjecture is a longstanding open problem in learning theory, originating in the work of Littlestone and Warmuth in the 1980s. At its heart is a connection between simplification and generalization: if a predictor consistent with a training sample is defined using only a small part of that sample, then it is likely to generalize. Sample compression schemes formalize this idea, and many natural learning algorithms can be analyzed this way. The sample compression conjecture of Floyd and Warmuth (1995) asserts that every binary concept class of VC dimension $d$ admits a sample compression scheme of size $O(d)$; a weaker conjecture asks only for size polynomial in $d$. Both have remained open: the first bound depending only on $d$, due to Moran and Yehudayoff (2016), is exponential in $d$. We prove the weaker conjecture by constructing a sample compression scheme of size $O(d^2 \log^2 d)$.
entries.title_zh: 所有 VC 类的近二次样本压缩
entries.summary_zh: 样本压缩猜想认为 VC 维为 d 的二元概念类可用 O(d) 个样本点及少量信息重建一致预测器；更弱的“仅要求多项式规模”版本长期未解。本文证明弱猜想，构造大小为 O(d² log²d) 的样本压缩方案，将此前关于任意 VC 类的指数级上界降为近二次对数级。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 样本压缩把学习泛化与训练样本可简化性相连，该结果解决了长期开放的多项式界版本。
entries.pragmatic_review: 改进界有助于理论学习者估计一致学习器的压缩复杂度。
entries.cynic_review: 仍未达到线性规模的原猜想，且构造的具体常数和算法形式需阅读全文。
entries.paper_review: 完成弱样本压缩猜想，是 VC 学习理论中长期存在的结构性进展。

entries.source_title: Gradient-Based Co-Design of Systems and Reinforcement Learning Policies with Differentiable Simulators
entries.source_excerpt: Co-design is the problem of jointly optimizing the design of a system and the policy that operates it. Neither can be chosen independently: a system design is only as good as the policy trained for it, and the optimal policy changes with the design. When that policy is learned by reinforcement learning (RL), evaluating a candidate design requires a full policy training run, and the design is usually optimized by black-box search such as Bayesian optimization (BO) or evolution strategies (ES). These methods scale poorly with the design dimension and ignore the differentiable structure of modern simulators and, in particular, the sensitivity of the optimal policy with respect to the design. We instead derive a gradient-based co-design method, where the design gradient decomposes into a direct effect of changing the design at a fixed policy and an indirect effect through the design-dependent optimal policy. The indirect effect requires the sensitivity of the converged policy to the design, which we obtain by applying the implicit function theorem to the stationarity condition of the policy gradient. entries.title_zh: 利用可微模拟器对系统设计与强化学习策略进行梯度协同优化

entries.cynic_review: 梯度方法依赖模拟器可微性及策略达到稳定点等条件。
entries.paper_review: 摘录清楚说明梯度分解与隐函数工具，但缺少实验结果细节。

entries.source_title: Generic tensor products are not maximal

entries.title_zh: 一般位置张量积并非极大
entries.summary_zh: 论文构造均匀拟阵的张量积，证明某些情形严格比一般线性张量积“更自由”；例如两个 U_{7,9} 的一般张量积并非极大，并推广到指定参数族。该构造否定 Mason 猜想的一种均匀拟阵张量积表述；作者还得到不可由任何域表示的拟阵，以及各维度的 Jackson–Tanigawa 超连通性猜想反例。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 这是组合拟阵结构中的反例型结果，影响多个相关猜想。
entries.pragmatic_review: 结论涵盖具体反例和推广。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要未展开构造细节与定义约定。
entries.paper_review: 明确指出被否定猜想及推论范围。

entries.source_title: Pointwise to global good reduction problems
entries.source_excerpt: Given a smooth proper family of varieties over some $p$-adic field, if (sufficiently many of) the closed fibers have good reduction, does the family as a whole have good reduction? This question is asked and positively answered in recent work of Cadoret-Tamagawa for curves in general, and abelian varieties if the base field has absolute ramification at most $p-1$. In this paper we define a general framework for studying this question, yielding new positive answers for families of K3 surfaces and cubic fourfoulds, again with ramification at most $p-1$. Our strategy is to study several extension properties of moduli spaces and how they transfer under various morphisms. Of particular importance are integral canonical models of Shimura varieties, and whether or not their extension properties are preserved under ramified scalar extension. Additionally, building on earlier counterexamples by Raynaud-Ogus-Gabber and Vasiu-Zink, we show that the ramification assumption is optimal for the result of Cadoret-Tamagawa on families of abelian varieties. entries.source_title: Uniformising random greedy maximal independent sets on graphs with at most five vertices
entries.source_excerpt: A random greedy algorithm scans the vertices of a finite graph in increasing order of independent exponential arrival times and accepts each vertex unless an accepted neighbour blocks it. We ask an inverse question: can strictly positive finite arrival rates be chosen so that the terminal inclusion-maximal independent sets are all equally likely? We call this exact property exponential greedy uniformisability (EGU). We establish the complete small-order classification: every finite simple graph on at most five vertices is EGU, with the unique exception of the five-vertex path $P_5$ up to graph isomorphism. A strict $2\times2$ probability minor provides an explicit obstruction for the exceptional graph; the positive cases are certified by graph-isomorphism reduction and exact constructive witnesses. We explain the independent-exponential-clock probability law and the formal Lean 4 verification, registered as Palomar PALOMAR-2026-11-19-000021 (version 1). The registration is a formal proof record, not a claim of novelty certification or journal peer review.

entries.source_title: Inverse scattering for the one-dimensional discrete Schr\"odinger operator: a computational perspective
entries.source_excerpt: We revisit inverse scattering for the one-dimensional discrete Schr\"odinger operator with compactly supported perturbation. We consider a computational perspective, adapted to the case of a digitally sampled reflection coefficient, to determine the perturbation in the form of a Jacobi matrix, including a computation of the length of the smallest interval supporting the perturbation. A new representation of scattering data in terms of orthogonal polynomials underpins the computational results. A key technical role is played by polynomials on the circle constructed from pairs of successive orthogonal polynomials on the line. The inverse algorithm is demonstrated on numerical examples.

entries.source_title: Isolation of $k$-cliques in uniform hypergraphs
entries.source_excerpt: A copy of a hypergraph $F$ is called an $F$-copy. For any integers $k$ and $r$ with $2 \leq r \leq k$, let $K_k^r$ denote the complete $r$-uniform hypergraph whose vertex set is $[k] = \{1, 2, \dots, k\}$ (that is, the edges of $K_k^r$ are the $r$-element subsets of $[k]$). Given an $r$-uniform $m$-edge hypergraph $H$, the $K_k^r$-isolation number of $H$, denoted by $\iota(H, K_k^r)$, is the size of a smallest subset $D$ of the vertex set of $H$ such that the closed neighbourhood $N[D]$ of $D$ intersects the vertex sets of the $K_k^r$-copies contained by $H$ (equivalently, $H-N[D]$ contains no $K_k^r$-copy). We prove that if $H$ is connected and not a $K_k^r$-copy, then $$\iota(H, K^r_k) \le \left \lfloor \frac{(r-1)m + 1}{(r-1)(\binom{k}{r}+1) + 1} \right \rfloor.$$ The bound is best possible. This is a solution to a problem of Li, Zhang and Ye. We also provide an alternative proof for $r < k$. Both proofs introduce new ideas for establishing bounds on isolation parameters.

entries.source_title: Growing-time trace fluctuations and self-averaging form factors of Grover walks on random lifts
entries.source_excerpt: We prove a functional central limit theorem for trace statistics of Grover walks on random $N$-lifts of a fixed finite connected simple $d$-regular graph, $d\geq3$. All observations are computed from the same random lift. The squared centred traces, divided by their observation times, have averages converging in probability to a degree-dependent constant. Their partial sums, centred at this constant and divided by the square root of the window length, converge to Brownian motion. For a window of length $M$ beginning at $t\geq1$, it suffices that $M\to\infty$ and $R^4(d-1)^R/N\to0$, where $R=t+M$. The initial time may remain fixed, with no further restriction on $M/t$. Convergence holds jointly with fixed low-degree polynomial trace statistics; their limiting vector is independent of the Brownian motion. For non-bipartite bases, we also identify Gaussian trace limits at fixed time offsets. Under common initial-time normalisation, subtracting a deterministic growth profile gives an explicit Brownian time change when $M/t$ has a finite limit. entries.source_title: Chern classes, Poincar\'e polynomials, and Bernstein-Sato polynomials of plane curves
entries.source_excerpt: We show that the Poincar\'e polynomial of a reduced plane curve $C$ is the Chern polynomial of the dual of the bundle of Jacobian syzygies of $C$. Using the Zeuthen-Segre formula, we prove that its value at $t=-1$ equals the Euler number of the complement of $C$ up to the correction term $\mu(C)-\tau(C)$, so the two numbers coincide if and only if all singularities of $C$ are quasi-homogeneous. As applications, we show that the defect in a combinatorial inequality for free $d$-arrangements is the square of the difference of the exponents, extend the addition technique to arbitrary reduced plane curves, and locate the roots of local Bernstein-Sato polynomials at ordinary singular points.
entries.title_zh: 平面曲线的 Chern 类、Poincaré 多项式与 Bernstein–Sato 多项式

entries.source_title: Approximating It\^o Processes in Adapted Wasserstein Distance with Finite Support Laws
entries.source_excerpt: Motivated by finite-scenario surrogates in stopping and control problems, we study the approximation of It\^o diffusion laws by laws supported on $M$ paths in an adapted Wasserstein distance, which we term adapted functional quantization. Under the strict adapted Wasserstein distance, no finite-support approximation can achieve vanishing error, while even under its relaxed counterpart, naive empirical measures still fail to converge. To resolve this, we develop a recursive conditional sampling algorithm and derive constructive upper bounds on the adapted quantization error. In one dimension, this yields the Brownian rate $(\log M)^{-1/2}$ for every diffusion with continuous coefficients of linear growth and pathwise uniqueness. In several dimensions, a quantitative Osgood stability condition with exponent $\beta$ yields the rate $(\log M)^{-\eta_p}$, where $\eta_p=\min\{1/2,\beta/(\beta+4p-2)\}$. Without the Osgood condition, we construct a two-dimensional diffusion with smooth bounded coefficients whose adapted quantization error decays more slowly than $(\log M)^{-\gamma}$ for any $\gamma>0$.

entries.source_title: From Stories to Features: Scaling Concept Vectors for AI Alignment & Interpretability
entries.source_excerpt: We study feature vectors: directions in a language model's activation space that correspond to human-interpretable concepts, such as honesty or deception. Existing unsupervised methods like sparse autoencoders attempt to recover the whole feature space, often at the cost of feature quality and interpretability. We take a more pragmatic route: focusing on concepts relevant to AI safety and alignment, we generate synthetic concept-antagonist story pairs and use the difference of their mean model activations as a feature vector. We scale this approach to 1,036 alignment-relevant concepts using 2M synthetic stories across multiple languages and genres, which we publicly release. Across six models from three model families, our feature vectors reliably generalize to detecting their corresponding concepts in chat dialogues and web text. They form an interpretable geometry shared across models and can causally steer model behavior when injected into activations. entries.title_zh: 从故事到特征：扩展用于 AI 对齐与可解释性的概念向量

entries.source_title: Convergence analysis of physics-informed neural networks for subdiffusion
entries.source_excerpt: Physics-informed neural networks have emerged as mesh-free solvers for partial differential equations, yet their rigorous convergence theory for time-fractional problems remains limited. We present a convergence analysis of PINNs for linear subdiffusion equations and for the associated backward problem of recovering the initial data from terminal observations. To address the nonlocality and weakly singular kernels of fractional derivatives, we introduce a discretization-based PINN framework built on some popular time-stepping schemes satisfying discrete maximal regularity, including backward Euler, BDF2, L1, and fractional CN schemes. This approach avoids the exact evaluation of fractional derivatives at training points while preserving the stability structure needed for convergence analysis. For the forward problem, we prove that, under the natural fractional maximal-regularity condition $u\in W^{\alpha,p}(0,T;L^2(\Omega))\cap L^p(0,T;H^2(\Omega)\cap H_0^1(\Omega))$, the piecewise linear temporal reconstructions of PINN-loss minimizers converge to the exact solution. entries.title_zh: 亚扩散方程 PINN 的收敛分析
entries.summary_zh: 论文为线性亚扩散方程及其由终端观测反推初值的问题建立 PINN 收敛框架，利用满足离散最大正则性的时间步进格式构造离散化 PINN 损失。作者证明，在给定分数阶正则性条件下，前向问题中损失极小化器的分段线性时间重构收敛到精确解；方法避免在训练点直接计算奇异分数阶导数，同时保留离散稳定结构。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 补充 PINN 在时间分数阶方程中的严格收敛理论，而不只展示经验拟合。
entries.pragmatic_review: 研究亚扩散反问题或 PINN 理论时可借鉴离散损失设计。
entries.cynic_review: 理论针对线性模型和指定最大正则性条件。
entries.paper_review: 摘要交代了收敛对象、假设及避免分数阶直接求值的原因。

entries.title_zh: 多项式相互作用粒子系统的条件混沌传播
entries.summary_zh: 本文考虑离散时间演化的 N 个相互作用粒子，每个粒子受到多项式平均场作用，并共同承受由独立随机场构成的多线性集体扰动。随着 N 与时间步数同时增大，系统收敛到一个额外布朗运动驱动的条件 McKean–Vlasov 方程，并给出 Wasserstein-2 距离的显式误差界；证明结合不变原理、Wiener chaos 中心极限定理和条件 U 统计大数定律。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 刻画共同噪声扰动如何在大粒子数极限中形成额外布朗驱动。
entries.pragmatic_review: 显式 Wasserstein 界可用于定量评估有限粒子系统近似条件均场模型的误差。
entries.cynic_review: 假设包含特定多项式相互作用和高阶独立随机场结构，适用范围需对照模型。
entries.paper_review: 将多项式集体扰动纳入条件混沌传播并推导定量收敛。

entries.title_zh: The Open Distillation Codex：大型多领域蒸馏数据集

entries.pragmatic_review: 若只做初步调查，可先检查数据集分片、样本格式和具体来源，再挑少量样本验证其是否适合自己的研究任务。

entries.source_title: A note on functional non-central limit theorem for periodic regime-switching stable-like processes
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we establish a functional non-central limit theorem for regime-switching stable-like processes with periodic coefficients. Our approach relies on stochastic analysis methods, in particular semimartingale characteristics, combined with the ergodic theory of Markov processes. If the set on which the order function achieves its minimum value $\underline{\alpha}$ has positive Lebesgue measure, then the limit is a rotationally invariant $\underline{\alpha}$-stable L\'evy process. Otherwise, the limit is the zero process.
entries.title_zh: 周期状态切换稳定型过程的函数型非中心极限定理
entries.summary_zh: 论文结合半鞅特征与 Markov 过程遍历理论，研究周期系数状态切换稳定型过程的缩放极限。摘要称阶函数取最小值的集合若有正测度，极限为相应指数的旋转不变稳定 Lévy 过程；否则为零过程。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合异常扩散与随机环境的极限理论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 刻画不同微观区域如何主导宏观极限。
entries.cynic_review: 极限类型取决于最小值集合的测度。
entries.paper_review: 非高斯极限与退化极限形成条件分界。

entries.source_title: A Lambda Calculus Based on Quantum Logic
entries.source_excerpt: We propose a typed lambda calculus based on quantum logic. We first present a natural deduction system for quantum logic with the Sasaki hook as its implication operation and then formulate a typed lambda calculus connected to this system through the Curry-Howard correspondence. We prove soundness and completeness of the former with respect to orthomodular lattices and strong normalization of the latter. The resulting lambda calculus has the characteristic feature that only one assumption is available in the typing derivation that serves as the premise of $\lambda$-abstraction. Under this restriction, ordinary currying is not available in general, but it is still possible to perform $\lambda$-abstraction by combining multiple assumptions into a single argument of product type and to construct a term corresponding to a deduction using the Sasaki projection.
entries.title_zh: 基于量子逻辑的 Lambda 演算
entries.summary_zh: 作者为量子逻辑构造带类型 lambda 演算，采用 Sasaki hook 作为蕴涵，并证明自然演绎系统对正交模格可靠完备、对应演算强正规化。类型推导限制为单一假设，因此普通柯里化一般不可用，但可把多个假设打包为积类型参数，并构造对应 Sasaki 投影演算的项。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合逻辑、量子信息和 Curry–Howard 对应研究。
entries.pragmatic_review: 强正规化表示不会出现无限计算归约。
entries.cynic_review: 同时证明语义可靠完备与归约终止。
entries.paper_review: 类型上下文受限，不能直接使用通常函数逻辑的全部结构。

entries.source_title: The Walsh spectrum of the Dobbertin APN function
entries.source_excerpt: APN functions yield the best resistance to differential attacks when used as a building block of a block cipher. APN functions induced by monomials over finite fields have received particular interest both for their simplicity and their unique properties. A key property of APN functions is their linearity, which has been determined for all known APN monomials outside of the Dobbertin APN monomials. In this paper, we close this gap and determine the complete Walsh spectrum and in particular the linearity of the Dobbertin APN monomial, answering a problem that has been open for more than 20 years. Using known connections, our result also yields the asymptotically largest Sidon sets in elementary abelian $2$-groups constructed so far as well as binary linear codes of minimum distance $5$ that are almost optimal.
entries.title_zh: Dobbertin APN 函数的 Walsh 谱
entries.summary_zh: APN 函数常用于构造具有较强差分攻击抵抗力的分组密码组件；Dobbertin 单项式此前缺少完整线性度刻画。本文确定其完整 Walsh 谱，从而补上一个开放二十多年的线性度问题，并利用已知联系构造有限域二元群中的大 Sidon 集及接近最优的最小距离为 5 的二元线性码。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 补齐一类重要 APN 单项式的谱信息，并展示其与编码和加法组合结构的联系。
entries.pragmatic_review: 结果与密码组件分析及码构造都有明确连接。
entries.cynic_review: 理论线性度结果本身不等同于完整密码系统安全证明。
entries.paper_review: 解决长期空缺并导出多个组合推论，数学内容集中。

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 网页搜索成本会直接影响代理规模化使用，值得追踪，但目前证据不足以支持结论。

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关注数学文献可复核性与 AI 辅助形式化审阅。
entries.pragmatic_review: 找到疑点、形式化检查和发布勘误是不同阶段，不能混为自动修复。
entries.cynic_review: 切入真实存在的文献错误与长期维护问题。

entries.source_title: An ancient diophantine problem of Brahmagupta
entries.source_excerpt: In the seventh century CE, Brahmagupta gave a parametric solution to the problem of finding two numbers $x$ and $y$ such that $x+y, x-y$ and $xy+1$ are all squares. We describe a method for generating infinitely many rational parametric solutions of the problem and another method for generating parametric solutions of the problem in terms of univariate polynomials with integer coefficients. The complete solution of the problem still remains elusive.
entries.title_zh: 婆罗摩笈多提出的一个古老丢番图问题
entries.summary_zh: 论文回到七世纪的问题：寻找 x、y，使 x+y、x−y 与 xy+1 都是平方数。作者给出生成无穷多个有理参数解的方法，也构造系数为整数的一元多项式参数解；但文章明确指出完整解集仍未解决。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 连接古典丢番图问题与现代参数化构造，并清楚标出尚未完成的部分。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于课堂展示如何从一个数论条件寻找参数族。
entries.cynic_review: 产生无穷多解不等于分类了所有解。
entries.paper_review: 历史问题、构造方法和未解边界在摘要中区分清楚。

entries.source_title: On generation of the coefficient field of a primitive HMF by a single Fourier coefficient: An application of Nekov\'a\v{r}'s Theorem
entries.source_excerpt: Let $f$ be a non-CM primitive Hilbert modular form (HMF) over a totally real number field, of parallel even weight $k\geq 2$, with coefficient field $E_f$, and let $F_f \subseteq E_f$ denote the field fixed by the inner twists of $f$. In this article, we establish an analogue of Ribet's large image theorem for the residual Galois representations associated with $f$, by applying Nekov\'a\v{r}'s large image theorem (cf.~\cite[Theorem B.5.2]{Nek12}) to the automorphic representation $\pi(f)$ associated with $f$. As a result, we prove that if $f$ has no nontrivial inner twists, then $E_f$ is generated by a single prime Fourier coefficient, for a set of prime ideals of Dirichlet density one. We derive this result as a consequence of a more general theorem established for $F_f$.
entries.title_zh: 单个 Fourier 系数生成 Hilbert 模形式系数域
entries.summary_zh: 论文将 Ribet 的大像定理类比推广到全实数域上的非 CM 本原 Hilbert 模形式，并使用 Nekovář 的大像定理研究其剩余 Galois 表示。若该形式没有非平凡内扭，则对 Dirichlet 密度为 1 的素理想集合，其系数域可由一个素理想 Fourier 系数生成；一般情形先对内扭固定子域给出对应结论。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: Hilbert 模形式、Galois 表示和自守形式数论研究者可关注单个系数生成域的密度一结论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 结论精确但高度专业，直接用途在系数域与表示像研究。
entries.cynic_review: 需要非 CM、本原及无内扭等假设，密度一不是所有素理想。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出使用定理、假设和密度结论，证明细节需查正文。

entries.source_title: Distill What You Trust: Reliability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
entries.source_excerpt: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation allows a student to learn from complementary specialists on its own trajectories. Domain-routed approaches, however, select one teacher per example and keep it fixed throughout the response. This design both depends on domain labels that mixed training corpora often lack and cannot adapt teacher selection when the expertise required changes within a trajectory. We observe that each specialist deviates more from a shared reference on in-domain prompts than on out-of-domain prompts, on average. Based on this observation, we propose \textbf{TrustMOPD}, which replaces example-level teacher selection with label-free, token-level supervision allocation. At each student-generated prefix, TrustMOPD measures this displacement in next-token preferences, calibrates its magnitude across teachers, and uses the resulting scores as proxies for local reliability to weight teacher-specific distillation losses.
