entries.title_zh: 蒸馏可信内容：可靠性感知的多教师在线蒸馏
entries.summary_zh: TrustMOPD 不再按整条样本固定选择一位教师，而是在学生生成的每个 token 前缀上，依据教师相对共享参考模型的偏移估计局部可靠性，并分配蒸馏权重。数学、代码和指令任务中，作者报告该方法分别弥合 SingleCap 与 MultiCap 设置下 91.5% 和 98.0% 的学生到 oracle 路由分数差距，明显高于无标签基线；这些数字来自论文设定。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 使用多位专长模型训练学生模型的团队可关注逐 token 教师分配。
entries.pragmatic_review: 无需领域标签是优点，需评估参考模型偏移是否真能识别可靠性。
entries.cynic_review: 接近 oracle 的比例亮眼，但 oracle 路由本身定义了比较上限。
entries.paper_review: 三类任务和定量结果较具体，跨数据集泛化仍需测。

entries.source_title: Galois Groups of Trinomials with Small Coefficients
entries.source_excerpt: We calculate the Galois group of $f = x^n + ax^k + b \in \mathbb{Z}\left[ x \right]$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ for all $1 \leq \left| ab \right| \leq 3$, $n$ sufficiently large and $k$ coprime to $n$. In particular, we prove that the Galois group of $f$ is the maximal one that its factorization type allows. We do it by proving a new sufficient condition for the Galois group of a factor of a trinomial to be symmetric, which perhaps can be used to derive stronger results of this kind in the future.
entries.title_zh: 小系数三项式的伽罗瓦群
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究 f=xⁿ+a xᵏ+b∈Z[x]，在 1≤|ab|≤3、n 充分大且 k 与 n 互素时，计算其在 Q 上的伽罗瓦群。作者证明该群达到由多项式因式分解类型所允许的最大群，并为三项式因子的伽罗瓦群为对称群给出新的充分条件；摘要称这一条件或可用于进一步推广。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数数论读者了解小系数稀疏多项式的伽罗瓦群何时达到分解类型允许的上限。
entries.pragmatic_review: 明确的参数范围为后续验证其他系数与指数情形提供参照。
entries.cynic_review: 结果局限于小 |ab|、互素指数和充分大 n。
entries.paper_review: 摘要陈述主范围与关键充分条件，但具体例外和阈值需读论文。

entries.source_title: General Criterion for a Poset to Admit a Partition Into $\omega$-Chains
entries.source_excerpt: Given a poset $P$ with no maximal element the question naturally arises of when $P$ can be partitioned into $\omega$-chains. In this paper we give general criterion for when this can be done. We show that in the case when a poset with no maximal element is countable or a well-founded forest, then it can always be partitioned into $\omega$-chains. We then introduce the lifting property for posets with no maximal element and show that a poset can be partitioned into $\omega$-chains if and only if it has the lifting property.
entries.title_zh: 偏序集划分为 ω 链的一般判据
entries.summary_zh: 论文讨论没有极大元的偏序集何时可划分成若干条序型为 ω 的链。作者证明可数偏序集及良基森林都可如此划分，并提出 lifting property，进而证明任意无极大元偏序集可划分为 ω 链，当且仅当它满足该性质。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 将偏序链分解问题归结为一个必要且充分的结构性质。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可作为偏序分解和序理论问题的通用判别工具。
entries.cynic_review: lifting property 的使用价值取决于在具体偏序中能否容易验证。
entries.paper_review: 既给出典型类别的存在性，也给出一般充要条件。

entries.source_title: Conditional Reflected Backward Stochastic Differential Equations
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we introduce a new type of reflected backward stochastic differential equations (reflected BSDEs), referred to as conditional reflected BSDEs, in which the conditional expectation of the Y-component of the solution with respect to a given sub-{\sigma}-algebra appears in both the generator and the obstacle. Under a Lipschitz condition on the loss function with sufficiently small Lipschitz constants, we establish the existence and uniqueness of the solution for both the case of Lipschitz generator and the case of quadratic generator, bounded terminal value and bounded loss function. When the generator has quadratic growth and the terminal value and loss function are unbounded, we establish the uniqueness with the help of {\theta}-method. Finally, a penalization approximation scheme holds under an additional monotonicity structure imposed on the generator and the loss function, without any restriction on the Lipschitz constants of the loss function.
entries.title_zh: 条件反射型倒向随机微分方程
entries.summary_zh: 论文定义条件反射 BSDE：解的 Y 分量对指定子 σ-代数的条件期望同时进入生成元和障碍。对足够小 Lipschitz 常数的损失函数，作者证明 Lipschitz 及二次生成元情形的解存在唯一；终值和损失无界、生成元为二次增长时，则用 θ 方法证明唯一性。另在生成元与损失函数满足单调结构时建立惩罚逼近，而不再限制损失函数的 Lipschitz 常数。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把条件期望反馈纳入反射 BSDE，并分别处理有界与无界设定下的适定性。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于带条件信息约束的随机最优停止或风险控制建模。
entries.cynic_review: 部分存在性结果要求小 Lipschitz 常数，惩罚逼近另需单调条件。
entries.paper_review: 对不同增长条件分别给出存在唯一性与逼近结论。

entries.source_title: Abelian varieties with homotheties
entries.source_excerpt: In 1980, Bogomolov proved that the $\ell$-adic Galois image of an Abelian variety over a number field contains an open subgroup of the homotheties. In 1986, Serre refined that result, showing that the homotheties coming from the Galois side were uniformly bounded in $\ell$ inside the homotheties of the codomain of the representation. In a 2007 paper, Zarhin shows that Bogomolov's conclusion can fail in non-trivial cases for global function fields. We prove a suitable analogue of Serre's results over finitely generated fields of positive characteristic. As a consequence, we prove a new case of the 1978 conjecture by Geyer and Jarden.
entries.title_zh: 正特征有限生成域上的同伦特征阿贝尔簇
entries.summary_zh: 论文在正特征有限生成域上研究带有同伦标量作用的阿贝尔簇，提出并证明一个对应 Serre 结果的推广。作者称其处理了 Geyer–Jarden 猜想中的新情形；结论依赖域与几何对象的特定假设，摘要没有展开完整分类条件。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 从事阿贝尔簇、伽罗瓦表示与正特征算术几何的读者可关注。
entries.pragmatic_review: 高度专业的结构定理，主要服务相关算术几何研究。
entries.cynic_review: 推广方向清楚，摘要未列完整域假设与例外。
entries.paper_review: 预印本提出具体猜想新情形，细节需核对定理表述。

entries.source_title: On the Limits of Sufficient Explanations
entries.source_excerpt: We formally characterize the conditions under which sufficient explanations exist for classifiers on structured data such as graphs and strings. We focus on post-hoc explainers that select parts of the input as sufficient explanations. An explanation is sufficient if the selected part alone ensures the predicted label. Sufficient explanations have been widely adopted across data modalities, including graphs, strings, and images. However, a unified formal analysis of sufficient explanations remains missing. We bridge this gap with four main contributions: (i) We define a general explanation formalism consisting of an instance space, a classifier, and a select relation. The select relation specifies which potential sub-instances or feature subsets can be selected as explanations from each instance; (ii) We show that the existence of sufficient explainers is fully characterized by the interplay between the classifier and the select relation; (iii) We extend this analysis to practically relevant variants of sufficiency, including probabilistic sufficiency and deletion sufficiency; (iv) Based on the formal analysis, we devise statistics th
entries.title_zh: 充分解释的存在边界
entries.summary_zh: 论文形式化研究图、字符串等结构化输入分类器的“充分解释”：选出的输入部分单独存在时仍能保证预测标签，并证明其是否存在取决于分类器与可选子实例关系。作者扩展到概率充分性和删除充分性，构造任务级统计上界；在语言、蛋白质和分子数据上的评估显示，多数任务无法达到完全充分，因而任何解释器都受任务本身限制。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把可解释性评价从比较解释器转为先问任务是否允许充分解释。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用其上界避免对不可能达到的解释目标过度承诺。
entries.cynic_review: 任务级上界有助校准，但具体解释质量仍需其他指标评估。
entries.paper_review: 提供统一形式化、充分性变体和跨领域数据验证。

entries.source_title: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
entries.title_zh: FairStress：更深入评估大语言模型决策公平性的基准
entries.summary_zh: Ai2 发布 FairStress 基准，评估模型在招聘、借贷、医疗、教育和住房等高影响决策中是否公平，关注点超出最终选谁，还检查模型如何推理与给出理由。项目提供数据和代码，并计划接入 Olmo-eval；目前这是评测工具发布，不能单独证明现实部署中的公平性。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究 LLM 公平性评测的团队，尤其是想区分决策结果与决策过程的研究者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 补充传统身份互换基准对过程层面的覆盖。
entries.cynic_review: 基准表现不等同于现实社会中的公平保障，需审查场景覆盖。
entries.paper_review: 公开数据与工具降低复现实验门槛，指标效度仍需外部检验。

entries.source_title: 出道30天吸粉40万，AI演员“方桃子”首条商单引发6.82万元罚单
entries.title_zh: AI 虚拟演员广告违规被罚 6.82 万元
entries.summary_zh: AIbase 报道称，广州番禺监管部门认定虚拟演员“方桃子”推广彩色隐形眼镜时存在虚假宣传，运营公司被罚款 6.82 万余元；报道还提及相关产品广告审批要求。案例说明虚拟形象参与商业宣传并不会免除广告主和运营方的真实性、资质审核责任，具体法律适用应以行政处罚决定为准。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对使用虚拟人或生成式内容做商业推广的团队有合规参考价值。
entries.pragmatic_review: 发布前应核查代言表述、产品资质和广告审批。
entries.cynic_review: 单个处罚案例不能替代对具体行业规则的法律审查。
entries.paper_review: 监管新闻，不是 AI 技术研究。

entries.source_title: On the loss landscape of the linear neural network: beyond critical points
entries.source_excerpt: While the critical points of the loss landscape in linear neural networks have been extensively studied since the seminal work of Baldi \& Hornik in the late 1980s, a description of this landscape at an intermediate or global scale is still lacking. Such a characterization is crucial, particularly as a substantial body of literature indicates that gradient descent circumvents critical points. The present article introduces an intermediate structure, termed the critical thalweg, which encompasses all critical points and exhibits key geometric properties. Beyond providing a geometric proof of Baldi \& Hornik's results using simpler assumptions than the existing literature, this framework offers a global view of the loss landscape that can be easily visualized in a two-dimensional plane. Empirical observations suggest that gradient descent is attracted toward the critical thalweg, along which the loss continues to decrease to its global minimum.
entries.title_zh: 线性神经网络损失地形：超越临界点
entries.summary_zh: 针对线性神经网络损失地形已知临界点结构、但中间尺度与全局几何描述不足的问题，作者提出“临界谷道”（critical thalweg），一个包含所有临界点并具有特定几何性质的中间结构。它以较简单假设几何化证明 Baldi–Hornik 结果，并提供二维可视化的全局图景；实验观察显示梯度下降趋向该谷道并沿其继续降低损失至全局最小值。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 从临界点分类走向整片损失地形的几何描述，为理解梯度下降轨迹提供新的可视化对象。
entries.pragmatic_review: 临界谷道可作为研究优化路径和损失结构的分析框架。
entries.cynic_review: 梯度下降趋向谷道是摘要中的经验观察，不能混同为普遍收敛定理。
entries.paper_review: 提出中间几何结构并重证经典结论，但全局优化解释仍需区分理论与实验证据。

entries.source_title: On-Policy Transition Distillation
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) consolidates expert capabilities into a single student by matching teacher and student final-layer distributions on student-generated rollouts. We investigate whether depthwise prediction transitions, the changes in predictions between layers, can provide additional task-relevant supervision. Our diagnostic study finds that stronger teacher--student agreement in intermediate transitions is associated with higher answer correctness within questions, with correct responses exhibiting lower mean transition KL across all measured intermediate layer pairs. These observations motivate On-Policy Transition Distillation (OPTD), which augments final-layer distribution matching by aligning teacher and student layer-to-layer log-probability increments on student-generated rollouts. Evaluations across three backbones and eight benchmarks spanning mathematics, coding, and instruction following show that OPTD achieves the best or tied-best overall performance in both dual- and three-domain distillation. In the three-domain setting, OPTD recovers $\approx 90\%$ of the overall teacher--student capability gap, compared wit
entries.title_zh: 在线策略转移蒸馏
entries.summary_zh: 在线策略蒸馏通常在学生生成的轨迹上匹配师生最终层分布；论文研究各层预测变化能否补充有用监督。诊断结果显示，在题目内部，师生中间层转移越一致的回答往往越正确，正确回答在测量的层对上具有更低平均转移 KL；据此提出 OPTD，在最终层分布匹配外增加层间对数概率转移对齐。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把隐藏层逐步形成预测的过程纳入蒸馏，而不只匹配最终输出分布。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合希望保留专家推理行为而不只复制最终答案的模型训练。
entries.cynic_review: 层间 KL 与正确率的关联不自动证明蒸馏对齐会带来因果提升。
entries.paper_review: 先用过程诊断支持设计，再提出对应蒸馏目标。

entries.source_title: Combinatorial relative orientability for toric and tropical geometry
entries.source_excerpt: Many problems in enumerative geometry are solved by computing the degree of the top Chern class of a suitable vector bundle. Results from $\mathbb{A}^1$-homotopy theory allow to answer enumerative questions over arbitrary fields, replacing the top Chern class by the Euler class in Chow-Witt groups. For its degree to be well-defined, one needs the vector bundle to be relatively oriented. Another way to solve enumerative problems is to translate them to tropical geometry, where they become combinatorial problems. In this paper, we give a combinatorial description of relative orientability for vector bundles over smooth proper toric varieties. We show that it behaves well under tropicalization, establishing a tropical version of relative orientability, which will allow to the use of tropical geometry to answer enumerative questions over arbitrary fields. As a demonstration, we prove a quadratically enriched version of the Bernstein-Khovanskii-Kushnirenko theorem via tropical geometry. Lastly, we define the notion of $k$-phase structures on tropical hypersurfaces, generalizing the real case.
entries.title_zh: 环面与热带几何中的组合相对定向
entries.summary_zh: 在 A¹ 同伦枚举几何中，向量丛的相对定向关系到 Chow–Witt 群 Euler 类的次数能否定义。本文为光滑适当环面簇上的相对定向给出组合描述，讨论其在热带化下的表现，并用热带几何导出二次增强的 BKK 定理及 k-phase 结构。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把枚举几何所需的定向数据转成扇与热带对象上的组合条件。
entries.pragmatic_review: 组合判据可能简化具体 toric 计算，并为二次增强的计数提供工具。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要没有列出定向判据和 BKK 公式的具体形式，实用范围还待阅读全文。
entries.paper_review: 连接 A¹ 枚举几何与热带化，强调了定向数据的可组合处理。

entries.source_title: A Structure-Preserving Scheme for Computing the Gradient of the Eikonal Equation
entries.source_excerpt: We propose a first-order, structure-preserving method for directly computing the normalized traveltime gradient of the eikonal equation in smooth first-arrival regions. The method combines analytical derivatives of spherical linear interpolation (SLERP) in a Godunov-type upwind discretization with spherical forward Euler (SFE) pseudo-time integration. This construction gives a tangent residual and keeps every iterate on $\mathbb{S}^2$ without projection or normalization. The SLERP discretization exactly preserves a family of curved orientation equilibria. Removing the background discretization bias improves absolute orientation accuracy near these equilibria, allowing a prescribed error tolerance to be reached on a coarser grid. We prove the equilibrium-preservation property and, separately, a smaller angular error for SFE than normalized Euler in a one-cell relaxation under the stated step-size condition. Two- and three-dimensional experiments examine convergence, geometric preservation, and computational cost. Comparisons with gradient recovery from scalar traveltimes show more accurate directions on the same grid in the curved medi
entries.title_zh: 保结构计算程函方程的梯度
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出在光滑首达区域直接计算程函方程归一化旅行时梯度的一阶方法：在 Godunov 型迎风离散中使用球面线性插值导数，再用球面前向 Euler 伪时间积分，使每次迭代都留在单位球面上，无需投影或归一化。作者证明该方案精确保持一族弯曲方向平衡态，并分析球面 Euler 的角误差；二维、三维实验显示，在所测弯曲介质中，同网格方向精度优于从标量旅行时恢复梯度的方法。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 通过把方向变量的球面几何嵌入离散和时间推进，减少弯曲介质中的方向误差。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于波传播、几何光学及伴随反演中的方向场计算。
entries.cynic_review: 精度优势由特定平衡态分析及所报告数值实验支持，适用性需看网格与介质条件。
entries.paper_review: 保结构性质有理论证明，并配有二三维数值比较。

entries.source_title: Openbroca — Lightweight AI dictation for Mac that sounds like you
entries.source_excerpt: Lightweight AI dictation for Mac that sounds like you
entries.title_zh: Openbroca：面向 Mac 的轻量 AI 听写，主打保留个人表达风格
entries.summary_zh: Product Hunt 将 Openbroca 描述为 Mac 上轻量的 AI 听写工具，强调转写结果听起来像用户本人。现有材料没有解释它如何学习风格、是否本地处理、支持哪些语言或如何保护录音；实际评价需检查转写准确度和数据处理方式。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合需要语音转写并在意口吻保留的 Mac 用户关注，尤其应核验隐私与本地运行能力。
entries.pragmatic_review: 若能稳定保留个人语气，可能减少口述后改稿时间。
entries.cynic_review: “像你”是主张，材料没有说明训练数据或隐私设计。
entries.paper_review: 没有准确率、语言覆盖或用户测试证据。

entries.source_title: Extremal Ky Fan $p$-$k$ norms of graphs
entries.source_excerpt: We study a two-parameter extension of Nikiforov's extremal problems for graph norms, focusing on the quantity $$ S_{p,k}(G) = \left(\sum_{i=1}^{k}\sigma_i(G)^p\right)^{1/p}, $$ where $p\ge1$, and $\sigma_1(G) \ge \cdots \ge \sigma_n(G)$ are the singular values of the adjacency matrix of an $n$-vertex graph $G$. This quantity provides a common generalization of the Ky Fan $k$-norm and the Schatten $p$-norm, which correspond to the cases $p=1$ and $k=n$, respectively. We establish upper and lower bounds and characterize extremal and near-extremal graphs within specified parameter ranges. For each fixed $k \ge 4$, we determine an explicit exponent $\vartheta_k \in [1,2)$ such that the balanced complete $k$-partite graph is the unique maximizer for all sufficiently large orders, and we characterize the unique graph attaining the second-largest value. In particular, this determines the maximum Ky Fan $4$-norm for all sufficiently large orders. entries.title_zh: 图的极端 Ky Fan p-k 范数
entries.summary_zh: 文章研究图邻接矩阵前 k 个奇异值的 p 范数 Sₚ,ₖ，推广 Ky Fan 范数与 Schatten 范数的极值问题。对固定 k≥4 且 n 足够大，作者确定最大值由平衡完全 k 部图唯一达到，给出相应渐近指数，并刻画第二大值与固定边数亏损下的近极值结构；同时求出大 n 时 Ky Fan 4-范数的最大值。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 谱图论结果不仅给出极值图，还包括次极值与稳定性结构，适合研究矩阵范数的读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 极值对象和近极值刻画能帮助理解谱范数在图结构上的稳定性。
entries.cynic_review: 结论针对固定 k 与充分大的顶点数，有限规模阈值及完整证明细节需查全文。
entries.paper_review: 将两类经典图矩阵范数统一处理，并推进到次极值和稳定性层面。

entries.source_title: On disclosure and shame
entries.source_excerpt: “The arXiv is full of papers now that include a section, usually either after the acknowledgments or at the end of the paper, entitled ‘AI disclosure’. I strongly object to this phrase and I think it is a tremendous mistake to use it. […]”
entries.title_zh: 关于 AI 使用披露与羞耻感
entries.summary_zh: Max Lieblich 认为 AI disclosure 的说法可能暗示羞耻或利益冲突，从而促使年轻研究者隐瞒工具使用，建议改称 AI contributions 并具体描述贡献。作者还提出按贡献大小考虑致谢或共同署名；这是对学术规范的主张，尚不代表期刊或数学界共识。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 有助于讨论如何透明记录 AI 贡献而不制造污名。
entries.pragmatic_review: 贡献描述比单一使用声明更具体。
entries.cynic_review: 模型署名还涉及责任与出版规则。
entries.paper_review: 可与作者资格标准和可重复性要求比较。

entries.source_title: Gaussian Lower Bounds for Distinct Subset Sums in Higher Dimensions
entries.source_excerpt: For sequences of $n$ nonnegative integer vectors in $\mathbb Z^k$ with distinct subset sums, we prove, for fixed $k$, the uniform lower bound $M\ge (C_k-o(1))2^{n/k}/\sqrt n$ for the largest coordinate, where \[ C_k=\sqrt{\frac{2k}{\pi}}\, \frac{(k+1)^{(k-1)/(2k)}}{\sqrt{\lfloor (k+1)^2/4\rfloor}}. \] The proof compares a Gaussian-kernel expectation with a sum over a translated lattice, uniformly over the vector sequence. We optimise the resulting quadratic-form constant using a vertex second-moment certificate. We show that $C_k$ also exceeds the variance constant obtained by optimising an ellipsoidal geometry.
entries.title_zh: 高维不同子集和的高斯型下界
entries.summary_zh: 论文考虑 Z^k 中 n 个非负整数向量，其所有子集和互异，并为最大坐标 M 给出固定维数 k 下的一致渐近下界 M≥(C_k−o(1))2^(n/k)/√n。证明通过高斯核期望与平移格点和比较，并用二次型顶点二阶矩证书优化常数；所得 C_k 还超过椭球几何优化给出的方差常数。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把经典不同子集和问题推广到固定高维，并给出显式维数相关常数。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合加性组合学与离散概率中的向量子集和界研究。
entries.cynic_review: 下界针对固定 k 渐近 n，有限维数或变维情形需谨慎。
entries.paper_review: 给出渐近量级并改进常数优化方法。

entries.source_title: Quasi-Monte Carlo based meshfree methods for parabolic equations on parameterized Riemannian manifolds
entries.source_excerpt: We develop and analyze a randomized path sampling framework for the pointwise approximation of linear parabolic equations on parameterized Riemannian manifolds, treating both closed manifolds and manifolds with Dirichlet boundary. Based on the Feynman-Kac representation, we construct a parameter-coordinate retraction-based discretization, referred to as the p-Ret scheme, for the manifold diffusion generated by the uniformly elliptic operator, and use it to formulate the Monte Carlo (MC) and randomized quasi-Monte Carlo (RQMC) methods. We derive the local weak consistency of the p-Ret transition and first-order weak convergence of the temporal discretization on closed manifolds. For fixed $h$, we show that RQMC sampling yields asymptotically faster variance decay than standard MC. On closed manifolds, the variance is $o(n^{-1})$ and, under additional regularity, satisfies the sharper bound $O(n^{-2+\varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon>0$. For Dirichlet problems, despite the discontinuities induced by numerical first exit, nested-uniformly scrambled Sobol' sampling attains $O(n^{-1-1/s+\varepsilon})$ variance for any $\varepsilon>0$ unde
entries.title_zh: 参数化黎曼流形上抛物方程的准蒙特卡洛无网格方法
entries.summary_zh: 作者基于 Feynman–Kac 表示，对参数化黎曼流形上的线性抛物方程构造重traction 离散，并发展 Monte Carlo 与随机准 Monte Carlo 路径采样。闭流形上证明时间离散一阶弱收敛；固定步长时，RQMC 方差优于 MC，闭流形可达 o(n⁻¹)，附加正则性下达到 O(n⁻²⁺ε)，带 Dirichlet 边界的问题也给出受首出不连续影响后的方差率。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合流形 PDE 与随机数值方法读者，关注避免网格剖分的点值近似。
entries.pragmatic_review: 理论覆盖闭流形和边界问题，并量化随机采样收敛。
entries.cynic_review: 几何参数化、边界首出处理和正则性要求限制直接套用。
entries.paper_review: 给出误差阶和适用情形，算法成本与维数效应需看全文。

entries.source_title: A Reverse-Gold Theorem: Positive-Data Identification by Substrate-Bounded Contrastive Learners
entries.source_excerpt: Gold's theorem shows that no learner can identify an arbitrary language in a superfinite class from positive presentations alone. We prove a positive result of a different shape. Fix an innate \emph{recursive contrast operator} $R$ mapping any string to a finite set of structurally bounded perturbations of it, and a discriminative scorer of bounded capacity trained by InfoNCE-style contrastive estimation \citep{vandenoord2018,macollins2018} on self-generated perturbations. Under a faithfulness condition relating operator, scorer, and target, the trained scorer achieves \emph{PAC conditional identification} from positive data alone: with high probability it ranks all but an $\varepsilon$-fraction of positives above every out-of-language perturbation in their own orbit, with sample complexity polynomial in the capacity, the orbit size, the score bound, and $1/\varepsilon$. The negatives are constructed by the learner, not supplied by an oracle, and no global normalizing constant over strings is ever computed. The misranking bound follows from the geometry of the contrastive loss---per-example loss floors plus a definite loss increment
entries.title_zh: 反向 Gold 定理：有界底层对比学习者的正数据识别
entries.summary_zh: Gold 定理指出，超有限语言类一般不能仅凭正例展示被识别；本文给出形状不同的正面结果。若学习者拥有递归对比算子，可对输入字符串生成结构受限扰动，并用有限容量判别器通过 InfoNCE 式对比训练，在算子、判别器与目标语言满足忠实性条件时，就能仅凭正数据实现 PAC 条件识别，样本复杂度随容量、扰动轨道大小和误差参数多项式增长。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 刻画先天结构对比机制如何改变正数据语言识别的可能性边界。
entries.pragmatic_review: 为结构化语言学习和对比式识别提供理论条件。
entries.cynic_review: 正结果依赖预设递归扰动算子及忠实性假设，并未推翻 Gold 的一般不可能性。
entries.paper_review: 在经典不可能性旁建立带明确结构假设的 PAC 正结果。

entries.source_title: Anthropic 报告：Claude 研究模型在 Chrome、Safari、Android、Windows、Linux 发现漏洞并串联 5 条攻击链

entries.source_title: HiLo-RD: Cross-Budget Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: We propose HiLo-RD (High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation) to improve masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) under a limited generation budget. Unlike autoregressive models, MDLMs choose both what to generate and where to commit it. This creates two coupled challenges: predicting useful content before reasoning is complete, and deciding when to fix answer tokens that shape later predictions. We identify budget-induced premature commitment: even when a correct solution fits, the model can fix answer fragments near the window boundary before resolving intermediate steps. These fragments become context for later predictions and redirect subsequent reasoning. Existing post-training methods do not directly transfer the stronger trajectories that the same model follows with a larger window. HiLo-RD addresses this gap by (1) pairing large-window teacher states with cropped small-window views and (2) matching their hidden representations at committed positions. entries.title_zh: HiLo-RD：掩码扩散模型的跨预算自蒸馏
entries.summary_zh: 掩码扩散模型不仅决定生成什么，也决定何时固定 token；低预算时可能在中间推理未完成前提交答案片段，误导后续过程。HiLo-RD 用同一模型的大窗口状态指导裁剪后的低预算视图，并匹配已提交位置的隐表示；论文摘要报告其提升数学基准低预算准确率，但这份摘录没有列出具体增益数字。

entries.source_title: Acceleration of the Method of Alternating Projections on subspaces by GMRES
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper we propose a GMRES-accelerated version of the Method of Alternating Projections (MAP) for subspaces. It is proved that the accelerated version not only converges to a feasible solution, but also solves a best approximation problem. Comparisons are made with other accelerations proposed in the literature, for solving saddle point problems.
entries.title_zh: 用 GMRES 加速子空间交替投影
entries.summary_zh: 作者为子空间上的交替投影法提出 GMRES 加速版本，并证明新算法既收敛到可行解，也解决一个最佳逼近问题。论文与其他加速方式比较其求解鞍点问题的表现。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合约束可行性与线性代数迭代算法。

entries.source_title: BriLLM-MetaPred: A Representation-Prediction Unity Language Model with Adaptive Self-Measurement
entries.source_excerpt: We present BriLLM-MetaPred, the first engineering implementation of the MetaPred machine-learning framework established by a mathematical theory of AGI, instantiated for language modeling. The theory argues that MetaPred is both necessary and sufficient as a machine-learning primitive for general cognition. Taking this theoretical conclusion as a design premise, we report an implementation of the primitive for language modeling. A single continuously evolving dynamical state serves as both the context representation and the state from which predictions are read out. Continuous measurement of its own state reduces finite-depth inconsistency, maintains internal consistency, and provides an endogenous dynamical self-supervision signal in fixed-point form. The single dynamical state of MetaPred intrinsically couples training and inference. MetaPred therefore exhibits symmetry across almost all key elements of machine learning, an intuitive and observable property of the mathematical optimum over the space of all machine-learning paradigms. BriLLM-MetaPred is neither another recurrent language model nor an extension of BriLLM. It provides
entries.title_zh: BriLLM-MetaPred：以单一动态状态统一表示与预测
entries.summary_zh: 作者把 MetaPred 理论框架实现为语言模型：同一个连续演化状态既编码上下文，也读取预测，并通过持续自测减少有限深度不一致、生成固定点式自监督信号。论文进一步将该理论称为一般认知的必要且充分机器学习原语；这是作者的理论主张，摘要尚不足以证明其普适性，具体语言模型评测和与现有模型的差异需读全文。

entries.source_title: Klarner's sequences have density $0$
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that the set of non-negative integers $n$ which can be obtained from $0$ by repeated application of affine maps $x\mapsto 2x$, $x\mapsto 3x+2$ and $x\mapsto 6x+3$ has density $0$. Moreover, we reach the same conclusion for five other sequences of similar type introduced by D. Klarner. More generally, we establish a criterion excluding stationary measures with bounded density on the profinite group $\mathbb Z_P\cong\prod_{p\mid P}\mathbb Z_p$. A density-to-measure construction using invariant Banach limits and a combinatorial argument involving rational orbits and affine words yield our density-zero results. The criterion also applies to an infinite family of mixed-slope affine semigroups.
entries.title_zh: Klarner 序列的自然密度为零
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明由若干仿射递推生成的 Klarner 型整数序列及五个相关序列在自然数中的密度为零，其中例子包括映射 2x、3x+2 与 6x+3。论证建立了适用于 profinite 整数上的平稳测度判据，再将动力系统信息转化为序列占比结论。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对递推生成集合、数论密度和遍历方法交叉感兴趣的读者可读。
entries.pragmatic_review: 理论性强，适合序列与动力系统研究者。
entries.cynic_review: 密度零是明确结论，但覆盖的是指定递推族。
entries.paper_review: 摘要交代了递推例子与测度工具，完整证明仍需查阅。

entries.source_title: OpenAI partially disproves Littlewood's 1961 $L^α$-flat theorem
entries.source_excerpt: We present a counterexample, produced by OpenAI, to Littlewood's 1961 theorem on $L^\alpha$-flat polynomials. The theorem asserts that no $L^\alpha$-flat polynomials exist within the class of trigonometric polynomials of the form$$\sum_{m=1}^{n} a_m \cos(m\theta+\alpha_m), \qquad n \in \mathbb{N}^*,$$satisfying$$k\, n^2 \sum_{m=1}^{n} a_m^2 \;\leq\; \sum_{m=1}^{n} m^2 a_m^2,$$where $k$ is an absolute constant (alternatively expressed on the right-hand side as $K = 1/k$). We show that OpenAI's counterexample is contained within the class of hyper-lacunary sequences. Consequently, it offers only a limited refutation, as such sequences fail to satisfy an implicit assumption of Littlewood's theorem. We also discuss broader questions surrounding this counterexample and provide a brief historical overview.
entries.title_zh: OpenAI 对 Littlewood 平坦多项式定理的部分反例
entries.summary_zh: 论文讨论 OpenAI 给出的三角多项式反例及其与 Littlewood 1961 年 Lα 平坦性定理的关系。摘要认为该反例属于超稀疏序列，未满足原定理的一个隐含假设，因此反驳范围有限；这是作者对定理适用条件的分析，不能简化为整条经典定理被推翻。

entries.cynic_review: 部分反例与全面推翻有本质差别。
entries.paper_review: 值得对照原论文核查条件的准确表述。

entries.source_title: Existence of uniformly most reliable two-terminal graphs with distance constraints
entries.source_excerpt: A two-terminal graph is a simple graph equipped with two distinguished vertices, called terminals. Let $T_{n,m}$ be the class consisting of all non-isomorphic two-terminal graphs on $n$ vertices and $m$ edges. Let $G$ be any two-terminal graph in $T_{n,m}$, and let $d$ be any positive integer. For every $\rho\in [0,1]$, the \emph{$d$-constrained two-terminal reliability of $G$ at $\rho$}, denoted $R_G^d(\rho)$, is the probability that $G$ has some path of length at most $d$ joining its terminals after each of its edges is independently deleted with probability $\rho$. We say $G$ is a \emph{$d$-uniformly most reliable two-terminal graph} ($d$-UMRTTG) if for each $H$ in $T_{n,m}$ and every $\rho \in [0,1]$ it holds that $R_{G}^d(\rho)\geq R_{H}^{d}(\rho)$. Previous works studied the existence of $d$-UMRTTG in $T_{n,m}$ when $d$ is greater than or equal to $n-1$, or equivalently, when the distance constraint is dropped. In this work, a characterization of all $1$-UMRTTGs and $2$-UMRTTGs is given. Several structural properties of 3-UMRTTGs are established. entries.title_zh: 带距离约束的两端网络可靠性极值图
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究随机删边后，两终端之间是否仍有长度不超过 d 的路径，并按所有固定顶点数、边数的两端图比较可靠概率。作者完全刻画 d=1 和 d=2 的最可靠图，对 d=3 给出结构性质，并为 d≥3 的某些参数族证明最优图存在且唯一；当前摘录后半被截断，不能补充更细范围。

entries.source_title: Landau's problems through ratios of $L$-functions
entries.source_excerpt: Very recently, Lee announced a proof of the Twin Prime Conjecture assuming the Ratios Conjecture for the Riemann zeta function. We obtain conditional asymptotic formulas with power-saving errors for each of Landau's four prime problems. In the function field setting, using Sawin's estimates for factorization functions in squarefree progressions and a discriminant cohomology argument, we obtain unconditional Goldbach and prime-pair asymptotics over sufficiently large fixed odd fields, including prime fields. Similar results may be possible for other problems in analytic number theory.
entries.title_zh: 用 L 函数比值研究 Landau 的四个素数问题
entries.summary_zh: 论文在黎曼 ζ 函数的 Ratios Conjecture 等条件下，为 Landau 的四个素数问题建立带幂次节省误差项的渐近公式；函数域版本则借助平方自由数列估计与判别式上同调论证，无条件得到足够大奇特征域（含素数域）上的 Goldbach 与素数对渐近式。此工作不等于无条件证明整数上的孪生素数猜想，结论范围由假设与函数域设定限定。

entries.source_title: One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL
entries.source_excerpt: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for human-AI interaction usually trains the agent against a single large language model (LLM) that simulates the user. We show that agents trained this way can systematically fail to generalize, and we trace the failure to simulator collapse: the simulator LLM is mode-collapsed, and a policy trained against it learns narrow strategies that exploit the simulator's mode behavior; these strategies transfer poorly to unseen simulators and to real users. We formalize the collapse and propose two solutions. Verbalized Sampling, applied at inference time, samples each simulator reply from a verbalized response distribution. Co-Training, applied during training similar to self-play, co-evolves the simulator as the policy, so the policy cannot exploit the mode behavior. A population variant samples the simulator for each rollout from a pool of recent checkpoints. We validate both solutions on three benchmarks: Persuasion for Good, tau^2-bench, and CooperBench. entries.title_zh: 单一冻结模拟器不足：多智能体强化学习中的模拟器坍塌
entries.summary_zh: 论文指出，若多智能体强化学习只用一个语言模型模拟用户，模拟器的模式坍塌会让策略学会利用其固定反应，因而难以迁移到新模拟器或真实用户。作者提出推理时 Verbalized Sampling 与训练时 Co-Training，并在三个基准中报告 held-out 成功率最高提升约 9% 和 14%，真人研究也呈现类似趋势；结果仍受基准与研究设计限制。

entries.pragmatic_review: 可把多样用户模拟加入训练评估，特别检查跨用户迁移。

entries.paper_review: 有机制分析、多基准与人类研究，复现要核对协议。

entries.source_title: 把“增长优先”告上法庭：加州总检察长起诉 OpenAI
entries.title_zh: 加州总检察长起诉 OpenAI，指控其安全治理失当

entries.source_title: On the direct SLE-martingale approach to the integrability of Conformal Loop Ensembles
entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Jason Miller , Wendelin Werner; Subjects: Probability (math.PR) ; Mathematical Physics (math-ph); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: SLE 鞅法直接推导共形环系综的可积公式

entries.source_title: Cortex: A Fixed-Point Theory of Governed Coding Agents - Technical Report
entries.source_excerpt: A coding agent combines a large language model (LLM) with a harness that plans, edits, and executes code. We study Cortex, a supervisory layer for pre-execution governance, requirement tracking, and iterative validation and repair. We formalize requirement closure on a finite lattice. For a fixed requirement set and a sound, monotone validation rule with persistent evidence, exhaustive iteration reaches the least fixed point with no more strict increases than there are requirements. Fair consequence scheduling reaches the same closure. A separate stochastic model bounds expected completion time under a uniform positive-progress assumption. These results depend on their stated assumptions; artifact repair, fallible validation, and finite execution budgets do not satisfy them automatically. We define Gauntlet's trajectory-similarity and build-gated scores, attack-success estimators, Wilson intervals, and case-cluster bootstrap summaries. Effective-feedback accounting counts newly certified requirements, rather than estimating their information value or utility. The five evaluation families support raw-versus-governed comparisons. entries.title_zh: Cortex：治理编码智能体的一个不动点理论
entries.summary_zh: Cortex 作为代码执行前监督层，追踪需求并迭代验证修复；论文把需求闭包形式化为有限格，证明在验证规则可靠、单调且证据持久时，穷举迭代会在严格增长次数不超过需求数的情况下到达最小不动点。作者也定义 trajectory-similarity、build-gated 等评估指标，但明确指出错误验证、修复失败及执行预算会破坏理论假设。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合设计编码 agent 前置策略治理与需求验证流程的工程团队。
entries.pragmatic_review: 为有限需求闭环提供了形式化收敛条件，也界定了失效场景。
entries.cynic_review: 理论假设严格，真实工具链中的验证器常不可靠。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确区分形式化保证、随机模型与实际系统限制。

entries.source_title: Finite $\mathbf{BM}$-algebras and fixed-point combinators
entries.source_excerpt: We study algebras for the $\mathbf{BM}$-, $\mathbf{BI}$-, and $\mathbf{BMI}$-fragments of combinatory logic, where $\mathbf{B} xyz \to_{w} x\left(yz\right)$, $\mathbf{M} x \to_{w} xx$ and $\mathbf{I} x \to_{w} x$. We prove that every finite $\mathbf{BM}$-algebra $\mathcal{A}$ contains an element $Y$ satisfying $Yx = x\left(Yx\right)$ for all $x\in A$. Moreover, a single closed $\mathbf{BM}$-term represents such an element in every finite $\mathbf{BM}$-algebra. On the other hand, we show that there exists an infinite $\mathbf{BMI}$-algebra with no such element. Consequently, the variety of $\mathbf{BM}$-algebras is not generated by finite $\mathbf{BM}$-algebras. We also characterise finite $\mathbf{BI}$-algebras as finite semigroups with two distinguished left units $B$ and $I$, and finite $\mathbf{BMI}$-algebras as finite idempotent semigroups with three distinguished left units $B$, $M$ and $I$.
entries.title_zh: 有限 BM 代数中存在不动点组合子
entries.summary_zh: 作者证明每个有限 BM 组合代数都含有 Y，使任意 x 满足 Yx=x(Yx)，且同一个封闭 BM 项可在所有有限 BM 代数中表示该元素。另一方面，存在没有这种元素的无限 BMI 代数，因此有限 BM 代数不能生成整个 BM 代数簇；论文也刻画有限 BI 与 BMI 代数的半群结构。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合组合逻辑、lambda 演算和代数语义研究。
entries.pragmatic_review: Y 是实现递归自应用的固定点组合子；这里不预设 I 组合子。
entries.cynic_review: 有限与无限情形形成清楚对照。
entries.paper_review: 结论依赖具体弱组合子基 BM/BI/BMI，不可直接泛化。

entries.source_title: Dependency Graphs of Mathematical Arguments: Representation, Structural Measurement, and Proof Review
entries.source_excerpt: We propose a source-grounded framework for representing and measuring mathematical arguments with assistance from large language models. It includes numbered and unnumbered statements, equations, assumptions, and constructions, distinguishing source occurrences from contextual states and inference records. Proposed dependencies retain source evidence and review status. A measurement contract fixes manuscript versions, boundaries, granularity, proof choices, and macro anchors. On a selected finite directed acyclic graph, depth is the longest prerequisite-path length, and bulk counts distinct ancestor edges. We give a union recurrence that accounts for shared subarguments and identify reachability conditions preserving depth and the macro skeleton; unrestricted refinement need not preserve depth or bulk. A standardized, versioned prompt protocol separates annotation discovery, deterministic recomputation, and review assistance. Cross-paper links support a research agenda on theorem co-use, rare combinations, and connections between dependency communities. entries.title_zh: 数学论证依赖图：表示、结构测量与证明审阅
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出由原文证据支撑的数学论证依赖图：区分原文中的陈述、上下文状态和推理记录，并用版本、边界、粒度及宏标签固定测量标准。对有限 DAG 定义深度和祖先边总量，给出处理共享子论证的并集递推；说明何种可达性条件下细化保留深度/宏结构，任意细化则不保证。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 为数学证明的结构化审阅、跨论文定理复用研究提供可追溯表示。
entries.pragmatic_review: 深度衡量最长前置链，bulk 衡量不同祖先依赖边数。
entries.cynic_review: 明确强调版本、证据和审核状态，减少模型注释不可复查问题。
entries.paper_review: 依赖图测量不等同于数学正确性验证，标注仍需审阅。

entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Giulia Gaggero , Megumi Harada , Hannah Nardone , Brett Nasserden , Jenna Rajchgot , Lisa Seccia , Adam Van Tuyl; Subjects: Algebraic Geometry (math.AG) ; Combinatorics (math.CO); Representation Theory (math.RT); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: A 型最小幂零轨道 Hessenberg 簇上同调环的表示
entries.summary_zh: 已有结果把最小幂零轨道 Hessenberg 簇的上同调环表示为旗簇上同调环的商，并用若干 Schubert 类描述核。本文在 A 型情形中给出该核的最小生成集，以由 Hessenberg 函数构造的置换对应的 Schubert 多项式描述，所需生成元显著少于原表示。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 精简 Hessenberg 簇上同调环的关系式，便于进一步计算和组合分析。
entries.pragmatic_review: 更小的生成集可降低环结构计算与证明中的代数复杂度。
entries.cynic_review: 改进仅针对 A 型的最小幂零轨道情形，其他 Lie 类型未覆盖。
entries.paper_review: 针对既有环表示压缩关系生成元，并给出明确 Schubert 多项式构造。

project_insight.one_liner_zh: 汇集多行业第一人称手工作业视频及同步 IMU 数据，附有任务和步骤级标注。

分析同类手部动作在不同工作环境、工具和材料中的变化。
评估第一人称视频与同步惯性传感器数据对任务识别的用途。

entries.source_title: Classification of bipartite observables I: stable and uniformly stable observables
entries.source_excerpt: When two quantum systems are prepared independently and each is driven to an idealized limit, the expectation of a bipartite observable may depend on which system is idealized first. We call an observable stable when it does not. We show that stability is equivalent to two operational properties. First, every idealized preparation of one system can be simulated to arbitrary accuracy, uniformly over all probes, by finite mixtures of actual preparations, provided that the probing system is idealized first. Second, any two idealized preparations have a unique, symmetric independent product. Under a uniform form of stability, we prove, the number of preparations that $n$ adaptive probes can tell apart at a fixed margin is bounded by a polynomial in $n$, and responses can be learned with a bounded number of mistakes; otherwise, at some margin, protocols with $n$ probes tell apart $2^n$ preparations. The swap test, Hong--Ou--Mandel coincidences and discrete equality tests turn out to be uniformly stable, with bounds independent of the dimension, while order comparisons of discrete spectra unbounded above are unstable. entries.title_zh: 二部观测量分类 I：稳定与一致稳定观测量
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究两个量子系统分别取理想化极限时，二部观测量的期望值是否依赖先理想化哪一方，并把这种次序无关性定义为稳定性。作者证明稳定性等价于两项操作性质：理想制备可由有限实际制备的混合一致近似，且任意两个理想制备有唯一、对称的独立乘积；一致稳定时，n 次自适应探测能区分的制备数在固定误差下至多多项式增长，否则某个误差尺度下可达 2^n。交换测试、Hong–Ou–Mandel 计数及离散相等测试被证明一致稳定，而无界离散谱的顺序比较不稳定。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合数学物理与量子信息读者，文章把抽象稳定性转化为可操作的模拟性与探测复杂度结论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 探测复杂度的多项式／指数差异有助于理解哪些观测任务可有效学习。
entries.cynic_review: 结论依赖理想化制备和固定间隔等形式假设。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出等价刻画、复杂度界及典型例子，理论证明需阅读全文核对。

entries.source_title: Pseudocompact MAD families under $\mathfrak b=\mathfrak c$
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that if the bounding number $\mathfrak b$ equals the cardinality of the continuum $\mathfrak c$, then every infinite almost disjoint family of size less than $\mathfrak c$ can be extended to a maximal almost disjoint family whose Isbell--Mr\'owka space has a pseudocompact Vietoris hyperspace.
entries.title_zh: 在 b=c 条件下构造伪紧 MAD 族
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明，若调和数 b 等于连续统基数 c，则任意大小小于 c 的无限几乎不交族都可扩张为一个极大几乎不交族，使其 Isbell–Mrówka 空间的 Vietoris 超空间伪紧。结论把基数不变量条件与拓扑超空间的紧致性性质联系起来。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 集合论拓扑与几乎不交族研究者可关注 b=c 对超空间伪紧性的构造保证。
entries.pragmatic_review: 属于特定集合论假设下的存在性结果，直接应用面较窄。
entries.cynic_review: 结论依赖 b=c，不能当作 ZFC 下无条件的普遍扩张定理。
entries.paper_review: 摘要清楚给出假设、扩张对象和拓扑结论，构造细节需读正文。

entries.source_title: Reflections on Trusting Lean
entries.source_excerpt: It is known, by works of Werner and Carneiro, that the type theory of Lean (and indeed of CIC plus a version of choice) is equiconsistent with ZFC plus "there are infinitely many strongly inaccessible cardinals". We prove a finer connection between these two formal systems; namely, given any formula in the language of second order arithmetic, that formula is provable in the aforementioned extension of ZFC if and only if the same formula, when viewed as a type in Lean, is inhabited.
entries.title_zh: 关于信任 Lean：与强集合论的更细对应
entries.summary_zh: 在既有 Lean 类型论与 ZFC 加无穷多个强不可达基数等一致性结果基础上，论文声称对每个二阶算术公式，集合论扩展中可证明当且仅当其 Lean 类型有项。它讨论形式系统间的证明能力，不是无条件证明 Lean 或集合论一致。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合理解证明助手的逻辑基础与信任边界。
entries.pragmatic_review: 有助于区分内核检查与基础公理。
entries.cynic_review: 相对证明能力不能消除一致性假设。
entries.paper_review: 二阶算术层面的等价强于单纯等一致性。

There are more than 100,000 synsets in WordNet, majority of them are nouns (80,000+). ImageNet aims to provide on average 1000 images to illustrate each synset. Images of each concept are… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ILSVRC/imagenet-1k.
entries.title_zh: ImageNet-1k（ILSVRC 2012）数据集
entries.summary_zh: 来源摘要将 ImageNet 描述为按 WordNet 层级组织的图像数据集，并指出每个 WordNet 概念对应一个同义词集（synset）。摘要称其目标是平均为每个 synset 提供约 1000 张图像，但未提供该数据集具体划分、样本数量或使用条件的完整信息。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合查阅经典图像分类数据集的组织方式，或作为理解视觉模型基准与 WordNet 标签层级的背景材料；使用前需核实访问和许可条件。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于了解图像分类数据如何按概念组织，但当前摘录不足以指导下载、划分或训练。
entries.cynic_review: 页面标记为自动门控且许可字段为 other，不能仅凭数据集知名度推定可自由获取或任意再分发。
entries.paper_review: 材料只给出数据集概述，没有提供划分细节、标注质量说明或具体基准协议。

project_insight.translation_zh: ImageNet 数据集卡片摘要：ILSVRC 2012 通常称为 ImageNet，是一个按照 WordNet 层级组织的图像数据集。WordNet 中每个有意义的概念（可能由多个单词或词组描述）称为“同义词集”（synset）；其 synset 超过 100,000 个，其中大多数是名词（超过 80,000 个）。ImageNet 的目标是平均为每个 synset 提供 1000 张图像。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 按 WordNet 概念层级组织图像，常用于视觉识别研究与基准背景。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读数据集卡片的完整说明，核对可访问范围、数据划分、使用条款和引用要求；确认条件符合研究用途后，再按卡片提供的官方方式获取数据。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 输入标记许可为 `other`、访问状态为自动门控；摘录未给出具体许可文本、门控条件、数据划分或图像数量，不能据此认定为可自由再分发的开源数据集。
use_cases_zh: 学习图像分类数据集如何使用 synset 组织类别。
阅读视觉识别研究时核对 ImageNet-1k 的数据集背景。
在确认访问和许可后，开展合规的图像分类实验。

entries.pragmatic_review: 适合已有 7B 模型推理环境的用户做数学补全或微调起点实验。

project_insight.translation_zh: DeepSeekMath-7B-base 是一个文本补全模型。模型卡示例使用 PyTorch 和 Transformers 加载模型，并续写“从 0 到 2 对 x² 积分”的提示。模型卡称代码仓库采用 MIT 许可证，而模型使用受 DeepSeek 模型许可证约束，并表示支持商业用途。

entries.title_zh: Forgejo MCP Server：Forgejo 的 MCP 服务端
entries.summary_zh: Forgejo MCP Server 通过 MCP 让兼容的 AI 助手以自然语言操作 Forgejo 仓库、议题、拉取请求、文件和 Actions 工作流。项目已迁移到 git.b4mad.industries；Codeberg 仓库是只读镜像，不再发布新版本或容器镜像。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 如果你在用 Forgejo，可用它把仓库浏览、议题处理和工作流查看接入 MCP 助手；README 也说明了访问令牌、stdio/HTTP 传输和远程访问的配置要点。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可先在自己的 Forgejo 实例上为令牌授予所需的最小权限，并从本机 stdio 接入开始，再逐项确认助手能访问哪些仓库操作。
entries.cynic_review: 该工具能执行写操作，配置令牌和网络可达性会扩大操作影响；远程 HTTP 部署还要求明确主机、来源和认证设置。
entries.paper_review: 摘录含有操作示例及多种部署说明，但未展示代码审查、测试结果或独立安全验证。

project_insight.translation_zh: Forgejo MCP Server 是连接 Forgejo 与 MCP 系统的集成插件。配置后，可通过 Claude、Cursor 或 VS Code 扩展等 MCP 兼容助手，以自然语言与 Forgejo 仓库交互；项目已迁移，Codeberg 仓库仅作为只读镜像。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 它把 Forgejo 的仓库、议题、拉取请求和工作流操作接入 MCP 助手。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 从项目当前维护位置获取安装和发布信息；先在测试仓库创建权限受限的访问令牌，采用本机 stdio 方式配置 MCP，并检查每项写操作的目标后再执行。若部署 HTTP 服务，应按文档配置认证、监听地址、允许的主机名和来源。
project_insight.limitations_zh: Codeberg 页面是只读镜像，维护、问题反馈、发布和容器镜像均已迁移到 git.b4mad.industries。服务需要 Forgejo 实例和访问令牌；HTTP 远程部署涉及主机、来源和认证配置。所给摘录未显示许可证信息，不能据此判断具体许可条款。
use_cases_zh: 让助手列出个人 Forgejo 实例中的仓库或读取 README 文件。
在确认目标仓库和权限后，通过助手创建议题或查看开放的拉取请求。
查看指定项目最近的 Actions 工作流运行记录。

entries.source_title: Cutoff profile for the coupon collector with many collections
entries.source_excerpt: We solve the problem posed by Erd\H{o}s and R\'enyi in $1961$ about the limiting distribution of the number of draws $T_{n,m}$ that a coupon collector needs to complete $m$ collections of $n$ distinct types of coupons, when $m$ increases with $n$. For fixed $m$, Erd\H{o}s and R\'enyi proved that $\mathbb P(T_{n,m}\leq n\log n+(m-1)n\log\log n-n\log (m-1)!+\theta n)$ converges to $ \mathcal G(\theta)$, for every $\theta \in \mathbb R$, as $n \to \infty$, where $\mathcal G$ is the standard Gumbel distribution function, and they asked what happens when $m=m(n)$ increases with $n$. We give a complete answer to this question. More precisely, for every increasing sequence $m=m(n)$, we determine explicit sequences $t_{n,m}$ and $w_{n,m}$ satisfying $w_{n,m}/t_{n,m}\to0$ such that $\mathbb P(T_{n,m}\leq t_{n,m}+\theta w_{n,m})\to\mathcal G(\theta)$ for every $\theta\in\mathbb R$. We also determine the corresponding asymptotic behavior of $\mathbb E[T_{n,m}]$. entries.title_zh: 多轮集邮问题的 cutoff 分布
entries.summary_zh: 经典集邮者问题求集齐 n 种优惠券所需抽取次数；Erdős–Rényi 曾给出固定收集轮数 m 时的 Gumbel 极限并提出 m 随 n 增长时的情形。本文对任意递增 m(n) 给出中心位置 t_{n,m} 与窄化尺度 w_{n,m}（w/t→0），使标准化完成时间仍收敛到 Gumbel 分布，并给出期望的渐近行为。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合随机算法等待时间、占位问题及极值渐近。

entries.cynic_review: 解决 m 可随规模任意增长的长期开放问题。
entries.paper_review: 具体 t、w 公式与增长区间需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Doing Less with More: A First-Principles Exploration of the Suitability of Agentic Computing over Alternative Architectural Choices
entries.source_excerpt: There is growing interest in automating business activities with Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) due to latter's seeming ease of use. Never has it been easier, or costlier, to do less with more. However, little is known about when agents are preferable to established alternatives such as local computation, Representational State Transfer (REST), the Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), particularly when development speed, performance, and operational cost are considered. We investigate this question using a controlled mathematical task that compares seven methods on a benchmark of 1,000 arithmetic expressions where semantics of operator precedence has to be preserved. entries.title_zh: 多做反而少得：从第一原理比较智能体计算与替代架构
entries.summary_zh: 论文用 1000 道需遵守运算优先级的算术任务，比较本地确定性计算、REST/SOAP/MCP、云端 LLM 和调用 MCP 工具的 agent，评估正确率、开发速度、性能和成本。摘录已显示确定性方案达到 100% 准确率且延迟可忽略，直接 LLM 最高 92.9%；其余 agent 比较结果未随摘录提供，因此不能概括 agent 的相对收益。

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对希望研究编码智能体工作模式的人，plan 与 build 的权限区分以及 general 子智能体值得关注；使用前应确认当前版本、权限行为和模型配置。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可先用只读 plan 模式探索代码库，再根据需要切换 build，但 README 所示命令和桌面版状态可能随版本变化。
entries.cynic_review: “开源”与多平台安装入口并不能单独说明模型能力或命令执行风险，build 模式默认具备完整访问权限尤其需要留意。
entries.paper_review: 摘录列出安装渠道和智能体模式，但没有给出论文、基准成绩或独立复现证据。

project_insight.translation_zh: OpenCode 将自己描述为开源 AI 编码智能体。它提供两种内置智能体：用于开发工作的默认全权限 build，以及默认拒绝文件编辑、适合分析与代码探索的只读 plan；还提供用于复杂搜索和多步骤工作的 general 子智能体。项目有命令行版本和 Beta 桌面应用，并列出多种安装方式。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 一个带有全权限开发、只读规划和通用子智能体模式的开源编码助手。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读官方文档中的安装、智能体和权限说明，按自己的操作系统选择受支持的安装渠道；首次使用可从 plan 模式和非敏感代码库开始，核实模型配置及命令执行许可后再使用 build。
project_insight.limitations_zh: README 对模式和安装渠道的描述属于项目自述；摘录没有提供模型清单、独立性能评测或安全审计细节。build 被描述为默认全权限，桌面应用标注为 Beta；版本和安装方式应以官方文档为准。
use_cases_zh: 用只读模式了解陌生代码库结构和实现逻辑。

entries.source_title: DIGEST: Discovery-Guided LLM Tuning for Symbolic Regression
entries.source_excerpt: Symbolic regression (SR) seeks to discover mathematical expressions directly from data, without requiring task-specific scientific descriptions. Despite tremendous progress in both conventional search-based methods and recent LLM-based methods, two critical limitations largely remain. First (Limited Generation Flexibility), conventional search-based methods rely on either fixed search rules or specialized learned generators, severely limiting adaptive candidate generation across diverse expression structures. Second (Underutilized Search Discoveries), most LLM-based methods cannot reliably recover ground-truth expressions because they fall short in effectively leveraging the LLM itself to thoroughly digest past expressions or adaptively guide future search. To address these limitations, we propose DIGEST. To render greater flexibility in generation, DIGEST repurposes a pretrained decoder block from a lightweight LLM into a symbolic policy for Genetic Programming (GP) population seeding, thereby leveraging the broader modeling capacity of the LLM. entries.source_title: Sharp error estimates for Lagrange interpolation and Kantorovich-type operators in weighted $L_p$-spaces
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we establish sharp direct and inverse approximation estimates for algebraic Lagrange interpolation polynomials and Kantorovich-type operators in weighted $L_p$ spaces on $[-1,1]$. A well-known limitation in the theory of approximation by interpolation polynomials states that for small rates of convergence $\alpha \le 1/p$, classical moduli of smoothness fail to provide matching direct and inverse estimates due to the insufficiency of integral metrics to determine pointwise values at the interpolation nodes. To overcome this difficulty, we introduce new special semi-discrete measures of smoothness based on Steklov averaging operators, which combine global $L_p$-smoothness with discrete deviations from Steklov averages at the interpolation nodes. By using these measures, we establish fully matching direct and inverse approximation theorems for Lagrange interpolation polynomials, thereby providing complete two-sided characterizations of the rate of convergence for an arbitrary rate $\alpha > 0$. entries.title_zh: 加权 Lp 空间中 Lagrange 插值与 Kantorovich 算子的尖锐误差估计

entries.source_title: Numerical Analysis for a Nonlinear Coupled Thermoelastic System with Acoustic Boundary Conditions
entries.source_excerpt: This paper presents the first $L^2$-norm error analysis for a nonlinear thermoelastic system with acoustic boundary conditions. The model involves three coupled variables: the acoustic potential $u$, the temperature $\theta$, and the normal displacement to the boundary $\delta$, with nonlinearities $|u|^d u$ in the domain and $g(\cdot,u')$ on the boundary, in addition to a nonlocal term $\beta(\int_\Omega\theta dx)\Delta\theta$ in the heat equation. We establish error estimates for the fully discrete problem, using the Crank-Nicolson method for time discretization and finite element method with basis of degree $r \geqslant 1$ for space discretization. We demonstrate that the domain-boundary coupling induces a half-power loss in the spatial convergence order for the variable $u$, and this effect propagates to the remaining variables due to the thermoelastic and boundary couplings, resulting in the final error estimate $\mathcal{O}(h^{r+\frac{1}{2}} + \tau^2)$. entries.source_title: Budget-Aware Predict-and-Verify Theorem Proving with Heterogeneous LLM Solvers
entries.source_excerpt: Large language model (LLM) theorem solvers differ in both proving capability and inference cost. Applying an expensive solver to every subgoal wastes computation when cheaper models are sufficient, while always starting from the cheapest solver wastes attempts on subgoals that require stronger models. We present BudgetPV, an agentic budget-aware predict-and-verify system that allocates computation across unresolved subgoals and heterogeneous LLM solvers. BudgetPV uses a cross-solver predictor to guide solver selection for each subgoal and revises the allocation as verification feedback becomes available. The allocation problem changes as proving progresses. Early decisions mainly determine which solver should handle an untried subgoal, while later decisions determine which previously attempted subgoals should receive additional computation. We train the predictor with two objectives for these two stages. Class-weighted cross-entropy improves assignment to less frequent stronger solvers during the initial stage, while plain cross-entropy provides better calibrated probabilities for later allocation among previously attempted subgoals.

entries.source_title: A large ultrafilter number at $\aleph_ω$
entries.source_excerpt: Gitik constructed a model where $\aleph_\omega$ is strong limit, $2^{\aleph_\omega}=\aleph_{\omega+2}$ and every strongly uniform ultrafilter on $\aleph_\omega$ has character $\aleph_{\omega+2}$. We show that in fact every uniform ultrafilter on $\aleph_\omega$ has character $\aleph_{\omega+2}$ in that model.
entries.title_zh: 在 aleph-ω 上的一个大超滤数
entries.summary_zh: 在 Gitik 构造的模型中，aleph-ω 是强极限基数、2^(aleph-ω)=aleph-ω+2，且每个强一致超滤的特征数为 aleph-ω+2。本文加强这一结论，证明该模型中的每个一致超滤都具有同样的特征数；结论是在所指定集合论模型内部成立，不是 ZFC 无条件定理。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把超滤特征数结论从强一致超滤推广到所有一致超滤。
entries.pragmatic_review: 对研究大基数、基数算术与超滤结构的读者具有理论价值。
entries.cynic_review: 结果建立在特定强迫模型背景下，需区分相对模型结论与绝对结论。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确指出模型假设及推广对象。

entries.source_title: Finite model theory for pseudovarieties and universal algebra: preservation, definability and complexity
entries.source_excerpt: We explore new interactions between finite model theory and classical streams of universal algebra and semigroup theory. A key result is an example of finite algebras whose variety is not finitely axiomatisable in first order logic, but where the class of finite members are finitely axiomatisable amongst finite algebras. These algebras present a negative solution to a first order formulation of the Eilenberg-Sch\"utzenberger problem, and witness the simultaneous failure of the {\L}os-Tarski Theorem, the SP-Preservation Theorem and Birkhoff's HSP-Preservation Theorem at the finite level. The examples also show that a pseudovariety without any finite pseudoequational basis may be finitely axiomatisable in first order logic amongst finite algebras. Other results include the undecidability of deciding first order definability of the pseudovariety of a finite algebra, and a mapping from any fixed finite template constraint satisfaction problem to a first order equivalent variety membership problem.
entries.title_zh: 伪簇与普适代数的有限模型论
entries.summary_zh: 论文构造有限代数例子：其生成的簇不能用一阶逻辑有限公理化，但只在有限代数中考察时却可以有限公理化，并由此同时展示多个经典保型定理在有限层面的失效。作者还证明，判定有限代数所生成伪簇是否一阶可定义是不可判定问题，并把任意固定有限模板的 CSP 归约到一阶等价簇成员资格问题。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 有限模型论、半群理论和约束满足问题研究者可关注这些有限层面的保型反例与复杂性结果。

entries.source_title: The recent counterexamples to the Eisenbud-Schreyer-Weyman Ulrich problem (2003) and to Hochster's small Cohen-Macaulay conjecture (1973): a survey, with a generalization to arbitrary dimension
entries.source_excerpt: In September 2026 four preprints and an AI-generated manuscript moved one numerical obstruction from projective geometry to local algebra. We recall the definitions and main statements, and add two things. First, through a finite projection to $\mathbb P^2$ and an identity already present in the OpenAI manuscript, the three obstructions become one variance identity; for surfaces this explain
entries.title_zh: Ulrich 问题与小 Cohen–Macaulay 猜想近期反例综述及高维推广
entries.summary_zh: 这篇综述整理 2026 年若干预印本对 Ulrich 问题与 Hochster 小 Cohen–Macaulay 猜想的反例，并指出若干障碍可由一个方差恒等式统一理解。作者进一步推广 OpenAI 10 月 6 日稿件中的论证，证明若光滑复 m 维簇 (X,H) 的完备截面环存在小 Cohen–Macaulay 模，则 (K_X²−2c₂(X))·H^(m−2)≤(m+4)H^m；据此给出各维 Hesse 对及其与射影空间乘积的无此类模结论。综述区分了已发表工作、预印本和作者提出的推广，相关结果仍需按原论文核对。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 帮助读者把几项近期反例串联成共同数值障碍，并提供高维推广的可检验条件。

entries.source_excerpt: We prove that a Borel strict partial order is an increasing union of wellfounded Borel partial orders if and only if it admits an (injective) Borel homomorphism to the eventual domination order.

entries.source_title: "I Am Not a Kiddo!": Quantifying Epistemic Infantilization in Large Language Models via Multi-Metric Bias Analysis
entries.source_excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for tutoring and professional knowledge retrieval, yet safety evaluations still focus mainly on overt harms such as toxicity while overlooking benevolent failure modes. We study epistemic infantilization, defined as an identity-conditioned reduction in technical depth that appears when disability disclosure precedes an expert-level query. To measure this effect, we construct a counterfactual dataset of matched question-answer pairs and compare model responses across three settings: no identity context, disability disclosed in prior conversational context, and disability disclosed via a short query prefix. We introduce two composite metrics, the Infantilization Bias Index (IBI) and the Epistemic Accessibility Response Score (EARS), which capture retention of mathematical and formal content, domain terminology, reasoning coverage, and tone signals such as simplification markers and unsolicited offers to adjust the level. Across five open-weight model families, we find consistent evidence that disability disclosure reduces epistemic access by replacing formal explanations with higher-lev
entries.title_zh: “我不是小孩子”：量化大语言模型中的认知 infantilization
entries.summary_zh: 论文把“认知 infantilization”定义为：用户披露残障身份后，模型对同一专家级问题降低技术深度；研究者构造匹配反事实问答，并用 IBI 与 EARS 衡量数学内容、术语、推理覆盖及语气变化。对五类开放权重模型的评估发现，身份披露后回答更常转向较浅解释；结果来自特定提示和基准，仍需验证其他身份与真实互动场景。

entries.title_zh: 通过同时二次扭曲构造非零的二初级 Kolyvagin 类

entries.source_title: Four colours are needed for closed-neighbourhood conflict-free colouring of all planar graphs
entries.source_excerpt: A colouring of the vertices of a graph is conflict-free with respect to closed neighbourhoods if every closed neighbourhood contains a colour that appears on exactly one of its vertices. The colouring need not be proper. Every planar graph has such a colouring with four colours. Fabrici, Lu\v{z}ar, Rindo\v{s}ov\'a and Sot\'ak conjectured that three colours always suffice. We disprove this conjecture. We give a simple gadget construction that turns every planar graph of chromatic number four into a planar graph with no such colouring with three colours. This also shows that it is NP-complete to decide whether three colours suffice for a planar graph. We also give a planar graph on $25$ vertices that needs four colours. Further, we give critical planar graphs on $25$ vertices with $52$ and with $51$ edges, an infinite family of plane triangulations that need four colours, and an infinite family of critical examples.
entries.title_zh: 平面图的闭邻域冲突自由染色至少需要四种颜色
entries.summary_zh: 闭邻域冲突自由染色要求每个顶点连同其邻点的闭邻域中，至少有一种颜色恰好出现一次，且染色不必是正常图染色。论文反驳“三色总够”的猜想：证明四阶色数平面图可经简单 gadget 扩展成无法三色的平面图，并构造需要四种颜色的 25 顶点例子及若干无限临界族；同时证明判定平面图能否三色为 NP 完全。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合图论读者关注局部唯一颜色约束与平面性如何改变染色阈值及计算复杂度。

entries.source_title: Intervention-Certified Amplification: A Validity Gate for $\sigma$-Weighted Post-Training
entries.source_excerpt: Hybrid post-training often mixes supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), using training-side signals to set each sample's balance. Such signals characterize the anchor data and policy, but not whether the emphasized behavior helps in the target task and evaluation setting. This mismatch can reactivate and amplify pretrained behavior even after its literal form is removed from supervision. We demonstrate this with DIAA (Dual-Implicit Adversarial Amplification), a per-sample $\sigma$-weighted SFT/RL hybrid. With all literal Python fences removed from its anchor, DIAA emits unexecuted Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) on $29%$ of MATH-500 prompts, three times vanilla GRPO. Paired interventions show $10.6$ percentage points of accuracy recovery when TIR is suppressed and comparable contributions from SFT imitation and $\sigma$-amplification; a student trained on a $0%$-TIR teacher anchor emits it at $45.8%$. Intervention-Certified Amplification (ICA) gates $\sigma$ with paired-rollout target evidence. Frozen and online ICA reduce TIR to $13.8%$ and $11.2%$, halve residual drag, improve accuracy from $47.5%$ to $48.7%$
entries.title_zh: 干预认证放大：σ 加权后训练的有效性门控
entries.summary_zh: 论文发现按训练侧信号混合 SFT/RL 可能放大目标任务中无益的预训练行为：DIAA 在移除示例中显式 Python 代码后，仍在 29% MATH-500 提示上输出未执行的工具推理。作者以成对干预认证目标收益，再门控 σ 放大；冻结/在线 ICA 将该行为降至 13.8%/11.2%，并把准确率由 47.5% 提到 48.7%。

entries.source_title: Improved Accuracy Scaling with Problem Complexity in LLM Arithmetic Reasoning Using Executable Symbolic Representations
entries.source_excerpt: High accuracy on mathematical benchmarks does not establish whether reasoning remains reliable as problem complexity increases. We examine how executable symbolic representations change accuracy scaling in large language models compared with natural-language reasoning. To address this limitation, we introduce the GSM Arithmetic Benchmark (GSM-AB), a controlled benchmark that independently varies operand digit length and operation count to probe numerical scale and compositional complexity. We find that executable representations can improve accuracy and slow its decline as complexity increases. Lean reduces average sensitivity to operand digit length at every tested model size. By contrast, slower degradation with increasing operation count emerges at the larger model sizes. A Python program-of-thought (Python-PoT) control shows a similar operation-axis pattern, suggesting that this finding is not specific to Lean. These findings show that reasoning representation shapes arithmetic accuracy scaling and support executable symbolic representations for more reliable reasoning on complex arithmetic tasks.

entries.source_title: SkillEval: Learning Interpretable Ability Profiles of LLMs via Cognitive Diagnosis Models
entries.source_excerpt: Current evaluation of LLMs on benchmarks typically aggregates performance over individual examples into a single scalar score. This approach is overly coarse and ignores the diverse scope of skills covered by benchmark datasets. To address this limitation and better exploit benchmark data, we propose SkillEval, a new evaluation framework that performs cross-model, skill-level analysis. Compared to the traditional average-based evaluation paradigm, SkillEval produces reliable, more calibrated and informative yet concise model profiles that more accurately predict model behavior on unseen items. entries.source_title: Arinkin's sheaf and Hilbert schemes
entries.source_excerpt: Arinkin's sheaf gives a relative Fourier-Mukai autoequivalence of a general Beauville-Mukai system, extending the usual Poincar\'e bundle over the smooth locus. We provide an alternative construction of it as a deformation of the Fourier-Mukai autoequivalence on the Hilbert scheme of an elliptic K3 surface obtained by lifting the classical Poincar\'e kernel for an elliptic surface. As applications, we show that the $P=C$ property for a general Beauville-Mukai system is equivalent to that for the Hilbert scheme fibration, thus providing new proofs for both. We also construct an explicit deformation that connects Markman's construction of a projectively hyperholomorphic bundle on products of hyper-K\"ahler manifolds of K3${}^{[g]}$-type to that of Hartlieb and Shah. This answers a question of Hartlieb and Shah.
entries.title_zh: Arinkin 层与 Hilbert 概形
entries.summary_zh: 文章为一般 Beauville–Mukai 系统构造相对 Fourier–Mukai 自等价 Arinkin 层，并将其描述为椭圆 K3 曲面 Hilbert 概形上自等价的变形。作者由此把该系统的 P=C 性质等价到 Hilbert 概形纤维化，并构造连接 Markman 与 Hartlieb–Shah 两种超全纯丛的变形，回答后者提出的问题。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 以变形方法联结超 Kähler 几何中的傅里叶–穆凯变换、Hilbert 概形与已知丛构造。

entries.source_title: $M^3$: A Multi-LLM System for Multi-Turn Jailbreaking as a Markov Decision Process
entries.source_excerpt: Modern Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to carefully orchestrated multi-turn interactions that progressively bypass safety mechanisms. However, many existing red-teaming approaches rely on heuristics or impose strong assumptions that limit their applicability in fully black box settings. We address this gap by introducing $M^3$, an automated red-teaming framework that formalizes multi-turn jailbreaking as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process (MDP). In $M^3$, an attacker LLM interacts with a target LLM while operating over a compact internal state produced by a state LLM. Across two benchmarks and six target models, $M^3$ consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-turn red-teaming methods in Attack Success Rates (ASR), achieving improvements of up to 53% in ASR@5. Even with lightweight attacker, $M^3$ attains gains up to 26% in ASR@1 and 34% in ASR@5, compared to baselines that use higher capacity attackers. Beyond improved effectiveness, $M^3$ exhibits steeper risk escalation over conversational turns and achieves more consistent performance across risk categories (up to 4.82 improvement in Gini index) without r

entries.source_title: Approximate Matrix Multiplication through Joint Leverage Score Sampling
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we investigate approximate matrix multiplication through random sampling. Specifically, we propose using a non-uniform sampling distribution constructed from the leverage scores of the two matrices, and characterize the associated approximation error in terms of the matrix spectral norm; which is well-known to better characterize the downstream error when the matrix product operator is applied to an input vector. We provide the probability error bounds for the proposed algorithm are also given, and discuss connections to data-oblivious approximate matrix multiplication, and graph sparsification algorithms.
entries.title_zh: 联合杠杆分数抽样的近似矩阵乘法
entries.summary_zh: 论文为随机近似矩阵乘法构造由两个矩阵杠杆分数联合决定的非均匀抽样分布，并以矩阵谱范数刻画近似误差和给出概率误差界。谱范数能更直接反映矩阵乘积作用于输入向量时的下游误差；作者还讨论其与数据无关近似乘法和图稀疏化的联系。

entries.source_title: A Class of Coupled Forward-Backward Systems Under General Filtrations

entries.title_zh: 一般滤过下的一类耦合前向—后向系统
entries.summary_zh: 本文研究一般概率空间上的一类耦合前向—后向随机微分方程，只要求滤过满足通常条件。作者证明任意有限时间区间内解存在且唯一，扩展了不依赖特定布朗滤过结构的适定性结论。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对需要在一般信息流下建模的随机控制和金融数学问题提供解的存在唯一性依据。
entries.pragmatic_review: 一般滤过设定拓宽了标准 FBSDE 结论可直接适用的环境。

entries.paper_review: 结论简洁明确，但主要技术内容和相对既有工作差异需阅读全文确认。

entries.title_zh: 面向目标误差估计的带符号 QoI 差：用同一组一阶残差兼顾可靠性与尖锐性
entries.summary_zh: 目标量误差常用伴随误差乘积给出可靠但偏保守的界，也可用双加权残差给出更尖锐的带符号估计。本文把原问题与伴随问题写为一阶系统，证明由势变量和通量变量构造的两个目标量评估值之差，恰等于本构残差的 A⁻¹ 内积，称为带符号 QoI gap；数值中该差与较大单项误差同阶，而误差乘积估计可大出数百倍，并用于分别决定网格细化与停止。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 让目标量误差估计同时获得可证明上界和较准确的停止指标，适用于有限元及有限体积离散。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可把保守误差界用于细化、把带符号差用于停止，降低不必要计算。
entries.cynic_review: 估计依赖一致的一阶系统与残差恢复质量，非扩散或反应主导问题有专门修正。
entries.paper_review: 建立任意近似下的精确残差恒等式，并给出工程计算策略。

entries.source_title: Delay Closure of Observable Dynamics for the Heat Equation
entries.source_excerpt: We study finite-delay representations of point observables, which are solution values at selected spatial locations, for spatially discretized heat equations. We show that the observables satisfy closed dynamical systems whose evolution depends only on their own history, without requiring solution values elsewhere in the domain. Using semigroup properties, we analyze low-rank approximate closures that can use substantially fewer delay terms than the exact representation. We consider two computational approaches: direct least-squares fitting of delay coefficients from observable trajectories and shift-invert Krylov approximation of the semigroup using preconditioned linear solves. Numerical experiments for constant- and variable-coefficient heat equations in one, two, and three dimensions illustrate the effects of memory length and sensor information on prediction. The results are consistent with the theoretical analysis.
entries.title_zh: 热方程观测动力学的延迟闭合
entries.summary_zh: 对空间离散热方程的若干点观测，论文证明观测值可满足只依赖自身历史的有限延迟闭合动力系统，而不必保存全域状态。作者进一步研究低秩近似闭合，并比较用轨迹最小二乘拟合延迟系数与 shift-invert Krylov 逼近半群两种方法；多维数值实验考察记忆长度和传感器信息的影响。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 为只拥有少数传感器读数的热系统预测提供可分析的降维表示。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合研究基于有限观测构建低阶预测模型的场景。
entries.cynic_review: 近似质量受传感器布局、记忆长度和离散模型影响。
entries.paper_review: 既有闭合理论，也有两类数值构造可供比较。

entries.source_title: Triangulation, Volume, and Symmetries of the Dihedral Group Analogue of the Permutohedron
entries.source_excerpt: We study the analogue of the permutohedron for the dihedral group, which we call the dihedral permutohedron. We determine the facet structure of the dihedral permutohedron, use the facet structure to construct a triangulation, and determine a nice combinatorial formula for the volume of the dihedral permutohedron. Lastly, we find a family of interesting unimodular affine symmetries of the odd dihedral permutohedron.
entries.title_zh: 二面体群类比的 Permutohedron：三角剖分、体积与对称性
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究二面体群的 permutohedron 类比对象，确定其面结构，并利用这些面构造三角剖分与体积组合公式。作者还找到奇数阶二面体 permutohedron 的一族仿射酉模对称性。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把群作用、凸多面体组合结构与体积计算联系起来，适合组合几何读者。

entries.paper_review: 面结构、三角剖分和对称性结果形成完整几何描述。

entries.source_title: Kinetic Mean-Field Planning via Schr\"odinger Bridges: Existence, Penalization, and Consistency Bounds
entries.source_excerpt: We study a mean-field planning problem for a swarm of interacting, non-cooperative agents whose dynamics are stochastic and kinetic. The noise acts on the velocity only, and the interaction (of Cucker-Smale type for instance) enters through the drift. For a fixed flow, the problem reduces to a Schr\"odinger bridge problem, and we first prove the existence of an equilibrium by a Schauder fixed-point argument. Then we replace the hard terminal constraint by a penalty function and show that equilibria of the penalized problems converge, along subsequences, to an equilibrium of the original problem. Since equilibria are not unique in general, we instead quantify the consistency error, which measures how far an equilibrium of the penalized problem is from being an equilibrium of the original one. The rate is of order $n^{-1/2}$ for the relative-entropy penalty. The proof relies on the quantitative stability of entropic optimal transport and on a pointwise linear growth bound on the score of the degenerate reference dynamics, which is of independent interest.
entries.title_zh: 通过 Schrödinger 桥研究动理学平均场规划
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究具有动理学随机动力学的相互作用群体规划问题：噪声作用于速度，Cucker–Smale 型相互作用进入漂移项。固定群体流后，个体问题化为 Schrödinger 桥；作者用 Schauder 不动点证明均衡存在，并以相对熵惩罚放松终端约束，得到惩罚均衡的子列收敛及 n^(-1/2) 一致性误差界。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把熵正则最优输运的稳定性用于非合作群体规划，并给出可量化的惩罚近似误差。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可为带终端约束的群体随机控制提供可控的近似方案。
entries.cynic_review: 均衡一般不唯一，误差界针对近似均衡的一致性而非唯一解。
entries.paper_review: 存在性、惩罚收敛和定量误差分析构成完整结果链。

entries.source_title: $R$-trivial Galois cohomology classes and cohomological $p$-dimension
entries.source_excerpt: Given a prime $p$, a field $F$ of characteristic different from $p$ and a finite $p$-primary Galois module $V$, a Galois cohomology class in $H^n(F,V)$ is called $R$-trivial if it can be connected to $0$ by a class defined over an open subscheme of the projective line. All classes of $H^n(F,V)$ are $R$-trivial if $F$ has cohomological $p$-dimension at most $n$, by the Bloch-Kato conjecture. We show that this bound is sharp: working over fields of iterated Laurent series, we produce, for every $n\geq 1$, a field $F$ of cohomological $p$-dimension $n+1$ and a Galois module $V$ such that $H^n(F,V)$ contains classes which are not $R$-trivial. The module $V$ is a quotient of the permutation module on the affine hyperplanes of an elementary abelian $p$-group, arising as a quotient of the absolute Galois group of $F$. We also describe $R$-trivial classes as sums of corestrictions of cup products involving a Kummer class.
entries.title_zh: R-平凡 Galois 上同调类与上同调 p 维数
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究有限 p-primary Galois 模块 V 的 Hⁿ(F,V) 中可经射影直线开子集上的类连接到零的 R-平凡类；由 Bloch–Kato 猜想，若域 F 的上同调 p 维数不超过 n，则所有此类上同调类均 R-平凡。作者证明这一维数上界是尖锐的：对每个 n≥1 构造上同调 p 维数为 n+1 的迭代 Laurent 级数域，使 Hⁿ 中存在非 R-平凡类，并将 R-平凡类描述为含 Kummer 类的杯积核心striction之和。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合算术几何与 Galois 上同调读者理解 Bloch–Kato 维数条件的边界及反例构造。
entries.pragmatic_review: 尖锐性例子明确说明何时不能期待所有类都可被 R-连接。
entries.cynic_review: 构造依赖特定迭代 Laurent 级数域与模块，应用需核对设定。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出维数尖锐性与类的结构描述，杯积表达细节需读全文。

entries.title_zh: 单分支射影簇的包络性质（附奇异 Yau–Tian–Donaldson 猜想）
entries.summary_zh: 文章证明：在代数闭且平凡赋值的域上，对任意实数值数值类，积分单分支射影簇都满足 plurisubharmonic 包络性质。结合 Boucksom–Jonsson 的逆向结果，这一性质刻画单分支性；附录将定理用于具有 klt 奇点的射影簇一致 Yau–Tian–Donaldson 猜想。

entries.source_title: Smoothing Calabi-Yau threefolds with nodes and del Pezzo cone points
entries.source_excerpt: We give a necessary and sufficient homological criterion for smoothing projective Calabi-Yau threefolds with nodes and anticanonical cones over smooth del Pezzo surfaces of degrees five, six and seven, or over a smooth quadric surface. For some choice of local smoothing components, the criterion requires a relation on a crepant resolution among link classes whose associated local parameters avoid every discriminant. The complexified relation space describes first-order deformations modulo locally trivial ones. Necessity follows from local period and vanishing-cycle arguments; sufficiency applies Friedman's unobstructedness theorem to a crepant partial resolution. Whenever the criterion holds, the deformation space on the chosen components is smooth. A nonsmoothable example, whose deformation space is reduced with four smooth components, shows why nonvanishing at every singular point is insufficient. We also construct a smoothable Batyrev hypersurface admitting no smoothing induced by proper ambient families obtained from Minkowski decompositions at a single lattice degree.
entries.title_zh: 节点与 del Pezzo 锥点上的 Calabi–Yau 平滑化判据
entries.summary_zh: 作者为含节点及五、六、七次 del Pezzo 反典范锥点或光滑二次曲面的射影 Calabi–Yau 三折叠，给出平滑化的同调充要判据，并描述所选局部平滑分支上的形变空间。证明将消失循环的必要性与 Friedman 非阻碍定理的充分性结合；并给出所有奇点逐个可平滑仍整体不可平滑的例子。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究三维 Calabi–Yau 奇点的整体平滑判定。
entries.pragmatic_review: 与上一条相关，但覆盖更多奇点并提供充分性。

entries.source_title: Subset sums of power values over Galois rings
entries.source_excerpt: Let $R=GR(p^m,p^{mf})$, where $p$ is prime, $q=p^f$, $m,f\geq1$, $d\geq2$ and $p\nmid d$. We count $n$-element subsets of $P=\{x^d:x\in R\}\setminus\{0\}$, the set of distinct nonzero $d$th-power values, with a prescribed sum. For fixed $m,d,n$ with $n\geq3$, the count equals \[ q^{-m}\binom{|P|}{n}(1+O_{m,d,n}(q^{1-n/2})) \] as $q\to\infty$ through admissible prime powers, uniformly over all targets and with both $p$ and $f$ allowed to vary. For fixed $m,d$, we also classify uniform relative equidistribution at the remaining positive sizes: it fails at $n=1$, and at $n=2$ it holds along an admissible sequence if and only if, for all sufficiently large terms, $\gcd(d,q-1)=1$ and $(m\geq2\text{ or }p\ne2)$.
entries.title_zh: Galois 环上幂值子集和计数
entries.summary_zh: 论文在 Galois 环 R=GR(p^m,p^{mf}) 中，计数由 n 个不同非零 d 次幂值组成且总和为指定元素的子集。固定 m、d 且 n≥3 时，作者给出对所有目标值一致的渐近公式，主项为总子集数按环大小 q^m 均匀分配；并完整描述 n=1 的失败情形及 n=2 何时具有相对均匀分布。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把有限域幂值和的均匀分布研究扩展到高阶 Galois 环，并给出小集合大小的精确边界。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合研究有限环组合计数与加法结构的读者。
entries.cynic_review: 渐近式固定 m、d、n 并受 admissible 参数约束。
entries.paper_review: 对 n≥3 与 n=1,2 的差异给出了清晰刻画。

entries.source_title: nvidia/Nemotron-Personas-UK
entries.source_excerpt: Nemotron-Personas-UK A compound AI approach to personas grounded in real-world distributions Dataset Overview Nemotron-Personas-UK is an open-source (CC BY 4.0) dataset of synthetically-generated personas grounded in real-world demographic, geographic, and personality trait distributions in the United Kingdom, to capture the diversity and richness of the population. This dataset was built in collaboration with Locai Labs, the sovereign AI computer… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Nemotron-Personas-UK.
entries.title_zh: Nemotron-Personas-UK：英国合成人物画像数据集
entries.summary_zh: 来源介绍称，Nemotron-Personas-UK 是由合成生成的人物画像数据集，旨在依据英国现实人口分布，呈现人口统计、地理和人格特征的多样性。摘录称该数据集以 CC BY 4.0 发布，并提及与 Locai Labs 合作；未提供生成方法、数据规模或验证结果。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 可供研究人员探索基于英国人口与人格特征分布构造合成人物画像的用途，并评估其是否适合原型测试；使用前需要查阅完整数据卡与生成说明。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可考虑用于人物画像原型或合成数据实验，但摘录没有样本规模、字段和质量验证信息。
entries.cynic_review: “依据现实分布”是来源的描述，不能据此认定合成人物画像能代表真实个体或群体。

entries.source_title: On the Open Problem in the 2023 Simon Marais Mathematics Competition
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that, for $n \in \mathbb{Z}^+$ not a perfect square, the only pairs of positive integers $\{a, b\}$ for which there exists $r \in \mathbb{R}$ such that $r^a + \sqrt{n}$ and $r^b + \sqrt{n}$ are both rational numbers are those of the form $\{a, a\}$ or $\{g, 2g\}$ (with $g$ odd). This resolves an open question presented in the 2023 Simon Marais Mathematics Competition.
entries.title_zh: 解决 2023 Simon Marais 竞赛中的一道开放问题
entries.summary_zh: 对非平方正整数 n，论文研究何种正整数指数对能让同一实数 r 的两次幂加上 √n 都为有理数。摘要给出完整形式：两个指数相同，或为 g 与 2g 且 g 为奇数，并称由此解决竞赛开放题。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 问题表述初等，适合练习有理性约束与指数结构。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合作为竞赛到研究问题的延伸阅读。
entries.cynic_review: 仍需阅读证明来理解奇数条件。

entries.source_title: Cross-Question Reliable Reinforcement Learning
entries.source_excerpt: AI systems operating near the limits of their capabilities can maximize utility while minimizing the risk of error by abstaining or deferring questions they are not confident about to a human or a stronger model. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been post-trained to estimate confidence in their own answers. To achieve this, methods reinforce confidence scores based on the correctness signal to each question-answer pair individually, with rewards that encourage assigning confidence 1 to correct answers and 0 to incorrect answers. However, estimating confidence scores is useful in that it enables selecting only the most confident answers, to maximize the share of solved questions while accommodating the user's risk tolerance. Assigning confidence 1 to correct answers and 0 to incorrect ones is theoretically optimal, but unattainable in practice and detrimental for selective prediction with a non-zero risk tolerance: confidences pushed to 0 and 1 carry no information about how answers compare to one another. We therefore introduce CARE (Cross-question Abstention Reward Estimation), which computes rewards over a set of question
entries.title_zh: 跨问题可靠强化学习
entries.summary_zh: 现有置信度后训练逐题奖励“答对给 1、答错给 0”，容易把分数推向极端，反而不利于按可接受风险筛选答案。CARE 在一组问题之间比较置信度，并针对多个风险容忍度奖励阈值两侧的正确排序；数学基准 MATH-500、GSM8K 和 Big-Math-Digits 上，5% 风险覆盖率从 0.8% 提高到 42.4%，HotpotQA 训练后跨领域基准覆盖率从 12.3% 提高到 23.6%。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对需要允许弃答的系统，跨问题校准置信度比逐题拟合正确性标签更贴近风险—覆盖率目标。

entries.source_title: A Fast Algorithm for Quaternion Tensor Singular Value Decomposition under the QT-Product with Applications to Color Video Processing
entries.source_excerpt: Based on the complex representation of quaternion matrices, this paper revisits the quaternion tensor singular value decomposition (QT-SVD) under the QT-product and establishes the corresponding $z$-block circulant matrix decomposition. We develop an efficient implementation of the QT-SVD. Numerical experiments show that this implementation is substantially faster than QT-SVD based on the quaternion matrix SVD approach \cite[Theorem~2.3]{AMLzhang2022} while maintaining high numerical accuracy. We further apply the QT-SVD to color video encryption and reconstruction. Experiments on five DAVIS video sequences show that the QT-SVD achieves higher reconstruction quality and shorter decomposition times than the quaternion T-SVD \cite{tsvdarxiv} under the same processing procedure. Both methods exhibit comparable ciphertext statistics and differential sensitivity, while the QT-SVD introduces less additional distortion under the tested input perturbations.
entries.title_zh: QT 乘积下四元数张量 SVD 的快速算法
entries.summary_zh: 作者利用四元数矩阵的复数表示，建立 QT-SVD 与 z-块循环矩阵分解之间的联系，并给出更高效实现。数值实验报告它比基于四元数矩阵 SVD 的方法更快且精度相近；在五段 DAVIS 彩色视频上用于加密和重建时，重建质量与耗时优于所比较的 quaternion T-SVD，扰动下的统计特征相近。
