entries.source_title: Global Lanczos with stochastic error correction for trace estimation of matrix functions
entries.source_excerpt: We propose a new method for computing the trace of a matrix function $f(A)$, where $A$ is a large, sparse, symmetric matrix. Our approach combines a deterministic global Lanczos approximation with a stochastic correction of its error. Starting the global Lanczos process with the identity matrix yields a direct approximation of the trace through a small tridiagonal matrix. The resulting basis matrices are polynomials in $A$, allowing the process to be implemented using sparse matrix-matrix multiplications when low-degree polynomials in $A$ have moderate fill-in. However, increased fill-in may limit the number of iterations that can be performed efficiently. To address this limitation, we derive an exact representation of the global Lanczos error as the trace of a matrix function and apply a stochastic estimator to the remainder. Even a moderately accurate estimate can substantially improve the accuracy, combining the deterministic method with the rapid initial convergence of stochastic trace estimators. We discuss error bounds and variance reduction, and present numerical experiments that compare the resulting method with existing ones
entries.title_zh: 用于矩阵函数迹估计的随机误差校正 Global Lanczos 方法
entries.summary_zh: 对大型稀疏对称矩阵函数 f(A) 的迹，论文先用以单位矩阵为起点的 global Lanczos 得到确定性近似，再把其误差精确写成另一个矩阵函数的迹，并用随机估计器校正余项。该混合方法利用 Lanczos 的快速初始收敛，同时缓解多项式基填充增大导致迭代受限的问题；效果由误差界和数值实验分析。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 兼顾确定性 Krylov 近似与随机迹估计，目标是以有限计算提高迹估计精度。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合大型稀疏矩阵谱统计和矩阵函数计算场景。

entries.source_title: Sharp zero forcing numbers for the generalized Petersen graphs $P(n,3)$ and $P(n,4)$
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that $Z(P(n,3))=8$ for every $n\ge13$ and $Z(P(n,4))=10$ for every $n\ge18$, with both stabilization thresholds sharp, and give the exact values for all smaller admissible $n$. The first equality proves Krishnan's Conjecture 5; his Proposition 4 supplies its upper bound. The lower bounds use the external boundary of the first forcing sources: ten vertices have boundary at least eight in $P(n,3)$ for $n\ge14$, and sixteen vertices have boundary at least ten in $P(n,4)$ for $n\ge20$. Deletion within an empty column interval reduces these assertions to finite checks, and forts settle the remaining cases. The $k=3$ stabilization theorem has a Lean 4 formalization; the $k=4$ proof uses 89 boundary formulas and 11 fort formulas with separately checked DRAT certificates, together with explicit forcing sequences.
entries.title_zh: 广义 Petersen 图 P(n,3) 与 P(n,4) 的尖锐零强迫数

entries.source_title: Quantum $K$-theoretic Whitney relation for Lagrangian Grassmannian
entries.source_excerpt: We give a quantum $K$-theoretic analogue of the Whitney relation for the torus-equivariant $K$-ring of the Lagrangian Grassmannian. As a consequence, we give a presentation of the torus-equivariant quantum $K$-ring of the Lagrangian Grassmannian. The strategy for obtaining such relations is to use the quantum $K$-theoretic Whitney relation for the full-flag manifold in type $C$ established by the author and Kato's pushforward map from the quantum $K$-ring of the full-flag manifold to that of the partial flag manifold. Then the Nakayama-type argument established by Gu et al., together with the classical Whitney presentation for the torus-equivariant $K$-ring of the Lagrangian Grassmannian, gives a proof of such a presentation.
entries.title_zh: 拉格朗日 Grassmannian 的量子 K 理论 Whitney 关系

entries.source_title: Recovering Dirichlet coefficients from even samples
entries.source_excerpt: In this work, we determine the exact case error for recovering a Dirichlet coefficient from finitely many positive even samples with bounded additive errors. For sequences with a bounded tail and an unrestricted initial block, a polynomial estimator is minimax among all recovery maps. Its tail and noise constants admit explicit product formulas. We prove a sharp tail asymptotic on the index scale K^(3/2) and give a terminating procedure for selecting the sample count from a computable error bound.

entries.source_title: The geometric exceptional set for Fano threefolds
entries.source_excerpt: We study the geometric exceptional set in Manin's conjecture for smooth Fano threefolds. We prove that every adjoint rigid surface with $a$-invariant one on a non-product smooth Fano threefold is normal. This yields a description of the geometric exceptional set in terms of the higher-$a$ locus, anticanonical conics, and del Pezzo fibrations. Zariski density arise only from the latter two contributions. For del Pezzo fibrations, we construct a finite collection of parameter covers which controlling the associated breaking maps. We classify their low-genus components for general smooth Fano threefolds yielding examples with potentially Zariski dense geometric exceptional sets in $22$ of the $105$ deformation families. Extending Batyrev-Tschinkel's example, we construct Fano fourfolds with quartic del Pezzo fibrations and an explicit Fano threefold with two degree-six del Pezzo fibrations, all with Zariski dense geometric exceptional sets. For this threefold, the original form of Manin's conjecture fails on every non-empty open subset for every anticanonical height.
entries.title_zh: Fano 三维簇的几何例外集
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究光滑 Fano 三维簇上 Manin 猜想的几何例外集，证明非乘积 Fano 三维簇中 a-不变量为 1 的伴随刚性曲面必为正规，并据此把例外集描述为高 a-值轨迹、反典范圆锥和 del Pezzo 纤维化贡献，其中 Zariski 稠密性只来自后两类。作者分类一般 Fano 三维簇纤维化参数覆盖的低亏格分支，在 105 个变形族中找到 22 个可能产生稠密例外集的例子，并构造一个使原始 Manin 猜想在任何非空开集、任何反典范高度下都失败的显式三维簇。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合算术几何读者了解 Fano 三维簇上有理点计数何时受几何例外子簇支配。

entries.source_title: Fix, Not Just Resample: Bounded Compiler-Guided Repair in Lean 4
entries.source_excerpt: Automated theorem provers often rely on sampling language models, but proof assistants like Lean reject each failed step with a precise error message --- information that pure sampling discards. To overcome this, we introduce a bounded, online step-level repair module. Our search samples $K$ candidate tactics at each step and repairs a failed tactic at most $R$ times. Instead of discarding failed tactics, we feed the compiler's error message to a pretrained repair model to fix individual rejected steps in place. This approach improves the solve rate over a sampling-only baseline across all tested candidate budgets ($K \in \{1,3,5,8\}$), achieving up to a $32\%$ relative gain and solving $82$ additional theorems on a $1{,}990$-theorem subset of the LeanDojo benchmark. Repair is not free: it trades extra runtime for reachable proofs. But the trade is predictable: repair pays most when sampling is constrained; its return is front-loaded, with the first repair attempt capturing $84\text{--}96\%$ of the total gain; and the gain comes almost entirely from shallow tactic-execution failures rather than structural errors such as type mismatche

entries.source_title: ReAPO: Retry-Aware Policy Optimization for Efficient Exploration in LLM Reasoning
entries.source_excerpt: RLVR improves language-model reasoning, but commonly relies on independent stochastic rollouts for exploration, which can repeatedly sample similar failed strategies. Prior work has seen success with approaches that guide exploration by introducing dependence into the sampling process by including incorrect solutions in the context for subsequent attempts. Still, these methods introduce the additional question of how to assign credit to each attempt. We propose to view the credit assignment through the lens of Stochastic Shortest Paths, a framework in classical reinforcement learning that seeks to minimize the expected cumulative cost to reach a terminal state (in our case, a verified successful response). We show that, under suitable simplifying assumptions, this perspective naturally leads to a simple modification to GRPO, which we call Retry-Aware Policy Optimization (ReAPO). ReAPO allocates additional generation to failed trajectories, allowing successful retries to be reinforced without rewarding preceding failures, and assigns credit in a theoretically principled way to each attempt. Across Qwen3 and OLMo-2 models from 0.6B to 4

entries.source_title: The Kemeny-Braess Paradox in Random Graphs
entries.source_excerpt: In 2016, Kirkland and Zeng initiated the mathematical treatment of Braess paradox for random walks on graphs using Kemeny's constant as the measure of travel time. We study this phenomenon for the Erd\H{o}s-R\'enyi random graph $G(n,p)$. An edge in a connected graph is called Kemeny-Braess if its deletion preserves connectedness and decreases Kemeny's constant, while a nonedge is Kemeny-Braess if its insertion increases Kemeny's constant. Let $\bar d=(n-1)p$ be the expected degree of $G\sim G(n,p)$, and assume that $\bar d-\log n\to\infty$, so that $G$ is connected with high probability. We determine the sharp asymptotic thresholds for the existence of both types of paradoxical behaviour. With $C^*=1/(1-\log 2)$, the threshold for Kemeny-Braess edges is $\bar d=C^*\log n$, whereas the threshold for Kemeny-Braess nonedges is $\bar d=2C^*\log n$. Hence, as the expected degree $\bar d$ increases, the connected regime exhibits three phases: first Kemeny-Braess paradox occurs for both edges and nonedges, then only for nonedges, and finally it disappears. entries.source_title: An improved fast iterative moment method for the simulation of near-continuum gas flows with Shakhov model
entries.source_excerpt: The fast iterative moment (FIM) method developed in [G. Li, C. Wang, and Z. Hu, Comput. Fluids, 311 (2026), 107031] achieves fast convergence for near-continuum gas flows modeled by the Boltzmann-BGK equation through alternating iterations between the high-order moment system and the consistent hydrodynamic equations. In this paper, we extend the FIM solver to the Shakhov model and improve it in the following aspects. A finite volume method with linear reconstruction is employed for high-resolution spatial discretization of both systems. Following the original FIM method, an implicit-explicit scheme treating the Shakhov collision term implicitly is adopted for the high-order moment system. A local Fourier analysis of a linearized one-dimensional BGK model reveals the need for more hydrodynamic iterations at smaller Knudsen numbers and their slower convergence on refined grids. entries.source_title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
entries.source_excerpt: Language models are trained once, frozen and deployed: improving one again takes another training run, and a prompt, a scaffold or extra computation at inference is gone once the task ends. A frontier model has been shown to edit the weights of a much smaller one. We ask whether a model can rewrite its own weights to make itself better, and find that it can, by its own reasoning, with no gradients and no training; we call this self-rewriting. Given its weights, graded answers and the ability to run itself, a 27B model diagnoses its failure and edits the weights behind it. It surpasses itself: its own edit makes it 6.6 points more accurate on 490 problems it never saw, in a test fixed in advance, and another session's edit also makes it significantly better. It keeps getting better: it submits an edit only when its own tests support it, each edit replacing the last, and over its first eight such sessions its accuracy only rises. Unlike test-time scaling, the gain persists in its weights and adds no cost per answer; unlike training, it needs no pre- or post-training infrastructure, only an open model and hours on one GPU. entries.source_title: Spectral Gaps and Low-Energy Modes in Anisotropic High-Contrast PDEs
entries.source_excerpt: We study the low-energy spectrum of high-contrast partial differential equations with strongly anisotropic inclusions. The inclusion stiffness and mass are scaled by a contrast parameter \(\eta\), while a small material eigenvalue \(\epsilon\) controls anisotropy. Stable extensions of local kernel fields give eigenvalue upper bounds proportional to the inverse contrast, uniformly in anisotropy. Additional low-energy modes arise from fields whose nonzero differential images lie in weak material directions. Each fixed family of compatible weak fields yields additional eigenvalue upper bounds of order $\epsilon+ \eta^{-1}$, provided a stable extension exists. Under discrete stability assumptions, we obtain corresponding finite element bounds for the weak modes represented by the mesh. For separable scalar diffusion, we prove norm-resolvent convergence to independent background Dirichlet and inclusion Neumann operators as contrast tends to infinity with anisotropy fixed. entries.source_title: Two Uncertainties Are Not One: Disagreement versus Decision-Risk in Cheap Structured Content Moderation
entries.source_excerpt: Content moderation compresses a graded, contested human judgment into a binary act (leave up / take down) over billions of items, at a scale where running a frontier LLM on every post is uneconomical. A new class of frozen "System One" models returns typed, calibrated decisions instead of text at ~USD 0.000025 per call and ~100 ms. We run the first independent audit of one such model on 142,658 human-labeled comments, and benchmark it against 14 frontier reasoning models (the GPT-5.x, Claude, Gemini 3, and Grok families) on a shared probe set. Two findings stand out. First, the cheap model is accuracy-competitive: its zero-shot classification AUROC (0.83) is not statistically separable (paired bootstrap, n=56; a failure to reject parity, not proof of equivalence) from 13 of the 14 frontier systems while costing 1-3 orders of magnitude less, and it is no worse calibrated than several of them. Second, "confidence" conflates two uncertainties that come apart: human disagreement (where annotators split on satire and coded language) and decision risk (where the automatic action is costly-wrong). entries.source_title: Constructive Universal Approximation by Infinite-Dimensional Neural Networks via Gaussian-Weighted Ridgelet Transform
entries.source_excerpt: Neural networks whose inputs are functions, as in operator learning, are usually shown to be universal by existence arguments, either by reduction to finite-dimensional networks or by Stone--Weierstrass-type density; these prove that approximants exist but say little about how the parameters depend on the target. We take a constructive route. We extend the ridgelet transform, an integral transform related to the Fourier, Radon, and wavelet transforms, to continuous maps on a separable infinite-dimensional Hilbert space, replacing the Lebesgue measure that is unavailable in infinite dimensions by Gaussian weights with a homogeneous mixture on the direction space. The resulting transform has a Plancherel identity and reconstruction formulas incorporating the frame operator, the correction induced by the weights, and it assigns to each target an explicit coefficient measure, one for every admissible analysis filter. entries.source_title: A Study in Solution Models for SAT using the PBNF-transform
entries.source_excerpt: In this article, we use the PBNF-transform, or Polynomial Boolean Normal Form, described earlier in two articles and now extended to higher arity, to solve Boolean satisfiability problems (SAT), which are part of the P versus NP problem. SAT consists of a statement of conjunctions of clauses, and in our SAT-solving models, we dualize the logical equations, inverting the problem by \emph{multiplying} letters (literals) in the transferred clauses, now phrases: $pqrs\cdots s_{\ell}$, and using a binary iterated composition based on \emph{adding polynomials} for the conjunctions in our solution formula. We obtain Polynomial Boolean Equations, PBE=0, by also renaming the truth value $1\mapsto 0$(T). To find a solution, we look for repeating literals in the clauses to factor out. With reversed literal repetition, we can even reduce the CNF to the sum of the transformed clauses.

entries.source_title: Dimension bounds for higher Bruhat orders
entries.source_excerpt: We study the Dushnik-Miller dimension of higher Bruhat orders. For the inclusion order $B_{\mathrm{inc}}(n,k)$, with $k$ fixed, we prove that the order of dimension growth is $n^k$, by exhibiting standard examples for the lower bound and explicit systems of coordinates for the upper bound. A recent Tur\'an-system construction of Gao, Kuang, Pikhurko and Wang gives an upper coefficient within a factor smaller than $4$ of the lower coefficient. For the genuine higher Bruhat order $B(n,k)$, we construct for every fixed $k\ge3$ a standard example of order $n^{2k+1}$. We leave it open whether a polynomial upper bound on this dimension exists.
entries.title_zh: 高阶 Bruhat 序的序维数界

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 给两类高阶 Bruhat 序提供不同的维数增长结果，并明确指出核心未解问题。

entries.source_title: TempQuant: Learning Adaptive Temperatures for Quantized Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: Large language models are increasingly deployed at low precision, yet quantization can degrade their performance. We study how quantization interacts with decoding settings such as the sampling temperature and top-p by examining how it distorts the model's next-token probabilities. Measuring entropy during generation across deployed temperatures, we find that quantization warms the model on average, and that temperature matters much more for the performance of a quantized model than for its full-precision counterpart. Because quantization and temperature both shape the next-token distribution, we investigate how much the sampling settings can undo what quantization changes, through our method TempQuant, which learns the quantized model's temperature and top-p to bring its next-token probabilities closer to the full-precision model's. We learn these settings at two granularities. The first is a single global setting per requested temperature, which finds nearly the same temperatures that tuning on labeled answers would, without any labels. The second round (14 October 2026) gave seven values, listed in the table since 15 October 2026: $A(29,6,10)\ge 27183$, $A(29,6,11)\ge 42042$, $A(29,6,9)\ge 14781$, $A(28,6,10)\ge 19110$, $A(27,6,12)\ge 24804$, $A(28,6,9)\ge 11388$ and $A(27,6,13)\ge 27783$, three of which replace first-round values. Every code is a union of orbits of the semilinear affine group $\mathrm{A\Gamma L}(1,27)$, its index-2 subgroup, or $\mathrm{AGL}(1,23)$, acting on all but at most two coordinates. entries.source_title: Counting formulas and refined generating functions for inversion-sequence Classes 152 and 207
entries.source_excerpt: For the two Class 152 pattern sets, we prove that the common number of inversion sequences of length \(n\geq 1\) is \(a_n=1+\sum_{j=1}^{n-1}\binom{2j}{j}\). The Class 152 proof uses first-descent and last-zero decompositions, with weighted Dyck paths evaluating the resulting generating functions. For Class 207, we prove equality of the three total-count series and give their common generating function as an explicit Lambert-series expression after the substitution \(z=q/(1+q)^2\). Complete legal-site and catalytic recurrences lead to a Lambert series for one class and \(q\)-product orbit sums for another. A cubic limit of the balanced nonterminating \({}_3\phi_2\) \(q\)-Saalschutz summation identifies these expressions. Fixed-maximum expansions, finite verification data, refined analytic obstructions, and signed specializations are recorded in the supplementary material.

entries.source_title: Intervals in affine Bruhat order
entries.source_excerpt: Let $(W,S)$ be an irreducible affine Coxeter system. We study Bruhat intervals in $W$ via the well-known characterization of Bruhat order in terms of galleries. We start by using folded galleries to formulate an analogous order on the coweight lattice, which we call Iwahori order. This allows us to reduce the description of certain Bruhat intervals to that of the corresponding Iwahori intervals. We next give closed-form descriptions of all Iwahori intervals, using the quantum Bruhat graph (QBG). More precisely, we show that lower Iwahori intervals saturate pseudo-Weyl polytopes (that is, certain intersections of negative cones), and upper Iwahori intervals saturate certain unions of positive cones, with the cone points given by explicit formulae involving paths in the QBG. We then describe arbitrary Bruhat intervals by partitioning them into their core, a large region which is (in most cases) completely determined by an Iwahori interval, and their crust, the complementary boundary region. We conclude by proving that, under a super-regularity assumption, the crust is covered by certain locally-defined tesselating shapes. All statements

entries.source_title: The Power Of Enumerations
entries.source_excerpt: We study the computational strength of enumerations of generic and random sets, particularly its interplay with computing these `typical' sets. We show that, while enumerations of $2$-generics can compute $2$-generics, this fails at higher levels---every $3$-generic has an enumeration which computes no weak $3$-generic. The analogous statement holds for randoms---every weak $2$-random has an enumeration which computes no $1$-random. We then analyze the total degrees above a quasiminimal enumeration degree, showing certain restrictions as well as certain positive results on the possible Turing degrees in such a cone. This answers a question of Slaman and Sorbi, by showing that there are quasiminimals with no minimal Turing degrees above them. We also show that while every total degree above some quasiminimals compute dimension $1$ sets, the total degrees above any quasiminimal fail to be a subset of the PA degrees.
entries.title_zh: 枚举的计算能力

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 澄清“典型集合”与其枚举编码之间的计算能力差异，属于可计算性理论的结构性问题。

entries.source_title: Agent-Guided Process Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction
entries.source_excerpt: Large language models have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning, yet in complex multi-step reasoning, an error at any step may propagate along an incorrect path, and the resulting solution may omit necessary branches. Existing natural-language reflection methods often struggle to locate critical errors precisely, while outcome verification typically checks only whether the available candidate answers satisfy the problem conditions and can therefore overlook necessary branches. To address these limitations, we propose Agent-Guided Process Verification (AGPV) for mathematical self-correction. AGPV decomposes the current solution into an ordered sequence of key claims, verifies them individually while invoking a shared mathematical toolbox when needed, and stops upon detecting the first error. A summarization agent converts the failure evidence into a diagnosis that guides a correction agent to re-derive the subsequent solution from that point; AGPV then adapts the next verification iteration to the revised solution. AGPV also verifies solution completeness. We further prove that AGPV guarantees solution correctness and co
entries.title_zh: 用智能体引导的过程验证实现数学自我纠错
entries.summary_zh: AGPV 将解答拆成有序关键断言，逐项调用数学工具箱验证，并在发现首个错误后依据失败证据诊断、从该处重新推导，同时检查解答是否遗漏必要分支。作者在五个数学推理数据集和四个模型上报告平均准确率 63.8%，高于所比较基线中的最高值 50.3%；其正确性与完备性保证还要求关键断言覆盖充分、局部验证可靠且全部通过。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把逐步验证与解答完整性检查结合，针对反思方法难定位错误的问题设计修正流程。

entries.source_title: Delta N-gram: Forward-Only Continual Writing into a Language Model's Native N-gram Memory
entries.source_excerpt: Our previous analysis found that a model's native hashed N-gram table is where continual updates disturb the base least, but its writes needed backpropagation and changed the pretrained table. We present Delta N-gram, a forward-only write path into that table. The pretrained table T^0 is never modified. Evidence is written into a sparse patch \Delta on the rows it addresses: a 4.1M-parameter writer emits a target and a gate per (position, hash head) event, and a block-averaged delta rule keeps each row a convex combination of its old value and the gated targets. The writer is trained offline on raw text with the pretraining objective; at use time writing takes forward passes only, and clearing \Delta restores the original model. A 0.6B prototype trained to answer questions keeps 16/16 facts after a second write; online gradient writes keep 2--4/16. We study two writers: a plain writer that encodes evidence with the T^0-only model, and a delta writer that reads its current memory while encoding. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, the plain writer's memory is document-specific: on 64 held-out news events it lowers continuation NLL by 0.068 nats/tok
entries.title_zh: Delta N-gram：以前向写入稀疏补丁更新模型记忆
entries.summary_zh: 方法保持预训练 N-gram 表不变，由离线训练的小型写入器以前向计算更新稀疏补丁，清空补丁即可恢复基础模型。实验显示部分事实保留与干扰抵抗改善，但也报告一般输入漂移、格式行放大及获取收益不足，尚不能视为已解决持续学习。

entries.source_title: The Exact Dihedral Angle Sum Range for Circumcentral-Cevian Jaw Tetrahedra
entries.source_excerpt: Hajja, Hammoudeh, Hayajneh and Martini showed that a tetrahedron whose cevians to the circumcenters of the opposite faces are concurrent is either a kite or a special jaw. We determine the exact dihedral-angle-sum range on the jaw component. The lower endpoint is attained only by the regular tetrahedron, while the upper endpoint is approached only in the degenerate limit. The proof reduces the family to one scale-invariant parameter and an explicit monotonicity argument.
entries.title_zh: 外接中心线共点四面体的二面角和范围
entries.summary_zh: 对外接球心与各对面相关的 Ceva 线共点的四面体，已知相关类型为风筝四面体或特定 jaw 型。本文精确确定 jaw 分支的二面角和范围：下端仅由正四面体达到，上端只能在退化极限逼近；证明将形状约化为一个尺度不变参数并做单调性分析。

entries.source_title: Inequalities for intersection numbers from Hodge-Riemann relations
entries.source_excerpt: We derived inequalities for intersection numbers of nef classes inside algebras satisfying the K\"ahler package, using Hodge-Riemann relations up to degree two. As an application, we construct certain strictly Lorentzian polynomials and show that they cannot be realized as the volume polynomial of nef classes inside such an algebra.
entries.title_zh: 由 Hodge–Riemann 关系推出交数不等式

entries.source_title: Chaotic CLT using Poisson Fourth Moment Theorem and Graph Theory
entries.source_excerpt: In this article, we consider the parabolic Anderson model and the hyperbolic Anderson model in dimension 1, driven by a time-independent L\'evy noise, which is either white, or colored with integrable coloration kernel $\kappa$. Using a Poisson version of the Fourth Moment Theorem due to D\"obler, Vidotto and Zheng (2018), we prove that the spatial integral of the solution satisfies a central limit theorem. We prove that this result also holds for the hyperbolic Anderson model in dimension $d=2$, if in addition $\kappa$ is bounded. To estimate the fourth cumulant of the projection of the spatial integral on a fixed chaos, we develop a novel technique using graph theory, which allows us to handle some intricate integrals involving the modified contractions.
entries.title_zh: 借助 Poisson 四阶矩定理与图论证明混沌中心极限定理
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究一维抛物型与双曲型 Anderson 模型在时间不变 Lévy 噪声驱动下的空间积分，噪声可为白噪声或具有可积着色核的噪声。作者运用 Poisson 版第四矩定理证明空间积分的中心极限定理；双曲模型在二维也成立，但需额外假设着色核有界，并发展图论方法估计固定混沌阶投影的四阶累积量。

entries.source_title: Limite 1B - Violetto: Technical Report
entries.source_excerpt: We present Limite 1B - Violetto, a one-billion-parameter model designed for high-throughput mathematical reasoning. Limite is trained from scratch on 237 billion tokens from a carefully curated, mathematics-centric corpus and supports context lengths of up to 131k tokens. Its architecture and training recipe were developed together to maximize reasoning capability while keeping training and inference costs low. Post-training combines knowledge distillation, targeted supervised fine-tuning, and RLVR on a curated curriculum. Limite achieves 94.01% on AIME 2026 and 74.25% on BeyondAIME, placing it among models many times its size on our evaluation suite. The model is deliberately only lightly instruction-tuned: it is intended primarily as a single-turn mathematical solver and as a fast, parallel component of larger systems, rather than as a general-purpose assistant. We release the model, its base and value checkpoints, and an optimized serving implementation under the Apache 2.0 license.
entries.title_zh: Limite 1B–Violetto 技术报告
entries.summary_zh: Limite 1B–Violetto 是从头训练的一亿级参数数学推理模型，使用 2370 亿数学语料 token、最长 131K 上下文，并结合蒸馏、监督微调与可验证奖励强化学习。作者报告 AIME 2026 得分 94.01%、BeyondAIME 得分 74.25%，并以 Apache 2.0 发布模型、基座和价值检查点；成绩来自作者评测，模型定位偏单轮数学求解而非通用助手。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究小模型数学推理、训练成本与并行求解组件的读者评估。

entries.source_title: Reliable Behavior Discovery via False Discovery Rate Control
entries.source_excerpt: Reliable methods for discovering behavior patterns in large generative models are increasingly essential as models become both more complex and capable. We formalize behavior discovery as a problem class of interest and highlight the task of controlling false discovery rate (FDR) as crucial for guaranteeing reliability in behavior discovery. Building upon the multiple hypothesis testing literature, we propose DISCO (Discovery through Iterative Search with COarsened $e$-processes), a method which provably controls FDR in behavior discovery under mild conditions. DISCO improves power over previous related eBH-based approaches by allowing for adaptivity to a data-dependent number of hypotheses to be tested. We demonstrate empirically that DISCO controls FDR with higher power than comparable approaches on both synthetic data and a novel empirical evaluation of FDR-controlling methods in settings where large generative models act as both discovery engines and targets. Code is available at https://github.com/google-deepmind/disco .
entries.title_zh: 通过错误发现率控制可靠发现模型行为
entries.summary_zh: DISCO 把大模型行为发现表述为多重假设检验问题，并使用粗化 e-process 的迭代搜索，在温和条件下可证明控制错误发现率。与相关 eBH 方法相比，它允许待检验假设数量依赖数据，从而提高检验功效；合成实验和模型行为实测均报告在控制 FDR 的同时取得更高功效。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对从大量模型交互中筛选行为模式的研究者，错误发现率控制能减少把偶然模式误报为行为规律。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适用于探索式行为审计，尤其需要对多轮、多假设发现作统计保证时。
entries.cynic_review: 保证依赖论文列出的条件和检验设计，实际审计中假设定义仍可能主观。
entries.paper_review: 将自适应行为搜索与可证明 FDR 控制结合，兼顾可靠性和发现能力。

entries.source_title: Two technical questions: floating intellectual property and liability risks of AI agents and users in research
entries.source_excerpt: This was prompted by the recent disclosure that, in June 2026, an artificial intelligence agent developed by OpenAI autonomously hacked into Australia's Medicare system to access non-public data.
entries.title_zh: 研究智能体的两类风险：隐性信息流动与责任归属
entries.summary_zh: Pedro Freitas 提出两个问题：研究者与模型的交互是否可能造成未经知晓的信息流动，以及求解任务是否会促使智能体采用违法的信息获取手段。文章以近期数学争议及假设场景讨论保密、知识产权与责任，属于问题提出和风险观点，未证明所设想的入侵或泄露已发生。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 有助于研究团队明确保密约定、操作边界和披露内容。
entries.pragmatic_review: 应把模型工具权限和研究材料访问写清楚。
entries.cynic_review: 不能把风险假设当作已证实事件。
entries.paper_review: 可形成可审计系统与研究伦理的问题清单。

entries.source_title: Functional limit theorems for self-interacting random walks
entries.source_excerpt: We consider a wide class of nearest neighbor self-interacting random walks on $\mathbb{Z}$ and show that, under mild conditions, their scaling limits at the process level can be uniquely identified and constructed directly from the augmented joint Ray-Knight theorem for their local times, i.e., the joint convergence of rescaled local time ``curves'' of the walks stopped at certain stopping times together with the merge and absorption times of these ``curves'' to a concatenation of coalescing reflected-absorbed diffusions and their merge and absorption times. We apply our results to polynomially self-repelling walks introduced and studied in the mid-90s by B. T\'oth, and to ``true'' self-avoiding walks with bond repulsion. The first application solves a problem that has been open since T\'oth's work: it gives a construction and first properties of a new family of processes, polynomially self-repelling motions, as scaling limits of polynomially self-repelling walks. These processes were simultaneously and independently constructed from flows of correlated powers of Bessel processes by Y. Yu. The second application strengthens an earlier
entries.title_zh: 自相互作用随机游走的函数极限定理
entries.summary_zh: 论文考察整数线上一类最近邻自相互作用随机游走，利用增强联合 Ray–Knight 定理中局部时曲线及其合并、吸收时刻的联合收敛，直接构造并识别过程级缩放极限。应用包括多项式自排斥游走（构造了此前缺少的多项式自排斥运动极限）和带键排斥的真正自回避游走，并加强后者到真正自排斥运动的收敛结果。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 展示局部时几何如何反推出自相互作用路径的缩放极限，并解决一项长期悬而未决的构造问题。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合研究随机游走、局部时和扩散极限的读者。
entries.cynic_review: 结果依赖文中所设自相互作用类别及相应的局部时收敛条件。
entries.paper_review: 把增强 Ray–Knight 收敛反用为过程级极限定理工具。

entries.source_title: Connected graphs with equal independence number and radius
entries.source_excerpt: A classical theorem states that the independence number of any connected graph is at least its radius. In 2007, DeLaVi\~na, Pepper, and Waller proved that every connected graph with equal independence number and radius is traceable. We first give a new short proof of this theorem and then prove two results for graphs of higher connectivity. (1) Every 2-connected graph with equal independence number and radius is Hamiltonian. (2) Every 3-connected graph with equal independence number and radius is Hamiltonian-connected and pancyclic. Several lemmas used in the proofs are of independent interest.
entries.title_zh: 独立数等于半径的图具有更强环结构
entries.summary_zh: 既有定理保证独立数等于半径的连通图存在遍历所有顶点的路径。本文称进一步证明二连通时存在 Hamilton 环，三连通时任意端点间有 Hamilton 路且含各种长度的环，并给出旧结论的短证明。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究图连通性如何控制 Hamilton 性质。
entries.pragmatic_review: 结构引理可用于相关图类。
entries.cynic_review: 不同结论依赖不同连通度条件。
entries.paper_review: 从可迹性提升到泛圈性具有清晰层次。

entries.source_title: Using the Blackwell-Cover Guessing Strategy to Separate Unobserved Bernoulli Trials - II
entries.source_excerpt: In a prior paper, we investigated what could be said about the number in the pair that was not observed when we employed the BlackwellCover Guessing Strategy. In this paper, we generalize prior results to arbitrary distributions. We use a variant of the BlackwellCover strategy ro take pairs of coins chosen from a mixture of two different distributions G and H such that one of the coins is flipped, and as a result of that flip the unobserved (unflipped) coin is placed in one of two sets A and B. We show that, regardless of which distributions are used for G and H, there are situations in which this can be done so that the mean of the heads probabilities of the unobserved coins in A is less than the mean of the heads probabilities of the unobserved coins in B. What makes this result surprising, in addition to its generality, is a comparison with a corresponding result for marbles. entries.title_zh: 用 Blackwell–Cover 猜测策略区分未观测的 Bernoulli 试验
entries.summary_zh: 本文把此前的 Blackwell–Cover 猜测策略推广到任意两种概率分布 G、H 混合出的硬币对：观察其中一枚的投掷后，把另一枚未观察硬币分入集合 A 或 B。作者证明总存在一种设置，使 A 与 B 中未观察硬币的正面概率均值呈严格大小差异；这与已知重量弹珠的情形不同，因为硬币随机结果不会决定未观察硬币的类型。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合概率论、统计决策和不完全信息问题。
entries.pragmatic_review: Blackwell–Cover 策略通过一次观测间接分组未观测对象。
entries.cynic_review: 明确展示随机观测与确定重量信息的差别。
entries.paper_review: 摘要未列出策略构造和适用分布的细节。

entries.title_zh: 随机反对称核矩阵的谱分类
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究由独立各向同性行作用于确定性反对称 Hilbert–Schmidt 核所得到矩阵的经验奇异谱，给出谱紧性与能量尾部条件的刻画，并描述极限谱的确定性来源。对固定核，某些 resolvent 或对数行列式收敛与临界 Weyl 定律等价，极限为可能退化的半 Cauchy 分布；结论依赖均匀二次型方差等假设。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 随机矩阵、自由概率与随机面积谱研究者可关注这一分类框架。
entries.pragmatic_review: 高度理论化，主要适用于谱极限与自由概率研究。
entries.cynic_review: 紧性条件和极限律结构明确，但技术假设较强。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出多种等价刻画和极限分布，证明细节复杂。

entries.source_title: Recommendations on the use of AI for PhD students and supervisors
entries.source_excerpt: We provide a proposed set of guidelines for PhD students and their supervisors. Given that PhD students are the most affected, both professionally and psychologically, by the advent of AI in mathematics, such guidelines, even if they may soon be obsolete, could be useful to them, their advisors and graduate schools.
entries.title_zh: 关于博士生与导师使用 AI 的建议
entries.summary_zh: 一组辛几何研究者提出面向数学博士生、导师和研究生院的 AI 使用指南，核心立场是把 AI 作为数学家的工具，同时由数学家决定重要问题，并保留判断结果是否有趣的责任。作者强调博士生在职业和心理上受到 AI 变化的影响尤甚，也说明指南是帮助学生与机构应对变化的实用建议，不试图统一 AI 风险立场；具体做法应结合机构政策与研究任务调整。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合博士生和导师讨论研究诚信、训练目标与 AI 辅助边界，可作为共同制定组内规范的起点。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把选题和成果价值判断留给研究者，有助于保持训练责任。
entries.cynic_review: 建议可能随工具快速变化，且不同机构政策不一。
entries.paper_review: 这是研究者集体提出的规范建议，不是效果评估研究。

entries.source_title: On the pure part of the cohomology of character varieties
entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Olivier Schiffmann , Eric Vasserot; Subjects: Algebraic Geometry (math.AG) ; Representation Theory (math.RT); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: 特征簇模空间上同调的纯部分
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明 Hausel–Rodriguez-Villegas 关于 GL(r) 扭曲特征簇模空间纯上同调部分的猜想，将其分次维数与一顶点、g 个环的 quiver variety 联系，并给出由对应 Kac 多项式表达的混合 Hodge 多项式纯部分公式。证明借助 P=W、Higgs 丛栈的 P=C 结果、BPS Lie 代数及解析邻域定理，把问题化为特定上同调比较。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 解决特征簇模空间纯上同调猜想，并导出显式多项式公式。
entries.pragmatic_review: 几何表示论和 Higgs 丛研究者可关注其工具链与公式。
entries.cynic_review: 结论依赖多项深层结构定理，适用设置较专门。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确报告猜想证明、公式和关键理论桥梁。

entries.source_title: SliMOO: Interpretable Multi-Objective Evolutionary Search for LLM Depth Pruning
entries.source_excerpt: As large language models (LLMs) grow more powerful, their scale makes them costly to serve. Depth pruning offers a practical route to efficiency by directly reducing memory and latency without hardware-specific support. However, we observe that transformer layers exhibit markedly different task-dependent layer contributions, whereas existing depth-pruning methods ignore this heterogeneity and thus tend to optimize for a narrow domain or benchmark rather than preserve broad capability. This suggests that LLM depth pruning should be formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem rather than a single-score ranking problem. We propose SliMOO, an interpretable multi-objective evolutionary search framework for LLM depth pruning. SliMOO first uses single-layer removal probing to construct a task-layer importance map, which provides an interpretable view of task-shared and task-specific layers and serves as a search prior. entries.title_zh: SliMOO：可解释多目标进化搜索剪枝语言模型深度
entries.summary_zh: 深度剪枝可减少大模型服务内存和延迟，但不同 Transformer 层对不同任务贡献不一，单一分数排名容易牺牲宽泛能力。SliMOO 将剪枝表述为多目标优化，采用可解释的进化搜索在压缩、任务保持等目标间探索层组合，避免只针对窄领域优化；实际效益需按模型与任务权重评估。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把层贡献异质性显式纳入多目标剪枝搜索，并提供可解释的候选权衡。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于按业务能力目标定制模型深度和推理成本。
entries.cynic_review: 进化搜索成本、目标设定和能力评估基准会影响最终方案。
entries.paper_review: 面向层贡献异质性设计多目标而非单指标剪枝框架。

entries.source_title: AI and Mathematics: Public Good, Credit, and Education
entries.source_excerpt: We should preserve the human ability to understand and explore mathematics, not preserve unsolved problems merely to protect a familiar way of working. The goal should be to enlarge public mathematical knowledge and understanding, whether the discoveries are made by humans, AI, or a collaboration between them. I also discuss competition, credit for AI contributions, and why restrictions on AI in education raise different questions from restrictions on research.
entries.title_zh: AI 与数学：公共利益、贡献认可和教育
entries.summary_zh: András Juhász 主张从数学作为公共知识的价值审视 AI 辅助发现，质疑仅为保留研究过程而排除 AI 的立场。文章认为可检查、可读的证明仍可促进理解，同时把研究者处境、署名和教育列为需要讨论的问题；这些是规范性观点，不能把文中能力判断视为独立评测。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 比较数学发现的公共价值与职业、教育目标如何协调。
entries.pragmatic_review: 有助于制定团队使用 AI 的讨论框架。
entries.cynic_review: 医疗或交通类比不能直接解决数学教育问题。
entries.paper_review: 适合辨析解题、建理论与理解的不同目标。

entries.source_title: High-order IMEX local discontinuous Galerkin methods with sparse grids for high-dimensional nonlinear parabolic PDEs
entries.source_excerpt: In this work, we develop a high-order IMEX-LDG scheme on sparse grids for solving nonlinear parabolic PDEs in moderate to high dimensions. The method combines the advantages of LDG methods for convection--diffusion problems, IMEX-RK time integrators for stiff systems, and sparse-grid techniques to mitigate the curse of dimensionality. The resulting scheme is fully parallelized in MPI, is robust, efficient, and scalable, making it suitable for a wide range of applications involving high-dimensional nonlinear parabolic PDEs.
entries.title_zh: 稀疏网格上的高阶 IMEX 局部间断 Galerkin 方法

entries.source_title: Derived equivalences and isogenies of supersingular abelian varieties
entries.source_excerpt: We study (twisted) Fourier-Mukai partners of supersingular abelian varieties. We give a simple proof that any two supersingular abelian varieties of the same dimension at least two are derived isogenous, answering a question raised by Li, Lu, and Tang and generalizing the result of Li and Zou. Moreover, in every dimension greater than two, we construct derived-equivalent supersingular abelian varieties whose corresponding positive powers are never isomorphic. We also give conditions under which derived equivalence between two supersingular principally polarized abelian varieties implies that their underlying abelian varieties are isomorphic. In particular, this implication holds in dimensions at most three.
entries.title_zh: 超奇异阿贝尔簇的导出等价与等源
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究超奇异阿贝尔簇的（扭曲）Fourier–Mukai 伙伴，证明维数至少为 2 的任意两个同维超奇异阿贝尔簇均导出等源，回答既有问题并推广前人成果。维数大于 2 时构造导出等价但任意对应正次幂都不同构的例子；此外给出主极化情形下导出等价可推出底层簇同构的条件，特别在维数不超过 3 时成立。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数几何读者理解导出范畴等价与几何同构之间的差异。
entries.pragmatic_review: 给出广泛等源结论并构造清楚区分导出等价与同构的例子。
entries.cynic_review: 结论涉及超奇异特征及维数条件，不能直接推广一般阿贝尔簇。
entries.paper_review: 摘要提供多条按维数区分的精确结论。

entries.source_title: Nonvanishing implies abundance
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that the nonvanishing conjecture implies the abundance conjecture.
entries.title_zh: 非消失猜想蕴含丰沛猜想
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明代数几何中的非消失猜想若成立，则丰沛猜想成立。摘要未陈述具体维数、对象类别或相对版本，因此可确认的是两个猜想间的逻辑蕴含，而非丰沛猜想本身无条件已证。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 有助于理解极小模型纲领中不同核心猜想的依赖关系。
entries.pragmatic_review: 阅读时需把“若 A，则 B”与 A 或 B 已解决区分开。
entries.cynic_review: 结论简洁，揭示猜想体系中的条件链。
entries.paper_review: 这是条件性推论，非消失猜想仍是前提。

entries.source_title: From a finite subgroup of $SO(3)$:$C_2$ leads to a Holant dichotomy
entries.source_excerpt: Counting complexity within the Holant framework has been extensively studied through complexity dichotomy theorems. While substantial progress has been achieved for various restricted settings, the general complex-valued even-arity case without auxiliary unary signatures remains largely open. This paper studies a fundamental case in this program where the binary signatures induce a group structure satisfying \(M(B(\mathcal{F}))\cong C_2\). It is observed that projective equivalence classes of binary signature matrices naturally embed into finite subgroups of \(SO(3)\), providing an algebraic viewpoint for structural classification. This paper further identifies two fundamentally different regimes for the \(C_2\) case, namely the normal and isotropic cases, and analyzes their complexity behavior separately. entries.title_zh: 从 SO(3) 有限子群出发：C₂ 情形的 Holant 复杂性二分
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究二元签名诱导群结构为 C₂ 的 Holant 计数问题，利用二元签名矩阵在 SO(3) 有限子群中的代数结构区分 normal 与 isotropic 两类。作者结合 gadget、分解、插值和实数化方法证明完整二分定理：每个满足条件的偶数元签名集对应问题要么多项式时间可解，要么 #P-hard。

entries.source_title: Contrastive local learning in large nonlinear analog circuits
entries.source_excerpt: Machine learning in physical hardware promises to reduce training cost by colocating computation, memory and adaptation within device physics. Contrastive local learning networks (CLLNs) offer a compelling route: an electrical circuit relaxes to equilibrium in free and weakly clamped states, and each adaptive element updates from local voltage contrasts rather than backpropagated error signals. Yet whether nonlinear transistor implementations can scale beyond proof-of-concept circuits, and what design principles control that scaling, have remained unknown. Here we show that nonlinear analog circuits trained by contrastive local rules can learn larger machine-learning tasks and remain robust under hardware nonidealities. Using device-level circuit simulations, we systematically explore initialization, operating regime, loss-dependent clamping and training parameters, and scale CLLNs beyond ten thousand adaptive edges. entries.source_title: Annihilation versus anchoring of a topologically charged pair on a perforated two-dimensional surface
entries.source_excerpt: Two independent random walks of opposite topological charge move on the discrete torus $(\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^2$, which contains $k$ well-separated holes. The walks annihilate when they come within a core distance of each other, and each walk is anchored when it first touches a hole. We prove that the probability of annihilation before anchoring converges to $w_0/(w_0+\sum_j w_j)$, where the weights are explicit and depend only logarithmically on the sizes of the core and of the holes; for point-like core and holes, the limit is $1/(1+k)$. We then prove a fate theorem: the pair either terminates or ends as two opposite charges anchored on two different holes, with probability $(k-1)/(k+1)$ in the point-like case, and the hosting pair $\{j,l\}$ is chosen with probability proportional to $w_jw_l$. The proof combines an abstract competition lemma for rare sets in reversible Markov chains with sharp two-dimensional Green's function estimates.

entries.source_title: Finite Symplectic Automorphisms of Hyperk\"ahler Manifolds of $K3^{[n]}$-Type Act Trivially on Discriminant Groups

entries.source_title: ReMaRL: Learning to Unmask and Remask in Frozen Diffusion Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: Masked diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, and the order in which tokens are unmasked affects final-answer accuracy. Several methods learn unmasking policies from task rewards, but these policies cannot remask earlier predictions. Remasking lets the model correct those predictions using newly generated context. Heuristic rules guide both unmasking and remasking, while supervised remaskers learn to detect token errors. Neither approach directly optimizes these decisions for final-answer correctness. To address this gap, we introduce ReMaRL (Remasking with Reinforcement Learning), a lightweight policy that learns which tokens to unmask, retain, or remask. We train this roughly 0.3M-parameter policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) from final-answer rewards while keeping the diffusion model frozen. With LLaDA-8B-Instruct, ReMaRL achieves the highest scores among the compared unmasking and remasking policies within the tested inference budgets of 4-32 model calls on math and 8-16 calls on code.
entries.title_zh: ReMaRL：训练冻结扩散语言模型重新遮蔽与解遮蔽

entries.title_zh: Mullins–Sekerka 流的参数化对称 Galerkin 边界元收敛性
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明平面闭曲线两相 Mullins–Sekerka 流的全离散参数化方案收敛，方案结合分段线性曲线、曲率离散和对称 Galerkin 边界元近似 Dirichlet-to-Neumann 映射。在光滑解满足容量条件、边界积分精确且网格 h≤c₀τ² 时，离散曲线保持正则嵌入，并在弧长重参数化后的 W¹,∞ 距离上以时间步长一阶逼近真解。

entries.source_title: BernBRS: Certified Backward Reachability for Deep Bernstein Neural Networks
entries.source_excerpt: Ensuring the safety of complex neural network systems requires mathematically rigorous verification. While backward reachability analysis is a critical tool for identifying safe initial states, computing tight, formal bounds remains notoriously difficult to scale. Recent advancements have demonstrated that DeepBern-Nets neural networks utilizing Bernstein polynomial activation functions possess advantageous mathematical properties that enable exceptionally fast and tight forward reachability analysis. Building upon this efficiency, this paper introduces BernBRS, a highly accurate and scalable framework for the backward reachability analysis of DeepBern-Nets. BernBRS simultaneously computes certified inner and outer approximations of the Backward Reachable Set (BRS). Rather than relying on single convex bounding, our method intelligently refines a cover of the input space by analyzing activation patterns, splitting the input domain precisely where an exact decomposition of the relaxation gap predicts the most significant reduction in error. entries.title_zh: BernBRS：用 Bernstein 深度网络认证反向可达集

entries.source_title: Think More or Read More? A Token-Budget Theory of Reasoning with Shared Context
entries.source_excerpt: Reasoning systems increasingly improve answers by incorporating additional context into the model's input, from multi-agent debate, where agents read their peers' responses, to self-refinement, where a model revisits its own drafts. In these systems, communication consumes context as one agent's output becomes another's input. We study the regime where token reading and generation draw on one fixed token window, so every token spent reading is a token that cannot be spent reasoning. We develop a \textbf{token-budget theory} that formalizes this trade-off, modeling accuracy as a function of the reasoning budget remaining after reading and aggregating votes with a Condorcet jury model that permits correlated errors. For multi-agent debate, the theory gives a closed-form prediction for the optimal number of agents. This quantity is estimated from single-agent measurements, allowing the optimal group size to be determined without running debate, and the same accounting extends to a heterogeneous set of different models. entries.source_title: Margin Certificates for Voting Classifiers under Mixing Dependence
entries.source_excerpt: Margin bounds explain why weighted votes generalize after training error vanishes, but dependent observations require concentration arguments that keep the dependence model and failure budget explicit. We study stationary mixing streams without treating dependence as a formal substitution of an "effective sample size." For a finite base class, we combine independent-block Rademacher theory for stationary $\beta$-mixing processes with a clipped margin loss to obtain an explicit uniform voting-margin certificate, whose dependence penalty is set by the number of approximately independent blocks and the coupling budget $4(\mu-1)\beta(a)$. A black-box transfer theorem shows that any i.i.d. voting-margin guarantee remains valid on a regularly spaced subsequence, with only an additive $\beta$-mixing failure probability. For votes fixed independently of a stationary finite-state reversible Markov stream, spectral concentration gives the cleaner $\sqrt{t_{rel}/n}$ rate, and a sticky-refresh construction shows this exponent is unavoidable. entries.source_title: Normal approximation and self-normalized moderate deviations for the minimal random walk with random step sizes
entries.source_excerpt: We study the minimal random walk with independent positive random step sizes. By separating the movement count from the centered step-size noise, we obtain normal approximations and self-normalized Cram\'er-type moderate deviations under finite-moment assumptions. For the noise, conditioning on the movement count yields Kolmogorov, Wasserstein and Zolotarev bounds. A polynomial moderate-deviation range holds when a recalled stop can lead to movement. At the boundary where this probability is zero, we obtain a logarithmic range and construct a bounded nonsymmetric example excluding a general polynomial range. For the full position, a weighted martingale representation gives limit laws in the different regimes, nonuniform normal approximations and moment-distance bounds without logarithmic losses. Variance concentration also yields self-normalized moderate deviations in the diffusive and critical regimes.

entries.source_title: On various notions of universally Baire sets and reflection of non-Baire property in Cantor sets
entries.source_excerpt: Universally Baire sets are a standard tool in modern set theory, where they are closely connected with forcing and absoluteness. In this paper we study universal Baireness instead as purely a regularity notion for subsets of Polish spaces. Our aim is not to develop the set-theoretic theory, but to place the notion on a systematic descriptive-set-theoretic footing and to clarify the several nonequivalent definitions that occur in the literature. A subset of a Polish space is called \emph{universally Baire} if all its continuous preimages possess the property of Baire. However, it is important to specify what the domain of these continuous functions can be. entries.source_title: The totient bound and extremal gaps in cyclotomic polynomials
entries.source_excerpt: Let $m>1$ be odd and squarefree, and let $p\nmid m$ be prime. If $p m$, the maximum gap has length $\varphi(m)$ and occurs exactly $2\lfloor p/m\rfloor$ times. We determine its positions and endpoint coefficients. These results prove the equality criterion of Ambrosino, Hong and Lee and the multiplicity formula of Zhang. We also treat repeated prime factors, even cofactors and extremal zero runs in periodic coefficient blocks.

entries.source_title: Energy-constrained Brownian motion
entries.source_excerpt: For reflected Brownian motion in an interval of length $N$, we consider the first time at which the length of time since the most recent visit to the boundary reaches $M$; this random `lifetime' comes from the interpretation in which the Brownian motion has a finite energy capacity $M$, uses energy at unit rate in the interior, and gets its energy replenished up to $M$ on every visit to the boundary. We prove distributional asymptotics for the lifetime in three different regimes depending on the relative growth of $N$ and $M$; these one-dimensional results parallel results in the random walk case by Wade and Grinfeld. We also present some initial results on the multidimensional version of the problem, for one scaling regime in the case of a ball, and conjectures on the behaviour in general domains.

entries.source_title: Self-Interpretations and Kraj\'{\i}{\v{c}}ek-Theories
entries.source_excerpt: We study self-interpretations of theories and their connection to Kraj\'{\i}\v{c}ek-theories. Our two main results are the following. Firstly, if the self-interpretations of a theory form a group in the category ${\sf INT}_3$ of theories and interpretations, then the theory is a Kraj\'{\i}\v{c}ek-theory. Secondly, a sequential theory is a Kraj\'{\i}\v{c}ek-theory iff all its self-interpretations are initial. Here initiality of the interpretation $K$ means roughly that its internal interpretations of the weak theory ${\sf S}^1_2$ are initial in all interpretations of ${\sf S}^1_2$.

entries.source_title: One Teacher, Many Views: Reducing Reference Sensitivity in On-Policy Self-Distillation
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a model on its own trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a privileged copy conditioned on a reference solution. Existing methods typically use a single teacher distribution conditioned on the complete reference. We identify a limitation of this formulation: a reference is only one realization of the reasoning process. Although it provides evidence about the answer, it also encodes an ordering, phrasing, and solution path. Full-reference conditioning can therefore produce correct targets that depend excessively on information unavailable to the student at inference. We show that replacing one valid reference with another, while holding the problem and student state fixed, can substantially alter the teacher distribution, a phenomenon we call reference-induced target instability. entries.source_title: Computing with Orientation-Dependent Vector Fields in Crystallographic Texture Analysis
entries.source_excerpt: We present a computational framework for representing orientation-dependent vector fields. Building on (arXiv:2608.21235), we translate the differential-geometric formulation into crystallographic notation and focus on its computational use in crystallographic texture analysis. In crystallographic applications, small orientation changes are commonly described by rotation vectors, spin tensors, or infinitesimal misorientations. By contrast, vector fields in harmonic computations are usually represented by components with respect to Euler-angle derivatives, following the classical formulation of generalized spherical harmonics. This representation is convenient but numerically unfavorable. We instead use rotation-vector components, extending a familiar description of individual orientation changes to orientation-dependent vector fields. In this representation, vector fields are described by three scalar component functions, which can be expanded into generalized spherical harmonics. entries.source_title: The geometry of neural network decision boundaries
entries.source_excerpt: Artificial neural networks (ANNs) are built using well-understood mathematical operations, yet their complex nature poses significant challenges to intuitively understanding their decision-making processes. This work introduces a method for visualizing and measuring ANN decision boundary geometry directly in the high-dimensional input space, avoiding distortions found with traditional projection-based techniques. We analyze boundary curvatures and distances in diverse inputs, architectures, and training methods. Boundary distances grow smoothly and slowly with consistent curvature as the size of the subspace increases, suggesting that decision boundaries are close to input samples within large, continuous subspaces. We also quantify how much boundary distances and curvatures reduce near dataset samples after adversarial training. Training methodology has a significantly stronger impact on boundary distance and curvature than architecture or test-set accuracy. entries.source_title: The Conic Tverberg plus minus
entries.source_excerpt: We prove a Tverberg type theorems: Given a set $A\subset \mathbb{R}^d$ and an affine subspaces $L_1,...,L_m\subset \mathbb{R}^d$. In some conditions there is a partition $A_1, ..., A_m, B_1, ..., B_m$ of $A$ such that the sets $L_i\cup A_i\cup B_i$ for $i=1,...,m$ have common barycentre with negative masses in $B_i$ and positive masses in $A_i$. The case $B_1=...=B_m=L_1=...=L_m=\varnothing$ is Tverberg's classical theorem. The case $L_1=...=L_m=\varnothing$ gives a partial answer to the question of Barany-Soberon about the possible number of negative masses.

entries.source_title: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
entries.source_excerpt: Enhancing the agentic capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex software engineering (SWE) and general terminal-usage problems is a pressing challenge. Current state-of-the-art LLMs often go through large-scale agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, they mostly rely on high-level outcome rewards, with minimal consideration of low-level toolcall and mid-level workflow-stage rewards, which makes the training less effective. To overcome this limitation, we propose **Lean4AgenticRL**, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first framework that grounds multi-level process rewards in the unified Lean4 formalization schema for open-ended agentic RL. **Lean4AgenticRL** first builds a *problem-specific workflow* system that balances the agent's own capability and controllability during execution, laying the foundation for further verification. Subsequently, our workflow formalization and multi-level reward annotation methods enable agent behavior verification within a general harness system. It provides multi-level rewards to support more effective agentic RL with the workflow-stage-normalized GRPO algorithm. U
entries.title_zh: Lean4AgenticRL：用可验证多层过程奖励推进智能体强化学习

entries.source_title: Projective surfaces with infinite fundamental group and trivial profinite completion
entries.source_excerpt: For every nontrivial finite abelian group \(A\) of odd order, we construct a smooth complex projective surface with infinite topological fundamental group and trivial \'{e}tale fundamental group. The isomorphism types of its finite subgroups are precisely those of the subgroups of \(A\). The surface is Kobayashi hyperbolic and has Stein universal cover.

entries.source_title: On non-isomorphic universal sofic groups
entries.source_excerpt: We show that there are $2^{\aleph_0}$ non-isomorphic universal sofic groups. This proves a conjecture of Simon Thomas.

entries.source_title: Isolating Perception for Multi-View Planning under Occlusion-Induced Partial Observability
entries.source_excerpt: Vision-language models (VLMs) are beginning to saturate visual planning benchmarks, yet they fail to resolve depth ambiguity and degrade sharply with problem size under occlusion-induced partial observability (PO). We introduce BW-PO based on the Blocksworld domain, a controlled benchmark that reduces existing VLM planners and formalizers to near-zero performance, and propose VLM-as-perceiver, a paradigm that narrows the VLM's role to local perception while delegating cross-view evidence reconciliation and plan generation to external solvers. Across model-specific challenging subsets of BW-PO, this raises plan success from 1% to 97% for Gemma-4-31B, 0% to 95% for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 3% to 84% for Gemini-3.1-Pro. Isolating perception in this way separates two bottlenecks that are otherwise entangled: reconciliation under depth ambiguity, and completeness of visual extraction under scene density.
entries.title_zh: 在遮挡导致部分可观测时分离多视角规划中的感知与推理
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出 Blocksworld 遮挡基准 BW-PO，并指出视觉规划中把感知、跨视角证据整合和规划全部交给 VLM 会在深度歧义和规模增大时失效。新范式让 VLM 只负责局部感知，由外部求解器整合视角并生成计划；在作者构造的困难子集上，Gemma、Qwen 和 Gemini 的成功率分别从 1%、0%、3% 提高到 97%、95%、84%，属于特定受控基准结果。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 通过拆分感知与规划职责，大幅改善遮挡场景下的受控任务表现。
entries.pragmatic_review: 复杂视觉代理可把模型输出限制为结构化局部观察再交给验证器。
entries.cynic_review: 极高增幅来自专门构造的 Blocksworld 子集，迁移到现实场景仍未知。
entries.paper_review: 基准诊断和角色分工设计清楚，并跨多个模型比较。

entries.source_title: Vanishing bond-percolation threshold implies vanishing contact-process threshold
entries.source_excerpt: We show that for any infinite, locally finite and connected graph $G$ and $p\in(0,1/2]$ the survival probability of the contact process with infection rate $\lambda\ge20p$ is at least $3/4$ times the bond percolation probability with retention probability $p$. In particular, $\lambda_c(G)\le20\,p_c(G)$ whenever $p_c(G)<1/2$, and $p_c(G)=0$ implies $\lambda_c(G)=0$. The proof uses a submartingale built from percolation clusters on finite balls. We contrast this with the SIR epidemic, in which every vertex is infected at most once, and for which there are graphs with $p_c(G)=0$ on which the SIR epidemic dies out almost surely for every infection rate.
entries.title_zh: 键渗流阈值为零蕴含接触过程阈值为零
entries.summary_zh: 对任意无限、局部有限、连通图及 p≤1/2，文章证明感染率 λ≥20p 时接触过程的存活概率至少为相同参数键渗流概率的 3/4。于是当临界渗流概率 p_c<1/2 时有 λ_c≤20p_c，特别地 p_c=0 会推出接触过程临界值 λ_c=0；证明使用由渗流构造导出的次鞅。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 定量连接静态渗流与动态感染过程，给出临界阈值之间可直接使用的比较。
entries.pragmatic_review: 该不等式为在一般图上由渗流信息推断接触过程存活提供工具。
entries.cynic_review: 常数 20 可能并非最优，且关键比较限于 p≤1/2。
entries.paper_review: 在广泛图类上建立静态与动态相变的定量联系，推论直观有力。

entries.source_title: Non-vanishing of central values of angular Hecke $L$-functions
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we evaluate asymptotically the first and second moment of central values of the family of Hecke $L$-functions associated to angular characters over imaginary quadratic number fields of class number one. We use our results to deduce a non-vanishing result concerning these $L$-functions.

entries.source_title: HOL in HOL: mechanized soundness, completeness and consistency, with and without infinity
entries.source_excerpt: What can a logic certify about a copy of itself? For Church's simple theory of types, formalized as a deep embedding in Isabelle/HOL with Henkin semantics and a natural-deduction calculus, the answer has two tiers. On the first tier, plain Isabelle/HOL certifies the logic without an axiom of infinity, by a standard model with one individual. On the second tier, the logic with a Dedekind-style axiom of infinity is certified only in Isabelle/HOL extended by a large enough set-theoretic universe. Both tiers appear in Harrison's self-verification of HOL Light. What the present formalization adds is Henkin completeness, and with it a semantics that matches the calculus exactly, compactness and model existence on the first tier, and the boundary between the tiers. Comparing two ways of adding infinity to the object logic shows where the boundary lies. One is an infinite domain of individuals, expressed by the first-order sentences "there are at least $n$ individuals", each of which has a finite model; the other is the Dedekind axiom, a single sentence with no finite model, and there the first tier ends. entries.title_zh: HOL in HOL：机械化验证逻辑的可靠性、完备性与一致性
entries.summary_zh: 论文在 Isabelle/HOL 中深嵌入 Church 简单类型理论及 Henkin 语义，机械化验证可靠性、完备性和一致性，并区分两种“无穷”公理的证明层级。没有 Dedekind 无穷公理时可在 Isabelle/HOL 本身用单元素个体域建模；加入该公理则需要更强的集合论宇宙假设，结果还包括紧致性与模型存在性。

entries.source_title: On the $\mathbb{F}_q$-linear relations among multiple zeta values in positive characteristic
entries.source_excerpt: This paper gives a new path to determine all $\mathbb{F}_q$-linear relations among multiple zeta values in positive characteristic, which had been done by Huang, Lai, Li and the author. The path used in this paper is based on the idea of operator generation, which originated from the work of Todd, developed by the author, and independently by Im-Kim-Ngo Dac.
entries.title_zh: 正特征中多重 ζ 值的 Fq 线性关系
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出一种通过算子生成方法确定正特征下多重 ζ 值 Fq-线性关系的新路径，并说明该思路承接既有相关工作。摘要未声称发现一组新的关系或给出具体公式，因此更适合视为对已研究关系的结构化证明方法，而非新的完全分类结论。

entries.cynic_review: 摘要说的是新路径，不能误读成新发现全部关系。
entries.paper_review: 可见材料较简略，具体新增内容需与先前结果比较。

entries.source_title: On the Fragility of Tasks under Composition: Implicit Budgeting in Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: Modern language models are increasingly asked to handle several tasks within a single prompt. Doing so requires solving each task correctly while integrating the resulting answers into a coherent response. In this paper, we identify a fundamental limitation in this process, where models make substantially more errors when tasks are composed, even when they can solve every constituent task reliably in isolation. This degradation cannot be fully explained by the accumulation of independent errors. Across both open-weight models and the frontier model Claude Opus 5, our findings instead point to an implicit thinking budget underlying this effect. In particular, under composition, models use substantially fewer tokens per task than in isolation, even when the full sequence remains well within the context window. Tasks that require longer solution traces in isolation are consequently more $\textit{fragile}$ under composition, i.e., models make more errors on prompts containing these tasks. entries.title_zh: 任务组合下的脆弱性：语言模型的隐式预算

entries.source_title: Uniformity of the minimal exponent on the GIT boundary of projective hypersurfaces
entries.source_excerpt: Let $X$ be a non-stable (in the sense of GIT) hypersurface of degree $d \ge 3$ in the projective space $\mathbb{P}^{n}$. S. G. Park proved that the global minimal exponent of $X$ satisfies the inequality $\widetilde{\alpha}(X) \le \frac{n+1}{d}$. In this paper, we establish the uniform sharpness of this inequality: we prove that $\widetilde{\alpha}(X) = \frac{n+1}{d}$ holds for a general member $X$ of every irreducible component of the strictly semistable locus. Moreover, a general point of each irreducible component of the GIT boundary $\partial M^{\mathrm{GIT}}$ admits a strictly semistable zero-weight representative with this minimal exponent. By the lower semicontinuity of the minimal exponent on the affine cone and a theorem of Musta\c{t}\u{a}--Popa for general linear combinations of monomials, the problem is reduced to computing the log canonical thresholds, at the cone vertex, of the monomial ideals associated with the maximal strictly semistable supports with respect to a maximal torus and their weight-zero parts. entries.source_title: Finite speed Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac processes and their applications in generative modeling
entries.source_excerpt: We study the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac (OU-K) process, where instead of a Brownian motion, a finite-speed Kac process defines the driving process. The OU-K process can be analyzed through a rescaled, time-inhomogeneous Kac process, characterized by a switching rate from the Kac part, and a convergence rate from the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) part. The law of this inhomogeneous Kac process describes the solution of a wave equation, the Euler-Poisson-Darboux (EPD) equation. For Kac switching rates being multiples of the OU convergence rate, we can explicitly derive this EPD solution via the sum of (the derivative of) two Legendre polynomials, restricted between two Dirac points representing the wave fronts. Using the framework of piecewise-deterministic Markov processes (PDMP), we describe the conditional velocity fields of the OU-K process via our polynomial-law-formula. This allows us to apply the OU-K process in a generative flow model. Since the OU-K velocity fields prove to be bounded by the finite Kac speed, the usual time truncations of diffusion models become unnecessary. entries.source_title: An explicit elementary proof of no Landau--Siegel zeros
entries.source_excerpt: We give an elementary proof of the absence of Landau--Siegel zeros with the explicit constant $c=1/100$. For every primitive quadratic Dirichlet character $\chi$ of conductor $q\ge3$, each real zero $\beta\in(0,1)$ of $L(s,\chi)$ satisfies $(1-\beta)\log q>c$. The proof combines integer coefficient counting, polynomial congruences, a paired-tail hyperbola estimate, and a logarithmically weighted comparison of positive sums. All required constants are explicit, and one choice of parameters covers every conductor. The argument uses elementary arithmetic and real summation and integration, without separate zero computations for small conductors.

entries.source_title: Norm-Euclideanity in cyclic fields
entries.source_excerpt: Consider a cyclic number field of prime degree $p$. For a fixed degree, there are only finitely many such fields which are norm-Euclidean. When $p=2$ or $3$, these have been completely determined. If instead $p>3$, one can bound the discriminant of such fields from above. We substantially sharpen these upper bounds via an explicit Burgess-type criterion and describe a method for completely resolving other small prime cases.

entries.source_title: A positivity conjecture of Prellberg and Stanton
entries.source_excerpt: We prove the conjecture of Prellberg and Stanton (2003) that $\frac{1-q}{(q^n;q)_m}\genfrac{[}{]}{0pt}{}{n}{m}_{q}$ has nonnegative power-series coefficients for $0 <n$, except when $n$ is even and $m\in\{2,n-2\}$. We obtain a polynomial version by bounding a M\"obius correction by first differences of Gaussian coefficients. The proof uses partitions and quadratic and cubic semi-invariants of binary forms. An extension of this bound proves the Reiner--Stanton--White conjecture on positivity of orbit polynomials for flags of subspaces.

entries.source_title: automodel: A Skill for Agentic Model Discovery
entries.source_excerpt: The search for better models, whether expressed as analytical equations or neural architectures, has increasingly shifted from manual design toward data-driven automation. While a multitude of algorithms exist, ranging from exhaustive search to AlphaEvolve, recent advances in general-purpose coding agents such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex raise the question: could providing such systems with a "model discovery recipe" be enough to discover or improve models? We present automodel, an agent skill for general model discovery. With case studies in astrophysics, cardiovascular dynamics, precision agriculture, traffic flow, and vehicle tire dynamics, we show how commercial agents equipped with automodel can successfully identify novel and scientifically-relevant models. Our findings suggest that encoding model-discovery methodology as a portable agent skill can provide a simple, interactive, powerful and broadly applicable alternative to domain-specific automated discovery pipelines. The skill is available at: https://github.com/unlayer-ai/automodel.

entries.source_title: Affine extensions and central compression for product-one-free sequences

entries.source_title: Generic vanishing for Dolbeault cohomology of mixed Hodge modules on abelian varieties
entries.source_excerpt: We study generic vanishing for the Dolbeault cohomology of mixed Hodge modules, where the differentials in the Dolbeault complex are modified by a one-form. We prove that, on the Dolbeault moduli space of Higgs line bundles, the cohomology support loci of mixed Hodge modules agree with the images of the cohomology support loci of their underlying $\mathscr{D}$-modules on the de Rham moduli space under the map induced by the nonabelian Hodge correspondence. We further apply this result to study Fourier-Mukai transforms of mixed Hodge modules on abelian varieties. We show that the extended Fourier-Mukai transform for bounded complexes of mixed Hodge modules has cohomology sheaves that are flat over the twistor line of $\lambda$-connections. This also gives an extension of Fourier transform of mixed Hodge modules to a compactification of the de Rham moduli space.
entries.title_zh: 阿贝尔簇上混合 Hodge 模的 Dolbeault 上同调一般消失
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究混合 Hodge 模的 Dolbeault 复形在一形式扰动后的上同调支撑集，并证明：在 Higgs 线丛的 Dolbeault 模空间中，这些支撑集等于其底层 D-模在 de Rham 模空间支撑集经非阿贝尔 Hodge 对应映射后的像。作者进一步研究阿贝尔簇上的 Fourier–Mukai 变换，证明有界复混合 Hodge 模的扩展变换具有沿 λ-连接 twistor 直线平坦的上同调层，并由此把 Fourier 变换扩展到 de Rham 模空间的紧化。

entries.source_title: Rational lines on pairs of quadrics and cubic hypersurfaces
entries.source_excerpt: We study rational lines on smooth intersections of two quadrics and on smooth cubic hypersurfaces over number fields. For an intersection of two quadrics in $n$ variables, we prove the Hasse principle and weak approximation for the variety of lines when $n\geq 11$, and more generally for the variety of $r$-planes when $n\geq 3r+8$. In this range an $r$-plane exists over the ground field if and only if one exists over every real completion. For the variety of lines, we also prove the Hasse principle and weak approximation when $n\geq 8$, conditional on the finiteness of certain Tate-Shafarevich groups. For a smooth cubic hypersurface in $n$ variables, we prove that a line exists over the ground field when $n\geq 23$.
entries.title_zh: 二次型交截与三次超曲面上的有理直线
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究数域上两个光滑二次型交截及光滑三次超曲面中的有理直线与高维线性子空间。在变量数至少 11 时，作者证明二次型交截的直线簇满足 Hasse 原理和弱逼近，并推广到变量数至少 3r+8 的 r 平面；变量数至少 23 时，光滑三次超曲面上存在定义在底域上的直线。部分较低维结论依赖 Tate–Shafarevich 群有限性。

entries.source_title: Denominators of Hodge integrals and Minkowski numbers
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that the least common denominator of all genus $g$ Hodge integrals is the Minkowski number $T_{2g}$ or, equivalently, the Bhargava factorial $(2g+1)!_{\mathbb{P}}$ associated to the set of primes $\mathbb{P}\subset\mathbb{N}$. As a corollary, we prove a conjecture of Liu-Xu on the multiplicity of $3$ in the least common denominators of certain descendant integrals, and generalise their result on a conjecture of Itzykson-Zuber to Hodge integrals with $\lambda$ classes. Namely, the order of the automorphism group of any pointed stable curve of genus $g'\le g$ divides the least common denominator of all genus $g$ Hodge integrals. We also comment on the use of generative AI via IMProofBench, which played a fruitful part in the development of this (entirely human-written) paper.

entries.source_title: Modeling fluid--solid interaction in three-dimensional granular systems: Two-way coupling of SPH and LS-DEM
entries.source_excerpt: This paper presents a two-way coupled fluid--solid interaction framework for granular systems based on the level-set discrete element method (LS-DEM) and smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH). The proposed method is mesh-free, fully Lagrangian, and equipped with a seamless description of arbitrary solid shapes. In particular, a level-set representation of grain geometry is used for both contact detection and fluid--solid coupling, allowing for realistic, highly irregular grains to be handled within a unified computational framework. Moreover, the method incorporates a convenient treatment of moving boundaries and admits a simple computational implementation. The capabilities of the proposed SPH--LS-DEM framework are demonstrated through several numerical benchmarks involving dam-break flow, flow through porous media, granular collapse, and cyclic loading of a saturated granular specimen. The study sets the stage for several extensions to multiphysics problems across disciplines.

entries.source_title: Budgeted Proper Loss Design for Uncertain Decision Thresholds
entries.source_excerpt: A binary probability estimate may be used by several decision makers with different error costs. Proper scoring rules can emphasize selected probability thresholds, but a single average threshold distribution need not give a good worst-case regret guarantee. We study the choice of a proper loss when the threshold distribution belongs to a finite specified family. Among integrable loss weights with a positive pointwise floor and a fixed total mass, we derive the weight that minimizes the sharp, distribution-free multiplier from surrogate regret to threshold-averaged decision regret. The solution clips a rescaled upper envelope of the threshold densities at the prescribed floor; its normalization is found by a one-dimensional root search. We give proofs of sharpness, optimality, and stability under density misspecification, as well as a limitation for atomic threshold laws. An exact histogram implementation and two synthetic experiments across 20 seeds verify the construction. entries.source_title: See Every Block Once: Variance-Reduced Post-Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: Policy gradient methods are widely used to align large language model outputs with human preferences, but the log-likelihoods they require cannot be directly computed in Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs). MDLM post-training therefore relies on a surrogate objective based on the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO), and recent work estimates a blockwise variant of this objective via Monte Carlo methods to support blockwise generation. However, existing estimation schemes randomly sample the block index, so they may evaluate the same block more than once and leave some blocks unevaluated. This introduces variance arising from block selection into the estimates. In this work, we propose a full-block estimator that evaluates every block exactly once and averages the results. We theoretically show that the proposed estimator remains unbiased while eliminating the between-group variance arising from block selection, thereby achieving lower variance than the baseline for the same sample size.
