entries.paper_review: 来源是 CEO 社交帖，属于公司自述，尚非独立分析。

entries.source_title: Joint extreme-value asymptotics for the radius and centre of smallest enclosing balls
entries.source_excerpt: We study the joint extreme-value behaviour of the radius and centre of the smallest ball containing an i.i.d.\ spherically symmetric sample. In the Gumbel and Weibull regimes, we obtain joint limit theorems and show that the enclosing ball is asymptotically supported by exactly $d+1$ sample points, thereby resolving an open support problem in the Gumbel case. In the Fr\'echet regime, the limit is given by the smallest enclosing ball of an extremal Poisson cloud. For planar Gaussian samples, we derive an explicit joint limit law from Daniels' finite-sample formula and show that this law is universal throughout the planar Gumbel domain. In the bounded-support Weibull regime, we additionally obtain uniform tail bounds, moment convergence and an explicit limiting density, while the uniform-ball case admits an interpretation in terms of a Poisson zero cell.
entries.title_zh: 最小包围球半径与球心的联合极值渐近
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究球对称独立样本的最小包围球，分别在 Gumbel、Weibull 和 Fréchet 三类尾部条件下建立半径与球心的联合极限定理；在 Gumbel 情形还证明渐近支撑包围球的恰为 d+1 个样本点，解决一个开放的支撑问题。对平面高斯样本，作者从有限样本公式得到显式且在整个平面 Gumbel 域内普适的联合极限分布。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 极值概率、随机几何和高维统计研究者可关注联合极限及 d+1 点支撑结论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 结论为包围球统计量提供清晰渐近描述，实际估计仍需有限样本误差分析。
entries.cynic_review: 三种尾部情形的适用范围区分明确，普适性结论仅针对所述平面 Gumbel 域。
entries.paper_review: 摘要报告联合极限定理、开放问题和显式密度等具体结果。

entries.source_title: 微软为Outlook引入小型AI模型，优化邮件搜索排序
entries.title_zh: Outlook 测试小型重排序模型，改善邮件搜索相关性

entries.pragmatic_review: 重排序是明确的应用切口，实际收益需在邮件数据上验证。

entries.title_zh: NVIDIA Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-Finance-v1 金融智能体微调数据集
entries.summary_zh: 该数据集包含 7,878 条基于公开 SEC 文件构造的多轮工具调用样例，覆盖数值推理、金融建模、市场分析、调整项和业绩超预期或不及预期问题。资料称问题与答案由模型合成，并从多条生成轨迹中筛选 SFT 目标；它面向使用 NeMo RL recipes 和 NeMo Gym agent framework 的模型后训练。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 可供研究金融领域工具调用智能体的人检查任务类型、数据字段和合成流程；尤其值得留意其轨迹筛选方法与题目能否被独立复核。
entries.pragmatic_review: 若你正在用 NeMo 工具链研究金融智能体，可先抽查 JSONL 样例，再评估其是否适合自己的微调流程。

entries.paper_review: 资料给出了样本数、类别、生成模型和格式，但未附独立评测、完整生成与筛选验证结果或可复现的质量审计。

project_insight.translation_zh: 该数据集包含 7,878 条用于训练金融推理智能体的多轮工具调用样例，涵盖基于公开 SEC 文件的数值推理、金融建模、市场分析、调整项以及业绩超预期或不及预期问题。数据集适用于商业或非商业用途。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 一套以公开 SEC 文件为基础、用于监督微调金融工具调用智能体的合成对话数据。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读数据卡和 OpenMDW-1.1 条款，再检查 JSONL 中的 messages、metadata、题型分布及失败样本；确认研究用途和训练工具链匹配后，再考虑小规模实验。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 这是模型生成并筛选的合成数据，不是人工标注质量已获独立验证的数据；资料报告 7,350 条在四次 profiling 尝试中均未成功。使用受 OpenMDW-1.1 条款约束，数据卡未提供独立复现实验结果。
use_cases_zh: 抽查多轮工具调用轨迹，研究金融智能体如何检索 SEC EDGAR 文件并回答问题。
以 NeMo RL recipes 和 NeMo Gym agent framework 为基础，评估该数据集是否适合个人的金融智能体微调实验。

entries.source_title: LogicVal:A Logic-Formalized Benchmark for Constraint Satisfaction in Text-to-Image Generation
entries.source_excerpt: Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have made significant progress in producing high-fidelity images from natural-language prompts. Alongside this progress, numerous benchmarks have been developed to evaluate capabilities such as attribute binding, numeracy, spatial reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. In this work, we propose a new perspective on T2I evaluation by casting it as a constraint-satisfaction problem. We introduce a logical framework that formally specifies the benchmark domain, including objects, attributes, and relations, alongside the constraints that generated images must satisfy. We evaluated four state-of-the-art T2I models across 9 classes of constraints ranging from a single-object-attribute to multi-object relationships constraints involving logical operators ($\forall, \exists, count, \rightarrow$). Our results reveal a substantial gap between single-object and complex conditional multi-object relationship constraint classes, with the best-performing model achieving 98% accuracy on the former and just 53% on the latter. We assess compositional generalisation, finding that the best-performing model`s accuracy d
entries.title_zh: LogicVal：用逻辑形式化评测文生图约束满足
entries.summary_zh: 论文把文生图评测建模为约束满足问题，用逻辑语言描述对象、属性、关系及图像必须满足的条件，并在九类约束上测试四个模型。摘要报告最佳模型对单对象属性约束准确率 98%，但对涉及多个对象的复杂关系约束仅 53%，显示组合条件仍是明显短板。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合评估文生图模型能否遵守复杂空间与关系指令的研究者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 约束形式化使错误类型和组合难度更易量化。
entries.cynic_review: 结论依赖所选基准和图像判定规则，不能覆盖全部生成质量。
entries.paper_review: 给出清晰的九类任务与明显的简单—复杂性能差距。

entries.source_title: Equivariant resolution of singularities for $T$-varieties in positive characteristic
entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Gary Martínez-Núnez; Subjects: Algebraic Geometry (math.AG); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: 正特征下低余维环面作用簇的等变奇点消解
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明，在代数闭正特征域上，若带代数环面作用的簇一般轨道余维至多为 3，则存在等变奇点消解。证明把此类簇表示为适当的多面体除子与扇，再结合三维以内对数消解和环面嵌入消解理论；条件限定于一般轨道余维，而不是任意维数的环面簇。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把正特征奇点消解推进到具有低余维环面作用的一类簇。
entries.pragmatic_review: 研究 T-变体的双有理几何时可检查一般轨道余维条件。
entries.cynic_review: 定理仅覆盖一般轨道余维不超过三的情形。
entries.paper_review: 摘要清楚解释了组合描述与低维消解工具的拼接。

entries.source_title: Idempotent generically stable measures in NIP groups
entries.source_excerpt: Let $\mu$ be a global generically stable Keisler measure on a type-definable group in an NIP theory. Then $\mu$ is idempotent if and only if it is the unique translation-invariant measure on its type-definable stabilizer subgroup. This resolves the NIP case of the Idempotent Measure problem studied by Chernikov, Gannon, and Krupi\'nski.
entries.title_zh: NIP 群中幂等且一般稳定的测度
entries.summary_zh: 文章研究 NIP 理论中类型定义群上的全局一般稳定 Keisler 测度，证明测度幂等当且仅当它是其类型定义稳定子群上唯一的平移不变测度。该等价刻画解决了摘要所指的幂等测度问题的 NIP 情形。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 为模型论中的幂等测度问题给出群结构上的精确刻画。
entries.pragmatic_review: 结论可作为分析一般稳定测度及其稳定子群的直接判据。
entries.cynic_review: 高度专业的模型论术语使结果应用面较窄，定理依赖一般稳定性假设。
entries.paper_review: 完成了一个被明确提出的问题在 NIP 框架下的解决。

entries.source_title: A note on the Besov spaces ${\rm B}_1^{\Phi_2}$
entries.source_excerpt: Regarding the Besov space ${\rm B}_1^{\Phi_2}$, defined by S. Geiss and Ylinen (Memoirs AMS 1335, 2021) by a coupling method, we prove for $\xi\in{\rm B}_1^{\Phi_2} \cap L_2$ a distributional estimate in terms of the Lorentz-Zygmund space $L_{1,\infty}(\ln L)^{-1}$ for the Malliavin derivative ${\rm D}(T_u\xi)$ uniformly in $u>0$, where $(T_u)_{u\ge }$ is the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck semi-group. Here $\xi$ is not necessarily Malliavin differentiable in the ${\rm D}_{1,1}$-sense. This provides for Theorem 4.22 of the aforementioned reference an extension to the borderline case $p=1$.
entries.title_zh: Besov 空间 B₁^{Φ₂} 的一个端点估计
entries.summary_zh: 对由耦合法定义的 Besov 空间 B₁^{Φ₂}，作者证明当 ξ 属于该空间且 L₂ 可积时，Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 半群 T_uξ 的 Malliavin 导数在洛伦兹–齐格蒙德空间 L_{1,∞}(ln L)^{-1} 中满足一致分布估计。该结果允许 ξ 不具通常 D_{1,1} 意义下的 Malliavin 可微性，从而把相关文献结论延伸到临界 p=1 端点。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合高斯分析、Malliavin 微积分和函数空间端点正则性研究。
entries.pragmatic_review: Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 半群是高斯测度上的基本平滑算子。
entries.cynic_review: 明确指出端点改进和不要求经典可微的范围。
entries.paper_review: 高阶函数空间记号繁多，常数和证明条件需查原文。

entries.source_title: Germwise singular Fourier--Mukai partnerships
entries.source_excerpt: We study how local behavior on the base controls whether integral transforms induce fully faithful functors or equivalences between singularity categories of proper flat families. By working with \'{e}tale germs, we show (under mild hypotheses) that the loci where this happens are open and are compatible with \'{e}tale base change. Moreover, we give examples, exhibit an autoequivalence of the singularity category which detects regularity of the base, and compute these loci for arithmetic families.
entries.title_zh: 逐点奇异 Fourier–Mukai 对应
entries.summary_zh: 论文考察适当平坦族的基底局部几何如何决定积分变换是否诱导奇点范畴间的全忠实函子或等价。通过 étale germ，作者证明相应性质发生的基底点集是开集且与 étale 换基相容，并给出例子、一个能检测基底正则性的自等价，以及算术族上的具体计算。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 提供从基底局部数据判断奇异性范畴等价的可迁移几何框架。
entries.pragmatic_review: 开集性和换基相容性可帮助局部到整体分析。
entries.cynic_review: 结论要求摘要所说的温和假设，需查明具体条件。
entries.paper_review: 把 Fourier–Mukai 性质定位到 étale 局部基底。

entries.source_title: A Cut Finite Element Method with Boundary Value Correction for Robin, Neumann and Interface Conditions
entries.source_excerpt: We extend the cut finite element method with boundary value correction of Burman, Hansbo and Larson [Math.\ Comp.\ 87 (2018) 633--657] to Robin and Neumann conditions and to interface problems with imperfect bonding. The formulation retains a piecewise affine boundary for all integration, while using the exact geometry only at boundary quadrature points. The correction uses Taylor expansions of the solution and its gradient along the discrete normal, with the exact normal used to evaluate the transported flux. At an interface, a further correction to the normal flux jump accounts for the difference between these two normals. Under the stated trace and Poincar\'e bounds, the corrected form is an $O(h^{1/2})$ perturbation of a symmetric form, whose matrix can therefore be used as a preconditioner. For a fixed finite Robin coefficient, we obtain the energy error bound $C_\beta(h^p+\delta_h^{m+1})$, whereas the bound uniform in the Robin coefficient is $C(h^p+h^{-1/2}\delta_h^{m+1})$, provided the Poincar\'e constant is uniform. entries.source_title: Nondimensionalization, Variational Inequalities and Uncertainty Quantification in a Morphoelastic Model for Burn Injury Healing
entries.source_excerpt: Mathematical modelling of burn injury healing involves coupling biological processes with mechanical deformation, resulting in computationally stiff, nonlinear partial differential equations that severely limit the scalability of existing numerical solutions. We present a computational framework addressing these challenges. By nondimensionalizing the model and performing scaling analysis, we show that chemotaxis and inertia are negligible, permitting a quasi-static momentum approach. To enforce non-negativity constraints, we implement a Variational Inequality formulation using the Finite Element Method in FEniCSx, and verify it via numerical convergence studies and mass balances. We identify high-order parameter interactions, specifically equilibrium collagen density and signalling dynamics, as the primary drivers of solver stability. A sensitivity analysis of nearly four million simulations reveals that isolated parameter variations predominantly govern the maximum wound contraction. entries.source_title: A functional central limit theorem for the KPZ equation with narrow wedge initial data
entries.source_excerpt: In this article, we consider the Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) equation with narrow wedge initial data. We prove a functional central limit theorem for the spatial average of the solution, which solves an open problem from Gu and Pu (2025). Our main tool is Clark-Ocone formula from Malliavin calculus, combined with an in-depth analysis of the increments of the solution. The main step is a moment bound for time increments of the normalized spatial integral. For this, we introduce a new technique, called a ``common-ray'' change of variables. Using the fact that Malliavin derivative of the solution satisfies a Chapman-Kolmogorov relation, we reduce the kernel differences at two times to spatial increments at one common time.

entries.title_zh: Borel 版 Ruziewicz 问题

entries.source_title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
entries.source_excerpt: We present \'{E}pi, an autonomous research agent that sustains investigations across model sessions and evolves its methods through accumulated experience. \'{E}pi combines persistent research history, hierarchical memory, branching and independent review to maintain research continuity, learn from experiments, and explore and revisit alternative approaches. Its experiments run across session boundaries, and a fixed verifier evaluates their outputs. \'{E}pi produced 120 record-setting results, comprising 20 numerical bound records across 12 families and 100 construction records across eight families. These include an approximately 84-fold narrower interval for the $n$-queens constant and a more than 3.6-million-fold narrower rigorous interval for the quartic Feigenbaum attractor dimension. Exact dual certificates establish that the Cohn-Elkies linear-programming bound cannot be sharp in dimensions 10 and 11. Beyond numerical improvements, \'{E}pi gives a computer-assisted proof of Tuza's conjecture for split graphs with an eight-vertex clique part and at most three triangle-active neighborhood types, with arbitrary multiplicities. entries.source_title: Avalanche Sharpness and the Stationary State of the Bak--Sneppen Model on $\mathbb Z^d$
entries.source_excerpt: We establish the stationary picture for the nearest-neighbour Bak--Sneppen model on $\mathbb Z^d$, for every $d\ge1$. We show that the threshold at which the mean avalanche range diverges coincides with the threshold for the appearance of an infinite avalanche, using the hierarchical structure of avalanches and an estimate on the creation of new sites under translation. We then prove that an avalanche reaching a macroscopic distance on the torus can, after any fixed positive increase of the level, be amplified into one covering the whole torus. Finally, below criticality, we obtain exponential integrability of the avalanche range and give a finite--infinite volume comparison. entries.source_title: Explicit strong blocking sets and minimal codes from expander graphs using a new graph parameter
entries.source_excerpt: A strong blocking set is a set of points in a finite projective space that intersects every hyperplane of the space in a spanning set of the hyperplane. These objects have been studied both in finite geometry and coding theory due to their equivalence with minimal codes. We give an explicit construction of strong blocking sets using expander graphs that improves the explicit construction of Alon et al. (Noga Alon, Anurag Bishnoi, Shagnik Das, Alessandro Neri, Strong blocking sets and minimal codes from expander graphs. Transactions of the American Mathematical Society ) by introducing a new geometrically motivated graph parameter that is better suited for this problem. Using this approach, we improve the constant $C$ in the explicit construction of a strong blocking set of size $C (q+1) k$ in the $(k - 1)$-dimensional projective space over $\mathbb{F}_q$ for every prime power $q \geq 7$.

entries.source_title: On the existence of mixed orthogonal arrays of strength two with six factors
entries.source_excerpt: Orthogonal arrays are foundational objects in combinatorial design theory and experimental design theory, with broad applications in computer science, coding theory, and cryptography. In this paper, we investigate the existence for mixed orthogonal arrays of strength two with six factors, and propose several new constructions based on incomplete orthogonal Latin squares, incomplete transversal designs, and $\Sigma$-resolvable transversal designs. As a result, we show that the necessary conditions for the existence of such mixed orthogonal arrays are also sufficient, except for a small number of known exceptions and nine unsettled cases.

entries.source_title: Elementary Moves on Ideal Webs, Local Monodromies on Hitchin Fibrations, and Tropical Mutations on $\mathrm{K_0}$ Groups
entries.source_excerpt: This paper builds on the work of Goncharov by studying the correspondence between topological spectral covers constructed from generic $A_{m-1}$-webs with rank $m\ge2$, Hitchin spectral curves over good Hitchin loci, and the Grothendieck groups $K_0(\mathcal{D}_{\Gamma})$ associated with the quivers with potential $(Q_{\Gamma},W_{\Gamma})$ assigned to corresponding bipartite $A_{m-1}$-graphs. We show that the automorphisms on the non-frozen quiver lattices $\Lambda_{\Gamma}^{\circ}$ induced by compositions of elementary moves on ideal webs/bipartite graphs are the same as the Gauss--Manin monodromy actions on the $SL_m$ Hitchin fiber lattices $H_1(\operatorname{Prym}(\Sigma);\mathbb{Z})$ locally around discriminant loci. And the Gauss--Manin monodromy actions agree with the automorphisms on the Grothendieck groups $K_0(\mathcal{D}_{\Gamma}^{\circ})$ induced by compositions of mutations on the quivers with potential $(Q_{\Gamma},W_{\Gamma})$.
entries.title_zh: 理想网的基本变换、Hitchin 单值与 K₀ 群变异
entries.summary_zh: 论文比较三种结构：理想 A_{m−1} 网给出的拓扑谱覆盖、Hitchin 纤维曲线，以及带势箭图的范畴 K₀ 群。作者证明基本变换诱导的非冻结箭图格自同构，与判别子附近 Hitchin 纤维的 Gauss–Manin 单值作用一致，也等于 quiver mutation 在 K₀ 上诱导的变换。

entries.source_title: KnowledgeClaw: Towards Agentic Knowledge Engineering via Omnimodal Hypergraphs
entries.source_excerpt: Knowledge engineering (KE) turns raw files into a reasoning-ready knowledge base, a task now within reach of LLM agents. KE has progressed from chunk and graph retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to memory agents, agentic KE and multimodal KE. However, a live knowledge base needs omnimodality, a closed-loop lifecycle and multi-granular application at once, yet existing systems meet at most two and no benchmark measures all three. We formalize Omnimodal Knowledge Engineering (OmniKE) and release OmniKE-Bench, six tasks with 1,829 model-free items over 3,960 real files in five modalities. We further propose KnowledgeClaw, an agentic system that builds an omnimodal typed hypergraph, keeps it current with a closed-loop lifecycle agent and routes each query to the granularity it needs. Against 30 baselines, it ranks first on all six tasks with an overall OKE of 55.9, +14.6 over the strongest baseline. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/KnowledgeClaw.

entries.source_title: Classification of Forbidden 0-1 Patterns by Their Extremal Function
entries.source_excerpt: This paper concerns the maximum weight of $n\times n$ 0-1 matrices that avoid some pattern $P$, denoted $\operatorname{ex}(n,P)$. Furedi and Hajnal initiated a research program of classifying all patterns according to their extremal function, but to date, only the weight-4 patterns are completely understood. In this paper we make progress on several fronts of the classification problem. A pattern is light if its columns have weight 1 and linear if $\operatorname{ex}(n,P)=O(n)$. We characterize the set of weight-5 linear light patterns, and the set of weight-5 linear patterns more generally. Along the way we identify several new infinite classes of linear patterns, which support the Pettie-Tardos conjecture on characterizing all linear light patterns. It was known that there exist infinitely many minimally nonlinear patterns. We identify a specific infinite set of minimally nonlinear patterns. entries.source_title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
entries.source_excerpt: Symantec 研究人员通过蜜罐截获一个把大语言模型嵌入核心的攻击智能体，它会劫持互联网上无防护的模型端点，自主扫描目标、利用服务器漏洞、窃取数据库凭据并安装挖矿程序，最多连续执行 100,000 步，算力费用由被劫持模型的主人承担。
entries.title_zh: 恶意智能体劫持未受保护的大模型发起持续攻击
entries.summary_zh: The Decoder 转述 Symantec 蜜罐捕获的攻击提示词：操作者试图劫持暴露在互联网上的模型端点，让模型规划扫描、利用漏洞、窃取凭据和部署挖矿程序，并设计了最多 10 万步的循环流程。报道指出提示词使用多层越狱，并含 74 个攻击模块，但蜜罐没有执行这些工具，分析也未证明越狱能稳定绕过商业模型防护；主要风险是暴露模型端点被盗用并产生算力账单和下游攻击。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 提醒组织保护未认证模型 API、密钥和工具权限，并将报道中的观察与已执行攻击区分。
entries.pragmatic_review: 应检查模型网关鉴权、速率限制、密钥轮换和工具隔离。
entries.cynic_review: 捕获到攻击提示词不等于完整攻击链已成功运行。
entries.paper_review: 展示了模型劫持与自主工具链组合的威胁模型。

entries.source_title: Preserving Reasoning Diversity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards via Adaptive Replay
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but often reduces the diversity of their reasoning behaviors. We study this phenomenon from the perspective of finite-sample learning dynamics and show that limited on-policy rollouts can progressively suppress semantically distinct but equally rewarded reasoning modes. Once a mode becomes sufficiently under-sampled, standard on-policy RLVR rarely recovers it. Motivated by this observation, we propose TAR, a Targeted Adaptive Replay framework that preserves diverse correct reasoning behaviors already present in the base policy. TAR constructs a compact memory bank of diverse base-model solutions and selectively replays them through an adaptive mechanism that activates only when stored behaviors are being suppressed during RLVR. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two Qwen2.5 model scales, TAR consistently achieves a better balance between reasoning performance and diversity preservation than existing diversity-preserving post-training methods, while substantially reducing the forgetting of correct base-model
entries.title_zh: 用自适应回放在可验证奖励 RL 中保留推理多样性
entries.summary_zh: 论文分析 RLVR 的有限 rollout 可能逐步压低语义不同但奖励相同的正确解法，被压到低频后普通 on-policy RL 很难恢复。TAR 从基础模型保存多样正确答案，仅在训练检测到某类行为正在被压制时选择性回放；在六个数学推理基准、两种 Qwen2.5 规模上，作者报告其在性能与解法多样性之间取得更好平衡，并减少对基础模型正确模式的遗忘。

entries.cynic_review: 结果取决于基础模型已包含有价值的解法多样性。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出失效机制、方法和多基准验证范围。

entries.source_title: Geiss-Besov Regularity of Exit Times of Diffusion Processes
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that the truncated exit times of possibly degenerate diffusion processes from open domains satisfying the exterior sphere condition belong to the Geiss-Besov space $\mathbb{B}_p^{\frac{1}{2p}}$. In the one-dimensional case, the same result is proven using Zvonkin transformation for untruncated exit times if the diffusion is uniformly elliptic.
entries.title_zh: 扩散过程退出时间的 Geiss–Besov 正则性
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明，从满足外球条件的开域退出的截断时间，对可能退化的扩散过程属于 Geiss–Besov 空间 B_p^{1/(2p)}。在一维一致椭圆情形，作者借助 Zvonkin 变换把结论扩展到未截断退出时间。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 随机微分方程与数值金融研究者可关注退出时间正则性对离散误差分析的潜在作用。
entries.pragmatic_review: 结论可服务于随机数值分析，但其实际应用依赖边界和椭圆性假设。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要区分了截断的一般结果与未截断的一维一致椭圆结果。
entries.paper_review: 函数空间阶数与几何条件明确，证明估计和具体应用未在摘要展开。

entries.source_title: Robust topology optimization of isogeometric Kirchhoff--Love shells by the Speed Method
entries.source_excerpt: This paper presents a framework for robust topology optimization of Kirchhoff-Love (KL) multi-patch shells using isogeometric analysis and non-matching meshes and provides a CAD-compatible method. The material distribution is optimized via a NURBS-based level set method, enabling accurate boundary representation and seamless export to standard CAD/CAM workflows. The shape derivative is computed using the speed method, yielding a volume-based formulation that avoids boundary approximations and aligns with the isogeometric principle of coarse, high-order discretizations. This eliminates the need for local refinement, adaptive quadrature, or trimming as the descent direction for the compliance and volume objectives are obtained through a biharmonic equation. The framework is extended to robust optimization under uncertainty, accounting for stochastic loading and material properties via Monte Carlo sampling and Gaussian Random Fields. Numerical examples demonstrate the method's efficiency and robustness across single- and multi-patch shells, reproducing literature results with fewer elements than traditional FEM or refined IGA approaches.
entries.title_zh: 等几何 Kirchhoff–Love 壳的鲁棒拓扑优化
entries.summary_zh: 论文以 NURBS 水平集表示多片壳材料边界，用速度法求形状导数，并通过双调和方程确定下降方向，保持 CAD 兼容。作者进一步用蒙特卡洛与高斯随机场处理载荷和材料不确定性，数值例子报告较少单元下复现既有结果。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合壳结构设计与 CAD 到仿真的工作流。

entries.source_title: Numerical approximation of Benjamin-Ono type models for two-dimensional internal waves
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper we analyze the numerical approximation with spectral methods of two asymptotic models for the two-dimensional propagation of internal waves in a two-layer system of fluids with rigid-lid condition. The semidiscretization in space of the periodic initial-value problem with the spectral Fourier-Galerkin method is introduced and some error estimates are derived. Then the semidiscrete system is integrated in time with the Implicit Midpoint Rule and several numerical experiments illustrate the performance of the corresponding full discretization.
entries.title_zh: 二维内波 Benjamin–Ono 型模型的数值近似
entries.summary_zh: 论文分析两层流体刚盖条件下二维内波的两种渐近模型，先用 Fourier–Galerkin 方法离散周期空间变量并推导误差估计，再以隐式中点法推进时间。数值实验展示全离散方案的表现；摘要未给出模型间精度或成本的定量比较。

entries.source_title: Lean Finder V2: Semantic Search for Mathlib That Disambiguates User Queries
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce Lean Finder V2, a semantic search framework for Mathlib that disambiguates user queries through complementary model-level adversarial training and input-level query rewriting. Human mathematicians and coding agents rarely search Mathlib by providing detailed context. In practice, they query short properties, notation, aliases, or hypotheses, leaving much of the intended mathematics implicit. In contrast, existing Mathlib search engines unrealistically assume context-rich queries. The scarcity of real-world short queries paired with ground-truth Mathlib statements makes this ambiguity even more intractable. We argue that this is essentially a data problem. Through adversarial training, we scale up the generation of labeled short and ambiguous queries, and learn to disambiguate user queries at both model-level fine-tuning and input-level query rewriting. On the human-curated MathlibQR benchmark, our Lean Finder V2 sets a new state of the art, with at least 11% relative improvement over the previous best Mathlib semantic search engines. On top of our state-of-the-art retriever, optimized query rewriting further improves Math
entries.title_zh: Lean Finder V2：消歧短查询的 Mathlib 语义搜索
entries.summary_zh: 框架针对只有别名、符号或简短性质的 Mathlib 搜索，结合对抗生成标注查询、模型微调与查询改写。摘要称在 MathlibQR 上比既有系统至少相对提升 11%，接入 Claude Code 后也改善下游证明成功率；这属于检索及实验进展，不是新定理认证。

entries.source_title: MHeatmap: Two-Walk Laplacian Reordering and Mosaic Layout for Rectangular Matrix Visualization
entries.source_excerpt: Weighted rectangular matrices record relations between two types of objects, such as occupations and industries, documents and terms, origins and destinations, or annotated classes and computed clusters. Their heatmaps become difficult to read when arbitrary row and column orders scatter related objects, while equal size cells hide large differences in row and column totals. We present MHeatmap (Mosaic Heatmap), which addresses these problems in two stages. Two-Walk spectral seriation first represents the matrix as a weighted bipartite graph. Ordinary bipartite ordering uses only observed row to column links. Two-Walk also uses length-two walks, so rows that share columns and columns that share rows receive explicit similarity links. Sorting a Fiedler vector of the resulting graph Laplacian gives coordinated row and column orders. The Mosaic layout then partitions a unit square so that row height is proportional to the row total and column width is proportional to the column total, while color represents the observed entry. We prove how the Two-Walk energy combines direct alignment with shared-neighbor smoothness, derive an exact matr
entries.title_zh: MHeatmap：基于双步游走与镶嵌布局的矩阵可视化

entries.source_title: A nonlinear multigrid method for the preconditioned lattice Boltzmann equation
entries.source_excerpt: This work developed a preconditioned lattice Boltzmann equation (PLBE) smoother for the residual-driven full approximation scheme (FAS) multigrid to accelerate steady-state LBE calculations. To overcome the deterioration of LBE smoothing at low viscosity, we used a two- relaxation-time (TRT) collision model together with characteristic-velocity and kinetic precondition- ing to keep the relaxation frequency for the even-order moments within a favorable range, while independently selecting the relaxation frequency for the odd-order moments to reduce their local amplification factor. We further investigated F-, W-, and hybrid V/W-cycles to address residual stagnation observed with V-cycles at high Reynolds numbers. The 2D lid-driven cavity flow was used as a test case. At Re = 5000, TRT-PLBE-FAS achieves an approximately 27-fold speedup over single-grid TRT-PLBE. At Re = 20000 on a 20482 grid, the hybrid V/W-cycle reduces solution time by 14% compared with the W-cycle.
entries.title_zh: 预条件格子 Boltzmann 方程的非线性多重网格
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出针对预条件格子 Boltzmann 方程的 TRT-PLBE-FAS 非线性多重网格方法，并报告在 Re=5000 算例中约比单网格方法快 27 倍；在 Re=20000、2048² 网格上，混合 V/W 循环又比 W 循环快约 14%。这些是特定数值实验的性能结果，硬件、收敛容差和基线选择会影响加速比。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 高雷诺数流动数值模拟人员可检查多重网格策略是否适配自己的求解器。

entries.paper_review: 有具体 Reynolds 数和网格结果，尚需完整实验设置验证。

entries.source_title: Non-Deterministic Finite Automata for Telugu Letters and Visualizations for Metrical Poetry
entries.source_excerpt: Syllabic weight is central to Telugu metrical poetry. Syllabically, every letter (aksharam token) is either light (laghuvu) or heavy (guruvu). Poets classify it using a set of pre-defined rules. This paper formalizes aksharam token, the atomic unit of syllabic classification, as a non-deterministic finite automaton (NFA) with the regular expression$\colon$ $(A_h+A_d+A_p)(\epsilon+V_s)+A_m+H^+G(\epsilon+H+V_s+V_v)$, where $\epsilon$ denotes a null string, $A$ denotes a vowel (achchu), comprising hrasvam ($A_h$), deergham ($A_d$), plutham ($A_p$), and miscellaneous ($A_m$), $H$ a pure consonant (pollu\_hallu), $G$ a vowel diacritic (gunintha\_chihnam), $V_s$ the sunna (anusvara), and $V_v$ the visarga, the latter two being nasal and aspirated sounds respectively. We then present automata diagrams and regular expressions for (i) a necessary condition satisfied by every light letter, and (ii) a sufficient condition for a letter to be heavy. Finally, we propose graphical visualizations for the 9 Telugu poem types.
entries.title_zh: 泰卢固字母的非确定有限自动机与格律诗可视化
entries.summary_zh: 论文把泰卢固诗律中的音节单位 aksharam 形式化为非确定有限自动机，并用规则描述轻音与重音的必要或充分条件。作者还绘制九种诗体的图形表示；这项工作重点是把语言学分类规则转成可检验的自动机结构，摘要没有声称已覆盖所有诗歌变体。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 将区域诗歌格律知识转成形式语言模型，便于教学、检查和可视化。

entries.paper_review: 给出明确的形式化对象和诗体展示范围。

entries.source_title: A Study of Fixed versus Adaptive Step Sizes for Phasor Dynamics Simulations
entries.source_excerpt: Transient phasor dynamics simulations model the response of power systems to disturbances using differential-algebraic equations (DAEs). Fixed-step integration is widely used to solve these DAEs numerically, but a step size suitable for resolving a fault transient may be unnecessarily small during the rest of a simulation. In this work, we provide a quantitative comparison of fixed and adaptive backward differentiation formulas on a suite of seven grid test cases ranging from 200 to 70,000 buses. Adaptive step sizes automatically shrink near faults, perturbations, and controller limits, and grow during less active portions of the simulation. At the global error achieved by a fixed quarter-cycle step size, adaptive results give 1.8 to 2.6 times speedups. Local error distributions, step size profiles, and work-precision plots show how accuracy, nonlinear solver, and step selection contribute to these differences. The results establish adaptive integration as the preferred approach for these simulations.
entries.title_zh: 相量动态仿真中固定与自适应步长的比较
entries.summary_zh: 论文在 200 至 70,000 母线的七个电网算例上比较固定步长与自适应步长的后向微分公式求解相量动态微分代数方程。自适应方法会在故障和控制限值附近缩小步长、平稳时放大；在达到固定四分之一周期步长的全局误差时，计算加速为 1.8 至 2.6 倍。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 电力系统仿真与数值积分开发者可参考多规模算例对自适应步长效率的定量比较。
entries.pragmatic_review: 结果覆盖从数百到数万母线的测试，实际收益仍取决于求解器和事件模型。
entries.cynic_review: 速度提升以匹配给定全局误差为比较条件，不能脱离算例集泛化。
entries.paper_review: 摘要报告七个算例和工作精度分析，复现实验需确认代码与配置可得性。

entries.source_title: Hypercube Richardson varieties from magic words
entries.source_excerpt: Inspired by the recent preprint of Ellenberg, Libedinsky, Plaza, Simental, and Williamson, we study the geometry of Richardson varieties whose associated Bruhat intervals are boolean posets. We define magic words for a Bruhat interval and prove that for intervals with magic words the associated Richardson variety is a tower of $\mathbb{P}^1$-s. We also prove that the Bruhat intervals consisting of the dyadically well-distributed permutations all have magic words. This gives a new proof that they form a boolean poset.
entries.title_zh: 由 magic words 构造超立方 Richardson 簇
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究 Bruhat 区间为布尔偏序时对应的 Richardson 簇几何，并为含有“magic word”的区间证明其簇是由若干个 P¹ 依次构成的塔。作者还证明，坐标分布具有 dyadic 均匀性的置换所对应的 Bruhat 区间都存在 magic word，从而给出这些区间为布尔偏序的一个新证明。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数几何与组合表示论读者了解置换组合条件如何控制 Richardson 簇的几何结构。
entries.pragmatic_review: P¹ 塔结构提供了这些特殊 Richardson 簇的具体几何描述。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要聚焦特定布尔区间与置换族，推广范围需看条件定义。
entries.paper_review: 摘要报告几何结构定理及组合应用，magic word 构造细节需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: $a$-numbers of covers in characteristic two: semigroups and Riemann-Roch spaces
entries.source_excerpt: We compute the $a$-numbers of the Garcia-G\"uneri-Stichtenoth curves, the Beelen-Montanucci curves, and the Skabelund covers of Suzuki curves in characteristic two. The proofs use the identity $a(X)=\ell(\tfrac12\operatorname{div}(dt))$ and reduce the calculations to Riemann-Roch spaces on the base curves. We obtain transfer formulas for odd-degree radical covers, with one or several points at infinity, and evaluate them using Weierstrass semigroups and plane sections of the Hermitian curve. For the first two families we also give cyclic models over the projective line and relate the formulas to Elkin's rank formula. We then treat two classes of Artin-Schreier fibre products. A supersingular genus-six family has a-number $3$ at the zero parameter and $2$ elsewhere, although the genera and $a$-numbers of its quadratic quotients remain fixed. We determine its Ekedahl--Oort types as $(0,0,0,1,2,3)$ and $(0,1,1,2,3,4)$,
entries.title_zh: 特征二覆盖曲线的 a 数：半群与 Riemann–Roch 空间
entries.summary_zh: 论文计算若干特征二代数曲线覆盖（包括 Garcia–Güneri–Stichtenoth、Beelen–Montanucci 与 Suzuki 曲线的 Skabelund 覆盖）的 a 数，并把计算化为基曲线上的 Riemann–Roch 空间维数，再用 Weierstrass 半群和 Hermitian 曲线截面求值。一个超奇异亏格六族的 a 数在零参数时为 3、其他参数时为 2，尽管其二次商的亏格和 a 数保持不变；作者还给出对应 Ekedahl–Oort 类型。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数曲线与正特征几何研究者，展示覆盖构造如何转化为可计算的半群和 Riemann–Roch 问题。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把 a 数计算归约到基曲线空间有助于处理更多覆盖族。
entries.cynic_review: 结论针对具体曲线族和特征二，不能直接推广到一般特征。
entries.paper_review: 摘要列出计算恒等式和类型结果，曲线方程与参数范围需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Analysis and approximation for inverse potential problem of space-dependent variable-exponent sub-diffusion in heterogeneous medium
entries.source_excerpt: Anomalous transport in complex heterogeneous medium is often characterized by non-Markovian memory effects and spatially varying trapping properties. From the point of view of continuous-time random walks, such heterogeneity can be described by a position-dependent heavy-tailed waiting-time density $q(t \mid x)\sim C(x)t^{-1-\alpha(x)}$, where $0<\alpha(x)<1$ is the local anomalous exponent. This microscopic interpretation naturally leads to the sub-diffusion with a space-dependent variable exponent $\alpha(x)$. Compared with constant-exponent models, the variable-exponent fractional operators generally do not commute with the spatial Laplacian, which makes both the forward and inverse analysis substantially more delicate. This paper investigates the inverse problem of recovering a spatially dependent radiative or potential coefficient in variable-exponent sub-diffusion from terminal observation data. We formulate the inverse problem as a nonlinear fixed-point equation and prove that the associated fixed-point operator is monotone such that the fixed-point iteration converges decreasingly to the unique solution. entries.source_title: Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs
entries.source_excerpt: Proprietary language models and their reasoning traces are vulnerable to API-based distillation, where an adversary trains a student model on the teacher model's outputs. To obtain evidence of distillation, model providers can watermark the teacher's outputs, aiming to leave a radioactive signal in the student's outputs. Existing black-box detectors search for such radioactivity using token-level statistics of the suspect model's outputs. However, token-level signals are not always detectable, for instance when the distillation traces are sampled at a low temperature. In this work, we discover the watermark basin, a persistent signal that enables more reliable watermark detection: during fine-tuning, watermarked teacher traces embed a distinct, key-specific geometric signal in parameter space that lies orthogonal to the ordinary task-specific fine-tuning subspace. Building on this, we introduce Watermark Basin Alignment (WM-Basin), a black-box watermark detector that queries the suspect model through its API, without access to its weights or logits. entries.source_title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
entries.source_excerpt: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
entries.title_zh: Cloudflare 安全审计 Skill：多阶段代码审计与结构化发现
entries.summary_zh: 这是一个供编程智能体使用的安全审计 Skill，将审计拆成侦察、按覆盖清单搜寻、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录核验和报告生成六个阶段，并用覆盖台账和 findings.json 管理结果。项目称该 Skill 是 Cloudflare 漏洞发现流程的单仓库起点；材料描述了工作流和验证器，但没有提供独立审计效果或漏洞发现率数据。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对构建代码审计 Agent 的人有参考价值，尤其是如何把覆盖范围、候选漏洞反证和最终记录核验变成可追踪流程；其对沙箱与网络隔离的要求也提示了自动化审计的部署边界。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可先借鉴其阶段划分和机器可读结果结构，再按团队代码库与隔离环境调整审计流程。
entries.cynic_review: 多阶段设计和独立验证能改善流程纪律，但不能单凭流程描述推断漏洞检出能力，且运行依赖隔离沙箱与并行子 Agent。
entries.paper_review: 材料列出 Skill 文档、JSON Schema、零依赖验证器及其测试文件，但没有给出测试运行记录或独立安全评估。

project_insight.translation_zh: 一个面向编程智能体的 Skill，可将智能体组织成多阶段安全审计流程，并输出经过独立核验的机器可读发现。流程包括：侦察并记录架构与覆盖范围；按覆盖清单分配搜寻任务并检查遗漏；让新的验证者尝试推翻候选问题；将结果写入 findings.json 并按 Schema 校验；由独立智能体核验最终记录中的源码依据；最后根据已验证记录和覆盖台账生成报告。发现分为 confirmed、needs_validation 和 rejected。项目要求使用支持工具调用和并行子 Agent 的编程智能体、Node.js 验证器，以及对目标代码构建与测试进行操作系统级隔离的沙箱；沙箱应禁用外网、使用受限环境并限制资源和写入路径。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 把单仓库安全审计组织为带覆盖台账、候选反证和独立记录核验的 Agent 工作流，并生成结构化发现与报告。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读 SKILL.md、RECONNAISSANCE.md 和 VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md，理解流程与结果判定；检查仓库中的 Schema 和验证器后，再选择隔离良好的测试仓库试运行，并为构建、测试和目标代码准备禁网沙箱。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 这是 Skill 工作流而非独立安全扫描器，效果依赖编程智能体、子 Agent 和沙箱能力；项目要求操作系统级隔离、禁用外部网络并限制资源。材料未提供审计基准或独立效果评估；GitHub 页面标注 MIT 许可。

参考其 findings.json Schema 和验证器，为内部安全工具搭建结构化结果管线。

entries.source_title: Metric dimension and maximum eigenvalue multiplicity of graph Laplacians
entries.source_excerpt: We study equality between metric dimension and the maximum eigenvalue multiplicity of the Laplacian and signless Laplacian matrices. These quantities are not ordered in general. Using the standard decomposition associated with twin classes, we separate forced multiplicities from quotient-spectrum contributions. We give complete equality classifications for complete multipartite graphs and core--satellite graphs, and enumerate the multipartite equality graphs by order. For graphs formed by attaching at least two leaves to every vertex of a connected core, the metric dimension and the multiplicity of the eigenvalue $ 1 $ are known; we show that this multiplicity is maximal for both matrices, and uniquely maximal except for $ P_3 $. We enumerate this core--leaf family up to isomorphism and obtain a uniform asymptotic formula by order and metric dimension, together with the quadratic exponential growth rate $ 1/18 $. An exact census of connected graphs of orders two through seven identifies the first separating examples and examples without twins. entries.source_title: Hypersurfaces that are far from ruled
entries.source_excerpt: We show that a very general complex hypersurface of degree $d$ in $\mathbb P^{n+1}$ is not ruled whenever $n\geq3$ and $d\geq2\lceil(n+2)/3\rceil$. This improves Koll\'ar's original degree bound to the bound subsequently obtained by Totaro for stable irrationality and, in particular, includes very general quartic fourfolds. More precisely, we find new bounds for the minimal degree of a dominant rational map from a very general hypersurface to a ruled variety or a conic bundle, improving on previous bounds of Chen--Stapleton. The proofs combine Koll\'ar's reduction to positive characteristic with the Jacobson correspondence for inseparable extensions.
entries.title_zh: 高维一般超曲面远离 ruled 结构

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 代数几何研究者可关注高维超曲面双有理结构的次数界改进。

entries.source_title: On counting integer symmetric matrices of fixed determinant in families of slant boxes
entries.source_excerpt: In this article, we develop an upper bound for the number of integral symmetric matrices of fixed determinant in a slant box with coefficients bounded by some given power of the volume of the slant box. We develop a counting method that expands on Shankar-Siad-Swaminathan's work on rank-3 integer symmetric matrices of fixed determinant to higher-rank matrices using geometry-of-numbers methods and invariant theory on the splitting of quadratic forms associated with the determinant formula into corresponding linear forms. We expect this generalization will allow us to apply the counting results to arithmetic statistics frameworks. In forthcoming work, we will apply the counting results to study the distribution of 2-torsion subgroups of class groups of unit-monogenised number fields.

entries.source_title: Average eccentricity in k-connected tournaments
entries.source_excerpt: The average eccentricity $\avec(D)$ of a strong digraph $D$ is the mean eccentricity of all vertices in $D$. A tournament $T$ is an orientation of a complete graph. In this paper, we prove that the average eccentricity satisfies $2 \le \avec(T) < \frac{n}{2k} + \frac{11}{2} + \frac{k}{8n}$ for a $k$-connected tournament $T$ of order $n$. We further examine the case for strong tournaments where $k = 1$, and show that $\avec(T) \le \frac{n+11}{2} + \frac{1}{8n}$ for any strong tournament $T$. Moreover, we show that the lower bound $2$ is sharp and that the upper bounds are best possible apart from an additive constant.

entries.source_title: Summation-by-parts operators for general function spaces: Flux differencing, entropy stability, and accuracy
entries.source_excerpt: Summation-by-parts (SBP) operators are a cornerstone of provably stable high-order methods for hyperbolic conservation laws. For nonlinear problems, the flux-differencing framework of Fisher and Carpenter combines such SBP operators with entropy-conservative two-point fluxes to obtain semi-discretizations that are conservative in the sense of Lax--Wendroff and discretely entropy-conservative or stable. So far, this framework has been developed exclusively for operators that are exact for polynomials. Function-space SBP (FSBP) operators lift this restriction by being exact on a general finite-dimensional function space that can be tailored to the problem at hand. In this work, we extend flux differencing to FSBP operators for general (potentially non-polynomial) function spaces. We prove that, whenever the operator has a diagonal norm and its function space contains the constants, the resulting semi-discretization is conservative in the sense of Lax--Wendroff, semi-discretely entropy-conservative within a single element, and entropy-stable across element interfaces. entries.source_title: Coherence by Construction: Synthesizing CTI Knowledge Graphs and the Formal Limits of Coherence Validation
entries.source_excerpt: Synthesizing relational training data such as knowledge graphs with a large language model typically emits structured objects one at a time, which keeps each object valid but leaves the relationships between them ungrounded. We study an alternative paradigm, generation by simulation: rather than describing a relational artifact, we simulate a process that produces it and take the artifact to be its causal record. Language-model agents propose intent and a deterministic referee resolves outcomes against an explicit world model, so a relation is emitted only when the event it represents occurs, making coherence a property of construction. We instantiate the paradigm for cyber threat intelligence knowledge graphs in the STIX 2.1 standard with three engines, among them an evolutionary engine applying language-model genetic operators to structured graph genomes, sharing a deterministic compiler that makes malformed and dangling output unrepresentable. entries.source_title: Deep Bayesian Approaches for Interpretable Nonlinear Structural System Identification
entries.source_excerpt: System identification, namely the inference of mathematical representations of dynamical systems from measured data, is fundamental to engineering diagnostics, prognostics, and decision-making. Bayesian filtering offers a principled framework for probabilistic state estimation but traditionally relies on prescribed transition and observation models. Recent advances in deep Bayesian filtering address this limitation by embedding learnable representations within probabilistic state-space formulations, enabling data-driven identification of unknown dynamics while retaining physical structure and uncertainty-aware inference. This tutorial provides a systematic introduction to deep Bayesian filtering for nonlinear structural system identification, focusing on the interplay between learned dynamics, physical inductive biases, and posterior inference. The Deep Markov Model serves as a data-driven reference, while the Physics-guided Deep Markov Model (PgDMM) and Neural Extended Kalman Filter (Neural EKF) illustrate complementary approaches based on amortized variational inference and differentiable Kalman filtering, respectively. Their capabi
entries.title_zh: 可解释非线性结构系统辨识的深度贝叶斯方法
entries.summary_zh: 这篇教程系统介绍用深度贝叶斯滤波从测量数据识别非线性结构动力系统，重点讨论学习动态、物理归纳偏置和后验不确定性如何结合。它以 Deep Markov Model 为参考，并比较物理引导 DMM 与 Neural EKF 两条路线：前者采用摊销变分推断，后者使用可微卡尔曼滤波。

entries.source_title: Stochastic differential delay equations with random delay driven by fractional Brownian motion
entries.source_excerpt: We prove an existence and uniqueness result for stochastic differential delay equations driven by a fractional Brownian motion with Hurst parameter $H > \tfrac{1}{2}$, where the delay is a random process. Extending the pathwise Riemann--Stieltjes approach of Ferrante and Rovira \cite{FR2010}, we show that if the random delay $\tau(\cdot,\omega)$ has almost surely $\gamma$-H\"older continuous trajectories with $\gamma\delta > (1-H)/H$, where $\delta\in(0,1]$ is the H\"older exponent of the gradient of the diffusion coefficient, then the equation has a unique solution with paths in $C^{1-\alpha}(-r_0,T;R^d)\subset W_0^{\alpha,\infty}(-r_0,T;R^d)$ for appropriate $\alpha\in(1-H,\tfrac12)$. We also prove that the solution has moments of all orders when $\gamma>1/(2H)$ and the H\"older constant of the delay is bounded.
entries.title_zh: 分数布朗运动驱动的随机延迟微分方程
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究具有随机时滞、由 H>1/2 分数布朗运动驱动的随机微分延迟方程，在随机延迟满足 Hölder 正则性约束时证明解的存在唯一性。摘要给出条件 γδ>(1−H)/H，并说明当 γ>1/(2H) 时解具有所有阶矩及相应 Hölder 控制；结论依赖这些正则性假设。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 随机控制与分数噪声建模研究者可参考随机时滞下的适定性条件。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于核对模型适定性，条件不满足时不能直接套用。
entries.cynic_review: 参数门槛说得具体，应用时要确认随机延迟正则性。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出存在唯一性和矩条件，完整空间设定仍需细读。

entries.source_title: CaDO: Formal Verification-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Causal Dataset Repair and Generation
entries.source_excerpt: High-quality causal reasoning datasets are essential for developing models with reliable causal understanding, particularly in specialized domains. However, existing datasets frequently suffer from incorrect annotations and structural imbalances, which can lead to biased predictions and limited generalization. To address this issue, we propose CaDO (Causal-Engine-Guided Multi-Agent Data Optimization), a multi-agent framework for automated diagnosis and repair of causal reasoning datasets. Our framework consists of three key stages: formal causal reasoning, multi-level diagnosis, and automated data repair and generation. First, a Formalizer Agent translates natural language questions into formal causal queries to minimize semantic deviations and make retrieval and verification more explicit and tractable. Second, a dual-level diagnosis mechanism employs independent Critic Agents to identify sample-level errors while analyzing query-type coverage and label distributions to detect dataset-level structural imbalances. Finally, the framework employs reusable repair operators grounded in formal causal semantics to correct erroneous samples,
entries.title_zh: CaDO：形式验证引导的多代理因果数据集修复
entries.summary_zh: CaDO 针对因果推理数据集中的错误标注和结构失衡，提出由形式因果推理、多层诊断、自动修复与生成组成的多代理流程。其目标是让数据质量控制建立在显式因果结构检查上；当前可见摘要未给出数据规模、修复准确率或人工审查结果，因此不推断实际提升。

entries.cynic_review: 多代理诊断容易共享同一错误假设，验证集设计很关键。
entries.paper_review: 摘要介绍了流水线，但缺少定量结果与复现细节。

entries.source_title: Martingale and signed diffusive optimal transport: geodesics and gradient flows
entries.source_excerpt: In signed diffusive transport, a path of probability densities $\rho_t$ on the circle and a momentum $m_t$ satisfy $\partial_t\rho=\partial_{xx}m$, and the cost of the path is the action $\int_0^1\int m^2/(2\rho)\,dx\,dt$. The diffusivity $m/\rho$ is an unknown of this variational problem and can take either sign. On the real line, the constraint $m\ge0$ gives the martingale Benamou-Brenier problem of Huesmann and Trevisan. We study geodesics and minimizing movements, which discretize gradient flows. For signed geodesics, we prove the $\Gamma$-convergence of the time-discrete problems for all probability endpoints, and of the fully discrete Fourier-grid problems as the space and time meshes tend to zero independently, without a positive lower bound on the densities. For a modified Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) scheme on the torus, we prove convergence along subsequences to a weak solution of a fourth-order equation, the Derrida-Lebowitz-Speer-Spohn equation for the entropy in dimension one, under the assumption that the densities of the scheme stay above a positive constant on every finite time interval. entries.title_zh: 鞅型与带符号扩散最优传输：测地线和梯度流
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究密度与动量满足 ∂ₜρ=∂ₓₓm、扩散速度 m/ρ 可正可负的带符号扩散传输，并分析其测地线和离散梯度流。作者证明时间离散问题对任意概率端点的 Γ 收敛，以及傅里叶网格全离散问题在时空网格独立趋零时的收敛；修改的 JKO 格式则在密度保持正下界的假设下，子序列收敛到一维 DLSS 方程弱解。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 将最优传输变分结构与四阶扩散梯度流联系，并给出离散化收敛保证。
entries.pragmatic_review: 为设计传输型 PDE 的时间和空间离散格式提供理论依据。
entries.cynic_review: JKO 收敛部分依赖密度有正下界等条件。
entries.paper_review: 明确区分带符号测地线、离散 Γ 收敛和 DLSS 极限结论。

entries.source_title: The Thin Orchestrator: How We Made Our AI Agents More Reliable by Giving the Router Less to Do
entries.source_excerpt: Meta 工程团队介绍其数据管道智能体采用的瘦编排器（thin orchestrator）模式：一个约 1300 行的编排器只负责路由和可靠性检查，将 20+ 工作流分派给 14 个上下文隔离的专项子智能体，自身不做任何领域推理。
entries.title_zh: Meta 用“瘦编排器”拆分代理职责以提升生产可靠性
entries.summary_zh: Meta 工程团队将数据管道代理系统拆成确定性的编排器与 14 个上下文隔离的专用子代理：约 1,300 行的编排器只做意图路由、收集必要字段和可靠性检查，不承担领域推理；系统把 20 多种工作流分派给各自专家。该设计用于跨三个代码库、三种语言和最多六阶段的数据列接入流程，Meta 称其单一“大而全”代理在生产中会混淆不同子系统的规则；文章也报告了按任务人工编写提示时成功率较高、取消手工提示后显著下降的内部观察。数字与经验均为 Meta 自述，未见独立对照实验。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合设计生产级多代理系统的人参考职责边界、上下文隔离和确定性校验的组合。
entries.pragmatic_review: 让路由层只负责流程和检查，能减少中心代理承担的混杂任务。
entries.cynic_review: 企业案例的收益数字来自 Meta 内部，迁移到其他流程未必相同。
entries.paper_review: 文章给出架构和失败模式，但未公开可复现数据集或独立评估。

entries.source_title: More: Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort for Self-Evolving Agents
entries.source_excerpt: Self-evolving training improves the performance of agents on difficult tasks through verifiable feedback, but it often applies costly deliberation uniformly across tasks. To address this problem, we propose Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort (MORE), a self-evolving training framework that adaptively selects both reasoning form and computational effort for each task. Specifically, MORE follows a two-stage training paradigm: (i) \emph{Stage 1} establishes a compact prior over direct answering, short and long chain-of-thought, and code-based reasoning, and (ii) \emph{Stage 2} self-evolves this prior with Mode-Adaptive and Test-time Effort PPO (MATE-PPO) on generated, verifiable task streams without curated data. By learning mode selection and token expenditure jointly, MORE allocates concise reasoning to tasks that permit it while retaining extended deliberation where it is useful. Across coding, mathematics, and general-reasoning benchmarks, MORE achieves consistent performance gains on Base and Coder backbones at model scales from 3B to 14B. During inference, MORE demonstrates higher accuracy and better efficiency, with
entries.title_zh: MORE：按任务自适应选择推理模式与计算量
entries.summary_zh: MORE 两阶段训练先建立直接回答、短/长思维链和代码推理的紧凑先验，再通过 MATE-PPO 在可验证生成任务流上自我演化，同时学习任务选哪种模式、花多少 token。作者在 3B–14B Base/Coder 模型的代码、数学和通用推理基准上报告精度与效率均提升，避免对简单任务统一投入长推理。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合把推理成本纳入智能体训练与部署策略。

entries.source_title: Period maps and the $C_{\rm st}$ conjecture
entries.source_excerpt: We construct a family of elliptic curves over an open disc whose total space violates the $C_{\mathrm{st}}$ conjecture in degree $1$. Hence the conjecture, known for proper and for Stein varieties, as well as for products of such, does not extend to proper families over Stein bases. This is an instance of a general criterion: the $C_{\mathrm{st}}$ conjecture holds for the total space of a smooth proper family over a sufficiently small open disc if and only if its period map is constant, i.e., all Gauss--Manin Higgs fields vanish or, equivalently, the $p$-adic local systems $R^if_*\mathbf{Q}_p$ are geometrically constant. This criterion is special to curves: over a $2$-dimensional polydisc, we give a family of $p$-adic analogues of non-K\"ahler elliptic surfaces whose period maps and local systems are constant, but whose total space violates the conjecture.
entries.title_zh: 周期映射与 Cₛₜ 猜想
entries.summary_zh: 作者构造椭圆曲线在开圆盘上的一个族，使总空间违反一阶 Cₛₜ 猜想，说明该猜想虽对适当、Stein 空间及其乘积已知成立，却不能直接推广到 Stein 底上的适当族。文章还给出判据：曲线底上的光滑适当族满足该猜想，当且仅当周期映射为常值；在二维多圆盘上，常值周期映射仍不足以保证成立。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 通过反例和周期映射判据精确标出 p-adic Hodge 理论猜想的适用边界。
entries.pragmatic_review: 反例与判据为检验猜想能否沿族推广提供清晰标准。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要聚焦特定复解析底空间与一阶情形，外推到其他设置需谨慎。
entries.paper_review: 同时给出失效例子和维数相关的判据，揭示几何参数空间如何影响猜想。

entries.source_title: Towards a world mathematical commons
entries.source_excerpt: Mathematics is changing and growing beyond us. Here's what we can do about it.
entries.title_zh: 迈向世界数学共同资源体系
entries.summary_zh: 标题与简短摘录提出，数学正在变化并超越个人，需要讨论共同应对方式。现有材料没有说明共同资源的治理、基础设施或实施方案，不能替作者补充具体政策。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 作为数学知识公共化倡议的阅读入口。
entries.pragmatic_review: 需查看原文的具体行动建议。
entries.cynic_review: 共同资源愿景需要明确维护责任。
entries.paper_review: 适合追踪开放数学基础设施讨论。

entries.source_title: Optimal CLT error bounds in the second order Wasserstein metric via Stein's method for weakly dependent sequences
entries.source_excerpt: We use Stein's method to prove general upper bounds on the second order Wasserstein distance in the CLT for general dependent partial sums $S_N=X_1+\ldots +X_N$. Then we use these estimates to provide optimal $O(N^{-1/2})$ rates for a variety of chaotic dynamical systems and $\phi$- and $\psi$-mixing sequences. Our results for $\psi$-mixing sequences are obtained under the fourth moment condition, which matches the best known results in the iid case. This is the first time that optimal CLT rates of any kind are obtained for unbounded weakly stationary variables under general mixing conditions. We then apply this result and obtain optimal CLT rates $O\left((\text{Var}(S_N))^{-1/2}\right)$ for non-stationary $\psi$-mixing sequences without any growth rates on $\text{Var}(S_N)$. We also obtain close to optimal CLT rates for nonconventional sums and some classes of random dynamical systems with non-uniform decay of correlations
entries.title_zh: 弱依赖序列中心极限定理的最优 W₂ 误差界
entries.summary_zh: 论文用 Stein 方法估计依赖部分和与高斯分布的二阶 Wasserstein 距离，并在若干混合序列和混沌系统中得到 N 的负二分之一次量级。对 ψ 混合序列，摘要强调仅需四阶矩，并进一步处理非平稳及部分非传统和。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合需定量正态近似的概率与动力系统研究。
entries.pragmatic_review: 距离误差界有助于量化近似精度。
entries.cynic_review: 最优速率必须连同混合与矩条件使用。
entries.paper_review: 统一处理无界弱平稳变量具有方法价值。

entries.source_title: Thinking Hard Above AI
entries.source_excerpt: There are many ways in which AI is generating uncertainty in mathematics. We are not sure how it will impact our jobs, it is raising questions about how it might affect academic training, and it is not clear how it might change the job search process and how we evaluate research. This is by no means an exhaustive list. In this post, I will focus two another related questions, which are: “Is there still any mathematics to be done? And will doing mathematics still be fun and interesting?” I believe that there is, and here I set out to explain why.
entries.title_zh: 在 AI 之上继续认真思考数学
entries.summary_zh: Benjamin Merlin Bumpus 从数学家追求真理、理解或参与“大对话”的不同动机谈起，把 LLM 描述为一种文化与社会技术：它以新界面调用书籍、论文、程序和对话积累的数学文化，同时也会产生幻觉。作者承认近期 AI 数学能力超出自己的预期，并据个人经历提出“是否还有数学可做、做数学是否仍有趣”的问题；文章以人的理解、交流和参与价值为主线，属于作者的反思而非对未来工作的定量预测。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关注 AI 时代数学研究动机与知识传承的人，提供超越竞赛式能力比较的视角。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把数学视作共同对话，有助于重新设计教育和协作方式。
entries.cynic_review: 文化技术的比喻有启发性，但不足以回答就业与训练的实证问题。
entries.paper_review: 文章以个人经验和观点论证，没有系统调查研究者动机。

entries.source_title: Boxes in Infinite Words: Complexity, Automata, and Point Modules
entries.source_excerpt: Motivated by the geometry of point modules over monomial algebras, we introduce a box-counting function associated to a right-infinite word over a finite alphabet. An extendable box is a family of finite words obtained by choosing letters independently at each position, subject to the condition that all choices admit a common infinite right continuation in the associated subshift. We prove several results for these functions for words of linearly bounded complexity. For $k$-automatic words, we show using techniques from first-order logic that the total box-counting function is $k$-regular. Finally, we apply our results to prove eventual affine growth of the number of positive-dimensional irreducible components in finite projections of point-module spaces associated to semiprime monomial algebras of at most quadratic growth.
entries.title_zh: 无限词中的盒计数、自动机与点模空间
entries.summary_zh: 论文为有限字母表上的右无限词定义可延拓盒计数函数，并研究其与子移位共同延拓及点模空间几何的关系。对 k-自动词，作者用一阶逻辑方法证明总盒计数函数是 k-正则，并推出某类半素 monomial 代数点模空间投影中正维不可约分支数量最终呈仿射增长。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 自动序列、符号动力系统与非交换代数几何交叉领域读者可关注。
entries.pragmatic_review: 跨领域结构结果专业，适合相关代数与自动序列研究。
entries.cynic_review: 从自动词计数推到点模分支增长，链条明确但条件较专。
entries.paper_review: 摘要说明定义、正则性与几何应用，假设需逐条核对。

entries.source_title: Strict monotonicity of weighted inhomogeneous percolation thresholds under covering maps
entries.source_excerpt: We study Bernoulli bond percolation under weak covering maps for a class of weighted inhomogeneous product measures such that each edge $e$ carries a positive weight $w(e)$ and is open at intensity $\lambda\geq 0$ with probability $1-\exp(-\lambda w(e))$. We prove a strict monotonicity of the weighted critical intensities $\lambda_c$ in the covering compatibility setting under bounded degree, uniform ellipticity, tame fibre and disjoint tree-lifting. While for the weighted uniform connection thresholds $\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$, we establish their strict monotonicity for non-injective weak covering maps under bounded degree, covering compatibility, uniform ellipticity, bounded-fibre and disjoint tree-lifting. Moreover, we verify a general-profile theorem on strict monotonicities of the two thresholds $\lambda_c$ and $\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$ respectively under explicit compact-interval finite-energy, derivative bounds and aforementioned geometric conditions.
entries.title_zh: 覆盖映射下加权非齐次渗流阈值的严格单调性
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究弱覆盖映射下的加权非齐次 Bernoulli 键渗流，其中边 e 以 1−exp(−λw(e)) 的概率开放，并证明在有界度、均匀椭圆性、纤维受控及不交树提升等条件下，覆盖兼容图的加权临界强度 λc 严格单调。对加权一致连通阈值 λ_conn，作者在非单射弱覆盖等额外条件下也得到严格单调性，并将结论推广到满足有限能量和导数界的一般概率剖面。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合概率图论读者了解图覆盖结构如何严格改变渗流临界参数。
entries.pragmatic_review: 严格单调性可用于比较覆盖图与基图的连通阈值。
entries.cynic_review: 结论依赖多项几何与概率正则条件，弱覆盖本身并不足够。
entries.paper_review: 摘要列明两类阈值及主要条件，定理假设的相互依赖需读正文。

entries.source_title: 搜索版图被撕开一道口子：ChatGPT 抢下谷歌两成流量
entries.title_zh: ChatGPT 搜索查询量约达谷歌的 20%：另一篇 AIbase 分析
entries.summary_zh: 这篇 AIbase 报道也引用 Adam Fry 称 ChatGPT 搜索类查询约为 Google 的 20%，并援引 Pew 调查说明信息检索是美国成年人常见的 AI 用途。它进一步指出，AI 搜索可能争取新增注意力，而非简单替代传统搜索；但材料没有证明两种服务的查询口径可直接比较，且与同日另一篇报道重复这一核心数据。

entries.source_title: Motivic Invariants of Automorphisms and the Plane Cremona Group

entries.title_zh: 自同构的动机不变量与平面 Cremona 群

entries.source_title: Reinforcement Learning Unlearns Corrupted SFT Reasoning
entries.source_excerpt: We show that reinforcement learning (RL) in reasoning tasks can succeed even when the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data is severely corrupted. In a mathematical reasoning dataset (GSM8K), we systematically corrupt training trajectories across 361 configurations by injecting realistic error types, varying error locations, trace-answer consistency, and corruption ratios up to 100%. While aggregated SFT-only performance steadily deteriorates under corruption (dropping from 43.61% to 13.80%), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training consistently restores model accuracy back to gold-baseline levels (approximately 60%). Crucially, initializing RL with as few as N = 8 minimal, incorrect, three-line "form-only" traces boosts post-RL performance to 69.30%, outperforming standard gold SFT initialization (60.71%) and GRPO without SFT (35.00%). Further, we show that SFT accuracy is largely uncorrelated with post-RL accuracy (r approximately 0), demonstrating a fundamental asymmetry in post-training: SFT primarily establishes structural layout (form), while RL independently discovers functional reasoning (function).
entries.title_zh: 强化学习能够纠正被污染的监督微调推理
entries.summary_zh: 作者在 GSM8K 上以 361 种配置污染 SFT 轨迹，改变错误类型、位置、答案一致性及污染比例，最高达到 100%。SFT-only 准确率从 43.61% 降至 13.80%，而 GRPO 后训练仍恢复到约 60% 的金标准基线；仅用 8 条格式正确但内容错误的三行轨迹初始化，后续达到 69.30%，高于金标准 SFT 初始化的 60.71%，作者据此区分 SFT 学到的输出形式与 RL 学到的任务功能。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对推理模型训练数据质量与监督信号作用分工提出可检验的实验结论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 结果可能帮助训练者分离格式示范与答案监督的作用。
entries.cynic_review: 强结论来自 GSM8K、特定 GRPO 配置和污染方案，不能直接推及所有推理任务。
entries.paper_review: 系统扫描大量污染条件并报告反直觉初始化结果，但需独立复现。

entries.source_title: The Compactness Theorem for Enriched Logic
entries.source_excerpt: The framework of enriched logic extends positive logic (also known as coherent logic) from sets to structures internal to a symmetric monoidal closed category $\mathcal{V}$. This framework was developed by Rosick\'y and the second-named author. The main novelty of this logic is that the arities of the function and relation symbols are now objects in $\mathcal{V}$. We prove the compactness theorem for this enriched logic. That is, a set of $\mathcal{V}$-enriched sequents has a model (internal to $\mathcal{V}$) if every finite subset has a model. To achieve this, we define ultraproducts of enriched structures and prove enriched versions of {\L}os' theorem. We then develop some model-theoretic applications. We start with an enriched version of the model-theoretic method of diagrams, establishing a correspondence between homomorphisms whose domain is some enriched structure $A$ and models of the set $\operatorname{Diag}(A)$ of all enriched atomic formulas with parameters from $A$ that are true in $A$. entries.title_zh: 富逻辑的紧致性定理
entries.summary_zh: 论文把正逻辑（相干逻辑）推广到对称幺半闭范畴 V 内部的结构中，函数与关系符号的元数本身可以是 V 的对象，并证明相应紧致性：若一组 V-富化序列的每个有限子集都有内部模型，则整组也有模型。作者通过定义富化结构的超积并证明 Łoś 定理，再发展模型论图式方法，推出若干嵌合结果并奠定富化语法类型的基础；实例包括集合、预层拓扑、幺半群作用、阿贝尔群、富化范畴、偏序与伪度量空间。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合模型论与范畴逻辑研究者了解紧致性如何扩展至富化结构及其应用范围。
entries.pragmatic_review: 超积与 Łoś 定理提供从经典模型论迁移到富化语境的工具。
entries.cynic_review: 理论适用范围依赖 V 的范畴条件，不能把摘要中的实例视为无条件推广。
entries.paper_review: 摘要陈述定理、证明工具和应用方向，具体假设需查看论文正文。

entries.source_title: Alp\"oge's counterexample to the JC, Economic Stabilization, and Zhao's Vanishing Conjecture
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we apply stabilization techniques which are economic in the number of added dimensions to a slightly tweaked version of Alp\"oge's counterexample to JC(3) and JC(3,7). The first idea which lead to more economic stabilization is to bypass the degree 3 reduction of Bass, Connell and Wright in the construction of a counterexample to HJC(n). We construct counterexamples to HJC(15), VC(28), and HVC(30). On the other hand, we will perform degree 3 reduction after all to obtain counterexamples of low degree. We construct counterexamples to JC(12,3), HJC(18,3), VC(34,4), and HVC(36,4). As an encore, we construct a cubic-linear counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture in dimension 90. All presented counterexamples to the Jacobian Conjecture (Vanishing Conjecture) are over the (Gaussian) integers.
entries.title_zh: Alpöge 对 Jacobian 猜想反例、经济稳定化与 Zhao 消失猜想

entries.source_title: Stability of Parallel Transport Convolution under Riemannian Metric Perturbations
entries.source_excerpt: Geometric convolutions on Riemannian manifolds depend on the geometry of the underlying domain, making stability under metric perturbations a fundamental question in geometric deep learning. This paper studies this question for parallel transport convolution through methods from differential geometry and analysis. On a fixed compact manifold, we establish that, for a continuous input signal and a continuous reference kernel supported in a sufficiently small normal neighborhood, the convolution output depends continuously in $L^2$ on the Riemannian metric in the $C^2$-topology, under the specified localization and transport-path conventions. The analysis develops perturbation estimates for geodesics, parallel transport, Jacobi fields, and exponential maps, and uses these estimates to compare the transported kernels. A central difficulty is the cut locus, which obstructs uniform comparison of the transport construction over the entire manifold. entries.title_zh: 黎曼度量扰动下平行移动卷积的稳定性

entries.source_title: Embedding-Based Educational Taxonomies
entries.source_excerpt: Educational taxonomies organize educational content, such as exercise problems, into concepts, which are also called skills or knowledge components. These taxonomies define learning objectives in educational applications such as intelligent tutoring systems. Developed through human expertise and iterative refinement, they also provide fundamental structure for curricula, assessment, and models of student learning. Recent advances in semantic text embeddings make it possible to construct alternative educational taxonomies computationally from the content itself. In this paper, we investigate this possibility by clustering embeddings of math questions to construct embedding-based educational taxonomies. We compare these taxonomies with the existing Common Core State Standards (CCSS)-based knowledge-component taxonomies in two ASSISTments datasets and evaluate their utility in Deep Knowledge Tracing, a downstream task that relies on taxonomic mappings of questions to knowledge components. entries.source_title: A sound pure type system with ranks as sorts and Type-in-Type
entries.source_excerpt: We present a dependently typed pure type system that contains a circular axiom $s : s$ for a certain sort $s$ and is nonetheless strongly normalizing. Girard's paradox is avoided because our sorts are not closed under a $\Pi$-former: function types are placed in sorts according to their rank. Turns out that this system has a unique set of characteristics: it has similar normalization behaviour as STLC (so complexity of normalization is TOWER-complete) while at the same time allowing non-uniform representation of arbitrary elementary recursive functions; furthermore, it has a nontrivial set-theoretical model in ZF+GCH and allows to carry out nontrivial proof developments. Base normalization proof is surprisingly simple (modulo general metatheoretical properties of pure type systems) and has been fully formalized in vanilla Rocq (formerly Coq) without additional axioms.

entries.source_title: Automorphisms and Hodge isometries of surfaces with $K^2=p_g=1$
entries.source_excerpt: Let $S$ be a minimal complex surface of general type with $K_S^2=p_g(S)=1$. By a theorem of Catanese, the canonical model of $S$ is a complete intersection of two sextics in $\mathbf{P}(1,2,2,3,3)$ whose equations admit a normal form, and the global Torelli theorem fails for these surfaces. We describe $\operatorname{Aut}(S)$ in terms of the coefficients of the normal form, prove that $|\operatorname{Aut}(S)|\leq 72$, and classify the surfaces attaining the bound: two surfaces with singular canonical model and a one-parameter family $X_r$ of smooth surfaces. For the surfaces $X_r$ we compute a basis of the primitive cohomology consisting of eigenvectors of a subgroup $\mathbf{Z}/6\mathbf{Z} \times \mathbf{Z}/6\mathbf{Z}$ of $\operatorname{Aut}(X_r)$, given by residues of explicit polynomials, together with the intersection form in this basis. We then show that the natural map from $\operatorname{Aut}(X_r)$ to the group of Hodge isometries of the primitive lattice modulo $\pm1$ is injective but has image of index at least $331\,776$, so that the Torelli principle for automorphisms fails for these surfaces.
entries.title_zh: K²=p_g=1 曲面的自同构与 Hodge 等距

entries.source_title: The CIDOC CRM Periodic Table: Documentation You Can Test to Support the Adoption of Scientific Research Ontologies for the Humanities
entries.source_excerpt: The CIDOC CRM family is not only a schema for museum collections. Its extensions formalise the apparatus through which research knowledge is produced and justified: CRMsci models scientific observation and measurement, CRMdig the provenance of digital processes, CRMinf inference and belief. Together they constitute a schema for research data, and the obstacle to their adoption is documentary rather than theoretical: four normative documents, four code conventions, and eighty-nine typed links crossing document boundaries. This paper presents the CIDOC CRM Periodic Table, a single-page browser rendering 131 classes and 480 property entries from CIDOC CRM 7.1.3, CRMsci 3.2, CRMdig 5.0 and CRMinf 1.2.1 as one navigable surface, with two inference facilities: a one-step triple builder admitting only the class-property combinations licensed by declared domains, ranges and the subclass closure, and a multi-step path finder enumerating property chains between two classes. entries.source_title: RadonBench: A Benchmark of Classical and Learning-Guided Search Techniques for Problems in Combinatorial Geometry
entries.source_excerpt: Classical optimization and learning-guided search offer complementary approaches to open problems in discrete mathematics, but their outputs are difficult to compare when search spaces, validity checks, and stopping rules differ. We present \emph{RadonBench}, a benchmark for constructing maximum-cardinality Radon-free lattice configurations: finite subsets of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ admitting no integral Radon partition. It remains open whether Radon-free configurations with $11$ points in $\mathbb{Z}^3$ or $21$ points in $\mathbb{Z}^4$ are possible. If they exist, they would improve the corresponding lower bounds on the integer Radon numbers. We compare exhaustive extension, greedy local search, PatternBoost, AlphaZero, and AlphaEvolve. All outputs use one success predicate: a convex target-sized configuration succeeds exactly when its number of integral Radon points is zero. entries.source_title: EVA-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Evaluators for Judging Temporal Quality
entries.source_excerpt: Video evaluators play an important role in video generation, yet they miss motion defects, limiting the quality of generated videos. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) has made strong progress in mathematics and coding, where explicit verifiers provide reliable feedback on a single goal. Video evaluation poses two difficulties for RSI: it has no verifier, and it must judge many dimensions at once, such as physics, smoothness and dynamics, where a gain on one can cost another. We introduce EVA-RSI, a multi-agent framework for exploring RSI under these two constraints. We build a fixed proxy exam with construction-defined targets by applying controlled changes to videos, such as temporal reversal and frame dropping. These edits supply supervision without human annotation. A small set of human-labeled real videos anchors the exam to human judgment. Each dimension has an LLM agent that proposes improvements. A leader agent coordinates the proposals, and a Nash bargaining rule selects updates that balance progress across dimensions. entries.source_title: On the evenness of coefficients of modular forms
entries.source_excerpt: We study the density of primes such that $a_p$ is divisible by a prime above $2$ for modular forms $f = \sum_{n \ge 1} a_n q^n$ of small levels. First, we reduce the problem to low weight and odd level, or a mod $2$ CM type form. Then, we provide calculations for the evenness of particular newforms. In particular, we provide a list of levels where this "evenness" can be computed exactly for all the forms with trivial nebentypus.

entries.source_title: Generators of derived category and toric Frobenius morphism
entries.source_excerpt: We investigate the action of the toric Frobenius pushforward functor on the derived category of a toric variety. Our main goal is to characterize objects of the derived category which become generators after applying a sufficiently high Frobenius pushforward. In particular, we extend a conjecture of A.Hanlon, J.Hicks, and O.Lazarev, which describes line bundles with this property, to arbitrary equivariant objects, and prove the extended conjecture for all smooth toric varieties.

entries.source_title: Gusto: a toolkit for compatible finite element dynamical cores
entries.source_excerpt: Gusto is a tool for rapid prototyping of new algorithms based on compatible finite element methods for discretising the fluid equations in the dynamical core of weather and climate models. In this context, the development of new algorithms typically follows a path that involves testing on a hierarchy of simpler equation sets sharing important features of the mathematical structure of the equation set solved by the dynamical core. Gusto provides compatible finite element spatial discretisations of the hierarchy of equation sets, along with a range of timestepping schemes. The code is modular so that different spatial and temporal discretisations can be combined and the same schemes can be applied to any of the equation sets. This facilitates fair comparison of the schemes and makes the extension of any algorithmic developments to the more complex equation sets more straightforward. In this paper we present Gusto to the community by describing the algorithms implemented in Gusto and showcasing their performance through a variety of test problems commonly used in numerical weather prediction.

entries.source_title: An Asymptotic for Non-Wieferich Numbers
entries.source_excerpt: A cyclic number is a positive integer $n$ such that $\gcd(n, \varphi(n)) = 1$. Erd\H{o}s showed that the number of cyclic numbers up to $x$, $C(x)$, has $C(x) \sim e^{-\gamma}x/\log_3(x)$ asymptotically as $x$ tends to infinity. We define Wieferich numbers to be odd, positive integers $n$ such that $(n, (2^{\ell(n)}-1)/n) > 1$, where $\ell(n)$ is the smallest positive integer with $2^{\ell(n)} \equiv 1 \mod n$. Franco and Pomerance showed that non-Wieferich numbers have density zero among the odd integers. We show that the counting function of $n \leq x$ in the symmetric difference of non-Wieferich numbers and cyclic numbers is $O(x/(\log_3(x))^2)$, under a mild assumption on the counting function of Wieferich primes.
entries.title_zh: 非 Wieferich 数的一个渐近公式

entries.source_title: MetaRigor: From Agentic Automation to Verifiable End-to-End Meta-Analysis Through Scientific Decision Boundaries
entries.source_excerpt: Automated meta-analysis requires not only accurate numerical extraction but also the consistent preservation of result identity across stages, including the associated study, comparison, population, outcome, time point, and analysis conditions. We present MetaRigor, an LLM workflow framework for verifiable end-to-end evidence synthesis. MetaRigor organizes study results as Study x Target units and operationalizes scientific decision boundaries at the task level through Task Contracts, programmatic rules, and source binding. The model performs semantic interpretation that depends on study context, whereas programs execute formalizable rules, computations, validation, and source verification. We conducted controlled evaluations across five stages: evidence acquisition, data extraction, risk of bias assessment, certainty of evidence assessment, and manuscript generation. MetaRigor achieved an F1 score of 86.29% for complete result delivery and 80.20% agreement for domain-level certainty of evidence judgments. entries.source_title: Permutation classes need not have proper growth rates
entries.source_excerpt: By the Marcus-Tardos Theorem (formerly the Stanley-Wilf Conjecture), every permutation class other than the class of all permutations has a finite upper growth rate, meaning that the $n$th root of the number of permutations of length $n$ in the class has a finite limit superior. It has long been conjectured that this limit superior is in fact always a proper limit. We disprove this by constructing a permutation class whose upper and lower growth rates differ. The construction uses grid classes with cubic row-column graphs of increasing girth, obtained from Haar graphs of finite 2-groups. The corresponding hereditary property of ordered graphs also disproves an analogous 2006 conjecture of Balogh, Bollob\'as, and Morris. Along the way, we show that every proper permutation class with a D-finite generating function has a proper growth rate. We also establish refined enumerative bounds for grid classes, which lead to a short proof of Albert and Vatter's generalization of Bevan's Theorem on the growth rates of grid classes.

entries.source_title: Motivic $C_p$-power operations in $\mathrm{MGL}$
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we give a new proof of the Hopkins-Morel-Hoyois theorem for fields $k$ of characteristic unequal to $p$ containing all primitive $p$-power roots of unity for a fixed prime $p$. This new proof follows Quillen's proof for the structure of the homotopy groups of $\mathrm{MU}$ which utilizes topological power operations. To this end we define a motivic analog of the Steenrod power operations, using the theory of normed motivic spectra as developed by Bachmann--Hoyois and their application for the definition of motivic colimits as developed by Bachmann-Elmanto-Heller.

entries.source_title: What Outcome RL Buys: Finishing, Reliability, Rarely Reach
entries.source_excerpt: Outcome RL raises pass@1 but not pass@k at large k (Yue et al., 2025). But every pass@1 is scored under a token budget. Every recipe also trains under one. On physics and math problems at fixed token budgets, we compare the pass@1 of 20 released RL models (1.5B to 32B) with that of the thinking models they started from. We ask whether each pass@1 gain is changed behaviour or new knowledge. We divide each change in pass@1 into three parts. Finishing measures answering before the budget runs out. Reliability measures being right once finished. Reach measures problems RL solves that its base answered wrongly in all eight tries, minus problems the base solves that RL answered wrongly in all eight. We find four things. (1) Where the base often hits the token budget before answering, most of the change, gain or loss, is finishing (82% at 4k and 8k). Given more tokens, the base closes most of the finishing gap itself. (2) Where the base has enough tokens, the gain is reliability: the RL model is graded right more often, even on problems both finish. (3) By our definition, RL rarely solves what its base cannot. Reach adds at most 2.1 percenta
entries.title_zh: 结果奖励训练究竟买到什么：完成率、可靠性还是新题覆盖？
