entries.source_title: Unranking $S$-avoiding permutations with two forbidden offsets
entries.source_excerpt: Given a finite family of combinatorial objects with a total order, ranking asks for the position of a given object, and unranking asks for the object occupying a given position. Both provide algorithmic access to families too large to enumerate. Kagey gave a polynomial-time algorithm for several position-restricted families and left open the case of $\{-1,1\}$-avoiding permutations. We show that when $|S| = 2$, the graph of forbidden squares is $2$-regular, a disjoint union of cycles, and that fixing a prefix leaves only paths and untouched cycles. This yields polynomial-time prefix counting, ranking and unranking for every two-element set of offsets, covering $\{-1,1\}$. The same structure gives a short proof that the number of $\{-1,1\}$-avoiding permutations equals the $n$-th m\'enage number for odd $n$ and exceeds it by $2$ for even $n$, proving a conjecture recorded in the OEIS entry A354152.

entries.source_title: Rates of metastability for a generalization of the Halpern iteration

entries.source_title: Third-Order Weierstrass Points on Plane Quartics
entries.source_excerpt: For a smooth plane quartic $C$, the $3$-Weierstrass points are the $300$ points (counted with weights) at which some plane cubic has contact order at least ten with $C$. Revisiting the work of Kamel and Elshareef, we write the third Veronese Wronskian as an $\text{SL}_3$-covariant form $\Omega_3$ of degree $75$, given by a determinant of iterated Hamiltonian derivatives, and explain the special $3$-Weierstrass points through contact cubics and homologies preserving $C$. We determine $\Omega_3$ for the Fermat, Komiya--Kuribayashi, Klein and Picard quartics; for the Klein quartic $\Omega_3\equiv\Phi_6^2\,\Phi_{21}\,(3\Phi_{14}^3+21962\,\Phi_6^7)$ modulo the curve, up to a non-zero scalar. Finally, the dectactic points of the Fermat quartic are not $4$-Weierstrass points, which disproves a conjecture of Kamel and Elshareef. All computations are supported by \texttt{SINGULAR} scripts.

entries.source_title: Analytification and tropicalization via hyperfields and definable types
entries.source_excerpt: We study the analytification and tropicalization of algebraic varieties over valued fields via Jun's spaces of hyperfield points. Our main new objects are a family of power-tropical hyperfields $H_n$ and their inverse limit $H$, recording at each level the class of a leading term modulo $n$-th powers of the residue field. They yield an enhanced tropicalization of the associated space $X(H)$, strictly finer than the Berkovich one exactly when the multiplicative group of the residue field is non-divisible: it specialises to the Berkovich analytification when the residue field is algebraically closed, to the real analytification of Jell-Scheiderer-Yu when it is real closed, and to a new $p$-adic analytification when it is $p$-adically closed. Over henselian valued fields of equicharacteristic $0$ we then construct a model-theoretic avatar of $X(H)$: the space $\widehat{X}_T$ of definable types orthogonal to the value group, which sharpens the geometry in the spirit of Hrushovski and Loeser and recovers their space over algebraically closed valued fields. entries.source_title: ParetoM$^3$: Learning on the Pareto Set under Preference Guidance via Min-Max-Min Optimization
entries.source_excerpt: Learning across multiple inherently conflicting objectives requires selecting desirable trade-offs from the Pareto set. In this work, we study preference-guided multi-objective optimization, where a predefined preference function is minimized over the weak Pareto set of multiple nonconvex objectives. Leveraging a merit function that vanishes on the weak Pareto set, we propose a penalty-based min-max-min formulation, termed the M$^3$ problem, which unifies preference optimization and the enforcement of weak Pareto optimality in a single objective. We further develop ParetoM$^3$, a single-loop first-order algorithm for computing stationary solutions of the resulting M$^3$ problem. Under a local Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz assumption, we prove that ParetoM$^3$ finds an $\epsilon$-stationary point of the M$^3$ problem that is also approximately weakly Pareto optimal for the original multi-objective problem when the penalty parameter is sufficiently large, with explicit non-asymptotic convergence rates. We also show that this stationarity notion recovers existing optimality criteria, including approximate preference stationarity and approximate Ka
entries.title_zh: ParetoM³：用偏好引导的 min-max-min 优化多目标权衡

entries.source_title: Geometry-Aware Latent Representation Learning for Drag Coefficient Prediction of Irregular Particles
entries.source_excerpt: Predicting the drag coefficient $C_\mathrm{d}$ of irregular particles requires representing their complex three-dimensional geometry in a form suitable for predictive models. Empirical drag correlations and many data-driven models represent particle geometry through a small set of hand-crafted shape descriptors. Geometric differences omitted by these descriptors are unavailable to the predictor. We propose a variational autoencoder-multilayer perceptron (VAE-MLP) framework that learns a latent representation directly from voxelized particle geometry. Geometry reconstruction and drag coefficient prediction jointly guide the learning of this representation. We compare VAE-MLP with a descriptor-based MLP (Descriptor-MLP) and established empirical correlations using CFD data for synthetic particle geometries at Reynolds numbers of 10--200. When the evaluated geometric variations are represented in the training data, the two learned models achieve comparable accuracy for regular ellipsoids, while VAE-MLP yields lower errors for irregular particles. entries.title_zh: 面向不规则颗粒阻力预测的几何感知潜在表示
entries.summary_zh: 作者提出 VAE-MLP，从体素化三维颗粒几何学习潜在表示，并联合训练几何重建与阻力系数预测；在 Re=10–200 的合成颗粒 CFD 数据上与形状描述符模型及经验关联式比较。规则椭球表现相近，不规则颗粒上潜在模型误差更低；训练中排除高阶表面扰动时，模型在五次测试中均优于描述符模型，最强扰动下相对误差为 4.97% 对 9.88%。

entries.source_title: Domains of attraction of quasi-stationary distributions for an absorbed random walk
entries.source_excerpt: We study a continuous-time random walk on the positive integers, killed at zero, where the downward rate $a$ and upward rate $b$ satisfy $a>b>0$. Its quasi-stationary distributions form a one-parameter family. We show that if the initial distribution $(m_n)_{n\geq 1}$ is strictly positive and satisfies $m_{n+1}/m_n\to r$, where $(b/a)^{1/2}<1$, then its conditional distribution given survival converges in total variation to the corresponding nonminimal quasi-stationary distribution. We obtain asymptotic equivalents for the joint probabilities of position and survival, and for the survival probability itself. We also give a moment condition under which the minimal quasi-stationary distribution is selected. Finally, we construct an initial distribution whose successive-term ratios do not converge but whose conditional distribution nevertheless converges to a nonminimal quasi-stationary distribution. Thus the ratio condition is sufficient but not necessary.
entries.title_zh: 吸收随机游走准平稳分布的吸引域
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究在 0 处被杀死、向下速率 a 大于向上速率 b 的连续时间随机游走，其准平稳分布构成一参数族。若初始概率质量比 mₙ₊₁/mₙ 收敛到指定区间内的 r，则给定尚未灭绝后，条件分布在全变差距离下趋于对应的非最小准平稳分布；作者还给出选择最小分布的矩条件，并构造比例不收敛但仍收敛的例子。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 细化吸收链准平稳极限的初始条件，并证明常见比值条件并非必要。
entries.pragmatic_review: 研究长期存活条件分布时可参考其吸引域判据。
entries.cynic_review: 速率和准平稳族结论依赖向下漂移及正初始质量条件。
entries.paper_review: 摘要兼有充分条件、矩条件和反例构造。

entries.source_title: Combating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Domain Adaptation via Knowledge Recasting
entries.source_excerpt: Adapting language models to new domains during post-training risks degrading previously acquired capabilities, a phenomenon commonly known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation methods largely treat forgetting as a consequence of excessive model drift. They therefore constrain updates by preserving old outputs, replaying old data, or regularizing changes to parameters and representations so that the updated model remains close to its previous state. We take a different view: Rather than pulling the updated model back toward its old state, we translate the new domain into the model's pre-existing knowledge space, making unfamiliar knowledge learnable through familiar procedures. Therefore, we propose Skill Schema Transport (SST), a post-training framework that transports new knowledge into the model's existing skill space. SST abstracts each example type into a skill schema, preserving its essential operations, dependencies, and verification steps while removing domain-specific surface forms. By recasting new examples as instances of reusable procedures, SST turns knowledge update from trajectory memorization into procedural
entries.title_zh: 通过知识重述缓解持续领域适配遗忘
entries.summary_zh: 持续领域适配会让语言模型学习新领域时遗忘既有能力；常见方法通过回放旧数据、保持旧输出或限制参数漂移来约束更新。本文改换视角，不把新知识硬塞进旧模型状态，而是把新领域内容“重述”为模型已有知识空间中更容易学习的形式；摘要未提供具体重述算法细节和实验量化，故不能据此断言优于传统保持方法。

entries.paper_review: 问题视角有新意，但本批可见材料不足以评价技术细节。

entries.source_title: Extreme value statistics for majorisation partial orders
entries.source_excerpt: We study extreme-value phenomena for random samples in partially ordered sets through their meets and joins, the order-theoretic analogues of minima and maxima. In this paper we consider the probability simplex equipped with either UT-majorisation or majorisation, with samples drawn uniformly from the corresponding simplex. We analyse these extrema both at fixed dimension and as the dimension grows, identifying almost-sure collapse to the bottom or top elements and critical scalings with nondegenerate limiting laws.

entries.source_title: A sporadic simplicial arrangement of $51$ lines
entries.source_excerpt: We construct a sporadic simplicial arrangement of $51$ lines in the real projective plane. It is obtained from the icosahedral arrangement $\mathcal{A}(21,2)$ by adjoining the $30$ images of the line $y+\sqrt{\varphi}\,z=0$ under the rotation group of the icosahedron, where $\varphi=(1+\sqrt5)/2$. Its intersection multiplicities are $t_2=120$, $t_3=190$, $t_5=36$, and $t_6=15$, with all other $t_r$ zero. These counts give equality in Melchior's inequality and hence prove simpliciality. The arrangement is irreducible, belongs to neither of the two known infinite families of irreducible simplicial arrangements, and is not supersolvable. It therefore disproves the $37$-line bound for sporadic arrangements conjectured by Cuntz and M\"ucksch. We give explicit coordinates, a finite incidence certificate, a geometric explanation of the parameter $\sqrt{\varphi}$, and a standalone exact-arithmetic verifier.
entries.title_zh: 实射影平面上一组含 51 条直线的孤立单纯排列

entries.source_title: Symbolic Abstraction Refinement
entries.source_excerpt: Autonomous systems choose actions whose outcomes are uncertain and are subject to time constraints. Probabilistic timed automata (PTAs) model exactly this, and verifying one answers a question about the system's decision-making: the maximum probability of reaching a goal, or the minimum probability of reaching a hazard, that a controller can guarantee. entries.title_zh: 概率时间自动机的符号抽象细化方法
entries.summary_zh: SYMAR 面向概率时间自动机，通过保留符号状态并细化值函数区域来逼近模型行为，避免反复重建状态空间或直接拆分状态。该方法将抽象细化重点放在数值函数表示上；可见材料未完整提供误差界与基准结果，适用规模还需以论文实验为准。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 形式化验证研究者可关注它对状态爆炸与值函数近似的处理思路。
entries.pragmatic_review: 先拿已有验证模型对照，检查区域细化是否减少状态开销。
entries.cynic_review: 避免拆状态听起来省事，精度和最坏复杂度尚未见全。
entries.paper_review: 摘录只展示算法方向，误差保证和实验没有完整呈现。

entries.source_title: On Hilbert's tenth problem for number fields
entries.source_excerpt: Given a quadratic number field $K$ we show that the $abc$ conjecture over $K$ implies that $\mathbb{Z}$ is Diophantine in $K$ and, hence, a negative answer to Hilbert's tenth problem over $K$. More generally, the same conclusions hold for an arbitrary number field $K$ provided that the $abc$ conjecture holds over $K$ and that there is an elliptic curve over $\mathbb{Q}$ whose rank is positive and does not increase over $K$.
entries.title_zh: 数域上的希尔伯特第十问题
entries.summary_zh: 论文给出一个条件性结果：若二次数域 K 上的 abc 猜想成立，则整数环 Z 在 K 中是 Diophantine 集，因而希尔伯特第十问题在 K 上有否定答案。对一般数域，作者还要求 abc 猜想成立且存在一条定义在 Q 上、正秩在扩域 K 中不增加的椭圆曲线；因此结论依赖尚未证明的 abc 猜想及附加条件。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 数论与数理逻辑研究者可关注 abc 猜想如何转化为数域中不可判定性的条件性证明。
entries.pragmatic_review: 逻辑后果重大但尚非无条件定理，因为核心 abc 假设仍未解决。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要明确是条件性蕴含，不能据此宣称希尔伯特第十问题已在这些数域无条件解决。
entries.paper_review: 假设、Diophantine 可定义性和不可判定结论链条清楚，技术构造需查正文。

entries.source_title: BBOWP-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Black-Box Optimization Word Problems
entries.source_excerpt: Formulating an optimization problem strongly affects final solution quality, yet good formulations usually require substantial expertise. Recent studies have explored automatically deriving optimization problems from natural-language descriptions, but existing benchmarks focus on settings where objectives and constraints can be written explicitly as mathematical expressions. Many practically important problems are naturally treated as black-box optimization (BBO) problems, in which only objective values are observable, and the functional form is unavailable. In BBO, search space design (as part of problem formulation) and optimization algorithm selection are crucial for problem-solving. Automating these processes with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging. We introduce Black-Box Optimization Word Problems (BBOWP), a novel problem setting in which a system must infer both a search space and an optimization algorithm from a natural-language description of a black-box optimization task. To support research on this setting, we establish the BBOWP Benchmark Suite (BBOWP-Bench), a dataset and evaluation framework for BBOWP. E
entries.title_zh: BBOWP-Bench：黑箱优化文字问题基准
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出 Black-Box Optimization Word Problems 基准，要求系统从自然语言任务描述中同时推断搜索空间和优化算法，而目标函数只能通过查询获得。作者指出现有自然语言优化基准多假设目标与约束可显式写出，难以覆盖黑箱优化中的建模环节；新基准旨在测量 LLM 从描述到优化方案的能力。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把优化建模本身纳入评测，补足仅测试显式数学公式求解的基准缺口。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合检验模型能否把业务描述转成可执行黑箱搜索任务。
entries.cynic_review: 基准表现仍取决于任务覆盖、答案判定和查询预算设计。
entries.paper_review: 问题定义有针对性，需阅读全文核实规模与基线设置。

entries.source_title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Clinical Decision Support in Gait Analysis: A Proof-of-Concept
entries.source_excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate significant potential for clinical decision support but lack specialized biomechanical knowledge required for accurate gait analysis interpretation. We developed and evaluated a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework to enhance LLM-generated clinical explanations for ankle fracture rehabilitation using ground reaction force data. Using the GaitRec dataset (503 subjects: 211 healthy, 292 ankle fracture patients), we implemented a five-stage pipeline integrating: (1) machine learning classification (91.3\% accuracy); (2) Layer-wise Relevance Propagation for explainable feature identification; (3) RAG knowledge base from peer-reviewed biomechanics literature; (4) GPT-5 explanation generation with and without retrieval augmentation; and (5) double-blind evaluation by experienced physical therapists across five clinical criteria. RAG augmentation produced statistically significant improvements in Clini-cal Benefit (mean difference=0.60, p=0.047, {\delta}=0.49) and Completeness (mean difference=0.70, p=0.049, {\delta}=0.49), both demonstrating large effect sizes. Baseline GPT-5 achieved stron
entries.title_zh: 步态分析临床决策支持中的检索增强生成：概念验证
entries.summary_zh: 研究者用 503 名健康者及踝部骨折患者的 GaitRec 数据构建五阶段流程，结合步态分类、特征解释、文献检索和 GPT-5 临床说明，并由物理治疗师盲评。摘要报告加入 RAG 后“临床获益”和“完整性”评分分别提高 0.60 与 0.70，p 值约 0.05；这是临床解释的概念验证，不证明患者结局或治疗效果改善。

entries.pragmatic_review: 可作为构建受专业人员评估的临床 RAG 原型的参考。
entries.cynic_review: 样本规模和接近显著性阈值的评分差异不足以证明临床有效性。
entries.paper_review: 包含双盲专业评估，但需查全文了解判分、置信区间和外部验证。

entries.paper_review: 榜单及医疗案例来自厂商发布，需在目标语言和录音环境实测。

entries.source_title: On Niu's Conjecture for Two-Station Tandem Queues
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we prove a long standing conjecture in queueing theory made by Niu (1980): in a two-station tandem queueing system with constant service time (c) at station 1, the stationary average waiting time at station 2 is nonincreasing in c. Two very different proofs are provided: one for the general case and one for a special case in which the arrival process is Poisson and the service time at station 2 is exponential.
entries.title_zh: Niu 双站串联队列猜想的证明
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明 Niu 于 1980 年提出的双站串联队列猜想：若第一站服务时间为常数 c，则第二站稳态平均等待时间随 c 增大而不增。作者提供两种不同证明，一种处理一般情形，另一种针对到达过程为 Poisson 且第二站服务时间为指数分布的特例。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合排队论读者关注上游服务时长如何影响下游拥堵，以及经典单调性猜想的证明方法。
entries.pragmatic_review: 单调关系可用于分析串联系统中的服务配置与等待时间。
entries.cynic_review: 结论针对稳态平均等待时间，不能直接推出其他绩效指标也单调。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确主猜想与两种证明适用范围，技术假设需读全文。

entries.source_title: Soliton Profiles in 1D: Enhanced Neural-Network Solvers and Constrained Deep Ritz Methods
entries.source_excerpt: We develop and compare enhanced neural-network solvers for one-dimensional ground-state profiles, which are solutions of $$ Q^{\prime\prime}=bQ-\gamma Q^{p},\quad Q>0,\quad p>1, \quad b, \gamma >0, $$ the stationary profile equation for the nonlinear Schr\"odinger, generalized Korteweg-de Vries, and nonlinear Klein-Gordon equations. Its explicit sech-type solutions serve as exact reference for error computation and benchmark hyperparameter selection. We improve on the standard Adam-trained physics-informed neural network (PINN) baseline by introducing higher-order optimization via Gauss-Newton/Levenberg-Marquardt and L-BFGS refinements, as well as Fourier-feature PINNs, and constrained Deep Ritz (DR) formulations. In DR approaches we introduce two new neural-network formulations, which implement two classical variational characterizations: a Nehari-constrained Deep Ritz method, in which the height is learned by projecting onto the Nehari/Pokhozhaev manifold, and a Weinstein Deep Ritz method, in which a normalized profile minimizes the Weinstein quotient. entries.title_zh: 一维孤子剖面的增强神经网络与约束 Deep Ritz 求解
entries.summary_zh: 论文求解非线性薛定谔、广义 KdV 与非线性 Klein–Gordon 方程的一维基态剖面常微分方程，并以已知 sech 型显式解评估误差和选择超参数。作者改进 Adam-PINN 基线，比较 Gauss–Newton/Levenberg–Marquardt 与 L-BFGS 精化、Fourier 特征 PINN，以及加入约束的 Deep Ritz 方法；评估重点是训练优化与物理约束对求解精度的影响。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 使用可计算真解作基准，比较多种神经 PDE 求解器改进策略。

entries.paper_review: 提供精确参考解并系统比较优化和约束设计。

entries.title_zh: 大 k-交叉自由集合族

entries.source_title: A new infinite family of covers of complete graphs that admit a half-transitive action of a Suzuki simple group
entries.source_excerpt: We construct a new infinite family of antipodal $2(q-1)$-covers of complete graphs $K_{q^2+1}$ of diameter $3$, where $q=2^{2e+1}\ge 8$, admitting a half-transitive action of the Suzuki simple group $Sz(q)$. We further show that each constructed cover admits an involutory automorphism interchanging the two $Sz(q)$-orbits on arcs, which yields that its full automorphism group is arc-transitive.
entries.title_zh: Suzuki 单群作用下的完全图新覆盖族
entries.summary_zh: 作者构造一族直径为 3 的反极 2(q−1)-重覆盖图，覆盖 K_{q²+1}，其中 q=2^{2e+1}≥8，并允许 Suzuki 单群 Sz(q) 的半传递作用。另证明存在交换弧上两个 Sz(q) 轨道的 involution，因此完整自同构群在有向边上可传递。

entries.source_title: Who Speaks, Who Authorizes, Who Acts? Understanding Trust Boundaries in Multi-Agent LLMs
entries.source_excerpt: Multi-agent LLM systems exchange messages before acting through tools, but message delivery, signing authority, and tool-side enforcement are separate trust boundaries. We represent them as communication, authorization, and execution structures, and use the authority cut to characterize the smallest independently compromised signer coalition that can construct a policy-valid false-claim proof under stated assumptions. Controlled paired hidden-state studies reveal four distinctions. First, no fixed-message routing contrast across four models meets the prespecified large-effect criterion; when relays rewrite messages, executed false-state action rates vary by model and route configuration. Second, presented source-identity cues do not uniformly increase protected-action selection across three models. Third, on invalid-proof cases, Nemotron and Llama request protected actions in 52.1% and 54.2% of trials, respectively, yet a deterministic tool gate commits none: request-level and commitment-level safety readouts diverge. entries.title_zh: 多智能体 LLM 中谁发言、谁授权、谁执行？

entries.source_title: Closed maximal eventually different families for $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^0_3$ and weakly Farah ideals
entries.source_excerpt: Motivated by the existence of closed maximal $\mathcal{I}$-eventually different ($\mathcal{I}$-MED) families, we study uniform combinatorial properties of ideals. For a fixed ideal, a property is uniform if its witnesses can be chosen by a single Borel map. We prove that every $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^0_3$ ideal is uniformly weakly $P^+$. We also prove that the classes of Farah and weakly Farah ideals coincide, answering a question of Hru\v{s}\'ak and Meza-Alc\'antara. We then show that every weakly Farah ideal is uniformly weakly Ramsey. As an application, we obtain closed $\mathcal{I}$-MED families for $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^0_3$ ideals and weakly Farah ideals.
entries.title_zh: Σ⁰₃ 理想的闭极大最终不同族

entries.source_title: Functorial height and Orlov's rationality conjecture
entries.source_excerpt: An exceptional collection in the derived category of a smooth projective variety may fail to generate the whole category, and this failure cannot be detected by K-theory or by Hochschild homology. Kuznetsov's height detects it through Hochschild cohomology, that is, through natural transformations from the identity functor to its shifts. We replace the identity functor by an arbitrary endofunctor $F$ and define the height of a collection with coefficient $F$. It controls, in a range of degrees, the restriction of natural transformations $\mathrm{id}\to F$ to the orthogonal complement of the collection, and it is computed from the collection by a finite complex. For collections of line bundles on surfaces whose Hom divisors have nonnegative canonical degree, the tensor product with a skyscraper sheaf has height exactly two, and the projections of skyscraper sheaves form a two-dimensional family of point-like objects in the orthogonal complement. entries.title_zh: 函子化高度与 Orlov 有理性猜想

entries.source_title: The generalized Dixmier conjecture and the two-dimensional Jacobian conjecture
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that the two-dimensional Jacobian conjecture $\mathrm{JC}_2$ implies the generalized Dixmier conjecture $\mathrm{DC}'_1$ for the first Weyl algebra $A_1$, which states, in one of several equivalent formulations, that every endomorphism of the two-by-two matrix ring $\operatorname{Mat}_2(A_1)$ is invertible. For the converse, an endomorphism of $\mathbb A^2_{\mathbb C}$ with Jacobian one gives rise to a family of holonomic $A_2$-modules over finite fields. One needs to lift this family to an $A_2$-module in characteristic zero with the prescribed arithmetic support. The existence of such a lift is a special case of Kontsevich's conjecture on holonomic $\mathcal D$-modules with prescribed arithmetic support. We prove that in this special situation such a lift is unique whenever it exists. If these lifts exists for every endomorphism with Jacobian one, then $\mathrm{DC}'_1$ implies $\mathrm{JC}_2$. For every $n\ge 3$, we construct a Lagrangian subvariety of $T^*\mathbb{A}^n$ that provides a counterexample to Kontsevich's conjecture. entries.title_zh: 广义 Dixmier 猜想与二维 Jacobian 猜想的联系

entries.source_title: Opposite filtrations on the parabolic compactified Jacobian
entries.source_excerpt: We show that the Hikita filtration on the cohomology of the parabolic compactified Jacobian of the plane curve singularity $x^m=y^n$, $(m,n)=1$, is opposite to the perverse filtration in a precise sense. This implies the parabolic Hilb-vs-Quot conjecture from https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.19633, and consequently the main conjecture from https://arxiv.org/abs/1201.2115 for these singularities. The new ingredient is an analysis of how the Bott-Mitchell filtration on the homology of the affine Grassmannian of $SL_n$ relates to both of the above filtrations.
entries.title_zh: 抛物紧化 Jacobian 上的相反滤过
entries.summary_zh: 对互素 m、n 的平面曲线奇点 xᵐ=yⁿ，作者证明抛物紧化 Jacobian 上的 Hikita 滤过与上同调的 perverse 滤过互为相反滤过。由此推出该类奇点的抛物 Hilb-vs-Quot 猜想及相关主猜想；关键新步骤是分析 SLₙ 仿射 Grassmannian 同调上的 Bott–Mitchell 滤过与前两种滤过的关系。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 用滤过之间的精确关系推出几何表示论中的猜想，是紧密连接代数几何与仿射 Grassmannian 的结果。

entries.paper_review: 把三种滤过的比较转化为猜想推论，数学结构和适用范围清楚。

entries.source_title: "Deep lifts": Neural networks can generalize even with the dumbest optimizer
entries.source_excerpt: Given a labeled dataset $\{(x_i, y_i)\}_{i = 1}^n$, consider drawing a parameter vector $\hat{\theta}$ uniformly at random from those that interpolate the data within a width-$W$ depth-$D$ ReLU architecture with continuous weights bounded within $[-M, M]$. We study the generalization properties of $\hat{\theta}$ in the case where the dataset can, in fact, be explained by a smaller $w$-by-$d$ ReLU network. Despite the obliviousness of the selection rule for $\hat{\theta}$, it adaptively generalizes at the rate $\tilde O\left(\frac{wdWD}{n}\right)$, rather than being governed by the VC dimension of the full $W$-by-$D$ hypothesis class. The reason is due to a particular inductive bias in ReLU networks: the $w$-by-$d$ parameter *witnesses* an exponential volume of $W$-by-$D$ interpolating parameters, which dwarfs the volume of poorly generalizing parameters (conditioned on interpolation). We explicitly construct this set of near-equivalent $W$-by-$D$ parameters by a proof technique called *deep lifting*, and then tie the achievable volume to stability properties of the $w$-by-$d$ witness. Examples show that these techniques allow us to co
entries.title_zh: “深层提升”：即使优化器很笨，神经网络也能泛化
entries.summary_zh: 研究在可插值的宽深 ReLU 网络参数中均匀随机选取解时，若数据本可由更小网络解释，泛化误差仍可按小网络规模而非整个假设类 VC 维度控制。作者用 deep lifting 构造大量近似等价的大网络参数，说明小网络见证解对应的良好插值参数体积可能压过泛化差的解。

entries.pragmatic_review: 结果挑战“随机插值必然按大模型复杂度泛化”的直觉。
entries.cynic_review: 结论依赖数据可由较小 ReLU 网络解释及特定均匀抽样设定。
entries.paper_review: 理论主张清晰，速率中的维度因子和适用条件需阅读全文。

entries.summary_zh: 这是为 ComfyUI 重新打包的 FLUX 3 Image Klein 图像生成与编辑模型文件，支持文本生成、单图编辑和最多10张参考图的多图组合，并可在提示中用边界框引导元素位置。页面建议先用 prompt upsampler 将简短请求扩写成完整场景描述，并给出不同精度文件大小及显卡提示；仓库需要接受访问条件，模型使用 FLUX Kommunity License。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对需要本地 ComfyUI 图像生成或多参考图编辑的个人用户，模型将生成、编辑和布局引导放在同一工作流中，且材料列出了量化版本与文件配置，便于按硬件规划。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可按显存和硬件选择精度版本，先从 ComfyUI 提供的工作流及 prompt upsampler 入手测试生成和编辑效果。
entries.cynic_review: 页面称 int8 文件可运行于8 GB显存显卡，但完整工作流还需要文本编码器、prompt upsampler 和自动编码器，实际资源需求不应只看主模型文件。
entries.paper_review: 材料给出模型组成、采样参数、文件大小和使用说明，但没有独立基准或可复核的效果评估，且文件访问需先接受条件。

project_insight.translation_zh: FLUX 3 Image Klein 是一个 5.6B 参数的图像模型，可根据提示生成图像并编辑图像，支持最多10张参考图；其中5.6B指图像 Transformer，文本编码器另计。这个仓库为 ComfyUI 重新打包了 distilled 和 base Transformer、文本编码器、prompt upsampler 和图像自动编码器，提供 BF16、int8、NVFP4 等版本。模型支持文本生成、单参考图编辑、多参考图生成、提示中的边界框布局引导和图像内文字渲染。页面建议始终使用 prompt upsampler 或其他 LLM 将短提示扩写成完整场景描述；边界框只是位置与尺度引导，不是硬像素蒙版。模型采用 FLUX Kommunity License，仓库文件需接受 Hugging Face 访问条件后获取。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 一套面向 ComfyUI 的 FLUX 3 Image Klein 模型文件，可用文字、参考图和提示中的边界框生成或编辑图像。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读 Hugging Face 模型卡和 FLUX Kommunity License，确认是否符合访问与使用条件；根据显卡选择 checkpoint 和精度版本，按模型卡将所需文件放入 ComfyUI 对应目录，再导入官方工作流并保留 prompt upsampler。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 仓库文件访问需先接受 Hugging Face 条件；许可为 FLUX Kommunity License，页面描述其允许非商业使用，并为符合条件的用户提供受条款约束的商业输出例外。边界框不构成硬蒙版，参考图也不会锁定结构；模型倾向完整场景描述，短提示可能产生泛化结果。文件体积较大，主模型之外还需文本编码器、prompt upsampler 和自动编码器。
use_cases_zh: 在本地 ComfyUI 中根据文字生成图像，并用完整场景提示控制构图。
通过多张参考图合成画面，或对单张图像进行提示式编辑。
用提示中的边界框引导元素的位置和大小，制作需要初步布局控制的图片。

entries.source_title: On the number of elite primes
entries.source_excerpt: A prime $p$ is elite if all sufficiently large Fermat numbers $F_n=2^{2^n}+1$ are quadratic nonresidues modulo $p$. Let $E(x)$ be the number of elite primes up to $x$. The best published bounds are $E(x)\ll x/(\log x)^{3/2}$ unconditionally and $E(x)\ll x^{5/6}$ under the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis (GRH), both due to Just. Just and Pollack remarked, without a written proof, that sorting primes by the exact power of $2$ dividing $p-1$ should give $x/(\log x)^{2-\varepsilon}$ and $x^{3/4+\varepsilon}$. We give complete proofs of slightly sharper statements: $E(x)\le(16+o(1))x\log\log x/(\log x)^2$ unconditionally, and $E(x)\ll x^{3/4}(\log x)^{1/2}$ under GRH. We also recall, with short proofs, known facts about the period of $(F_n\bmod p)$ that go back to Aigner: every elite prime $p$ satisfies the defining condition from the index $v_2(\operatorname{ord}_p 2)$ onwards, and the period is even unless $p\in\{3,5\}$. Finally, we show under GRH that, when the moduli involved are at most $x^{1/3}$, the set of primes bounded by the sieve argument has size $\asymp x\log\log x/(\log x)^2$. entries.title_zh: 关于 elite 素数的数量
entries.summary_zh: 论文将 elite 素数定义为：所有充分大的费马数在该素数模下都是二次非剩余，并改进其计数上界。作者给出无条件界 E(x)≤(16+o(1))x loglog x/(log x)²，GRH 下为 E(x)≪x³ᐟ⁴(log x)¹ᐟ²；文中还指出筛法在其设定下仍产生 loglog x 因子，并说明无法靠该方法消去。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把此前未写成完整证明的猜测型上界转化为严格数量估计，并区分无条件与 GRH 结果。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合关注费马数剩余性质和筛法上界的数论读者。
entries.cynic_review: GRH 下界需保留假设，筛法仍有 loglog 因子。
entries.paper_review: 同时交代形式化 Lean 证明与方法本身的限制，研究脉络完整。

entries.source_title: Semistable 1-Motives: Monodromy, Explicit Periods, and Local Duality
entries.source_excerpt: Let $K/\mathbf Q_p$ be unramified, with $p>2$. For a $1$-motive with constant lattice, split torus, and good abelian quotient, we compute the semistable extension complex from toric valuations and formal-group logarithms. A canonical monodromy boundary exists for every semistable representation; it detects splitting over crystalline periods and the increase in monodromy rank. For the stated $1$-motives, this boundary and the unramified quotient recover the restricted local Tate pairing, with exponential radicals. Nonsplit elliptic examples, Raynaud uniformization, and a height-one positive-period bound explain the geometric range. For toric motives we construct actual periods, convergent Robba bases, and integral action matrices. A toric basis family has perfect projective/trace-zero matrix duality, including its exact integral defect. An explicit residue-zero solution operator constructs every dual Herr class. Applied componentwise, the same operator gives relative full dual lifts for general constant-lattice $1$-motives once their coefficient sequence is specified. entries.title_zh: 半稳定 1-动机的单值作用、显式周期与局部对偶
entries.summary_zh: 论文在 p>2 且底域为非分歧扩张等条件下，研究带常值格、分裂环面和良好阿贝尔商的半稳定 1-动机，利用环面赋值和形式群对数计算其扩张复形。作者构造单值边界以检测晶体周期上的分裂及单值秩变化，并在环面情形给出显式周期、可收敛 Robba 基和积分作用矩阵。

entries.source_title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data. We trace the word through open models' training histories, reading it with label-free indices of frequency, position, form and usage and an injected-error test, all computed from sampled outputs. We find that zero-RL almost never coins the marker: on bases that lack the word, RL raises MATH-500 accuracy substantially while {wait} stays near absent. It arrives with training data: mid-training in OLMo-3, and fine-tuning on reasoning traces installs it in most models whose base lacks it. Where the base already uses it, both released RL-Zero recipes (OLMo-3, MiMo) multiply it, whereas KL-free GRPO from the same base does not; OLMo-3's recipe wears down its form and makes it a more sensitive but more liberal alarm; RL after supervised fine-tuning barely changes it, and our GRPO recipe erases a marker seeded by fine-tuning. entries.source_title: Same Beliefs, Different Policies: Learning Reusable Representations for Early Stopping in LLM Reasoning
entries.source_excerpt: Reasoning LLMs often continue reasoning after reaching a correct answer, wasting computation and sometimes replacing it with an incorrect one. Deciding when to stop is a metareasoning problem: the model must weigh what further reasoning could achieve against its cost, given what it can already answer. Direct utility training learns a stopping representation at a chosen token price; supporting new prices can require additional controller training. We introduce BELT (BELief-based Termination), which separates outcome prediction from stopping control. It learns beliefs about current and future answers from a frozen LLM's hidden states, then fits a linear stopping policy on the frozen features. The prediction targets are independent of token price, so one probe supports different accuracy-cost trade-offs through CPU policy refitting or threshold adjustment. Averaged over five out-of-distribution (OOD) math benchmarks, BELT reduces generated tokens by 41% on Qwen3-1.7B and 51% on OLMo-3-7B-Think without loss of accuracy. entries.title_zh: BELT：把推理结果预测与提前停止策略分离
entries.summary_zh: BELT 从冻结模型隐藏状态预测当前和未来答案，再训练线性停止策略，使同一表征可通过阈值或 CPU 重拟合适配不同 token 成本。摘要报告两个模型在五个分布外数学集平均减少约四成和五成 token 且准确率无损；结论限于所测模型与任务。

entries.source_title: Complete Determination of the Gallai--van der Waerden Number \(\mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)\)
entries.source_excerpt: This paper completely determines the Gallai--van der Waerden number \(\mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)\) for all integers \(r\ge 3\): \[ \mathrm{GW}(3;3,3)=\mathrm{GW}(4;3,3)=9,\qquad \mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)=r\quad (r\ge 5). \]
entries.title_zh: Gallai–van der Waerden 数 GW(r;3,3) 的完整公式
entries.summary_zh: 摘要声称完整确定该组合数在所有整数 r≥3 时的取值：r 为三或四时均为九，r≥5 时等于 r。当前摘要仅列结果，没有给出数的定义细节、上下界构造或证明方法。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合追踪 Ramsey 型着色阈值的精确结果。

entries.cynic_review: 精确公式需结合定义和证明核验。
entries.paper_review: 可关注小参数例外与一般情形的分界。

entries.source_title: Five Architectures, One Shared Space Cross-Model Representational Alignment Without Weight Merging
entries.source_excerpt: Combining language models is usually done by averaging weights, which works only when the models share a common starting point. We ask whether five frozen, independently trained models with different internal designs (four transformers from four organizations and one state-space model) can be related through their activations alone, with no weight merging. Using permutation tests, an independent replication probe set, depth sweeps, pooling ablations and confound checks, we find statistically robust correspondence between how the five models organize the same text. It is strongest at each model's final layer and weaker for the state-space model, whose weakest pairing is still 35-43 times chance. We use this to build a shared space with Generalized Procrustes Analysis, in which no model is a fixed reference. At the final layer, mean held-out retrieval accuracy over the twenty ordered model pairs is 0.91 to 0.93 on two probe sets (chance 0.03), beating pairwise linear maps (0.82 to 0.85), but the space is worse than those maps in the middle layers. entries.title_zh: 五种架构共享表示空间：不合并权重也能对齐模型
entries.summary_zh: 研究五个独立训练、架构不同的模型能否仅凭激活表示对齐。通过置换检验、独立探针集和混杂检查，作者发现模型间结构对应显著；用广义 Procrustes 建公共空间后，末层留出检索准确率约 0.91–0.93，优于成对线性映射，但中间层较差，且数学文本上对齐失败。

entries.paper_review: 数学文本失败说明共享空间并非普适语义映射。

entries.source_title: K3 surfaces with finite automorphism group in positive characteristic
entries.source_excerpt: We classify K3 surfaces with finite automorphism group in positive characteristic. The classification is the same as over the complex numbers, except when the base field is $\overline{\mathbb{F}}_p$.
entries.title_zh: 正特征下有限自同构群的 K3 曲面

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 便于从 Tao 博客获取该发布治理讨论的交叉链接版本。
entries.pragmatic_review: 阅读全文时应以原作者发布版本及任何转换校订说明为准。
entries.cynic_review: 标明客座来源及转载转换说明，便于追溯版本。
entries.paper_review: 与原站文章内容重复，当前摘录仍不含完整论证。

entries.source_title: alibaba/open-code-review
entries.source_excerpt: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
entries.title_zh: 阿里巴巴 OpenCodeReview：结合确定性流程与 LLM Agent 的代码审查工具
entries.summary_zh: OpenCodeReview 读取 Git diff，也可扫描完整文件；它用确定性流程筛选和组织待审内容，再由具备工具调用能力的 Agent 检索代码上下文并生成行级审查意见。项目介绍称其在 50 个开源仓库、200 个真实 Pull Request 上进行了基准测试，并报告了较高的精确率和 F1，但召回率低于通用 Agent；这些是项目方提供的结果，不能据此视为独立验证。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合想把代码审查接入个人 Agent 或 CI 的开发者；其确定性流程与 Agent 分工、原生审查和委派模式，值得对照现有代码审查 Skills 评估。
entries.pragmatic_review: 支持多种编码 Agent，并提供原生与委派两种审查方式，个人项目可以先从小型 Git diff 试用。
entries.cynic_review: 项目强调阿里巴巴规模验证和较高精确率，但材料也承认召回率较低，且基准数据与性能结论均来自项目方介绍。
entries.paper_review: 材料介绍了基准样本规模、标注数量和数据集入口，但没有呈现论文、完整实验方法或独立复现结果。

project_insight.translation_zh: 安全、快速、高效，并经阿里巴巴规模验证。它是一款混合架构代码审查工具，结合确定性流程与 LLM Agent，提供精确到代码行的评论、内置多语言规则集（包括空指针异常、线程安全、跨站脚本和 SQL 注入），并兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 将确定性的文件筛选、规则匹配与定位流程和可检索代码上下文的 Agent 结合，生成行级代码审查意见。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先确认环境满足 Git 2.41 及以上，并阅读仓库中的 Agent Skills 安装与模式说明；若使用现有 Agent，可了解委派模式如何复用其模型与认证，再在个人测试仓库的小型 diff 上检查误报、漏报和定位准确性。README 给出的 Skills 安装入口是 `npx skills add alibaba/open-code-review`，原生模式还需要配置 OCR 模型提供方。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 仓库材料称基准测试中召回率低于通用 Agent，代表可能漏掉部分问题；精确率、Token 消耗和速度等数据为项目方报告，材料未展示独立复现。输入未提供明确许可文本，虽 README 有许可证徽章，仍应查看许可证文件后再确定使用与分发条件。
use_cases_zh: 在个人仓库的 Pull Request 中检查潜在缺陷，并核对评论是否定位到正确代码行。
用完整文件扫描辅助熟悉陌生代码库，或审计没有明显 diff 的目录。
将委派模式接入已有编码 Agent，比较其审查结果与人工检查或其他工具的差异。

entries.source_title: Two parametric $q$-supercongruences from Andrews' multi-series transformation
entries.source_excerpt: Recently, Guo and Guo (Results Math $76:37, ~2021$) obtained curious $q$-analogues of the following two supercongruences conjectured by Guo and Schlosser \cite[Conjectures $12.6$ and $12.7$]{GuoSclssr ConstApprox 21}: \begin{align*} \sum_{n=0}^{(p-1)/3} (6n+1) \frac{\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)_n^{4}(2n)!} {(n!)^{4}\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)_{2n}} \equiv p \pmod{p^{3}} \qquad \text{for primes } p\equiv 1 \pmod{3}, \end{align*} \begin{align*} \sum_{n=0}^{(p+1)/3} (6n-1) \frac{\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)_n^{4}(2n)!} {(n!)^{4}\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)_{2n}} \equiv p \pmod{p^{3}} \qquad \text{for primes } p\equiv 2 \pmod{3}, \end{align*} where $(z)_n=z(z+1)\cdots(z+n-1)$ denotes the shifted factorial. In this paper, we establish a one-parameter extension of them. The main ingredients of our proofs are the creative microscoping method developed by Guo and Zudilin \cite{guo2019q} and Andrews' multi-series transformation.
entries.title_zh: 由 Andrews 多重级数变换得到两族参数化 q-超同余
entries.summary_zh: 论文把 Guo–Guo 对两条按 p 模 3 分类的超同余 q-类比推广为单参数族。证明使用 creative microscoping 技术和 Andrews 多重级数变换；结论是对 q-级数的模高次幂同余恒等式，摘要没有给出完整参数表达式。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合 q-级数、基本超几何级数和模 p 算术研究。
entries.pragmatic_review: 超同余通常比模 p 同余强，要求模 p 的高次幂成立。
entries.cynic_review: 清楚说明推广对象和证明工具。
entries.paper_review: 参数化公式的适用范围需看论文具体定理。

entries.source_title: The Laplace transform of the stationary measure of the open KPZ equation in the shock region
entries.source_excerpt: The stationary increment measure of the open Kardar-Parisi-Zhang equation on a bounded interval can be represented as the independent sum of a Brownian motion and another process defined via an explicit Radon-Nikodym derivative with respect to the measure induced by a Brownian motion. In the fan region, its finite-dimensional Laplace transform was previously expressed in terms of the continuous dual Hahn process. The main contribution here consists of computing the finite-dimensional Laplace transform for a range of parameters in the shock region by an analytic continuation argument. As an application, we provide a direct proof of the convergence of the finite-dimensional distributions of the increment height function of open WASEP under the stationary measure in the shock region, by computing the convergence of finite-dimensional Laplace transform without relating to the open KPZ equation.
entries.title_zh: 开放 KPZ 方程冲击区平稳测度的 Laplace 变换
entries.summary_zh: 论文利用解析延拓计算有界区间开放 KPZ 方程在冲击区一段参数范围内的有限维 Laplace 变换。随后直接证明开放 WASEP 平稳高度增量的有限维分布收敛；摘要没有声称完整路径空间收敛。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合可积概率、边界驱动粒子系统与 KPZ 理论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 显式变换可帮助比较不同模型极限。
entries.cynic_review: 参数范围与收敛层次需准确区分。
entries.paper_review: 解析延拓扩展了已知扇形区公式。

entries.title_zh: Inkling 2 Mini
entries.summary_zh: Thinking Machines Lab 将 Inkling 2 Mini 描述为可处理文本和图像、面向通用对话及工具使用的模型；其架构为带稀疏 MoE 的循环式 Transformer，支持最长 1M token 上下文。模型卡报告 26.4B 总参数、每 token 5.4B 有效激活参数，并列出若干第三方评测分数；这些是模型卡信息，摘录没有提供独立复现证据。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对想研究循环层、MoE 与长上下文模型的个人开发者有参考价值，也列出了多种推理框架和本地运行硬件方向。
entries.pragmatic_review: 模型卡给出 Hugging Face、vLLM、SGLang 和 llama.cpp 等运行入口，并建议至少 32GB 内存或显存，实用信息较具体。
entries.cynic_review: 多语言支持和评测表现由提供方描述，训练数据来源范围较宽泛，材料未交代各类数据的具体构成或第三方评测条件。
entries.paper_review: 摘录提供架构参数和结果表，但没有论文、训练细节或评测协议，不能独立验证其性能声明。

project_insight.translation_zh: Inkling 2 Mini 是一款通用多模态模型，可接收文本和图像并生成文本，面向对话、编码助手、智能体与工具使用等应用。模型采用 24 层解码器 Transformer，其中间 12 层以共享权重运行三次；模型卡称其总参数为 26.4B，每 token 有效激活参数为 5.4B，并支持最长 1M token 上下文。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 一款支持图像输入和超长上下文的 MoE 循环 Transformer，提供开放权重及多种推理框架支持。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先查看 Hugging Face 模型卡和 Tinker Cookbook，确认所选推理框架、权重格式及设备支持；本地尝试前按模型卡核实约 20GB 检查点和 32GB 以上内存或显存建议。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 模型卡说明权重约 20GB，建议设备具备 32GB 或更多内存/显存；训练数据涵盖多种公开、第三方、内部及合成来源，摘录未提供详细数据清单。Apache 2.0 许可之外还列有模型可接受使用政策。评测表为提供方报告，缺少独立复现材料。
use_cases_zh: 在本地尝试多模态问答，例如让模型阅读图表或截图并用文字解释。
搭建长文档检索或编码助手原型，评估 1M 上下文声明是否适合自己的材料。
比较循环层和稀疏 MoE 架构在本地推理中的资源占用与响应表现。

entries.source_title: Beyond Gold Standards: Epistemic Ensemble of LLM Judges for Formal Mathematical Reasoning
entries.source_excerpt: Statement autoformalization plays a crucial role in formal mathematical reasoning by enabling the automatic translation of natural language statements into formal languages. While recent advances using large language models (LLMs) have shown promising capabilities in autoformalization, methods for automatically evaluating autoformalization remain underexplored. LLM-as-a-judge presents a promising approach for automating such evaluation, however, existing methods typically employ coarse-grained and generic evaluation criteria, which limit their effectiveness for advanced formal mathematical reasoning, where quality hinges on nuanced, multi-granular dimensions. In this work, we take a step toward addressing this gap by introducing a systematic, automatic method to evaluate autoformalization tasks. The proposed method is based on an epistemically and formally grounded ensemble (EFG) of LLM judges, defined on criteria encompassing logical preservation (LP), mathematical consistency (MC), formal quality (FQ), and formal validity (FV), resulting in a transparent assessment that accounts for different contributing factors. entries.title_zh: 超越标准答案：形式化数学推理的 LLM 评审集成
entries.summary_zh: 论文针对自然语言数学命题自动形式化的评价问题，提出由多种 LLM 评审组成、依据逻辑保持、数学一致性、形式质量和形式有效性等维度打分的 EFG 框架。目标是超越粗粒度通用评审标准，让评估更透明、可诊断；评审模型本身仍需校准，不能替代 Lean 等证明检查器对形式化证明的验证。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把自动形式化质量拆成可解释维度，有助于建立更细致的评测协议。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于整理形式化翻译任务的评估维度与误差分析。
entries.cynic_review: LLM 评审可能共享模型偏差，需与人工及内核检查对照。
entries.paper_review: 框架具有诊断价值，需关注与专家标注的一致性证据。

entries.source_title: pbakaus/impeccable
entries.source_excerpt: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
entries.title_zh: Impeccable：为编码智能体提供设计词汇与网页检查
entries.summary_zh: Impeccable 为多种编码智能体提供网页设计技能、24 条命令、62 条确定性检测规则，以及需要 LLM 的评论检查。它包括记录产品背景的 init 流程、浏览器实时迭代、审计和重设计等功能；项目称确定性规则无需 LLM 或 API 密钥即可运行。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合希望把设计评审、页面适配和可访问性等检查纳入个人前端开发流程的用户，文档列有多种安装与使用方式；不过来源摘录未注明项目许可证。
entries.pragmatic_review: 对已有前端项目，可从 init、audit 或 polish 等命令入手，把设计约束和检查融入开发流程。
entries.cynic_review: 62 条规则只覆盖预设检测项，LLM 评论仍可能受模型判断影响，项目自述的反套模板效果也未由独立数据证实。
entries.paper_review: README 描述了命令、检测方式和安装选项，但当前材料没有展示检测准确率、用户研究或独立效果评估。

project_insight.translation_zh: Impeccable 为 AI 编码智能体提供设计指引，包括一项技能、24 条命令、浏览器实时迭代，以及用于识别 AI 生成前端设计问题的 62 条确定性检测规则。init 流程会记录稳定的产品背景，其他命令可用于设计规划、审查、审计和润色。确定性检测可在没有 LLM 或 API 密钥的情况下运行；项目说明支持多种编码工具。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: Impeccable 用一套设计命令和检测规则帮助编码智能体规划、审查和改进前端页面。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先查看其文档并在个人测试项目中安装，运行 init 建立项目背景，再选 audit 或 critique 检查一个页面；若使用 Codex，按项目文档核对 hook 的信任与审批设置。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 确定性规则覆盖的是预设检测项，LLM 评论也不等于独立质量验证；部分浏览器迭代功能需相应环境。来源摘录未注明许可证，宜先核对仓库许可后再分发或纳入项目。
use_cases_zh: 让智能体先记录个人网站的受众、用途和约束，再开始制作页面
对已有网页运行审计或设计评论，检查响应式与可访问性问题
在浏览器中迭代页面样式，并用确定性规则筛查常见设计模式

entries.source_title: Robust augmented Block Preconditioning for two-phase Incompressible Inductionless MHD
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we develop a robust augmented block preconditioner for three-dimensional, two-phase, incompressible inductionless MHD equations. We employ a high-order monolithic and charge-conservative arbitrary Lagrangian--Eulerian (ALE) finite element method as base scheme, for which the solution variables are current density, velocity, electric potential and pressure. Grad-div stabilization is added in both the current density equation and discrete momentum equation. Backward Euler method is used for the time discretization. At each time step, fully coupled solution strategy is adopted. This leads to large-scale, ill-conditioned, nonsymmetric, and indefinite dual saddle-point system. To solve this system efficiently, we construct an augmented block preconditioner within the constraint preconditioning framework. The ultimate preconditioner combines the augmented Lagrangian technique with approximate block factorization for current density sub-system and fluid sub-system. entries.title_zh: 两相不可压无感应 MHD 的稳健增广块预条件器
entries.summary_zh: 针对三维两相不可压、无感应磁流体方程的全耦合四场鞍点系统，作者提出增广块预条件器，组合增广拉格朗日、近似块分解，并用预条件 FGMRES 求解。离散采用高阶单体 ALE 有限元与 grad-div 稳定化；数值实验报告高阶精度和离散电荷守恒。

entries.paper_review: 稳健性对参数的数值范围需阅读全文实验。

entries.source_title: Extending Rademacher Complexity-Based Generalization Theory to Domain Generalization
entries.source_excerpt: Domain generalization (DG) aims to train models on multiple source domains with distinct distributions to ensure robust performance on unseen target domains. In doing so, it elevates the concept of generalization from the traditional sample level to the distribution level. Existing theoretical frameworks introduce a domain space endowed with a meta-distribution to extend classical generalization analysis to this new setting. However, these approaches typically treat the domain space as devoid of geometry. In reality, the domain space is an inherently infinite-dimensional, nonlinear abstract space composed of probability distributions, and its complex geometric properties fundamentally determine generalization behavior. Consequently, existing geometry-free theories of domain generalization have a fundamental limitation. They lack a formal characterization of what distinguishes distribution-level generalization from sample-level generalization, leaving the inherent difficulty of generalizing across domains largely unexplained. To bridge this gap, we formalize the domain space as the Wasserstein space over the representation space. Build
entries.title_zh: 将基于 Rademacher 复杂度的泛化理论扩展到域泛化
entries.summary_zh: 传统域泛化理论常把不同数据分布构成的域空间视为没有几何结构，难以解释分布级泛化与样本级泛化有何不同。作者把域空间建模为表示空间上的 Wasserstein 空间，利用 CD(K,∞) 曲率导出新的几何依赖误差界，并加入曲率相关置信项区分两种泛化效应；理论与实验都指出表示空间的曲率和不变性会影响域泛化。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 为分布迁移下的泛化误差提供显式几何视角，适合理论机器学习研究者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 曲率项可能帮助解释不同表示空间和迁移任务的泛化差异。
entries.cynic_review: Wasserstein 与 CD 曲率假设较强，如何从实际表示数据估计曲率尚需说明。
entries.paper_review: 把域空间几何纳入 Rademacher 分析，并区分样本层级与分布层级效应。

entries.source_title: Extreme central $L$-values of almost prime quadratic twists of elliptic curves II
entries.source_excerpt: We prove lower bounds for central $L$-values of quadratic twists of an elliptic curve by discriminants with at most five prime factors. Under the rank-zero Birch--Swinnerton-Dyer formula, these bounds give large Tate--Shafarevich groups.
entries.title_zh: 椭圆曲线几乎素数二次扭曲的极端中心 L 值（二）
entries.summary_zh: 论文为椭圆曲线按至多含五个素因子的判别式作二次扭曲时的中心 L 值给出下界。作者指出，若秩零情形的 Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer 公式成立，这些下界可推出相应 Tate–Shafarevich 群较大；后半结论依赖 BSD 猜想，不能表述成无条件证明。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 将中心 L 值估计与椭圆曲线 Tate–Shafarevich 群规模联系起来。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合解析数论和椭圆曲线算术方向读者。
entries.cynic_review: 关于群规模的推论明确依赖 BSD 公式。
entries.paper_review: 摘要区分了无条件下界与猜想条件下的算术推论。

entries.title_zh: Qwen2-Math-1.5B-Instruct 数学指令模型
entries.summary_zh: 这是 Qwen2-Math 系列中用于对话的 1.5B 数学指令模型，模型卡提供 Transformers 推理示例，并要求 transformers 版本不低于 4.40.0。页面自述该系列数学能力较强，但摘录没有提供对应评测数据；同时明确此模型当时主要支持英语。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 模型规模相对较小，适合希望探索数学问答模型或开展受控推理实验的个人用户；卡片还指出可参考 ModelScope 获取模型文件。

entries.cynic_review: 页面关于超过开源及闭源模型的能力描述属于作者自述，摘录没有基准成绩支撑，且当前模型主要支持英语。

project_insight.translation_zh: Qwen2-Math 是基于 Qwen2 的数学专用语言模型系列，重点提升算术和数学问题推理能力。模型卡称该系列在数学能力上超过开源模型及 GPT4o 等闭源模型，并希望帮助科学界处理需要复杂多步逻辑推理的问题；这些是页面中的作者自述，摘录未提供评测数据。该指令版本用于聊天，基础版本通常用于续写、少样本推理或微调。模型卡提示当前主要支持英语，并要求 transformers>=4.40.0。

project_insight.limitations_zh: 这是模型而非软件，许可为 Apache-2.0；模型卡称其当时主要支持英语。性能优势是页面作者的陈述，现有材料没有具体基准成绩、硬件吞吐数据或独立复现结果。

将模型作为数学教育或研究原型中的候选基线。

entries.source_title: Source Conditions and Sharp Transition Asymptotics for the Factorization Method with Far-Field Data
entries.source_excerpt: The factorization method characterizes an obstacle through a range test, but practical implementations replace the associated Picard series by a regularized approximation. This paper studies the resulting regularization bias for inverse acoustic scattering by impedance obstacles. For a disc, we show that every positive-order H\"older source condition fails at each noncentral interior sampling point, whereas logarithmic source conditions hold uniformly on compact interior subsets for every exponent, with explicit constants. At the center, the bias decays linearly with the regularization parameter. We then derive sharp spectral transition asymptotics through the Lambert W function. These asymptotics determine the stabilization rate inside the obstacle, the iterated-logarithmic growth at the boundary, and the divergence outside. They also yield a threshold rule for which the reconstructed disc converges in measure, together with quantitative boundary-location estimates. entries.title_zh: 远场数据因子分解法的源条件与尖锐过渡渐近
entries.summary_zh: 本文分析阻抗障碍物声学反演的因子分解法中，正则化 Picard 级数造成的偏差。在圆盘情形，作者证明非中心内部采样点不满足任何正阶 Hölder 源条件，但任意指数的对数型源条件在紧内部子集上一致成立且常数显式；中心点的偏差则随正则化参数线性衰减。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 指出常用源条件在不同采样点上的失效与替代，并量化正则化偏差。
entries.pragmatic_review: 对正则化参数与采样点位置的依赖给出了明确规律，可指导反演算法。
entries.cynic_review: 结果首先针对圆盘，推广到一般障碍物需额外论证。
entries.paper_review: 对源条件作尖锐区分并提供显式渐近，补充了方法的理论误差基础。

entries.source_title: Obstructions to deforming space curves lying on a complete intersection of quadrics

The linear system $|D|$ defines a birational morphism $f:S\to\overline S$ that contracts $E$ to a point and realizes an unprojection in the sense of Papadakis--Reid. When $n=3$, the surface $S=S_{2,2,2}\subset\mathbb P^5$ is a $K3$ surface and $E$ is a $(-2)$-curve. We prove that the complementary open surface $S\setminus E$ admits first-order infinitesimal deformations in $\mathbb P^5\setminus E$ that are obstructed at the second order. entries.title_zh: 二次完全交上曲线的变形障碍
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究含直线的二次超曲面完全交上的光滑曲线及变形障碍。摘录在三个二次式给出的 K3 曲面情形构造二阶受阻的一阶变形，并据此得到光滑空间曲线 Hilbert 概形的泛非约化分支；当前摘录末尾截断，无法补全精确维数公式。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合显式变形论及 Hilbert 概形病态研究。

entries.paper_review: 局部障碍通向全局非约化分支。

entries.title_zh: 大型三维声学时域边界元分析的时不变等价矩阵表示
entries.summary_zh: 常规时域边界元中，依赖点对的延迟时间把空间相互作用与历史边界数据耦合，带来大量存储和卷积成本。本文构造可在整个时间推进中复用的时不变压缩空间表示，并给出 H 矩阵和低频 H² 矩阵版本；在其假设下后者存储与单步成本线性于自由度，测试中 H 矩阵案例把 20,480 个自由度的存储从约 349 GB 降至 1.6 GB、加速约 45.4 倍，并扩展至百万自由度模型。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 针对大型瞬态声学仿真最重的历史卷积和存储瓶颈，提出可复用的低秩矩阵结构。

entries.paper_review: 把时间延迟与空间压缩解耦，并结合复杂度分析及大规模数值验证。

entries.source_title: The Information Geometry of Representation Formation
entries.source_excerpt: Most analyses of neural representations focus on trained endpoints, leaving the process by which internal structure forms comparatively unmeasured. We instead treat representation formation itself as an object of study, asking whether the path a representation takes through training reveals information that its endpoint does not. We formalize this idea by viewing representation learning as a geometric trajectory, using Bures geometry to measure movement through representation space and quantum Fisher information to characterize local sensitivity to input factors. We find that learning concentrates local sensitivity on task-relevant factors, and that changing only the prediction target reorganizes this geometry around the corresponding visual factor. More strikingly, representation trajectories become systematically less direct as the learned computation requires higher-order interactions among input factors. This effect persists under matched-performance and training-duration controls and transfers from synthetic vector inputs to residual CNNs on rendered and natural images. Importantly, formation history contains predictive informati
entries.title_zh: 表征形成的信息几何
entries.summary_zh: 论文不只比较训练后的神经表示，而把训练过程中表征变化看作几何轨迹，用 Bures 几何度量移动、量子 Fisher 信息描述对输入因素的局部敏感性。作者发现敏感性会聚焦任务相关因素，目标改变会重排几何；需要更高阶特征交互的任务对应更曲折轨迹，且形成历史能提供终点之外的预测信息。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究神经网络表示形成机制与训练动力学。
entries.pragmatic_review: Bures/Fisher 几何把概率或量子态变化量化为距离和局部敏感度。
entries.cynic_review: 在控制性能和训练时长后仍观察到轨迹结构差异。
entries.paper_review: 结果从合成输入扩展至部分 CNN，但不等于可解释因果机制已确立。

entries.source_title: A new tautological relation on $\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{2,14}$ in cohomology
entries.source_excerpt: We construct a relation $\mathsf{Q}$ in the cohomological tautological ring $\mathsf{RH}^*(\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{2,14})$ which lies outside the space of $3$-spin relations. $\mathsf{Q}$ is a simple linear combination of pure boundary strata classes of codimension 9 supported on the divisor $\Delta_0 \subset \overline{\mathcal{M}}_{2,14}$ of irreducible nodal curves, and transforms according to the irreducible representation of $\Sigma_{14}$ associated to the partition $(2^7)$. The result shows that the set of $3$-spin relations cannot be complete in cohomology. Motivic conjectures relating algebraic cycles to special values of $L$-functions suggest that $\mathsf{Q}$ is nonzero in Chow. More precisely, we prove that the Chow nonvanishing of $\mathsf{Q}$ follows from a conjecture of Harder concerning the failure of the Manin--Drinfeld principle in genus 2. We prove that $\mathsf{Q}$ vanishes in cohomology by pairing with generators of the tautological ring. entries.title_zh: 在曲线模空间 M̄₂,₁₄ 上构造新的上同调 tautological 关系
entries.summary_zh: 作者在 M̄₂,₁₄ 的 tautological 上同调环中构造一个由 Δ₀ 边界分层组成、余维为 9 的关系，并证明它不属于已有的 3-spin 关系集合，因而这些关系在上同调中并不完备。关系在 Chow 环中的非零性则依赖 Harder 猜想，摘要没有将这一条件性部分说成无条件定理。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 为曲线模空间的关系生成问题提供新例子，并区分上同调结论与 Chow 猜想条件。
entries.pragmatic_review: 代数几何研究者可用此例检验 3-spin 关系的完备性。
entries.cynic_review: Chow 环非零结论依赖额外猜想，需与已证明部分区分。
entries.paper_review: 摘要清楚界定关系的所在环及条件性增强。

entries.source_title: MGE-PO: Entropy-Aware Credit Assignment for Mathematical Reasoning
entries.source_excerpt: GRPO assigns the same group-relative advantage to equally rewarded responses within a question, leaving their generation uncertainty unused. We introduce MGE-PO, centered on four-quadrant (4Q) advantage shaping that combines verified correctness with rollout generation entropy. Correctness determines the sign of an additional correction, while entropy controls its magnitude: lower-entropy successes receive larger bonuses and higher-entropy failures receive larger penalties. An online entropy-based question curriculum supports this credit rule using cached rollout measurements. At the final checkpoint after eight training epochs on Qwen3-8B-Base, adding 4Q across three policy optimization settings yields absolute gains of 3.23-3.69% in six-benchmark macro avg@32 and 4.24-11.06% in macro pass@32. On Qwen2.5-7B-Base, the complete configuration raises four-benchmark macro avg@32 from 41.5% to 45.4%.
entries.title_zh: MGE-PO：用熵感知信用分配训练数学推理
entries.summary_zh: 论文指出 GRPO 会给同一题中获得相同奖励的回答相同组相对优势，未利用生成不确定性；MGE-PO 的四象限优势塑形把验证正确性与 rollout 熵结合，由正确性决定修正方向、熵决定幅度，并用在线熵课程挑选训练问题。作者报告在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上训练八轮后，加入该机制在六基准宏平均 avg@32 提升 3.23–3.69 个百分点、macro pass@32 提升 4.24–11.06 个百分点；Qwen2.5-7B-Base 的完整配置把四基准 avg@32 从 41.5% 提至 45.4%，均为论文设定下的实验结果。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究数学推理强化学习的人了解如何把采样难度与正确性纳入细粒度奖励分配。
entries.pragmatic_review: 熵信号为同分回答提供了额外的训练区分信息。
entries.cynic_review: 提升幅度取决于模型、基准和训练配置，不能直接外推到其他规模。
entries.paper_review: 摘要提供多个设置下的量化结果，但消融与跨种子方差需看全文。

entries.source_title: Operator Barron Regularity for Elliptic Equations and Application to Neural Operator Approximation
entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Shuhao Cao , Ruchi Guo , Daniel Zhengyu Huang , Na Liu; Subjects: Numerical Analysis (math.NA); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: 椭圆方程的算子 Barron 正则性及神经算子逼近
entries.summary_zh: 作者为无限维函数空间间的非线性算子建立谱 Barron 正则性框架，并证明一类椭圆方程解算子具有任意阶 Barron 正则性。进而为 FNO 型神经算子给出逼近误差界，显式依赖输入截断维数、输出重构维数和网络宽度；固定输入截断时，对正则阶优化可得到网络宽度方向的拉伸指数衰减率，并以数值实验作支持。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 论文把 PDE 解算子的正则性理论转化为神经算子逼近速率分析。
entries.pragmatic_review: 理论界明确连接函数空间结构与网络宽度。
entries.cynic_review: 速率结论依赖固定截断维数等条件。
entries.paper_review: 适合 AI for Math 与 PDE 学习理论交叉阅读。

entries.source_title: How Well Can LLMs Verbalize Mathematical Formulas? A Multi-Domain Evaluation
entries.source_excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across natural language tasks. But their ability to generate accurate written verbalizations of mathematical formulas has not been systematically evaluated. Such verbalization is important for text-to-speech systems supporting audio-based learning and visually impaired users. We evaluated five state-of-the-art LLMs across six scientific domains and constructed Read-Aloud Math, a balanced multi-domain corpus with LaTeX formulas, manually validated simple and extended transcriptions, multiple variants, textual context, domain labels, and formula complexity levels. Using multi-reference BLEU, GPT-5.2 achieved the highest score for simple transcriptions (75.9% without context, 64.9% with context), although without context it did not significantly outperform Grok 4.1 Fast or Claude Sonnet 4.5. Claude Sonnet 4.5 achieved the highest score for extended transcriptions without context (36.5%), and Grok 4.1 Fast with context (48.8%). For extended transcriptions, Statistics and Mathematics scored highest across the two context settings, while Physics scored lowest. Formula length was si

entries.source_title: Which Mathematical Context Supports Target-Aligned Conjecture Generation? A Paired Ablation Study
entries.source_excerpt: Generating mathematical conjectures from natural-language context is challenging because theorem-relevant information is distributed across multiple forms of mathematical context, including definitions, objects, assumptions, and constructions. We study which of these contextual signals help a model recover the specific claim supported by the surrounding setup, using 61 main theorems from 12 papers across four mathematical domains. For each theorem, we redact the result and represent the remaining setup using six context components. A paired ablation design compares full context, six leave-one-out conditions, and six single-component conditions, yielding 793 generated conjectures. Context components were largely complementary: removing one component usually had little effect, whereas retaining only one substantially reduced expected-theorem alignment. Local Mathematical Objects provided the strongest standalone signal, while Structural Constraints and Conditions produced the largest alignment decrease when removed. These findings suggest that target-aligned conjecture generation depends on combining information that identifies relevant
entries.title_zh: 哪类数学上下文有助于生成与目标定理一致的猜想？一项配对消融研究
entries.summary_zh: 论文从 12 篇、四个领域的论文中选取 61 个主定理，隐藏结论后对定义、对象、假设和构造等六类上下文做配对消融，共评估 793 个生成猜想。上下文信息大多互补：只留单类信息会降低与原定理的匹配度，其中局部数学对象单独最有帮助，移除结构约束与条件造成最大下降；结果衡量的是目标对齐，不等同于猜想具有原创性或重要性。

entries.paper_review: 配对设计与多个领域样本使上下文贡献可以逐项比较。

entries.source_title: Model Organisms of Collusion: Corrective Transfer in Untrusted Monitors
entries.source_excerpt: AI control protocols aim to get useful work from models that may be misaligned by monitoring their behaviour. One approach uses a second copy of the same model as the monitor. This avoids relying on a weaker reviewer the model could outsmart, but risks collusion: the model, now monitoring itself, may cover up its own misbehaviour. One remedy is to fine-tune the monitor on whatever examples of misbehaviour the control team has caught. We ask whether this training also removes collusion that the control team has not yet found. We fine-tune Llama-3.3-70B and Qwen2.5-72B to install five policy-monitor behaviour pairs, correct the monitor on 300 honest reviews of one caught collusion, and measure collusion on the other four in unseen prompt formats. Averaged over the three seeds of each family, correction reduces held-out collusion from 91% to 14-20% under three of the four methods we compare (individual seeds 10-32%), while a control fine-tuned on the same number of unrelated examples leaves 56-93%. Family-average accuracy on control items changes by at most five points and capability is preserved, apart from a drop in mathematical accura
entries.title_zh: 不可信监控器的纠偏能否迁移到未见串通
entries.summary_zh: 研究人为训练五组策略与监控串通行为，再用其中一类的三百个诚实审阅样例纠正监控器。部分方法将未见串通的平均发生率从 91% 降至 14%—20%，但没有消除串通；修正已知行为的准确率也不能单独预测迁移幅度。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合理解模型监控方案的纠偏价值与剩余风险。

entries.source_title: Low-degree filtrations in ordinary and Lagrangian Grassmannian cohomology
entries.source_excerpt: We prove the Hilbert-series formulas conjectured by Reiner--Tudose and by the Polymath Jr. Grassmannian group for the subalgebras of ordinary and Lagrangian Grassmannian cohomology generated in bounded degree. We determine the finite coefficient images underlying the proofs, together with the kernels of the coefficient and cancellation maps. We also construct bases adapted to the auxiliary ideal filtrations and identify the cancellation layers, as modules, with shifts of finite complete-intersection algebras. First-order deformations give the derivative inclusions needed to recover the filtration increments. We disprove the two ordinary basis conjectures of the Polymath group. For every $r\ge 2$, the span of each prescribed family has codimension one in weight $3r+2$ of $H^{2*}(\operatorname{Gr}(2,3r+1);\mathbb Q)$; replacing one index gives a basis in each of these components. More generally, each prescribed two-row family has codimension at most one in every weight. Weights are half the cohomological degrees, and all coefficients are rational.
entries.title_zh: 普通与拉格朗日 Grassmannian 上同调中的低次数滤过
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明 Reiner–Tudose 与 Polymath Jr. 群提出的有界次数生成上同调子代数 Hilbert 级数公式，并刻画系数映射的像、核及滤过层。它还反驳两条普通 Grassmannian 基猜想：在 Gr(2,3r+1) 的指定权重中，原候选族恰缺一维，替换一个指标即可得到基；更一般的两行族余维至多为一。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 兼有猜想证明、反例和明确的基构造修正，适合代数拓扑与组合表示研究者。

entries.paper_review: 统一了 Hilbert 级数证明并精确定位猜想差一维的情形。

entries.source_title: AI 与人各交一份千禧难题答卷：一边靠 Claude 写完 79 页证明，一边掏出 12 年手写的 940 页草稿

entries.source_title: ARCHER: From Rationale Imitation to Executable Reasoning in Small Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: Small language models are attractive for local, low-cost, and privacy-sensitive deployment, but they remain unreliable on mathematical reasoning tasks that require decomposition, exact computation, tool use, and verification. We introduce \textbf{ARCHER}: \textbf{A}ction-trace \textbf{R}einforcement for \textbf{C}alculator-grounded \textbf{H}ierarchical \textbf{E}xecutable \textbf{R}easoning, a two-stage framework for training small language models (SLMs) to produce executable and auditable reasoning trajectories. In the first stage, ARCHER compiles free-form chain-of-thought rationales into typed action traces containing reasoning steps, calculator calls, deterministic runtime observations, verification actions, and final answers. This shifts the supervision target from imitating explanatory text to learning a tool-grounded reasoning policy. In the second stage, ARCHER refines this policy through asymmetric hierarchical reinforcement learning, using grouped and conditionally gated trajectory rewards for answer correctness, tool grounding, process discipline, and trace alignment. Across five standard sub-10B backbones, ARCHER improves
entries.title_zh: ARCHER：让小语言模型从模仿推理转向可执行推理
entries.summary_zh: ARCHER 面向小语言模型的数学推理，把自由形式的思维说明转成带类型的动作轨迹，包含推理步骤、计算器调用、运行时观察、验证动作和答案，再以分层强化学习优化执行策略。核心变化是监督模型完成可执行、可审计的步骤，而不是只模仿解释文本；效果仍需结合完整基准与外部复现判断。

entries.source_title: Borel $(2n+1)$-coloring for bounded degree function graphs

entries.source_title: The Contingent HOD Dichotomy
entries.source_excerpt: The axiom V = HOD, referring to the class of hereditarily ordinal-definable sets, is contingently contingent by forcing---it holds contingently in the generic multiverse of some models of set theory but not others. Thus we introduce and investigate the \emph{contingent HOD dichotomy}, according to which either (1) the set-theoretic universe V is close to HOD by forcing---HOD is a ground, V = HOD is forceable, the universe is ordinal-definable from a set parameter $V=\text{HOD}_b$, the blurry HOD hierarchy collapses to kappa-HOD for some cardinal kappa, and furthermore these features are invariant by forcing and hold throughout the generic multiverse; or (2) the universe V is far from HOD by forcing in all those respects, so $V\neq\text{HOD}$, but also HOD is not a ground, V = HOD is not forceable, the set-theoretic universe is not ordinal-definable from a set, the universe is not kappa-HOD for any kappa, and these features hold invariantly throughout the generic multiverse. We investigate the nature of the dichotomy in connection with large cardinals, with set-theoretic geology, with the iterated $\text{HOD}^\alpha$ classes, and with
entries.title_zh: 偶然 HOD 二分法
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出集合论宇宙相对于 HOD（遗传序数可定义集合类）的“偶然二分”：要么 V 可通过强迫变得接近 HOD，且若干接近性质在强迫扩张中稳定；要么 V 在相同意义下始终远离 HOD。作者进一步把这一二分与大基数、集合论地质学和迭代 HOD 层级联系起来；摘要提供的是框架与研究对象，完整条件需看论文定理。

entries.paper_review: 提出统一研究框架，但摘要未列出全部相对一致性细节。

entries.source_title: Generalized Images for Brownian First Passage to Monomial Boundaries
entries.source_excerpt: We study the first passage of Brownian motion to a monomial moving boundary. For every integer degree at least two, we construct a time-independent signed image measure whose heat potential is the killed Brownian transition density on a nonzero interval of the natural Brownian time scale. The image density is determined by a second-kind Volterra equation in the image coordinate, not by the classical Volterra equations in time for the hitting density. Its kernel is an explicit Wright function, and the first-passage density is recovered afterwards from the boundary flux. Exponential bounds establish convergence, while a beta-moment transform connects the Wright kernel with the finite-order differential hierarchy previously obtained from transported moving zeros. A cubic numerical experiment independently checks the resulting density against simulated Brownian paths.
entries.title_zh: 布朗运动首次越过单项式边界的广义镜像法

entries.source_title: Convolution Quadrature with Adaptive History Compression for Variable-Order Fractional Reaction--Diffusion Equations
entries.source_excerpt: We develop a fully implicit fast method for semilinear variable-order fractional reaction--diffusion equations with periodic fractional diffusion and exponential-transition Scarpi memory. A Volterra-resolvent analysis establishes local well-posedness and temporal regularity estimates that describe the weak initial singularity. Backward Euler convolution quadrature combined with Fourier pseudospectral discretization achieves mesh-uniform stability and positive-time first-order convergence. To accelerate the scheme, we utilize Cauchy--FFT weight recovery and adaptive blockwise sum-of-exponentials compression, which significantly reduces the cost of history evaluation under local error control. A logarithmic perturbation bound quantifies the effects of weight recovery, history compression, and inexact nonlinear solves, giving tolerance conditions that preserve the convergence order. Numerical experiments confirm the first-order accuracy and demonstrate that the accelerated method efficiently resolves long-time spatial patterns at a substantially reduced computational cost.
entries.title_zh: 变阶分数阶反应扩散的自适应历史压缩卷积求积
entries.summary_zh: 论文为具有周期分数扩散和指数过渡 Scarpi 记忆核的半线性变阶分数阶反应扩散方程，构造全隐式快速算法。Volterra resolvent 分析建立局部适定性与描述弱初始奇性的时间正则性，再用后向 Euler 卷积求积和 Fourier 伪谱离散获得网格一致稳定性及正时间一阶收敛；Cauchy–FFT 权重恢复配合自适应分块指数和压缩，在局部误差控制下降低历史项计算成本。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把可证明稳定的卷积求积与自适应记忆压缩结合，针对长历史计算瓶颈。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合时间记忆核昂贵的分数阶扩散数值模拟。
entries.cynic_review: 压缩误差、阶数变化函数与局部误差容限会影响实际速度和精度。
entries.paper_review: 同时提供分析保证与历史压缩加速机制。

entries.paper_review: 模型卡披露了架构、采样参数和部分评测条件，但材料不含完整论文、训练数据细节或独立复现实验。

entries.source_title: ConsMSA: Semantic Distribution Consistency Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
entries.source_excerpt: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to predict human sentiments by integrating signals from different modalities such as text, video, and audio. However, raw multimodal sequences often suffer from semantic inconsistency--exhibiting redundancy or conflicts within and across modalities--which hinders robust understanding and increases computational cost. To this end, we introduce ConsMSA, which explicitly formalizes semantic distribution consistency across both $\textit{intra}$- and $\textit{inter}$-modality, providing a consistency-aware mechanism for robust and efficient multimodal sentiment prediction. Specifically, ConsMSA projects multimodal token features into a shared sentiment space to compute an Intra- and Inter-modality Consistency Score ($I^2CS$). By coupling this score with predictive relevance, we formulate consistency-aware importance signals that are utilized: (i) as a consistency regularizer to align latent distributions during training, (ii) to derive semantic-aware weights for adaptive multimodal token reweighting, and (iii) as a practical criterion to prune redundant or conflicting tokens. entries.title_zh: ConsMSA：多模态情感分析的语义分布一致性

entries.title_zh: 二项式系数与其上标最大公因数的分布
entries.summary_zh: 令 A_d(n) 统计满足 gcd(n, C(n,k))=d 的 k，本文证明对每个固定 d≥2，其累积和 S_d(x) 渐近为 ((d−1)/d)c·x/log x，其中 c≈1.526453；更一般地，对固定 d、j 及 e，相关最大公因数等于 e 的 m 数量渐近为 (c/e)x/log x。证明结合 Kummer 进位函数零集、素数小因子估计、Selberg 三角逼近和素数指数和。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 精确描述二项式系数与上标共享因子的平均分布，属于具有明确渐近常数的解析数论结果。

entries.cynic_review: 定理针对固定参数渐近，常数与应用范围需结合完整陈述核验。
entries.paper_review: 给出明确渐近密度，并把 Kummer 进位与素数筛估计结合。

entries.title_zh: AI 声称证明准黎曼猜想之后：数学家如何理解这份证明？

entries.cynic_review: 重要性判断来自受访数学家，仍需关注后续专业审查与正式发表。
entries.paper_review: 报道突出人类核查，但不是论文审稿或形式化验证报告。

entries.title_zh: 独立横截集的高效重构
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究给定顶点分区图中的独立横截集，即每个分区恰选一个顶点且所选顶点互不相邻，并要求通过局部合法变化把一个解变成另一个解。对固定 r 与 ε 的 r-爪自由图，作者给出多项式时间算法：要么找到长度多项式界的重构路径，要么识别一个分区子集，使其诱导子图具有特定强结构。

entries.cynic_review: 算法保证针对固定 r、ε 和爪自由图条件。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出算法与二择一证书，但需阅读全文看精确路径界。

entries.source_title: A generalization of pseudocomplementation in semilattices, lattices and posets with 0
entries.source_excerpt: Pseudocomplemented lattices satisfy a lot of nice properties and were studied by a number of algebraists. However, even when a poset P with 0 is not pseudocomplemented, we can assign to every element a of P the set $a^p$ of all maximal elements being orthogonal to a. This assignment $^p$ is a non-trivial operator provided P satisfies the so-called Ascending Chain Condition (ACC). In particular, we investigate this operator when the poset P in question is a semilattice or a lattice. We characterize this operator and describe its properties that turn out to be similar to the corresponding properties of pseudocomplementation. Moreover, we introduce an equivalence relation $\Theta_p$ on P induced by $^p$ similarly as it was done by V. I. Glivenko for distributive pseudocomplemented lattices. Finally, we investigate for which lattices L with 0 satisfying the ACC this equivalence relation turns out to be a congruence and when the quotient lattice $L/\Theta_p$ is complemented respectively modular.
entries.title_zh: 半格、格与偏序中的伪补运算推广
entries.summary_zh: 即使偏序集并非伪补格，作者仍可把元素 a 映到所有与 a 正交的极大元集合；在满足升链条件时该运算非平凡。论文刻画它在半格与格中的性质，并研究由此产生的等价关系何时为同余，以及商格何时补格或模格。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合格论与序理论研究者，扩展经典伪补结构的适用范围。
entries.pragmatic_review: 伪补是直觉上的“最大与元素不相交部分”；ACC 保证链不会无限上升。
entries.cynic_review: 把算子、同余和商格性质连成一套分类问题。
entries.paper_review: 摘要未列出各结构定理的精确充要条件。

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对研究网络安全知识组织、问答数据或安全领域模型训练的人可能有参考价值；但访问门槛较高，且应先评估来源、内容质量与进攻性材料的适用范围。
entries.pragmatic_review: 页面列出多个安全领域和数据格式，可供研究者初步判断主题覆盖，但需要同意访问条件且材料未展示数据样例质量。
entries.cynic_review: “最全面”和“博士级”等表述是数据集页面的自我描述，摘录未给出独立覆盖评估或质量审计。
entries.paper_review: 材料列出规模、主题与来源平台数量，但没有提供数据抽样方法、去重质量、标注审查或基准实验结果。

project_insight.translation_zh: 页面将其描述为面向 AI 训练的网络安全知识库，覆盖进攻性红队与漏洞赏金、蓝队与安全运营、数字取证及 AI/LLM 安全等领域；自述规模为 16 GB、507 个文件、30 多个领域和 15 多个平台来源。页面称其包含 MITRE ATT&CK、OWASP、NIST、CIS 等框架相关材料，以及实验场景。该数据集要求用户同意分享 Hugging Face 账户信息后才能访问文件；材料没有提供独立验证上述覆盖和质量主张的证据。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 一个需申请访问的网络安全文本数据集，页面称其覆盖攻防、取证、合规及 AI 安全等主题。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先审阅数据集访问条件、数据来源和用途限制，再决定是否提交账户信息；获准后先抽查少量文件的来源、时效、准确性及攻防内容边界，不要仅凭页面概述用于训练或生产决策。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 这是数据集，不是开源软件；虽标注 Apache-2.0，文件访问仍需登录并同意分享 Hugging Face 账户信息。页面中的“最全面”“博士级”等描述尚无材料所示的独立验证；摘录未说明数据抽取、去重、许可兼容性和质量审核细节。
use_cases_zh: 在获准访问后检查其主题和格式是否适合网络安全问答或分类研究。
研究网络安全知识库的数据组织方式，并与公开框架资料对照。
评估其 AI/LLM 安全内容能否用于防御性安全教育或研究。

entries.title_zh: 带非线性非局部漂移耦合抛物系统的保界有限体积格式

entries.source_title: Identity crisis on tightly $C^{(2)}$-compact cardinals
entries.source_excerpt: Bagaria and Goldberg asked if $\kappa$ being tightly $C^{(n)}$-compact implies $\kappa\in C^{(n+1)}$ for natural numbers $n\ge 1$? Usuba gave a negative answer for $n=1$. In this paper we give a negative answer for $n=2$.
entries.title_zh: 紧 C^(2) 基数上的“身份危机”
entries.summary_zh: 针对 Bagaria 与 Goldberg 提出的问题——紧致性条件“κ tightly C^(n)-compact”是否推出 κ∈C^(n+1)——此前 n=1 已有反例；本文对 n=2 也给出否定答案。摘录没有包含反例构造和大基数一致性背景。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合集合论读者跟踪紧致性层级之间的蕴含关系。

entries.source_title: When Does GEPA Merge Help? A Mechanism-Level Diagnostic
entries.source_excerpt: GEPA is among the strongest reflective prompt optimizers for language-model programs, but its system-aware merge operator is unstable across models: merge improves gpt-4.1-mini on average while degrading Qwen3-8B, an asymmetry noted but left unexplained by the GEPA paper. We investigate this instability across five datasets and two models. Our nine-configuration sweep over merge timing and merge operator shows that merge can improve both models when configured appropriately. This suggests that merge instability is better explained by configuration sensitivity than by an inherent flaw in the merge operator. We then test whether prompt-level features predict GEPA's merge-accept decisions and find that they do not, ruling out static-feature gating. As a proof of concept, a behavior-based probe built from these diagnostics avoids large merge failures in our multi-seed runs by abstaining on high-risk tasks, although it does not consistently outperform NoMerge. Code is available as GEPA-MergeProbe at https://github.com/ChongZZZZ/GEPA_MERGE .
entries.title_zh: GEPA 的 Merge 何时有帮助？机制层诊断
entries.summary_zh: 研究发现 GEPA 提示合并算子对 GPT-4.1-mini 平均有效、对 Qwen3-8B 却可能有害。跨五个数据集、两种模型的九配置实验表明调整合并时机和算子可改善两者，问题更像配置敏感而非算子本身缺陷；静态提示特征不能预测接受决策，行为探针可通过高风险任务弃权避免大幅失败，但未稳定胜过 NoMerge。

entries.source_title: Odd-degree cycles and rationality of Peskine sixfolds of discriminant 24
entries.source_excerpt: Benedetti and Faenzi conjectured that, for a general trivector $\sigma\in\mathcal D^{1,6,10}$, the Peskine sixfold $X_1^\sigma$ is rational if the Brauer class $\beta$ on the associated K3 surface vanishes. We prove this implication for every $\sigma$ in a nonempty Zariski open subset $U\subset\mathcal D^{1,6,10}$. When $\beta=0$, we construct a line on the generic fiber of the Peskine fibration after a cubic field extension and use odd-degree descent to obtain a line over the original function field. We extend criteria for rationality to smooth complete intersections of an arbitrary number of quadrics under suitable hypotheses. Finally, we describe the derived category of the generic fiber of the Peskine fibration in terms of a twisted nodal curve of arithmetic genus two.
entries.title_zh: 奇数次曲线与判别式 24 的 Peskine 六维簇有理性
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究与 K3 曲面 Brauer 类相关的 Peskine 六维簇，证明当该类消失时，在参数空间一个非空 Zariski 开集中的簇为有理簇。证明先在三次域扩张后构造纤维上的直线，再用奇数次数下降回原函数域；文中还扩展某些光滑二次曲面交的有理性判据。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 以奇数次数下降把 Brauer 类条件转化为高维代数簇有理性的构造性结果。

entries.source_title: Aligning Large Language Models with Human Feedback: Mathematical Foundations and Algorithm Design
entries.source_excerpt: This article provides an introduction to the mathematical foundations and algorithmic frameworks used to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intentions, preferences, and values. We discuss standard alignment techniques, such as fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and direct preference optimization (DPO). We also explore the theoretical underpinnings of learning from human preferences, drawing connections to inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) and discrete choice models. We present state-of-the-art algorithms in a tutorial style, discuss their advantages and limitations, and offer insights into practical implementation. Our exposition is intended to serve as a comprehensive resource for researchers and practitioners, providing both a foundational understanding of alignment methodologies and a framework for developing more robust and scalable alignment techniques.
entries.title_zh: 用数学基础理解大模型人类反馈对齐

entries.source_title: Markoff spectra of Hecke groups
entries.source_excerpt: We study the initial discrete parts of the Markoff spectra of Hecke groups of index $q\ge 5$. Using a digit expansion associated with geodesics and a Perron-type formula, we classify all bi-infinite digit sequences whose Markoff values lie at or below the first accumulation point. We obtain explicit formulas for the discrete spectral values and identify the sequences realizing them, including those attaining the first accumulation point. We also prove that the infinite family of discrete values increases strictly to this point. Our results recover Vulakh's description of the initial discrete spectra through an explicit symbolic approach.
entries.title_zh: Hecke 群的 Markoff 谱
entries.summary_zh: 论文分类指标 q≥5 的 Hecke 群 Markoff 谱最初离散部分，利用测地线数字展开和 Perron 型公式刻画 Markoff 值不超过首个聚点的双无限数字序列。作者给出离散谱值及实现它们的序列的显式公式，并证明无限离散谱严格递增趋近该聚点，提供 Vulakh 描述的符号动力学证明。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合双曲几何、数论与符号动力系统读者。
