entries.source_title: Upper Bounds on the de Bruijn-Newman constant for Dirichlet $L$-functions with primitive real-valued characters
entries.source_excerpt: Let $\chi_m$ be a primitive real-valued Dirichlet character of conductor $m\ge3$, let $L(s)=L(s,\chi_m)$ be the associated Dirichlet $L$-function, and let $\xi_L(s)$ denote its completed form. For each $t \in \mathbb R,$ we define the entire function \[ H^L_t(z) := \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{tu^2}\, \Phi_L(u)\, e^{izu}\, du, \] where $\Phi_L$ is the superexponentially decaying density \[ \Phi_L(u) := \frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \xi_L\!\left(\frac{1+is}{2}\right) e^{-isu}\, ds. \] The family $\{H_t^L\}_{t \in \mathbb R}$ describes the heat-flow evolution of $\xi_L$ and solves a backward heat equation. By the work of Newman, there exists a finite constant $\Lambda_L$, called the generalized de Bruijn--Newman constant, such that all the zeros of $H_t^L$ are real if and only if $t \ge \Lambda_L$. The Generalized Riemann Hypothesis (GRH) for $L$ is equivalent to the assertion that $\Lambda_L \le 0$. Dobner established the matching lower bound $\Lambda_L \ge 0$, while de Bruijn proved the upper bound $\Lambda_L \le \tfrac12$. entries.source_title: The Spectral Distribution of Matrix Least Squares Solutions, and the Ellipsoid Fitting Problem
entries.source_excerpt: We study the spectral distribution of the least squares solution to a random linear system whose unknown is a symmetric matrix. In the normalized and isotropic setting, we derive a closed-form description of the support of the spectral distribution. As an application, we consider the ellipsoid fitting problem: given $n$ standard Gaussian vectors in $\mathbb{R}^d$, does there exist a centered ellipsoid passing through all of them? It was recently shown that this problem has a sharp phase transition at $n \approx d^2/4$. On the satisfiability side, unlike earlier results, these sharp results do not rely on least squares candidates. We show that the least squares candidates considered in earlier works have a threshold of positive semi-definiteness at $n \approx d^2/10$, which was previously observed numerically and predicted non-rigorously using statistical physics methods. entries.title_zh: 矩阵最小二乘解的谱分布与椭球拟合问题

entries.source_title: Mathematics and mysticism: another defense of human mathematics
entries.source_excerpt: My intention here is to contribute to the discussion by pointing at an aspect of mathematics which I believe is under threat and has been forgotten in the rubble of this ongoing earthquake: the mystical aspect of mathematics. I am aware that using the word “mystical” in the mathematics community comes with some risks; yet I will try to defend it, because I think that this is one of the crucial aspects of human engagement with mathematics.

entries.source_title: On the Number of Iterations in a Kruskal-Type Process
entries.source_excerpt: Motivated by the Kruskal counting procedure, this paper investigates a combinatorial elimination process defined on a deck consisting of $m$ copies of each value $1,2,\ldots,n$. Starting from an arbitrary arrangement of the $mn$ cards, the process repeatedly removes a number of consecutive cards equal to the value of the first remaining card. This generates a sequence of elimination steps whose length determines $T$, representing the total number of iterations required to exhaust the deck. The main objective of this paper is to analyze an upper bound $\sigma(m,n)$ for $T$, valid for every initial configuration of the deck, and to show that this bound is attained by a specific configuration.
entries.title_zh: Kruskal 型过程的迭代次数
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究一副牌中 1 到 n 的每个数值各有 m 张的消去过程：每步读取当前第一张牌的数值，并从牌堆连续移除对应张数。作者分析任意初始排列所需步数 T 的统一上界 σ(m,n)，并构造达到该上界的排列；摘要未提供 σ 的显式公式。

entries.paper_review: 证明上界可达使迭代次数分析不仅是粗略估计。

entries.source_title: Relative computability and definability for nonregular oracles
entries.source_excerpt: Classically, a set is computable from an oracle if both the set and its complement are computably enumerable (c.e.) relative to that oracle. We construct a countable nonstandard model of true arithmetic with sets A and X such that both A and its complement are c.e. relative to X, yet A is not pointwise Turing reducible to X. The Turing functionals used here are single-valued at every oracle. For regular oracles, we prove that the classical equivalence holds over ISigma_1. Two further phenomena, each known from earlier work, are realized with the same oracle X that witnesses our main separation. Strong and pointwise Turing reducibility differ for this X, and some Delta_1^X set is not X-c.e.
entries.title_zh: 非正则 oracle 下的相对可计算性与可定义性
entries.summary_zh: 论文构造真算术的一个可数非标准模型及集合 A、X，使 A 与其补集都相对 X 可计算可枚举，但 A 并非逐点 Turing 可归约于 X；对正则 oracle，经典等价关系则在 IΣ₁ 中成立。该构造同时展示强归约与逐点归约可能分离，并产生非 X-c.e. 的 Δ₁ˣ 集合。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 递归论与非标准算术研究者可关注不同 oracle 可计算概念的边界。
entries.pragmatic_review: 纯理论递归论结果，主要价值是澄清定义间的分离。
entries.cynic_review: 构造同时区分多个归约概念，结论边界相当具体。

entries.source_title: A Brownian web invariance principle: Localized disturbance flows and Hastings-Levitov(0)
entries.source_excerpt: We establish a Brownian web invariance principle for localized disturbance flows, providing a criterion that strengthens the weak-flow convergence of [Norris--Turner 2015, Ann. Probab. 43, 935--970] to path-Hausdorff convergence of their full trajectory collections. We apply this approach to the radial, stationary, and cylindrical versions of the Hastings--Levitov$(0)$ aggregation model, proving path-Hausdorff convergence of the full harmonic measure path collections to the (Cylindrical) Brownian web, together with joint convergence of the full gap--finger collections to geometric embeddings of the corresponding double Brownian webs. This extends the radial HL$(0)$ small-particle limits of [Norris--Turner 2012, Commun. Math. Phys. 316, 809--841] for the harmonic measure flow and finite gap--finger collections. In the radial and cylindrical HL$(0)$, we also show that the rescaled one-arm domination time converges to a multiple of the global coalescence time of coalescing Brownian motion on $\mathbb T$, with convergence of expectations. entries.source_title: Error Analysis of Deep Learning
entries.source_excerpt: This review examines deep learning theory through the lens of error decomposition, systematically addressing approximation, statistical, and optimization errors. We trace the development of error analyses from bounds on individual error components to frameworks that account for all three. Using nonparametric regression and the Deep Ritz Method as dual running examples, we demonstrate how these analyses apply across fundamentally different loss structures. We then review representative analyses in scientific machine learning, generative learning, reinforcement learning, representation learning, and large language models, showing how learning errors affect solutions, distributions, and predictions through problem-specific arguments. Throughout, we clarify which error components are controlled, how they are combined, and what assumptions are needed to obtain guarantees for trained networks.

As applications, we endow the complement of a hyperplane arrangement with a complete cylindrical K\"ahler metric, and we show that the differential of a master function with nonresonant weights is well-tamed with respect to this metric. entries.source_title: SEAC from EAC modulo Schanuel: reduction to algebraic exponentials
entries.source_excerpt: We consider the problem of reducing Zilber's pseudo-exponentiation conjecture to mere exponential-algebraic closedness, assuming Schanuel's conjecture but not Zilber-Pink. Generalising work of Mantova, we show that it would suffice to show that perfectly rotund varieties have non-dense intersection with finitely generated subgroups of the graph of exponentiation in which the exponentials live in a number field.
entries.title_zh: 在 Schanuel 猜想下将 SEAC 约化为代数指数问题
entries.summary_zh: 论文讨论如何在假设 Schanuel 猜想、但不假设 Zilber–Pink 的前提下，把 Zilber 伪指数猜想从指数代数闭合性（EAC）约化到强指数代数闭合性（SEAC）。推广 Mantova 的工作后，作者证明只需处理某类 perfectly rotund 簇与指数图中有限生成子群交集不稠密的问题，并将指数值限制在数域中；这是条件性约化，不是对伪指数猜想本身的证明。

entries.source_title: Uniform local models of quasi-unipotent $p$-adic differential equations
entries.source_excerpt: We construct uniform analytic models of quasi-unipotent differential modules over Robba rings. For modules of rank at most $r$ and highest ramification break at most $b$, the inner radius of the model annulus depends only on $r,b$ and the residue characteristic $p$. At each radius, the model admits a basis, possibly depending on the radius, in which the connection matrix is bounded by a constant depending only on $r,b,p$. Both bounds are independent of the coefficient field, and these analytic models require no coefficient extension. A prescribed absolute Frobenius structure extends to such a bounded model with the same radius and connection bound. After a finite coefficient extension, we also realize quasi-constant modules, which carry the finite local monodromy, as differential direct summands of sums of pushforwards of rank-one modules, with uniformly bounded cover degrees and highest breaks of the inducing modules.
entries.title_zh: 准幺幂 p 进微分方程的统一局部模型
entries.summary_zh: 论文为 Robba 环上的准幺幂微分模构造统一解析模型：给定秩上界 r 和最高分歧断点 b，模型环带内半径与连接矩阵界只依赖 r、b 和剩余特征 p，而不依赖系数域，也无需扩张系数域。作者还说明绝对 Frobenius 结构可延续到具有相同界的模型，并在有限扩张后把准常数模实现为秩一推前和的直和分量。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究 p 进微分方程、局部单值性和刚性上同调的读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: Robba 环、分歧断点和 Frobenius 结构是必要背景。
entries.cynic_review: 统一性结论明确给出参数依赖与无需扩域的部分。
entries.paper_review: 内容高度技术化，具体构造及“准常数”分解需论文细节。

entries.source_title: Defining equations for two-block shallow ReLU pattern varieties
entries.source_excerpt: We give a complete algebraic characterization of two-block shallow ReLU pattern varieties. We show that the determinantal equations arising from rank constraints imposed by the activation patterns generate the defining ideals, thereby proving a conjecture of Alexandr-Mont\'ufar. The set-theoretic proof uses a characterization of orbit closures of matrix pencils in terms of the Kronecker canonical form.
entries.title_zh: 两块浅层 ReLU 模式簇的定义方程
entries.summary_zh: 论文给出两块浅层 ReLU 激活模式所对应代数簇的完整刻画：由模式施加的秩约束产生的行列式方程能够生成其定义理想。由此作者证明 Alexandr–Montúfar 猜想；集合层面的证明使用矩阵铅笔轨道闭包与 Kronecker 标准形。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究 ReLU 网络几何、代数统计和确定性神经网络可实现性的读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 代数刻画可帮助分析特定浅层网络模式，但不能直接推广到任意网络架构。
entries.cynic_review: 主结果是完整理想生成定理，适用对象明确限定为两块浅层 ReLU 模式簇。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确给出猜想证明和核心代数工具，技术证明仍需检查。

entries.source_title: Graphs attaining Haemers' toughness bound
entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Yifan Li , Cheng Yeaw Ku; Subjects: Combinatorics (math.CO); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: 达到 Haemers 韧性界取等的图
entries.summary_zh: 在 Greaves 与 Zhu 已证明 Haemers 韧性猜想之后，本文刻画其等号情形：图取到谱下界，当且仅当补图有一个完全分量，其阶至少等于其他分量的 Laplacian 谱半径。等价表述是代数连通度与独立数之和等于顶点数；作者还确定达到韧性的顶点割，并证明正则等号图恰为各部分大小相等的完全多部图。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 补齐已知谱韧性不等式的等号分类，并给出正则图的简洁刻画。
entries.pragmatic_review: 谱图论研究者可用取等结构识别紧致图族。
entries.cynic_review: 分类依赖已有不等式及连通非完全图假设。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出等号判据、等价式和正则特例。

entries.source_title: max-sixty/worktrunk
entries.source_excerpt: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
entries.title_zh: Worktrunk：面向并行 Agent 工作流的 Git worktree 管理工具
entries.summary_zh: Worktrunk 是一个用于管理 Git worktree 的命令行工具，目标是让并行运行的 AI Agent 各自在独立工作目录中处理任务。摘录列出创建与切换 worktree、状态查看和清理等核心操作，也介绍了钩子、构建缓存共享及合并流程等扩展功能。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 如果个人开发者常让多个 Codex 或 Claude Code Agent 并行改代码，独立 worktree 能减少工作目录相互干扰；摘录还提供了 Windows 的安装方向和具体工作流，便于进一步评估。
entries.pragmatic_review: 核心命令覆盖创建、切换、查看和清理 worktree，适合已有 Git 项目且需要并行任务隔离的个人开发者。
entries.cynic_review: 项目介绍称其已成为最受欢迎的 worktree 管理器并列出多项便利功能，但这些热度与功能描述不能代替对本机兼容性、维护成本和个人工作流适配度的检查。
entries.paper_review: 摘录提供了仓库文件、许可证标识、命令示例和 CI 信息，但没有展示测试报告、基准结果或独立验证材料。

project_insight.translation_zh: Worktrunk 是一个 Git worktree 管理命令行工具，专为并行 AI Agent 工作流设计。它提供创建、切换、列出和清理 worktree 的核心命令，并包含钩子、合并流程、构建缓存共享和交互式选择器等扩展功能。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 用简化的命令管理多个 Git worktree，让并行 Agent 各自在独立工作目录中改代码。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读官方文档并确认 Windows 安装方式与 shell 集成要求；在非关键 Git 仓库中创建一个测试 worktree，检查切换、状态查看和清理行为，再决定是否用于日常并行任务。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 摘录描述了多项功能，但不能据此确认它们在目标环境中的表现；共享构建缓存只列出 APFS、btrfs 和 XFS，未包含 Windows 文件系统。仓库注明采用 MIT 或 Apache-2.0 许可；安装方式因平台而异。
use_cases_zh: 同时运行多个 Codex 或 Claude Code 任务，并为每个任务分配独立分支和工作目录。
在多个功能分支之间快速切换并查看各自的改动与提交状态。
为重复创建的开发 worktree 配置钩子或共享构建缓存。

entries.source_title: DBDSVDMR3: An MRRR-Based Bidiagonal SVD Solver Built from DSTEGR
entries.source_excerpt: The optimal algorithm for the symmetric tridiagonal eigenvalue problem is Multiple Relatively Robust Representations (MRRR or MR$^3$), which is capable of computing $k$ eigenvalue/eigenvector pairs in only $O(kn)$ floating-point operations. While MRRR is nearly 30 years old, it has never successfully been adapted to the bidiagonal SVD. This is not for lack of trying; two previous attempts produced implementations that were considered for LAPACK but eventually abandoned, a result of the fact that neither was reliable enough when run on test problems. The question therefore remained: is there a problem with the theory of MRRR for the bidiagonal SVD or were there simply bugs in the previous implementations that went undetected? This paper resolves this question by presenting DBDSVDMR3 -- a new implementation of the MRRR-based algorithm for the bidiagonal SVD originally proposed by Willems and Lang [ETNA 2012], which, for the first time, performs well on a variety of test problems while achieving significant speedups over both LAPACK's bisection-based solver and, in certain cases, divide-and-conquer for the bidiagonal SVD (thereby indicat
entries.title_zh: DBDSVDMR3：基于 MRRR 的双对角 SVD 求解器
entries.summary_zh: 论文介绍从 DSTEGR 构建的 MRRR 双对角奇异值分解实现，在多组测试中报告可靠性和对现有求解器的加速。作者称实现曾获 Claude Code 辅助，并计划随下一版 LAPACK 提供；当前摘要不足以确认发布状态或所有矩阵上的优势。

entries.pragmatic_review: 值得用实际矩阵测试速度与残差。
entries.cynic_review: 测试集表现不能保证所有病态输入可靠。
entries.paper_review: 实现可靠性回应了长期算法落地问题。

entries.source_title: A relative Schinzel-Zassenhaus bound for the polynomial $T^2 - 1$
entries.source_excerpt: For $f(T) = T^2 - 1$, we establish a lower bound for the relative dynamical house of wandering algebraic integers. This bound depends on the degree over the maximal abelian extension of the rationals. Our proof follows Dimitrov's approach to the Schinzel-Zassenhaus Conjecture and its generalization by Habegger-Schmidt.
entries.title_zh: 多项式 T²−1 的相对 Schinzel–Zassenhaus 界
entries.summary_zh: 论文针对多项式 T²−1，建立游荡代数整数的相对动力学 house 下界，界的大小取决于该代数整数相对于有理数最大阿贝尔扩张的次数。证明沿用并发展 Dimitrov 关于 Schinzel–Zassenhaus 猜想及 Habegger–Schmidt 推广的路线。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 将代数整数共轭大小的下界问题推广到相对扩张背景，适合代数数论和算术动力系统读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 应用范围偏理论，重点是相对次数参数。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要只涉及特定多项式，范围不能误读为一般情形。
entries.paper_review: 对经典 house 下界问题提供了相对扩张版本。

entries.source_title: upio/roblox-executor-mcp

entries.source_title: Maximality of the Do\v{s}en-Petri\'{c} Boolean Category
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that the zero-identity Boolean category of Do\v{s}en and Petri\'c, freely generated by a nonempty set of propositional variables, is maximal. Every congruence preserved by the operations on morphisms and by uniform formula substitution either is equality or identifies every pair of parallel morphisms. This disproves their conjecture that the category is not maximal. We give two proofs that use Boolean Coherence and uniform formula substitution to derive equality of the product projections from an identification of distinct parallel morphisms. We also give a Lean formalization of these proofs and their dependencies. It includes Boolean Coherence and the correspondence between substitution on tagged occurrence sets and substitution on finite ordinals.
entries.title_zh: Lean 形式化证明 Došen–Petrić 布尔范畴的极大性
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明 Došen–Petrić 布尔范畴具有极大性，并反驳此前关于其不极大的猜想；相关论证已在 Lean 4 中形式化，且包括依赖项。形式化证明提高了该命题机器可核验的程度，但不能替代对范畴定义、编码边界和形式化范围的理解。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 范畴逻辑与 Lean 形式化数学研究者可查看证明与依赖库。
entries.pragmatic_review: 有 Lean 代码可供核验，适合研究者复用形式化结构。
entries.cynic_review: 不仅给出数学结论，还形式化验证了明确依赖范围。
entries.paper_review: Lean 形式化增强可核验性，仍需确认代码覆盖的完整命题。

entries.source_title: Space-filling curves and small-ball probabilities for the Kloosterman process
entries.source_excerpt: We construct explicitly a space-filling curve in the support of the limiting Kloosterman process, using the planar partial-sum curve of the Rudin--Shapiro sequence. The qualitative existence statement was previously attributed to J. Bober by Kowalski. The resulting curve is a closed, $1/2$-H\"older continuous loop whose image contains a specified triangle of area $1/128$. Its Fourier coefficients are purely imaginary and satisfy $|\widehat f(h)|\leq(2\pi|h|)^{-1}$ for $h\ne 0$. We also prove a uniform lower bound for small balls centred at closed $1/2$-H\"older curves with a fixed coefficient bound, of the form $\exp\{-C\varepsilon^{-2}\log^2(2/\varepsilon)\}$. Known functional convergence then gives a quantitative lower bound for the limiting proportion of two-parameter Kloosterman paths approximating the constructed loop.
entries.title_zh: Kloosterman 过程的空间填充曲线与小球概率
entries.summary_zh: 论文用 Rudin–Shapiro 序列的平面部分和曲线，显式构造一条位于极限 Kloosterman 过程支撑集中的闭合 1/2-Hölder 曲线，其像包含面积为 1/128 的三角形；傅里叶系数为纯虚数，并满足给定的 1/|h| 上界。作者还证明，以满足固定系数界的闭合 1/2-Hölder 曲线为中心的小球概率有统一下界，量级为 exp(−C ε⁻² log²(2/ε))，再利用已知函数型收敛推导二参数 Kloosterman 路径逼近该曲线的比例下界。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合解析数论与随机过程读者，展示显式构造、概率估计和极限过程收敛如何结合。
entries.pragmatic_review: 显式曲线把抽象支撑集性质转成可研究的具体几何对象。
entries.cynic_review: 量化下界依赖曲线正则性与系数约束，常数和范围影响实际强度。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出构造、傅里叶界和小球概率定量形式，技术细节需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt
entries.source_excerpt: We ask how much an autoregressive transformer retains of its prompt after generating $t$ tokens. Consider two different prompts followed by the same continuation text, so that any difference in their hidden states comes from the prompt alone, and we find that the distance between their hidden states decays approximately as a power law $t^{-\alpha}$, where $\alpha=1$ is the rate at which a fixed prompt's share of uniform attention shrinks and smaller values mean longer memory. Trained models forget fast ($\alpha\approx0.55$--$0.7$), untrained ones slowly ($\alpha\approx0.2$--$0.5$). We prove that this offset is $O\big(P(\log t)^{L-1}/t\big)$ for a prompt of length $P$ and depth $L$. The bound holds for finite-depth pre-LN softmax transformers with bounded attention logits, under one additional condition: the pre-norm activations stay away from zero. The mechanism is geometric: the prompt's direct influence is diluted as the context grows, and \emph{relay} --- continuation tokens passing on what earlier tokens read from the prompt --- can only add logarithmic factors. entries.title_zh: Transformer 的条件性“无发丝定理”：语言模型如何遗忘提示
entries.summary_zh: 研究两个不同提示接上相同续写时，模型隐藏状态差异如何随生成长度衰减；实测衰减近似 t^{-α}，训练模型 α≈0.55–0.7，未训练模型 α≈0.2–0.5。作者对有限深度 pre-LN softmax Transformer 证明提示影响偏移上界 O(P(log t)^{L−1}/t)，但需注意 logits 有界且 pre-norm 激活远离零等条件。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关注长上下文信息保留、提示影响衰退与 Transformer 理论的研究者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 结合经验衰减率与有条件的理论上界解释提示稀释。
entries.cynic_review: 定理依赖有界注意力 logits 等理想假设，不能直接等同真实模型遗忘率。
entries.paper_review: 摘要清楚区分实测幂律与理论上界的适用条件。

entries.source_title: Optimized linear multistep methods for stiff problems
entries.source_excerpt: We design and test several new optimized linear multistep methods for stiff problems. Each method is A-stable, implicit, and second-order accurate. We focus on achieving the smallest possible error constant while also ensuring that stiff modes are damped. We recover some known optimal L-stable three- and four-step methods, and provide new and improved five-step methods. We also develop new methods that are not L-stable but provide a prescribed rate of damping in the infinitely stiff limit. Variable-step-size formulae are also provided for some of the new methods. Numerical tests demonstrate that the improved error constants lead to improved accuracy.
entries.title_zh: 刚性问题的优化线性多步法
entries.summary_zh: 作者设计隐式、二阶且 A 稳定的线性多步法，在保持刚性模态阻尼的同时优化误差常数。工作恢复最优三步、四步 L 稳定方法，给出改进的五步方法，也构造具有指定极限阻尼但不满足 L 稳定的格式，并提供变步长公式；数值测试显示误差常数改善带来精度提升。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合常微分方程数值求解者比较稳定性、阻尼和局部误差之间的设计取舍。
entries.pragmatic_review: 直接提供可用于刚性求解器的方法族和数值比较。
entries.cynic_review: 方法阶数与多步长度范围有限，实际收益依赖问题及步长策略。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确给出稳定性与误差指标，稳定域和测试基准需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Measuring Empowerment from Offline Data for Intrinsically Motivated Exploration
entries.source_excerpt: Large, unlabeled datasets of prior experience have become increasingly available for agentic tasks in domains such as robotics and coding. A common recipe for these tasks is to train a policy using the prior data, and then further improve it with online rollouts. But while much work has studied how to use both the offline and online data for policy extraction, far less work has been done to understand how the prior data can be used to efficiently \textit{explore} during the online learning phase. Previous work has attempted to formalize this idea by defining the \textit{empowerment}, a measure of how many future states an agent can realize; states with higher empowerment require more exploration as there are more futures to explore. However, existing methods for estimating empowerment require online policy rollouts in the environment. We propose the first method for estimating empowerment from unlabeled prior data, without any environment interaction. entries.title_zh: 从离线数据估计内在动机探索的 empowerment
entries.summary_zh: 论文针对 agent 常先从已有无标签轨迹训练、再在线探索的流程，提出无需环境交互即可从离线数据估计 empowerment（状态可达未来数量的度量）。方法联合学习最大化 empowerment 的策略及其折扣状态占用分布，使用未知动力学产生的轨迹作为训练数据；摘录尚未给出具体环境成绩或估计误差界。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合机器人和代码 agent 的离线预训练与内在动机探索研究者。

entries.source_title: The pattern of consistency strength for membership in a computably enumerable set
entries.source_excerpt: Every computable preorder relation on the natural numbers is the order of consistency strength for the membership assertions "$n\in A$" in some computably enumerable set $A$. Moreover, for every computably enumerable list of theories $T_0,T_1,T_2,\ldots$, each extending PA, there is a computably enumerable set $A$ such that each $T_n$ is equiconsistent over PA with the membership assertion $n\in A$. And similarly for both results when using instead the nonmembership assertions $n\notin A$.

entries.source_title: Short sums of the M\"obius function over function fields
entries.source_excerpt: We develop a new method which allows us to estimate, with a power saving, sums of the M{\"o}bius function over function fields $\F_p(X)$. The sums run over monic polynomials with all other coefficients in short intervals, of length below the P\'olya--Vinogradov threshold $p^{1/2}$. A classical result of L.~Stickelberger (1898) reduces this question to bounding character sums with polynomial discriminants which are inhomogeneous multivariate polynomials. Variants of Burgess's method with non-linear shifts {\it {\`a} la carte} are introduced to go beyond the P\'olya--Vinogradov range, combined with a stratification result of J. Xu (2020) for complete character sums.

entries.source_title: TeachBack: Learning to Teach via Bidirectional Preference Optimization for On-Policy Self-Distillation
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables a language model to learn from a Teacher instantiated from the same model but given access to privileged information, such as a reference solution. We find that access to sufficient privileged information allows the Teacher to generate highly accurate trajectories; however, accuracy alone does not guarantee that these trajectories are suitable for Student learning. Direct access to a complete solution may encourage shortened, reference-conditioned derivations that omit the exploration, verification, and self-correction required to solve problems without privileged information. We introduce TeachBack, a bidirectional preference-learning framework for on-policy self-distillation that learns not only from the Teacher but also how the Teacher should teach. TeachBack shapes the Teacher's generation behavior by controlling the length of the reference-reasoning suffix injected into the prompt and by varying the prompt style. entries.source_title: Refined Cram\'er-type moderate deviations by Stein's method under dependence
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we establish refined Cram\'er-type moderate deviations for dependent random variables at any fixed order $m\geq3$. Combining higher-order Stein identities with exponential tilting, we obtain cumulant-corrected tail approximations with explicit error bounds for boundedly supported kernels. Our main application gives a fourth-order expansion under bounded local dependence, reaching an $O(n^{3/10})$ deviation range under standard normalization with fixed dependence parameters. It improves on previous work in both deviation range and applicability, and also covers bounded $m$-dependent sequences without an independent-base representation. Further applications to the generalized combinatorial central limit theorem and the Curie-Weiss model also extend some earlier results under permutation and mean-field dependence.

entries.source_title: DynaDFlash: Dynamic Feature Projection for Block Diffusion Speculators
entries.source_excerpt: DFlash trains a parallel draft model on hidden features from its target model. Inspired by the previous work of DFlare that introduced per layer combinations of target hidden states, we test whether context dependent weighting of these states helps improve acceptance length of block diffusion speculators. We trained both a DFlash baseline for the Qwen 3 of block size 16, and a dynamic model that computes gates for each layer to affect the magnitude of hidden features before projection. While mean acceptance length between the dynamic model and the DFlash baseline didn't significantly differ, we notice that the dynamic model excels for drafting in the context of math. In an evaluation of 700 prompts from the MetaMathQA and Orca-Math datasets, the mean accepted length improves by 5%. We also found this lead to a 4.1% higher throughput for a subset of the same dataset in the context of speculative decoding.
entries.title_zh: DynaDFlash：用于块扩散推测解码的动态特征投影
entries.summary_zh: DynaDFlash 为目标模型不同层的隐藏特征学习上下文相关门控，再投影给并行草稿模型，以尝试提高块扩散推测解码的接受长度。总体平均接受长度与 DFlash 基线差异不显著，但在 700 条 MetaMathQA 和 Orca-Math 提示上，数学场景的平均接受长度提高 5%，部分数据子集吞吐提高 4.1%；收益集中于特定数学评测。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 针对数学提示探索动态特征门控对推测解码吞吐的影响，并报告总体与子域差异。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可为数学推理服务的投机解码优化提供候选方案。
entries.cynic_review: 总体接受长度未显著提升，吞吐优势只在部分数据集观察到。
entries.paper_review: 包含明确提示数量和对照结果，但效果范围较窄。

entries.source_title: Sasakian Hodge Numbers of Calabi-Yau Links
entries.source_excerpt: The link of an isolated weighted homogeneous hypersurface singularity whose degree equals the sum of its weights is a Sasakian manifold that admits a contact Calabi-Yau structure, and its Sasakian Hodge numbers are dimensions of graded pieces of the Milnor algebra of the defining polynomial. In earlier work these numbers were computed with Gr\"obner bases for the $7$-dimensional links of $7549$ of the $7555$ weighted Calabi-Yau threefold links, and two conjectures were raised from the data. The first asserts that polynomials with the same weights have Milnor algebras whose relevant graded pieces have equal dimensions; the second asserts that the Sasakian Hodge number $h^{2,1}_S$ of the link is bounded above by the Hodge number $h^{2,1}$ of the base Calabi-Yau threefold. Both conjectures are proved here. The first holds for every polynomial with an isolated singularity, because its partial derivatives form a regular sequence; an independent derivation of the Sasakian Hodge numbers by sheaf cohomology on the leaf-space orbifold is also given. For the second, the stringy Hodge numbers of the Calabi-Yau orbifold are shown to bound the mid
entries.title_zh: Calabi–Yau 链的 Sasakian Hodge 数
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究由加权齐次孤立超曲面奇点得到的接触 Calabi–Yau Sasakian 流形，并证明两个由既有计算提出的猜想。第一项说明固定权重下相关 Milnor 代数分次维数不随多项式改变；第二项给出 Sasakian h²,¹ 不超过底层 Calabi–Yau 三维簇的 Hodge 数，并以层上同调及弦 Hodge 数工具处理。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把计算观察提升为关于 Sasakian Hodge 数的普遍定理。
entries.pragmatic_review: 复几何和奇点理论研究者可关注两个猜想的证明路线。
entries.cynic_review: 对象限定为特定加权齐次孤立奇点及其链接结构。
entries.paper_review: 摘要把计算猜想、代数证明和几何推导区分清楚。

entries.source_title: Counting Bessel zeros and applications
entries.source_excerpt: We establish o-minimal definability results and develop point-counting machinery applicable to the zeros of a Bessel function of fixed non-negative real parameter. We also give an Ax-Schanuel theorem for Bessel functions of fixed (complex) parameters and exponential functions. We combine these to prove a sparsity result (weak Manin-Mumford) for points on an algebraic variety whose coordinates are zeros of a Bessel function of fixed (non-negative real) parameter. We apply this result to improve density results on spectral sets for the unit ball motivated by Fuglede's conjecture.
entries.title_zh: 贝塞尔函数零点计数及应用
entries.summary_zh: 论文建立固定非负实参数贝塞尔函数零点的 o-极小可定义性与点计数工具，并证明贝塞尔函数与指数函数的 Ax–Schanuel 定理。结合这些结果，作者得到坐标为此类零点的代数簇点集稀疏性（弱 Manin–Mumford），并改进由 Fuglede 猜想启发的单位球谱集密度结果。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 将超越数论的 Ax–Schanuel 与零点计数用于几何点集稀疏性和谱问题。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合可定义几何、特殊函数和谱理论交叉研究。
entries.cynic_review: 参数固定且非负，点集结论也依赖特定贝塞尔零点坐标条件。
entries.paper_review: 从函数域超越性定理一路导出算术几何和谱应用。

entries.source_title: SART: Sign-Absolute Reformulation Theory for Binary Variable Reduction in Neural Network Verification
entries.source_excerpt: Complete formal verification of neural networks is crucial for their deployment in safety-critical domains. A key bottleneck stems from encoding complexity: traditional methods assign one binary variable per unstable ReLU neuron. We propose the Sign-Absolute Reformulation Theory (SART), which fundamentally breaks the conventional one-to-one mapping between unstable neurons and binary variables by establishing formal reducibility criteria. This allows for finer-grained modeling, where each unstable neuron corresponds on average to fewer than one binary variable, thereby reducing verification complexity at its source. Based on SART, we derive a theoretical lower bound on the number of binary variables required for complete verification and, under the assumption that $P \neq NP$, prove that variables in the final layer can be compressed by 50\%, while the number of variables in intermediate layers cannot be further reduced. To overcome the apparent ``last-layer-only'' limitation, we recast verification as a sequential process and, crucially, show that the gain lifts to the entire network: LayerABS, a SART-based progressive tightening ver
entries.title_zh: SART：神经网络验证中二元变量压缩的符号绝对值重构理论
entries.summary_zh: 神经网络完整验证通常为每个不稳定 ReLU 分配一个二元变量；SART 给出可约化条件，打破这种一一对应，并证明在 P≠NP 假设下末层变量可压缩 50%，而中间层不存在更强的单层压缩。作者随后把验证改写为逐层收紧的 LayerABS，使末层收益传播到全网搜索空间；该结论是对理论编码复杂度的分析，不直接等同于任意实例都能获得相同运行加速。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 从编码变量数量这一验证瓶颈入手，给出可证明的压缩界和逐层算法。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于安全关键神经网络的精确验证工具设计。
entries.cynic_review: 变量压缩上界不自动转化为每个网络实例的运行时间提升。
entries.paper_review: 给出理论下界、条件性压缩界及全网迭代方案。

entries.source_excerpt: AI voice acting you can direct, not just generate
entries.title_zh: Fish Audio Drama 3：可导演式 AI 配音
entries.summary_zh: Product Hunt 将 Fish Audio Drama 3 描述为可由用户指导表演的 AI 配音工具，卖点是从单纯生成语音转向控制角色表达。现有材料未说明可调参数、声音授权、语言覆盖或质量评测，故无法判断其对专业配音工作流的适用程度。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关注角色化语音和创作控制的人，试听样例与声音授权信息是关键。

entries.cynic_review: “可导演”没有具体控制项说明，也未交代声音使用边界。
entries.paper_review: 当前只有产品描述，缺少客观语音质量对照。

entries.source_title: Folding Language Models into Themselves
entries.source_excerpt: Knowledge distillation usually trains a compact student from scratch, which needs a large amount of data even though the teacher's weights already encode most of what the student has to learn. In this work, we explore building the student directly from the teacher's weights. We propose Concertina, which folds every group of N adjacent teacher layers into one shared block that is executed N times. Each loop step carries a low-rank correction initialized from the layer it replaces, and a per-token gate mixes these corrections, to let every token recover the behavior of the original layers from a single shared block. We further design a distillation data recipe that balances general, mathematical, academic and targeted multiple-choice data, to recover all capabilities of the teacher together rather than one at the expense of another. On Qwen3-4B, a 2.27B Concertina model distilled on 22B tokens retains about 90% of the teacher on commonsense and mathematical reasoning and 84% on average across eight benchmarks. It outperforms same-size dense and layer-sharing baselines, as well as Qwen3-1.7B, which is trained on over a thousand times mor
entries.title_zh: 把语言模型折叠进自身：Concertina 层共享蒸馏
entries.summary_zh: Concertina 将教师模型每组相邻层折叠到同一个共享模块并循环执行，每一步用低秩修正和逐 token 门控补回被折叠层的行为，再以蒸馏恢复整体能力。论文报告 Qwen3-4B 蒸馏得到 2.27B 模型，在 22B token 训练后保留约 90% 的常识与数学推理表现、八项基准平均约 84%；这些比例依赖论文评测集和教师模型。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 提供直接复用教师权重压缩层数的方案，目标是降低学生模型训练数据和部署成本。
entries.pragmatic_review: 边缘部署可关注其参数压缩与能力保留之间的权衡。
entries.cynic_review: 能力保留比例需结合各基准分项与推理成本理解。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出结构设计、蒸馏规模和多基准结果。

entries.source_title: Direct Element-Level Mass Matrix Inversion
entries.source_excerpt: Explicit finite element methods for transient solid dynamics commonly use lumped mass matrices to avoid solving systems of equations for nodal accelerations at each time step. However, diagonal mass matrices may inadequately represent inertia, particularly for higher-order elements and coarse or distorted meshes. This has limited the use of higher-order elements in explicit dynamic analyses. This paper presents a systematic method for directly evaluating the inverse of non-diagonal element-level mass matrices for solid isoparametric elements of arbitrary interpolation order. The method applies to mixed mass matrices defined as linear combinations of lumped and consistent mass matrices, with a weighting parameter controlling the transition between diagonal, consistent, and intermediate formulations. It therefore provides a framework for incorporating non-diagonal mass formulations, including those for quadratic elements, into explicit finite element algorithms. The approach is demonstrated by deriving an explicit inverse formula for the mixed mass matrix of the eight-node hexahedral element. This formula enables efficient element-level
entries.title_zh: 有限元质量矩阵的直接单元级求逆公式
entries.summary_zh: 论文针对非对角或混合有限元质量矩阵，给出可在单元层面直接计算逆作用的显式公式，并面向任意阶有限元讨论构造。作者以八节点六面体为例展示方法；其效率和数值稳定性仍需结合网格、基函数与实现细节评估。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 有限元实现者可关注避免全局矩阵求逆的局部代数技巧。
entries.pragmatic_review: 有潜在实现价值，先在目标单元和网格上测稳定性。
entries.cynic_review: 显式公式不自动等于更快，条件数和组装成本要比较。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出公式与示例方向，性能证据尚不完整。

entries.source_title: AI 挖出潜伏十几年的 PHP 底层漏洞，PHP2Shell 事件全景复盘
entries.source_excerpt: 作者复盘 PHP2Shell 事件：两个 CVSS 满分定为 9.2 分的 PHP 远程代码执行漏洞（CVE-2026-109618 和 CVE-2026-109619）在补丁发布前泄露，攻击演示视频外流，多国政府网站预防性下线，OpenAI 认领漏洞由 GPT-5.6 Sol 辅助发现。
entries.title_zh: AI 挖出潜伏多年的 PHP 底层漏洞：PHP2Shell 事件复盘
entries.summary_zh: 作者用通俗例子解释 PHP2Shell 的两条内存安全路径，并回顾漏洞披露提前、演示视频泄露、各地网站预防性下线及 10 月 21 日补丁发布。文中称 GPT-5.6 Sol 参与发现，但具体漏洞成因、严重度和修复版本应以 PHP 与相关安全机构公告为准；作者进一步提出 AI 降低漏洞发现成本后，老旧 PHP 系统与维护资源不足会成为更突出风险。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把漏洞技术机制与协调披露、基础设施维护压力联系起来，适合安全和运维人员快速了解事件背景。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可提醒团队优先检查长期无人维护的 PHP 服务。
entries.cynic_review: 长篇复盘包含评论性判断，技术事实需回到公告核实。
entries.paper_review: 案例适合讨论 AI 对漏洞发现与补丁治理的影响。

entries.source_title: Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams
entries.title_zh: 为医疗团队推进 computer-use agent
entries.summary_zh: OpenAI 举例说明，computer-use agent 可在电子病历与保险门户之间完成多步重复流程，例如整理 MRI 预授权所需的信息；它通过点击、输入和切换应用操作现有软件。公告强调这是辅助工作流的能力，未说明所有操作均可无人值守，敏感医疗流程仍需权限控制和工作人员确认。

entries.cynic_review: 跨系统录入一旦出错可能影响患者服务，必须保留人工检查。
entries.paper_review: 案例说明产品设想，不是临床试验或生产效果报告。

entries.source_title: On the gradient conjecture at infinity: Finite spherical length for gradient trajectories of definable potentials
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that for every open $ U \subseteq \mathbb R^n $ the spherical projection of every gradient trajectory $\theta(t)$, $t \geq 0$, of a definable $C^1$-potential $F \colon U \to \mathbb R$ has finite length and, in particular, converges (directional convergence). In other words, every gradient trajectory of a definable $C^1$-potential has finite total angular motion. Here, definable means definable in an arbitrary o-minimal structure expanding the real field. Notably, the gradient trajectory in this result is an arbitrary solution of the gradient flow differential equation (whose solutions may not be unique) with no further assumptions: The gradient trajectory may be unbounded and diverge to infinity or it may be convergent. The established theorem therefore provides affirmative answers to both the gradient conjecture at infinity for definable potentials and the definable Thom gradient conjecture. We apply our theorem to the training of deep neural networks (DNNs) to conclude that, in the case of definable and continuously differentiable activation and loss functions, the spherical projection of the DNN training flow must alway
entries.title_zh: 可定义势函数梯度轨道的有限球面长度
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明，在任意扩张实数域的 o-极小结构中可定义的 C¹ 势函数，其任意梯度轨道经球面投影后总长度有限，因此方向收敛。结果不要求轨道有界、趋于无穷或梯度流解唯一，适用于每一条解；这为“无穷远处梯度猜想”给出强形式的方向收敛结论。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把 o-极小可定义性转化为梯度轨道总角运动有限的普适结论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于非线性优化与动力系统中分析轨道远端方向行为。
entries.cynic_review: 关键前提是势函数在指定 o-极小结构中可定义且为 C¹。
entries.paper_review: 涵盖不唯一、无界等一般轨道情形，结论范围明确而强。

entries.source_title: Arithmetical and set-theoretic semantics of the logic of problems and propositions
entries.source_excerpt: Kolmogorov interpreted intuitionistic logic as a calculus of problems and later remarked that a complete treatment should deal with problems and propositions together. Melikhov's logic HC is such a joint two-sorted system: it combines classical propositions with intuitionistic problems by means of two modalities, the problem !A (``find a proof of the proposition A'') and the proposition phi (``the problem phi has a solution''). We give the language of HC a formal semantics in which the modalities are read literally: solutions of !A are proofs of A in a fixed formal theory, ?phi states that phi has a solution, and the connectives on problems are interpreted as in Kleene realizability. Three variants are studied: the arithmetical semantics I (provability in PA), its external version E (truth in the standard model), and the set-theoretic semantics B over ZF, where problem variables are ``black boxes'' and a quantifier Pi over them is available. Validity is defined as the existence of a computable uniform solution. We determine which schemes are valid, build calculi HCI, HCE, HCB sound with respect to the three semantics, and derive Lob's
entries.title_zh: 问题与命题逻辑的算术及集合论语义
entries.summary_zh: 论文为 HC 双类型逻辑建立形式语义，把命题与“求解问题”同时纳入系统，并用证明、可计算解以及可实现性解释相应模态。作者研究 PA 可证性、标准模型真理和 ZF 集合论三种语义，考察哪些逻辑模式有效并构造演算；其出发点是 Kolmogorov 将直觉主义逻辑视为问题演算的思想。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 连接直觉主义逻辑、可计算性和形式化证明语义，适合逻辑与计算基础读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 关注证明即程序或问题逻辑时可比较三类语义。
entries.cynic_review: 系统包含多种语义变体，具体有效性结论需逐条阅读。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出清晰的语义框架和研究目标。

entries.paper_review: 材料提供数据规模、字段和划分说明，但没有展示系统性图文一致性审核或评测结果。

project_insight.translation_zh: Pixel Art Atlas 包含 1,409,404 张合成游戏精灵图及英文说明，涉及 6,194 个训练主题；每张图为带透明背景的原生 16×16 图像。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 这是用于像素风图像生成与实验的合成图像及说明数据集，提供 Parquet 图像记录和可选的像素索引文件。

use_cases_zh: 为个人像素风图像生成或分类原型准备小尺寸训练样本。

entries.source_title: Poisson-Dirichlet statistics for the log-modulus of the Riemann zeta function on expanding intervals near the critical line
entries.source_excerpt: For $T > 0$ large, let $\tau$ be uniformly distributed on $[T,2T]$ and let $\sigma = \sigma(T)$ be a deterministic real part approaching $1/2$ from the right. As $\beta$ increases, the Gibbs measure increasingly favors positions where $|\zeta|$ is large, providing a way to study the spatial organization of extreme values. Under explicit conditions on the rate at which $\sigma$ approaches the critical line, a phase transition is established at the critical inverse temperature $\beta_{c}(\theta) := 2\sqrt{1 + \theta}$. entries.title_zh: 临界线附近扩展区间上 ζ 函数模的 Poisson–Dirichlet 统计
entries.summary_zh: 论文令实部 σ(T) 从右侧趋近 1/2，在长度约为 (log T)^θ 的区间上，以 |ζ(σ+iτ+ih)|^β 构造 Gibbs 权重，研究高模值位置的重叠相关。作者在明确的趋近速率条件下证明相变临界逆温度 βc=2√(1+θ)：β 不超过临界值时重叠极限集中于 0，超过后极限在 0 与 1 处分别有 βc/β 和 1−βc/β 的质量，低温联合重叠由 Poisson–Dirichlet 权重描述；证明不依赖黎曼猜想。

entries.source_title: The Manhattan cospectrality of the cocktail party graph
entries.source_excerpt: For a graph $G$ of order $N$ with adjacency eigenvalues $\lambda_{1}(G)\geq \cdots\geq\lambda_{N}(G),$ the cospectrality of $G$ is the smallest value of $\sum_{i}\left\vert \lambda_{i}(G)-\lambda_{i}(H)\right\vert $ over all graphs $H$ of order $N$ not isomorphic to $G.$ Abdollahi and Zakeri (Ars Math. Contemp. 22(1) (2022) P1.06) conjectured that the cospectrality of the cocktail party graph $CP_{n}$ is attained exactly at the graph $H_{n}.$ This graph is obtained from $K_{1,2,\ldots,2}$ by attaching a pendant vertex to the vertex of the part of size one. We prove this conjecture for every $n\geq2$ by showing that only three explicit graphs (two for $n=2$) are at distance less than $2$ from $CP_{n}.$ We work with the complement of a competing graph. First we remove its components $K_{2}.$ Then we treat the case in which its main component has a dominating vertex. The remaining cases are reduced to finitely many small graphs. The proof is computer-assisted, and all computations concern explicit finite lists of graphs.

entries.source_title: Batching the Reflective Optimization Loop: Parallel Proposals Make GEPA Faster and Better
entries.source_excerpt: Reflective text optimization makes agentic systems better, but the optimization loop is itself a resource-hungry workload whose sequential structure leaves parallel evaluation capacity idle. We extend the open-source GEPA optimizer to propose and evaluate a batch of candidates on each optimization step instead of one candidate at a time. In our sweep on two tasks, most batched runs finished in half the wall-clock time or less, and the fastest in about a quarter to a third. Batched settings also achieved higher held-out test scores, from 68.9% to 72.1% on LiveBench-Math (with $2\times2$) and from 49.0% to 60.0% on HoVer (with $8\times1$). A simple runtime model explains the measured speedups under a finite worker pool, and batched settings also spend their metric-call and dollar budgets more efficiently. We frame the axes along which a reflective optimization step can scale in parallel, a first look at allocating a fixed optimization budget across them.

entries.source_title: Dependent choice and iterated beta_n-model reflection
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we consider conservation results for iterated $\beta_n$-model reflection principles. Using these principles, we characterize the $\Pi^1_{m+2}$-, $\Sigma^1_{m+2}$- and $\mathsf{B}(\Pi^1_{m+2})$-consequences of $\Sigma^1_{n+1}$-$\mathsf{DC}_0$ and $\Sigma^1_{n+1}$-$\mathsf{TDC}_0$ for $m \leq n$. Here, $\mathsf{B}(\Pi^1_{m+2})$ denotes the set of Boolean combinations of $\Pi^1_{m+2}$-formulas, and $\mathsf{TDC}$ stands for transfinite $\mathsf{DC}$. We also show that, in each case, the stronger theory has a super-exponential speed-up over the corresponding conservative subtheory.

entries.source_title: The first-order part of the Ordered Variable Word theorem
entries.source_excerpt: An ordered $\omega$-variable sequence over a finite alphabet~$A$ is an infinite sequence over the extended alphabet $A \sqcup \{ x_0, x_1, \dots \}$, where each variable kind appears at least once, and the last occurrence of $x_i$ appears before the first occurrence of $x_{i+1}$. The Ordered Variable Word theorem states that for every finite coloring of the words over a finite alphabet~$A$, there is an ordered $\omega$-variable sequence~$W$ over~$A$ such that every word induced by substituting variables with letters, and cutting before the first undefined variable, has the same color. In this article, we prove that the Ordered Variable Word theorem is $\Pi^1_1$-conservative over $\mathsf{RCA}_0 + \mathsf{B}\Sigma^0_2$. It follows that the tree theorem for singletons by Chubb, Hirst, and McNicholl is $\Pi^1_1$-conservative over $\mathsf{RCA}_0 + \mathsf{B}\Sigma^0_2$, answering a long-standing open question. Lemma 3.13 was found by Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic).
entries.title_zh: 有序变量词定理的一阶部分
entries.summary_zh: 有序 ω-变量词定理断言：有限字母表上任意有限着色，都存在变量出现顺序受限的无限词序列，使对变量作字母替换并按规定截断后所得词同色。本文证明该定理对 RCA₀+BΣ⁰₂ 是 Π¹₁-保守的，并由此得到 Chubb、Hirst 与 McNicholl 的单点树定理相关推论；结果关注定理在反向数学中的逻辑强度。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 刻画组合 Ramsey 型变量词定理在弱算术基础上的证明论强度。

entries.source_title: The minimum number of wheel-saturating edges
entries.source_excerpt: Let $G$ be an $H$-free graph and $e$ be a non-edge of $G$. We say $e$ is an $H$-saturating edge of $G$, if $G+e$ contains a copy of $H$. We denote by $f_H(n,m)$ the minimum number of $H$-saturating edges of an $n$-vertex $H$-free graph with exactly $m$ edges. In this paper, we show that $f_{W_{2k+1}}(n,ex(n,F_{2k+1})+1)= \begin{cases} \ell -k, &(k-2)\ell \ \text{is even}, 2(\ell-k)-1, &(k-2)\ell \ \text{is odd}, \end{cases}$ and $f_{W_{2k}}(n,ex(n,F_{2k})+1)=\left(\frac{2}{33}+o(1)\right)n^2.$ At the same time, we characterize the corresponding extremal graphs.

entries.source_title: On the LLM Verification for Argument Graph Generation
entries.source_excerpt: Multi-agent LLM systems can formalize natural-language argumentation end-to-end, turning plain text into structured graphs by classifying components, connecting them with relations, and enriching the resulting graphs into formal models. Quality assurance for those graphs is almost always another LLMs: a reviewer, judge, or critic agent. On the other side, in adjacent neuro-symbolic fields, such generated output is often verified symbolically by external checks and solvers. In this work, we argue that in argument graph verification, the allocation should be similar, and based on what each instrument can guarantee. We propose layered verification: starting from deterministic checks, moving to solver-based and LLM reviews, and utilizing debate only under uncertainty, leaving human judgment for what no other instrument can decide. We ground our principle with a study on human-annotated graphs with injected structural defects. entries.title_zh: 论证图生成的分层验证
entries.summary_zh: 多智能体系统可把自然语言论证转换为结构图，但常由另一个 LLM 充当审稿人；论文主张应根据不同验证工具能保证什么分配工作。作者提出分层流程：先做确定性结构检查，再用求解器验证可形式化性质，之后才使用 LLM 评审，并把辩论机制留给仍不确定的情况，以降低把模型意见误当可靠验证的风险。

entries.source_title: Linear Axiomatization of Linear Differential Equations
entries.source_excerpt: This article presents an axiomatization of linear differential equations that is complete for topologically open properties with compact initial conditions and time horizons by proving them deductively via a sound reduction to formulas of linear real arithmetic. Indeed, linearity is preserved: linear differential invariants are complete for open properties of linear differential equations and reduce with a linear number of Lie derivatives (per atom) to linear real arithmetic. In particular, this article shows that the linear fragment of differential dynamic logic (dL), a modal extension of standard first-order logic over the reals satisfies these completeness properties. By establishing completeness within decidable linear real arithmetic, the need for proving sophisticated nonlinear formulas of real arithmetic is circumvented. Furthermore, this article establishes generalizations to the nonlinear fragment of dL that enable the practical certification of reachability computations, validating the output of external computations in dL with machine-checkable proofs.
entries.title_zh: 线性微分方程的线性公理化

Our assumptions include natural symmetry, a sign condition on the sum of the directional coefficients, and decay on the discrete weights. We also derive a consistency estimate for the complete nonlinear spatial operator. For rigorous convergence analysis, we restrict ourselves to one space dimension and introduce the cumulative variable associated with the density. entries.source_title: Compatible by Construction: Bottom-Up Nonlinear Model Reduction without Interface Bases
entries.source_excerpt: Nonlinear manifolds can provide compact representations of solutions to partial differential equations (PDEs), but generating training data and learning these representations on large domains remain costly. We present a bottom-up framework that reuses local nonlinear representations learned on a small training domain to solve larger PDE systems. A shared nonlinear decoder represents the full set of degrees of freedom owned by each subdomain, without separate interior and interface models. Each global degree of freedom has a unique owner, and local residuals directly use decoded state values from the corresponding neighboring subdomains. The resulting discrete state is single-valued by construction, eliminating the need for independent interface copies and additional interface compatibility constraints. Physical coupling is retained through the original time-discrete PDE residual. With the decoder held fixed, the subdomain-specific reduced coordinates are determined jointly by minimizing this residual, and the Gauss--Newton system is assembled from local contributions. entries.source_title: FederatedBytes: Tokenizer-Free, Byte-Level Small Language Models for Efficient Multimodal Federated Learning
entries.source_excerpt: Federated Learning (FL) is a powerful machine learning framework that allows building a global model from the contributions of multiple, distributed clients, while ensuring the privacy of their local data. However, its heavy computational and communication overheads challenge its use for contemporary AI workloads such as natural language processing (NLP) and multimodal analysis. For this reason, this paper presents a novel small language model that leverages byte-level text and multimodal data processing, enhanced by a linear attention mechanism, to enable manageable Federated Learning of NLP and multimodal analysis tasks. The proposed model, nicknamed FederatedBytes, manages to process text and any other data types, including images, by treating its input as a mere sequence of bytes, while its lean linear attention mechanism allows abating the overall memory and computational footprint. To prove the effectiveness of the proposed model we have carried out an extensive performance evaluation on sentiment analysis tasks in multilingual and multimodal settings over the Multilingual Amazon Reviews and ScienceQA datasets. entries.source_title: Terracini loci of tangential varieties of Veroneseans
entries.source_excerpt: The Terracini locus of a projective variety tells us the sets of points at which Terracini's lemma will fail to recover the dimension of the corresponding secant variety. We study the Terracini loci of tangential varieties of Veronese varieties, classifying several cases, including a complete classification of the Terracini loci of tangential varieties to rational normal curves. We also show that many Terracini loci involve only sets with "intratangent pairs" that lie on the same tangent space to the underlying Veronese variety. Finally, we give some applications to algebraic statistics, showing that osculating varieties of Veronese varieties are moment varieties for local mixtures of location families and connecting Terracini loci to local identifiability.

entries.source_title: Iterated Lavrentiev regularization under random noise: variational source conditions and rates in expectation
entries.source_excerpt: The convergence theory of iterated Lavrentiev regularization for nonlinear monotone ill-posed equations is deterministic: the data error is bounded by a known level that the discrepancy principle uses explicitly. Under Gaussian noise no such bound exists. For a discretized two-dimensional nonlinear inverse source problem for the Poisson equation, we analyse convergence in a finite-energy Gaussian noise model, keeping the linearized and nonlinear cases apart. The rate degrades gracefully, down to logarithmic, as the underlying continuum error loses smoothness, and a balancing rule attains it without knowing the smoothness. entries.title_zh: 随机噪声下迭代 Lavrentiev 正则化的期望收敛率
entries.summary_zh: 传统非线性单调病态方程的迭代 Lavrentiev 正则化依赖已知数据误差上界，但高斯噪声下该上界通常未知。论文分析 Poisson 方程二维非线性逆源问题的离散模型，区分线性化与非线性迭代：线性化误差可写成噪声经 resolvent 作用的结果，从而得到奇异值方差公式和期望先验率；再对满足距离函数一致有界的一族离散化给出主要收敛结论。

entries.pragmatic_review: 可为含随机测量噪声的非线性逆问题选择正则化参数提供理论基础。

entries.paper_review: 明确分离线性化与非线性分析，并给出期望误差率。

entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Michael Feischl , David Niederkofler; Subjects: Numerical Analysis (math.NA); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: 准正交性是一种几何性质
entries.summary_zh: 自适应网格细化的最优收敛证明常用准正交性，既有证明依赖离散稳定性或复杂矩阵分解分析。本文基于 Hilbert 空间几何证明准正交性本身是点集的几何性质，并在一大类针对单调非线性方程的 Petrov–Galerkin 方法中验证该性质。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 将自适应有限元收敛理论中的技术条件还原为几何性质，简化理解并扩大适用分析。
entries.pragmatic_review: 几何表述可能降低证明新离散格式准正交性的技术门槛。
entries.cynic_review: 应用仍需方法满足文中的几何条件，摘要未列出全部离散假设。
entries.paper_review: 把准正交性从矩阵分解技术中抽离出来，并展示非线性方法应用。

entries.source_title: NormTune: Norm-Guided Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Reasoning-Intensive Tasks
entries.source_excerpt: Full fine-tuning has achieved remarkable success on reasoning-intensive tasks, but it often requires substantial GPU resource consumption. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) provides a promising alternative for reducing this cost, yet we observe a substantial performance gap on reasoning-intensive tasks. In this paper, we present three key observations showing that this gap is closely associated with norm-related under-adaptation, where PEFT produces markedly smaller weight-update norms than full fine-tuning. Based on these observations, we propose Norm-Guided Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (NormTune), a simple yet effective strategy that adaptively strengthens insufficiently updated layers according to their weight-update norms. Extensive experiments show that NormTune consistently enhances multiple PEFT methods across challenging reasoning benchmarks. Specifically, when trained on S1K-1.1, integrating NormTune into rank-8 LoRA, Bone, and MoRA yields substantial average accuracy improvements of 24.24\%, 11.33\%, and 16.21\% , respectively, across AIME 2024, MATH 500, GPQA, and AIME 2025. Moreover, NormTune-enhanced rank-256 LoRA
entries.title_zh: NormTune：面向推理任务的范数引导参数高效微调
entries.summary_zh: 作者观察到参数高效微调在推理密集任务上的性能落差，与其权重更新范数显著小于全量微调有关，并提出 NormTune 按层更新范数自适应增强学习不足的层。方法旨在不承担全量微调成本的情况下缩小推理任务差距；具体效果以论文后续实验配置和模型范围为准。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 用可观测的层级更新范数诊断 PEFT 欠适配，并据此调整训练强度。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合资源受限、但对推理能力微调有较高要求的模型训练场景。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要中的性能主张需按任务、基线和计算预算对照实验核验。
entries.paper_review: 方法直接针对 PEFT 更新幅度不足这一经验观察。

entries.source_title: Cumulant Generating Function of the Hill-Lane-Sudderth urn model
entries.source_excerpt: We consider the Hill, Lane and Sudderth urn, in which a black or white ball is added at each step with probabilities depending on the current proportion of black balls. We solve the equation for the limiting normalized cumulant generating function when the urn function is invertible on the outer branches beyond the fixed points and the corresponding inverses are Lipschitz. The solution has a parametric representation through three quadratures of the urn function and a limit of compositions of radicals, with no derivatives or inverses of the urn function in the final formula. We prove an error bound that does not accumulate along the partition and remains valid when starting from the initial singularity. Four examples with exact solutions illustrate the two orientations of the construction, the non-affine case and the presence of zeros.
entries.title_zh: Hill–Lane–Sudderth 抽球模型的累积量生成函数
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究每一步按当前黑球比例决定加入黑球或白球概率的 Hill–Lane–Sudderth 抽球模型，并在抽球函数外侧分支可逆且逆函数 Lipschitz 等假设下求出归一化累积量生成函数的极限。公式通过抽球函数的三重积分和根式复合极限参数化，误差界不会沿分割累积，并给出四个可精确求解的例子。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 随机抽球模型和大偏差研究者可参考其显式极限公式与可控离散化误差。
entries.pragmatic_review: 解析公式有助于研究特定抽球模型的涨落，假设需逐项验证。
entries.cynic_review: 结果包含可检查的误差控制，但仅覆盖具有指定可逆分支和 Lipschitz 性的模型。
entries.paper_review: 摘要说明公式结构、误差性质和精确例子，定量界需查全文。

entries.source_title: Exceptional sequences of line bundles on $\mathrm{Fl}(1,\ell;\ell+1)$
entries.source_excerpt: Let $X_\ell=\mathrm{Fl}(1,\ell;\ell+1)\subset\mathbb{P}^\ell\times(\mathbb{P}^\ell)^\vee$ be the incidence variety of points and hyperplanes in $\mathbb{P}^\ell$. We prove that for every $\ell\ge 3$, every exceptional sequence of line bundles on $X_\ell$ of maximal length $\ell(\ell+1)=\operatorname{rk} K_0(X_\ell)$ is full. Together with the case $\ell=2$, due to Altmann, Hochenegger and Witt, this shows that for all $\ell\ge2$ an exceptional sequence of line bundles on $X_\ell$ is full if and only if it has maximal length. The proof translates exceptionality into a combinatorial condition on lattice points of $\operatorname{Pic}(X_\ell)\cong\mathbb{Z}^2$ and reduces fullness to sequences containing a non-orthogonal descent. A capacity count for admissibly ordered subsets rules out all but one family of descents; for that family we classify the possible configurations and verify generation using Euler sequences and Koszul complexes.
entries.title_zh: 旗簇 Fl(1,ℓ;ℓ+1) 上线丛例外序列的满性
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明对 ℓ≥3，旗簇 Fl(1,ℓ;ℓ+1) 上任一达到 K₀ 秩的线丛例外序列都是满的，结合 ℓ=2 的既有结果得到所有 ℓ≥2 的相应刻画。证明把例外性转化为 Picard 格点条件，再分析序列中的非正交下降并用 Euler 序列与 Koszul 复形验证生成性。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 为一族具体旗簇上的导出范畴例外序列给出完整性判据。
entries.pragmatic_review: 研究半正交分解与导出范畴时可作为明确几何例子。
entries.cynic_review: 结论针对指定旗簇和线丛序列，不自动推广到一般旗簇。
entries.paper_review: 摘要说明组合化证明思路及生成性验证工具。

entries.source_title: The Yau Geometric Conjecture for Isolated Hypersurface Singularities
entries.source_excerpt: This paper presents a proof of the long-standing Yau Geometric Conjecture.
entries.title_zh: 孤立超曲面奇点的 Yau 几何猜想
entries.summary_zh: 来源只提供一句摘录，称论文给出长期开放的 Yau 几何猜想的证明；没有说明猜想的精确表述、奇点类别、证明方法或推论。由于仅凭标题和声明无法核验定理范围，摘要不扩写其数学内容。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究复解析奇点的读者查看原文确认猜想表述及证明条件。
entries.pragmatic_review: 若声明成立，解决长期猜想将有较大理论意义。
entries.cynic_review: 来源摘录过于简短，不能独立判断证明覆盖范围。
entries.paper_review: 缺少摘要与定理条件，暂无法评估证明细节。

entries.source_title: Calibrated for Which Policy? Conformal Uncertainty for Fixed World Models Under Intervention
entries.source_excerpt: Changing a deployment policy can invalidate a world model's uncertainty while leaving the physical transition mechanism and predictor unchanged. For one-step prediction, if source and target laws share the conditional mechanism $P(Y|X)=Q(Y|X)$, then the intervention is identified by the pre-outcome change of measure $w(X)=dQ_X/dP_X$. For policy-controlled dynamics this ratio factors into state-occupancy and action-propensity terms. Weighted conformal calibration transports marginal coverage to the target law; with an estimated ratio $\hat w$, $P_Q\{Y \in C_{\hat w}(X)\} \ge 1-\alpha-TV(Q,\hat Q) \ge 1-\alpha-E_P|w-\hat w|$. Population log-loss regret for a source-versus-target domain classifier bounds the same ratio error. If $h$ is its clipped target posterior, $\rho$ is the target-domain prior, and $\Delta(h)$ is population log-loss regret, then $E_P|w-\hat w_h| \le (1/(\rho\gamma))\sqrt{\Delta(h)/2}$. An exact cancellation improves the dependence from a generic odds-map bound of order $\gamma^{-2}$ to $(\rho\gamma)^{-1}$. entries.title_zh: 策略改变后，世界模型的不确定性还校准吗？
entries.summary_zh: 论文分析固定动力学机制下部署策略改变导致的分布偏移，并用源/目标状态分布的密度比重加权共形校准，使边际覆盖率可迁移。若权重由域分类器估计，可用总体对数损失遗憾界控制覆盖误差；实验用 DINO 世界模型特征和 Franka 机器人轨迹检验策略干预。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合机器人策略迁移和分布外预测区间可信度研究。
entries.pragmatic_review: 共形预测提供有限样本边际覆盖，政策改变通过 covariate shift 影响校准。
entries.cynic_review: 给出明确覆盖误差界并解释估权误差来源。
entries.paper_review: 保证依赖条件机制不变及密度比估计质量。

entries.source_title: Diamond Maximal Operators: Classification, Moduli, and Oscillation Envelopes
entries.source_excerpt: We study maximal averages generated by bounded cancellative kernels taking values in finite-dimensional real normed spaces, on Euclidean balls and on balls in a non-Archimedean local field with a fixed uniformizer. For angular kernels, pointwise domination of the full maximal operators is equivalent to factorization of their angular averaging maps, with the same optimal constant. Nonzero scalar angular comparison classes are therefore projective kernel classes. For angular kernels constant on a fixed finite measurable partition of the direction space, symmetric convex bodies classify exact norm measurements, Grassmannians parametrize nonzero classes under mutual domination, and positive semidefinite Gram matrices classify Hilbert-valued measurements. For general kernels, the closed convex hull of the averaging densities obtained from all scales and the dual unit ball is a complete invariant of the full maximal operator. A dilation example exhibits identifications of residue kernels beyond scaling and unit-coordinate changes. entries.title_zh: Diamond 极大算子的分类、模空间与振荡包络
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究由有限维实赋范空间值的有界消去核生成的 Euclidean 与非阿基米德球上极大平均算子，并刻画算子间逐点支配关系。角向核的支配可等价转为角平均映射分解，有限分割情形由对称凸体、Grassmannian 或半正定 Gram 矩阵分类；一般核则由所有尺度平均密度与对偶单位球生成的闭凸包作完全不变量。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合调和分析与局部域分析读者关注极大算子之间何时等价或支配。
entries.pragmatic_review: 给出多类核函数下的分类不变量和结构化参数空间。
entries.cynic_review: 结果依赖有限维值域、核类别及文中定义，技术适用范围较专门。
entries.paper_review: 摘要说明了标量、向量和一般核的不同分类框架。

entries.source_title: Mahler measures and a cubic Dedekind zeta value in three dilogarithms
entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Vedran Menđušić; Subjects: Number Theory (math.NT); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: Mahler 测度与三个二重对数中的三次 Dedekind ζ 值
entries.summary_zh: 作者建立三变量 Mahler 测度在若干 Heegner 点的通式，并与 CM 模形式及射线类 L 值联系，从而证明 Zheng 猜测的六个恒等式。对由 a³+2a−2=0 定义的三次域，文章又用精确双曲体积公式把 Dedekind ζ 函数导数 ζ′(−1) 写成三个 Bloch–Wigner 二重对数；对应到其与 √5 的扩张时仍有一个明确的 Bloch 群等式猜想未解。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 连接 Mahler 测度、模形式、特殊 L 值与双曲几何体积，适合数论和算术几何读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 给出多个精确恒等式，能作为特殊值计算与猜想验证的工具。
entries.cynic_review: 所述 Heegner 判别式范围有限，扩张域的类似公式仍未证明。
entries.paper_review: 将不同领域的特殊值通过显式公式统一，并完成六个既有猜想。

entries.source_title: Cohomological VC-density: Bounds and Applications
entries.source_excerpt: The concept of Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) density is pivotal across various mathematical fields, including discrete geometry, probability theory and model theory. In this paper, we introduce a topological generalization of VC-density. Let $Y$ be a topological space and $\mathcal{X}$ a family of closed subspaces of $Y$. For each $p \geq 0$, we define a number, $\mathrm{vcd}^{p}_{\mathcal{X}}$, which we refer to as the degree $p$ VC-density of the family $\mathcal{X}$. The classical notion of VC-density within this topological framework can be recovered by setting $p=0$. Our definition of degree $p$ VC-density extends to higher orders as well. For $p \geq 0$, $q \geq 1$, we define the degree $p$, order $q$ VC density $\mathrm{vcd}^{p,q}_{\mathcal{X}}$ of $\mathcal{X}$, which recovers Shelah's notion of higher order VC-density for $q$-dependent families when $p=0$. Our definition introduces a completely new notion when $p > 0$. entries.title_zh: 上同调 VC 密度的界与应用
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出上同调 VC 密度，将经典 VC 密度推广到可由拓扑不变量描述的情形，并用参数 p 与阶 q 组织相关界；当 p=0 时恢复经典及更高阶 Shelah 型概念。摘要摘录未展示主要上界和应用细节，因此只能确认推广框架，不能比较具体的最优界。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 模型论与拓扑组合交叉研究者可关注 VC 密度的拓扑化推广。
entries.pragmatic_review: 目前可作理论线索，需读全文才能判断界的用途。
entries.cynic_review: 推广框架清楚，但核心数值界在摘录中缺席。
entries.paper_review: 摘要材料有限，只能核实 p=0 的恢复关系。

entries.source_title: Lifelong Context Adaptation through Bidirectional Memory-Skill Learning
entries.source_excerpt: Lifelong LLM agents must learn from an expanding history of interactions while making each decision within a bounded context window. Memory makes past experience available, but the agent may still need to infer how to solve each new task from the retrieved records. Skills provide reusable procedures, yet may omit the task-specific facts needed to apply them. Because retrieved memory and skills shape the agent's behavior, they also influence the experience available for future learning. We introduce MemCryst, a framework for lifelong context adaptation through bidirectional learning of memory and skills with a frozen language model. Recurring episodes stored in memory support skill creation and revision, and the interactions guided by those skills supply new memory for subsequent learning. Facts retrieved from memory and learned skills jointly form the agent's context, while task outcomes adjust the future retrieval influence of the records actually served without rewriting their content. Across ten settings spanning embodied control, long-document reading, conversation, mathematics, and code, MemCryst leads seven reported comparisons.
entries.title_zh: MemCryst：记忆与技能双向进化的终身上下文适配
entries.summary_zh: MemCryst 让冻结语言模型在交互历史中共同更新外部记忆和可复用技能：重复经验推动技能生成/修订，技能指导的新交互再补充记忆；任务结果会调整未来检索权重，但不改写存储事实。论文在具身控制、长文理解、对话、数学和代码等十种设置中，报告七项比较领先，强调在有限上下文窗口下积累可迁移经验。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合构建长期运行且上下文有限的工具代理。
entries.pragmatic_review: 记忆回答“发生过什么”，技能表达“如何做”，二者互相影响。
entries.cynic_review: 明确分离事实存储、技能程序与检索权重。
entries.paper_review: 摘要未给提升数值，记忆错误和技能漂移仍须治理。

entries.source_title: Continual Test-Time Learning with Evolution Strategies
entries.source_excerpt: Large language models increasingly operate in open-ended environments, where they are expected to continually adapt to evolving tasks and distributions, often without access to external supervision. Existing continual learning approaches rely on external supervision, such as labeled data, demonstrations, or reward signals, which can be costly or unavailable in practice. Test-time adaptation removes this dependence by learning from self-generated supervision, but existing methods derive that supervision from the single policy being updated, so once the policy drifts, its own learning signal drifts with it, leading to policy collapse, degraded reasoning, and catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning (ESRL)}, a continual test-time learning framework that draws its self-generated supervision from a population of policies instead of the single policy being trained. ESRL perturbs an anchor policy in parameter space to form a population of nearby policies, samples one trajectory from each, and aggregates their answers into label-free group-relative learning signals for the central st
entries.title_zh: Evolution Strategy RL：用进化策略做持续测试时学习
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出 ESRL，在无外部监督的持续测试时适应中，不再只用当前单一策略产生自监督信号，而是扰动锚点策略形成一组邻近策略，各自产生轨迹，再汇总为无标签组相对学习信号。该设计意在降低策略自身漂移导致监督信号同步漂移、最终崩溃或遗忘的风险；当前摘录未给具体基准增益。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究部署后持续适应且缺少标注/奖励的 agent 系统。
entries.pragmatic_review: 用策略群体而非单模型自评来减轻自我强化偏差。
entries.cynic_review: 群体采样会增加推理成本，实际稳定性收益需看完整实验。
entries.paper_review: 动机与方法明确，量化结果未在摘录出现。

entries.source_title: Complete regular dessins: the nonmetacyclic case
entries.source_excerpt: We classify regular dessins on $K_{2^e,2^f}$ with nonmetacyclic colour-preserving automorphism group, retaining the two specified vertex rotations. We give nonredundant presentations and exact counts in both the abelian and nonabelian Frattini cases. For orientation- and colour-preserving isomorphisms, the number is $2^{2e-2}+16$ when $e=f\ge4$ and $3\cdot2^{2f-3}+16$ when $e>f\ge4$, with explicit counts for all smaller exponents. The construction uses a parity criterion in the abelian case and a uniquely determined odd quadratic root with two lifts in the nonabelian case. A dessin in the classification is reflexible exactly when its Frattini subgroup is abelian. All symmetric classes are circular. We determine every circular subfamily, including its face orders and genera; the circular count is $2^e+8$ on the diagonal and $2^{f-2}(2^{f-1}+1)+8$ off the diagonal for $e\ge f\ge4$.
entries.title_zh: 完全正则 dessins 的非亚循环情形
entries.summary_zh: 论文分类嵌入完全二部图 K_{2^e,2^f} 的正则 dessins，限制为保持颜色的自同构群非亚循环，并保留指定的两个顶点旋转；分别在 Frattini 子群为阿贝尔和非阿贝尔时给出无冗余表示与精确计数。对于 e=f≥4，取向与颜色保持的同构类数为 2^(2e−2)+16；e>f≥4 时为 3·2^(2f−3)+16，较小指数另有显式计数；作者还刻画可反射性与 Frattini 子群阿贝尔性的等价关系，并分类对称类中的圆形子族及其面阶、亏格。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数组合与曲面拓扑读者，提供特定二幂阶完全二部图嵌入的群论分类和计数。
entries.pragmatic_review: 精确计数有助于构造和比较相关图嵌入族。
entries.cynic_review: 结论范围受图型、指数下界和自同构群条件严格限制。
entries.paper_review: 摘要说明分类分支及计数公式，术语和旋转约定需读论文确认。

entries.source_title: Solving Go under Positional Superko: Sound Proof Transfer and New Board Values
entries.source_excerpt: Positional superko (PSK) forbids recreating any earlier whole-board position. It is part of the Chinese rules as written and of the rules used in computer Go. Yet almost all solved Go boards were computed under a simpler basic-ko rule set. PSK makes solving hard: legality depends on the whole game history, and this breaks the three tools that make solving tractable, namely transposition tables (the graph-history interaction problem), static life-and-death recognition, and safe move pruning. We present Sanko, a parallel depth-first proof-number solver that restores all three soundly. Its core is a cheap proof-transfer theorem: a stored proof stays valid on a new path unless a board that the proof's winner must create has already occurred. Sanko proves 5x5 Go in 16 minutes with six threads, where the previous state of the art needed 5.25 hours with six processes, and in about a minute and a half on one 192-thread machine. It also establishes the first PSK values of twenty-three further boards, eleven of which were unsolved under any rules. entries.title_zh: 在位置超级劫持规则下求解围棋
entries.summary_zh: 位置超级劫持（PSK）禁止棋盘整体局面重复，使合法性依赖完整棋史，令常用的置换表、静态死活识别和安全剪枝难以直接使用。论文提出并行深度优先证明数搜索器 Sanko，以廉价的证明转移定理恢复这些工具的可靠使用，并据此重新求解棋盘、报告新的棋盘价值；证明转移具体条件需以论文全文为准。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 针对真实 PSK 规则下历史依赖造成的搜索难题，提出保持可靠性的求解框架。
entries.pragmatic_review: 对规则严谨的围棋求解器和博弈搜索实现有参考价值。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要未列棋盘实例数量和性能对比，不能由方法描述推断全面领先。
entries.paper_review: 证明转移机制直接针对 PSK 破坏传统搜索工具的核心障碍。

entries.source_title: A secondary term in the first moment of cubic $L$-functions over function fields
entries.source_excerpt: Let $q$ be a fixed odd prime power with $q\equiv2\pmod3$. We study the first moment of primitive cubic Dirichlet $L$-functions over $\Fq(T)$, ordered by their genus. By averaging the rational sieve variable in the double Dirichlet series of Hong and Fang, we obtain meromorphic continuation beyond the secondary polar divisor. Combining this continuation with the cubic Gauss-sum residues computed by David, Florea and Lal\'in gives an explicit term of order $q^{5g/6}$, with a real coefficient depending on $g$ modulo $6$, and an error $O_{q,\eps}(q^{(23/28+\eps)g})$. The periodic coefficient is not identically zero. The proof uses an exact first difference supplied by the functional equation, an Euler product for the sieve average, and Bochner's tube theorem in the Dirichlet variables.
entries.title_zh: 函数域上三次 L 函数一阶矩的次主项

entries.source_title: Uniform spatial Schauder estimates for backward stochastic partial differential equations with random coefficients
entries.source_excerpt: We prove spatial Schauder estimates for super-parabolic backward stochastic partial differential equations. All coefficients can be random and depend on time and space, and the estimates are uniform in probability and time. The key ingredient is a weighted conditional energy norm adapted to the parabolic scale of each frequency block. Together with heat-kernel bounds and coefficient freezing, it controls the gradient-martingale coupling without assuming a bounded martingale integrand. As an application, we establish Schauder solvability for semilinear stochastic Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equations.

entries.source_title: SCAFFOLD: Toward Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport for Reusable LLM-Agent Skills
entries.source_excerpt: An agent skill that succeeded yesterday may be executable today without being justified for reuse today. Tests may cover only observable contract clauses, outcome oracles may be absent, evaluations may inherit the same erroneous specification, and permissions or dependencies may change between validation and invocation. We argue that the appropriate unit of prospective trust is a Warranted Reuse Claim (WRC): a defeasible, claim-specific authorization tied to a versioned skill, target context, evidence, assumptions, and identified defeaters. The paper sharpens this position through Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport (WPET), a proposed discipline for deciding which historical evidence remains admissible after context change. It distinguishes evidence admissibility from truth of the supported safety or effectiveness claim; states a conditional preservation result and its limits; specifies three-valued applicability and asymmetric context-transfer judgments; and illustrates how provenance dependence and policy-invalidating changes alter authorization. entries.source_title: CohortFlow: A Steerable Clinical Cohort Curation Agent with Localized Semantic Correction
entries.source_excerpt: Language model agents for clinical cohort curation should accommodate evolving eligibility criteria without repeatedly processing unchanged requirements. We introduce CohortFlow, a steerable agent that represents natural language corrections as localized updates to a structured cohort specification and reconciles them with a persistent execution graph. Explicitly recorded semantic dependencies enable affected computations to be selectively invalidated while preserving valid prior results. On 100 scenarios derived from clinical-trial eligibility criteria, comprising 126 correction turns, localized steering achieves 77.0% requirement micro-F1 versus 76.4% for full regeneration using the same 8B model, a small numerical advantage that is not statistically significant ($p=0.493$). It reduces mean correction latency by 64.8% after completion and 44.3% during execution, with 38.1% fewer model calls. In a separate proof-of-concept evaluation over MIMIC, all 13 cohort states execute successfully, while correction trajectories demonstrate selective preservation of unaffected computations and recomputation of changed or dependent nodes. entries.source_title: There can be equitable social welfare orders but no fair voting system
entries.source_excerpt: In the context of intergenerational equity it is natural to ask that social welfare orders have th properties of finite anonymity and strong Pareto efficiency. Such social welfare orders can be constructed from nonprincipal ultrafilters over the set of natural numbers, and the existence of ultrafilters of this kind is known to be equivalent to the existence of a fair voting system for a countably infinite population in the sense of Arrow's theorem. Unfortunately, the existence of this variety of social welfare order, which we call anonymous Pareto, implies the existence of nonmeasurable sets of real numbers. For some, such as Litak, this entails that such social welfare orders are inadmissible for use in theoretical economics because they are non-constructive in nature. The authors seek to give nuance to this view, proving that anonymous Pareto and other social welfare orders can exist in the absence of nonprincipal ultrafilters over the set of natural numbers.

entries.source_title: Scoped Semantic Invariance as a Foundation for LLM Reliability
entries.source_excerpt: LLMs often answer semantically equivalent queries inconsistently, even when the underlying facts are known. We formalize consistency as semantic invariance over equivalence classes of queries and show that invariance under arbitrary meaning-preserving transformations is undecidable in general. This motivates scoped semantic invariance, where model behavior is evaluated relative to bounded semantic domains. We operationalize this framework using knowledge graphs (KGs), which act as explicit semantic control structures defining local semantic constraints and grounding contexts. Across the MITRE D3FEND ontology and eight Wikidata- derived domains, we show that inconsistencies are structured rather than random, concentrating in localized hotspot subgraphs organized around recurring TREE, STAR, and CYCLE patterns that remain stable across models and domains. We further show that selective graph grounding improves correctness and cross-model consistency, while indiscriminate grounding introduces regressions. entries.source_title: Regularized Score Centering
entries.source_excerpt: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, including online shopping, tool use, games, and fully asynchronous software engineering. entries.source_title: Characteristic Chow Polynomials of Layered-Permutation Intervals
entries.source_excerpt: We study characteristic Chow polynomials of principal intervals in generalized subword order, equivalently of pattern-containment intervals below layered permutations. A terminal-chain recurrence and canonical rightmost embeddings yield a recursive rational generating function for every fixed number of layers, governed by a universal denominator. In the two-layer case we obtain an explicit kernel, prove canonical interlacing when one layer has size at most four, and prove eventual interlacing at every fixed width by a Laguerre limit. We also treat two families with unboundedly many layers. Singleton-prefix intervals have a closed Delannoy-Jacobi gamma polynomial and form real-rooted interlacing sequences. Singleton-sandwich intervals admit rational three-variable series and a marked-slot formula for all gamma coefficients. Their central-layer-two and central-layer-three slices are real-rooted, with interlacing under growth from two to three. entries.source_title: Two-Sided large oscillations of the argument of the Riemann zeta function and its iterates
entries.source_excerpt: Assuming the Riemann hypothesis, we establish lower bounds for large oscillations of the iterated argument functions \(S_n(t)\) of the Riemann zeta function. As a corollary, we prove that, for every fixed integer \(n \geq 0\), \[S_n(t)=\Omega_{\pm}\Big(\frac{(\log t)^{1/2}(\log_3 t)^{1/2}}{(\log_2 t)^{n+1/2}} \Big).\] For even \(n\), this recovers two results of Chirre and Mahatab in 2021. For odd \(n\), our result strengthens theirs by establishing the missing direction of oscillation with the same order of magnitude.
